tei:div.tei:p: 4/ / / / nges don bstan pa'i snying po mgon po 'byu gung ga chen po'i gdan rabs chos kyi byung tshul gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'bri gung bstan 'dzin pad ma'i rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa/

sa ji —— rtsa rna sa 'bri gung gi gdan rabs tshos 'byung gser gyi steng ba zhes bya ba 'di sa 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po nas rtsis pa'i gdan rabs nyer dgu pa dang /skyob pa rin po che gong du phud de mkhan chen gur ba nas brtsi srol yongs graṭa ltar gyi gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med 'phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal mchog gis ljaṭa rtsom gnang ba yin/ khong ni kong yul gyi sa'i char 'khod pa'i mnga' bdag myang gi sku rgyud du grags pa'i sngags 'chang zhig gi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags stag lo ste spyi lo 1770lor sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun du phebs skabs 'bri gung gi gdan rabs nyer bdun pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma mchog nas thugs dam brtag dbya da gnang don/ gdan rabs nyer drug pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma 'phrin las phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba bzang po'i sde mchog gi yang sred du ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ spyi lo 1776bod me spre lor 'bri gung nas sgar mkhan zur rgyal sras pas gtso bo gnang ba'i sku 'khor ser skya mang po mchog sgrul gdan zhur kong yul du ched rdzongs mdzad pa bzhin/ lo de'i dbo zla ba'i gral tshes dge ba'i nyin gdan sar phebs nas yab mas zhal ༷/bye//sa/ / kyi ༷// ༷bye/ri // / //sdoX spya / bye / ṭī kyi bye rdo

gsar rnying gi chos bka' mang du gsan bzhes gnang / dgung lo bco lnga'i steng dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes/ mtshan bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs cir 'chag nas phyogs mam bad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bstsal/ lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan las kyang dbang chos du ma gas / dgung lo bcu dgur son pa sa sa lo snye spyi lo1788lor gdan sa 'byu gung gi chos srid kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur khri 'don bskyangs/ dgung lo nyer gsum du phebs thabs rje chos kyi nyi mas mkhan po dang / lho rin po ches las slob mdzad nas dge 'dun kha skong grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs banas/ lo de rang la rje gong ma dgongs pa rdzogs shing / 'bri gung gi chos srid yongs kyi thugs 'gan phrag thog tu bzhes ste rje bla ma'i dgongs rngogs rten bzhengs kyis gtsos pa'i 'bri bstan mi nyams gong spel la phyag rjes mi dman pa 'jog gnang mdzad par snang zhing / de min rnam thar ma mjal bas zhib par ngo sgod zhu ma thub pa bzod par gsol lo/ 〈〈'byu gung gi gdan rabs gser phreng 〉'di sa khong gis gdan rabs bco lnga pa kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dbang rin po che yan gyi lo rgyus dang / gdan rabs nyer gnyis pa dkon mchog rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈rin chen byung ba 〉〉 gdan rabs nyer gsum pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈〈padma'i phreng ba 〉 gdan rabs byer lnga pa donagrub rngos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i 〈〈gdan rabs shel dkar phreng ba 〉〉sogs gzhir mdzad pa dang / dpa' bo'i chos 'byung dang / rje gong ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar/ deb gaster gsar rnying sogs go bsdur zhing /lo dus mthun min rigs 'gos lo tsā ba'i deb sngon sogs dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang por dag ther bcas mdzad nas rab byung ba /

gsum pa'i lcags hwa/ lo 1800lor cung zad rgya bar phyog mi // / zlo / / ta/na pyo pa ba shā /rdo/ / dzasna ///rad pa shārnyi // // nos brgyud grub mtha' dang / bla rabs/ /dus —mtshams so sor dgon gnas dar rgud ji byung sogs mdor na 'byu gung pa'i lo zla sa la zhib 'jug bya rgyur cha mtshon na med thabs med pa'i yig rigs gal che gzhanalas lhag pa zhig yin par sngar nas skad grags yod/ 'on kyang de'i rjes 'bri gung gi bla brang dang dgon sde rim bzhin nyag por gyur pa sogs la brten gdan rabs gser phreng 'di'ang de snga shing par du 'khod ma thub pa ma zad/ ma dpe bris ma yang ha cang dkon pa bcas la brten/'bri gung pa ni bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad kyi khrod nas dar rgyas che shos kyi grub mtha' zhig yin la/ — da phan mi lo ba da brgya lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus yod pa dang / bod du chos srid gang thad nas skad grags chen /rdzu bye zlordo spya ya/ / sasko rdo ngab/cu /shā gyu rjo /rdo/ ra kya / //la ra rdo bcas kyi gong ma mang pos 'bri gub par 'ja' sa lung las dang / tham ga sogs kyis gzengs bstod gnang myong yod pa bcas bod kyi lo rgyus hril po'i nang gal che ba'i cha shas kyi gras shig yin/ der brten lo rgyus kyi dpe rnying myur skyob dang bod rig pa zhib 'jug gnang mkhan la dpyad gzhi mkho 'don bcas kyi ched du dmigs da lam lcags par thog dpe //nge rdogyi snanapa brdo/ sam/'i snying po 'bri gung pa chen po'i gdan rabs chos kyi byung tshul gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhuṭa so 〉〉zhes pa'i ma dpedabu med bris ma zhig 'bri gung sgo rtsog bla brang gi phyag dpe 'phros bsdad 3

khongs na ga ra bo bstsal thob byung zhing / ma dpe de bzhin cha tshabalayig gzugs kyang cung legs pa bcas brjod don thad 'khrul dogasache rigs med 'dra yang / rjod byed thad yi ge 'a dri mkhan gyi mo / tshad dbang gas ming tshig dang byed 'brel sogs za da sbyo ra nor 'phrul shor ba ma nyung tsam zhig 'dug da la ma dpe sgrig bya thabs ni skung yig rnams 'khrul med so sor phral thog yig nor dag bcos zhu phyogs thapa ma dpe'i yig nor rang sor bzhag pa de yang yig nor tsheg khyim gnyis yan chad kyi rigs la 'og tu nar rtags shig bkod yod pa dang / yig nor tsheg khyim gcig rang ga gras la nar rtags bkod med/ dag bcos byas pa'i yi ge rnams rtags 〈 〉'di'i nang bkod yod/ ma dper tshig 'bru chad pa 'di nas kha gsab byas pa dag rtags ( )'di'i nang bcug yod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i yon tshad zhan pa sa dpe sgrig byed phyogs thad ma 'dang ba yong rgyur rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis skyon brjod dang slob ston lhug por yong ba'i re ba zhu/chab spel tshe brtan kun tshogs kyis/ 1989 lo'i zla 2 ra/zu

dkar chagabaka' babs bzhi'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam ra mdor bsdus/ ( 6 )te lo pa'i rnam thar/ (21)na ro pa'i rnam thar/ (25)mar pa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar/ (32)rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ — — (38)dwags po lha rje'i rnam thar/ — (60)phag gru rdo rje rgyal po'i rnam thar/ (58)'bri gung skyob pa rin chen dpal gyi rnam ra/ (62)gdan rabs dang po mkhan chen gu ra ba'i skor/ — — (105)gdan sa gnyis pa dbon ston bsod nams grags pa'i skor/ — ཿ(1/ 5)gdan sa gsum pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar/ — (108)ba sa/ pa/ gcung rdo rje grags ba'i rnam ra/ — (110)lnga pa/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge'i rnam thar/ (112)drug pa/ mtshams bcad pa graṭa pa bsod nams kyi rnam thar/ (118)bcan pa/ jo snubs rdo rje ye shes kyi skor/ ('di'i skabs 'bri gung gling log byung /) (110) 5

brgyad pa/ rdo rje rin chen kyi rnam thar/ (124)dgu pa/ rdo rje rgyal 'o 'i rnam thar/ (128)bcu pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar/ — (131)bcu gcig pa/ don grub rgyal po'i rnam thar/ (139)bcu gnyis rdo/ma//ga/ po wa nga nga ma ri na che na da ba nga rgya la gyi (144)bcu gsum pa/ rin chen dpal bzang gi rnam thar/ — (147)bcu bzhi pa/ rin chen lhas rgyan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar/ (154)gsang rgyud dbang rin chen chos rgyal gyi rnam thar/ 6 (167)bco lnga tha/ kun dga' rinachenadabal bzang po'i rnamathar/('di skabs sna 'bri dbar 'khrug chen byung /) (162)sa drug pa/tha/// // spyan ཿpa // / yu la /ba'i // — ga lung 'kho gnang /) (186 )ba / ba//la //za/ / // // //do/rdo zi //shā / // ma //na 'ja' sa shel dam sogs gnang /) — ( 203〉bco pa da pa/ bsod nams dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i rna ma thar/ (214)ba dgu pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar/ ga (217)nyi shu pa/ chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis kyi rnam thar/ (219)nyer gcig pa/ —bapo shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal ma na gyi rnam thar/ (231)gre gnyis pha/ dkon mchog rin chen gyi rnam thar/ — (240)6

) ra gsum pa/ rig 'dzin tshos grags sam dgom mchog phun tshogs kyi rnam thar/ ('di'i skabs dga' ldan pho brang gi srid gzhung tshugs shing 'bri gung bla mas mnan gtad byas skor gyod gzhi byung 'dug) (267)nyer bzhi pa/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po'i rnam thar — (289)ster lnga pa/ dkon mchog 'phrin las don grub kyi rnam thar/ ('di'i skabs jun gar gyi dmag dpung bod du 'byor/) (304)nyer drug pa/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi rnam thar (322)ster bdun pa/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar (331)nyer brgyad pa/ gdan rabs 'di nyid rtsom pa po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi skor mdo tsam/mjug byang smon tshig — (346) (gdan rabs gser steng gi mjug tu shog nye kher rkyang gcig sbyar ba'i mdun ngos su/ gdan rabs sum cu pa dang / so gcig pa/ so gnyis pa/ so gsum pa bcas kyi mtshan dang / skabs de'i 'bri gung gi sprul sku che chung gnyis kyi mtshan tsam bkod 'dug pa'ang ji lta ba bzhin gsham du bkod yod/)

rig / /rdo // /sgo / /ba /zhi /ji4 // 1ba rgyal kun ma na ba sa ga ga bsdus thuṭa/ //sgo mag /tsho /sto /ri // //ga cha ga zab gsang rgya ma na pa gsung // 2na bslab gsum bdaganyid daphaṭa pa mchog gi sku/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla mar phyag bgyi'o//ye shes phul byung mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /mtshams sprin mdangs 'phrog rnam ba/sum rgyan gyis mdzes/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong phan bde'i lam bzang ster/ /thub dbang za ba'i seng ger phyag bgyi'o/ /'gyur bral mchog gi rang bzhin bde ba che/ /rnam kun shes rab btsun mos leṭa 'khyud byung / /zung 'jug ro la rtag rol gar gyis btsen 〈rtsen〉/ /yan lag bdun lda na de la rtag 'dud do/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rol pa yi 〈yis〉/ /srid dang zhi ba'i 'ching ba kun bcom nas/ /dpe yi 〈yis 〉mi ma tsho// phyag rgya chen po'i don/ /ston mdzad rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab ba ra nga / /bgrangs yas rig lam rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /khyor chu'i tshul du thugs kyi bum bzang 'khyil/ /thabs shes bde chen a 3 'bar 'dzag gis/ /dga' bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon gyur dra ro pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying brgyud sde bzhi'i/ /man ngag bcud kyi 〈kyis 〉sto ṭa'i lam yangs 'dir/ /kun gling chos kyi sgron me gsal mdzad pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug mar ston rje/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis snang sgyu ma yi/ /kun rtog 'od gsal me lces rab bsregs te/ /gdod nas lhan skyes (3na)gnyug ma'i rang zhalache/ /de nyid gzigs pa bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs/ /di tha na ra'i byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /

bka' yi gdams pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen cher/ /gang babs khyod thugs gser gyi dpal bo'ur/ /legs par sim pa mnyam med 'dzam gling grags/ /mdo sngasas rgya mtsho'i tshig don hub kyi 〈kyis /〉bzhes/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag sgo sa gsum na/ /dbyar gyi rnga chen rab brdungs ris med 'gro/ /dam pa'i lam ston dpal ldan phag gru pa/ /kun gyi byin rlabs phung po yongs gang ba/ /thub dbang nyid dang de'i sprul /rdo ma //na po/sa /sbya // la sog/snang rnyi spyaX /rdo/ ga/shā sam lda /ci/ :rdo 1dro/ga/ shārnyi /spra/ rdo/sna pa/ zirdo //jug da/pa // /rdzu bla/ ma/ /sdu / ste /pa/ pa 'dud/ /rigs san mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang gis/ /gdug pa 'jigs byed dus ma na 'dul ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i /rdo /bye /ra zlos / pa /ra/ / rdo // sa /// gnyis/ /rdo sbyang /zlo/)/bdag po'i byu lago bcom mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan ma hā na la phyag bzhi pas/ /bstan dang de 'dzin 3cas tshogs yeng med skyongs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyi ma bdun sogs/ /rnam mang sgyu 'phrul rol cing // sa // sdu/ g.yel med/bye byab / //da mo/ dbying / spya pa / / shā / / /sto// bye /spras/ pa/shā / dīrdo ces /shārdo rdo/ mo rdo rtag/sri / kodangapa zhi/ ba'i/ // / / pa pa gtsang sras po yis/ /yang yang snyan par bsngags pa'i mgon de'i/ /yang yang bstan pa'i nyin byed gsal mdzad pa/ /mang mar bka' babs rngo

snas kyi byung tshuladang / /mang mang skyes bu gser phreng byung tshul zhig /gdul bya'i skye tshal yangs por zang char gyis/ /zeg 〈zabs 〉ma thor bas dad pa'i rtsi shing tshogs/ /rgyas ste bla med 'bras bu yongs smin nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal yon phyug gyur cig /ces shis par brjod pa'i tshig gi 〈gis〉mdun bsus te/ de yang shākya'i dbang pos 〈bo'i 〉ba na pa 'di la bstan pa'i snying por gyur pa/ 'bri gung bka' ba da kyi lo rgyus chos kyi byung tshul cung zad brjod na/ /de yang mnyam med mgon bo 'bri gung pa chen po 'di nyid ni/ mdo rgyud mang po nas tsang du ba na cing / de yang bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉li tsa ri ( na)dri ma med par grags pa zhes sprul pa'i nyan thos chen po rnams zil gyis gnon cing / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas kyang cung zad zhum pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa de snyad ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa byebye/ / lho/ bye / da // / / / / 3

cig ces lung bstan par mdzad de/ 'de'i lo rgyus rgyas pa mig tshogs ches pas ma bris shing / ngo mtshar ba'i gtam sum cu so bdun sogs rmad byung gi mdzad (4ba)pa blo'i yul las 'das pa/ 'di nyid kyi seng ge'i khrir rim par byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang / brgyud par bzhugs pa'i sngon byon bka' brgyud gser phreng du grags pa ste/ de yang mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud du grags pa 'di/ blta 〈lta 〉ba rnam par dag pa dbu ma'i brgyud pa/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa pha rolatu phyin pa'i brgyud pa/ bsgom 〈sgom 〉pa rnam par dag pa gsang sngags kyi brgyud pa ste blta 〈lta 〉spyod bsgom 〈sgom 〉gsum dang / gsang sngaṭa la bka' babs kyi chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus pa'i bla brgyud gong ma bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / gtso bor gyur pa rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar mdor tsam brjod na/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di sa/ ngo bo gcig la chu za ltar sprul pa dpag tu med pa ste gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gtso 'khor gzhal yas khang la sogs pa thams cad kyang nyid kyis 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa yin la/ de la tshigs su bcad pa la/ ji skad du/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid lang tsho'i dpal yon du mas mdzes pa'i ma ma dang / /'gyur med bde ba'i dpal 'byor stobs kyis sgeg pa'i yab rje bcom ldan riṭa kyi bdag /gnyis med rol pa'i dpal las legs 'khrungs mgon po rdo rje 'chang dbang de nyid ni/ /rang rigs (sman)mdzes pa'i dpal dang kha sbyor bde la rtag rol rang bzhin med dang snying rje yis/ /sgra dbyangs 'gag pa med par sa gsum kun tu khyab par sgogs mkhas pa/ /skal ldan rnams la gzhom med sgra des thar pa'i lam ston mchog gi dpal ster 4

ba/ /snang grags 'di rnams gdod ma'i mgon po garadabang rgyal pode'i rnam 'phrul mchog /thugs bskyed tshul dang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar 'byon mkhas mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul sa/ /bcu gnyis ston sogs thub dbang rgyal po de yang rgyal ba 'di las gzhan min cing /sems can ma lus sgol ba'i slad du brgyad khri bzhi stong dri med chos kyi ni/ /'khor los dman dang rgya che'i don la mos rnams 'dul bar mdzad pa gang yin dang / /'og min zhing du mngon byang lnga las mngon par sangs rgyas dag pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /'dul mdzad rgyud sde'i chos rnams dbang po rno zhing zab mo'i don la mos rnams la/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis gsungs par mdzad pa'ang nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul mdzad pa'o/ /'khor 'das ma lus rnam par snang bar mdzad cing dgos 'dod rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dri med 'od zer dpag med dang ldan mgon po don rnams ma lus grub pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje sems sogs rnam mang rigs kyi 'khor lo ma lus rgyal ba 'di yi gar//de nyid phyir na rgyal ba 'di yang riṭa rnams (5ba)kun gyi bdag po zhes//rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi spyi bor rol pa'i snang brnyan dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /baiḍūrya dri ma med pa'i mdog ltar sngo sangs mtshan dpe'i dpal yon du mas pas/ /zla ba'i zhal can rdo rje dril bu'i 〈bus 〉mdzes pa'i phyag gnyis thugs kur bsnol thabs mdzad/ /srid zhi'i dpal la rol yang srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas skyil krung rdzogs par bzhugs/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan 'chang ral pa'i cod pan bcings pa'i zar bu grol ba yis/ /rtse mo'i bsil yab g.yo ba'i ngad kyi 〈kyis 〉'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung sel mkhas shing / /yan lag rgya mtsho'i gsung gi chu 'dzin mthug po las ni nges don bdud zhi'i char/ nges pa lnga dang

ldan nga/ra matso ngas med des ni srid mtha'i bar du 'bebs par mdzad//sku — gu ra dzod sa mcho ga nongs pa mi mnga' 'dod pa'i mchog rnams skad cib/ nyid khag ster bar byed/ /dpal ldan khyod kyi rnam thar chos nyid 'byor pa 'i dpal gyis gang ba'i mtsho 'gram du/ /dri med longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i ljon shing phreng ba'i gar stabs lang tsho can/ /mtshan dpe'i shel gyi tsu gas phran gzhon nus 'khril shing 〈zhing 〉yon tan me tog rgyas pa'i tshal/ /rgyal sras bung ba'i tshogs rnams 'phur lding byed byung myur ba'i zlos gar ci yang rtse/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi'i longs spyod ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bdag po khyab bdag rje/ /'gro ba kun gyi (༄ na )snying la gnas pa de'i bzhin ras kun gyis mthong bya'i phyir//rnam thar dri med nor bu'i phreng ba 'di long 〈longs 〉'dis sa yid kyi rto ga ba sel/ /mthong bya'i mgon po de yang geṭa med par ni khyod la bstan zin de nyid phyir/ /yengs pa med par lhan cig 'di dang rol cing 〈zhing 〉dpyid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /kun da'i 'od dang gangs ri'e phreng ba spel leṭa rtse mor nyi ma'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i dge ba des/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i dbang phyug nyid gyur byu 'bras mig gi snang bas 'gro ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob yan lag bdun la rol cing 〈zhing 〉rtse ba nyid gyur cig /ces pa ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam thar zur tsam bkod pa'o/khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang 'dis rje btsun te lo pa la dngos su rgyu da sde'i ma na ngag rnams gsungs te rjes su bzung ba yin kyang /'dir blo rngo sa dman pa ga mas rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ mi'i bla ma yod par bstar/ pa ni/ klu sgrub tsarya la ba pa/ /bskal ba bzang mo nga yi sa/bka' babs bzhe yi bla ma yi na/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po da/ do 6

rje 'chang gis/ ind+ra bo di/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ des ci su sa pa/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ma nt+ra ki las pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ de'i rdzogs rim rim lnga dmar khrid/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud man ngag ding bcas pa/ grong 'jug rnams te bka' (5ba )babs dang po'o/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ tsarya pa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rdzogs rim sgyu ma gsum rgyud sogs sgyu lus kyi skor rnams gsan te bka' babs gnyis pa'o/ do rje 'chang / phyag na do rje/ sna bi pa/mi na sa badzra/la ba pa la rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dgongs pa'i don/'od gsalagatso bor gyur pa'i rdzogs rim bsre ba'i skor rnams gsan te bka' babs gsum pa'o/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon yan lag me 〈med 〉pa'i rdo rje/ padma badzra/ mkha' 'gro ma bskal ba bzang mo/ de las dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams dang / de la brtan 〈brten 〉pa'i gtum mo gtso gyur gyi gdams pa chos drug soṭa gsan pa sna bka' babs bzhi pa'i rgyud rims so/ de rnams kyi lo rgyus zur tsam bshad par bya ste/ dang po ni/ chos rgyal ind+ra bo di ni/ sku rgyan yul gyi grong khyer nyams dga' zhing / bde ba'i 'byor pa kun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i pho brang chen po nyams dga' ba der/'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la rtse dga' zhing kun tu spyod pa las/ tho brang gi yangs thog tu skyo sangs la byon pa'i tshe sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang ba ltar nam mkha' la byon pa gzigs nas/ de'i lo rgyus dris pas/ blon po'i mchog gi 〈gis 〉lan zhib tu bsnya da pa las dad par gyur te spyan drangs nas bsnyen bskur byas (4na )te chos nyan pa'i phyir phyag byas nas zhabs la btud pa'i tshe/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod yon thong ba'i chos gsungs pas/ rgyal /

pos gsolapa/ lum bi'i tshal da nyams dga'i gnas/ /wa sa seng ger gyar kyang sla'i/ /'dod yon spangs pa'i thar pa ni/ /go'u ta ma nam yang mi 'tshal lo/ /zhes zhus pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rgyal po de rdo rje theg pas 'dul bar gzigs nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rigs mare tshogs dang lhan cig spyod par sprul te/ dbang bskur bas/ dbang dus su grogs rnams dang lhan cig grub pa brnyes te/ de nas rang gi rtogs pa brjod nas mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa lus ma spangs par mchog gi gnas su ga gas te/ yul de lan gcig stong 〈stongs 〉pa'e shul du mtsho chen po klu'i dbang po du mas gang ba gcig tu gyur to/ zhes byung zhing / de nas klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma ma/ phyag na rdo rjes klu de rnams la chos bstan nas/ rim gyis mir gyur nas mtsho 'gram du grong khyer chen por gyur te/ de rnams kyis rdo rje theg pa'i chos nyams su blangs pas de rnams dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa klu las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo yin zhing / dus re zhig gi tshe mtsho de yang skam pa'i shul du rang byung ba'i lha khang gcig byung ba (7ba )der dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa la/ phyag na rdo rjes dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde rnams kyi bka' gtad de sprul pa bsdus so/ de'i ma rgya gar lho phyogs o de sha'i rgyal po ste su ku pa zhes bya ba de rgyal srid spangs te/ rab tu byung nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇḍi tar gyur pa las/ thugs dgongs las/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa 'di las dang po ba rnams nyon mong sa pa spong ba'i lam du byed pa la/ 'od srungs kyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar grong khyer rnams kyi mi gtsang lud//de ma bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems

/ri/sto /mo /ri/sto /skye / )pa na ngas lud/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba sa rnams ba da la phan/zhes nyon mongs pa mi spong khya/nga lam du khyer ba mchos/ gi theg pa yod par rig nas/ de lta bu'i mchog gi zeg pa de dang mjal ba'i smon lam btab pa las/ mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan nas/ u rgyan gyi gnas te ru na rang byung gi lha khang du byon te phyag dang bskor 〈skor 〉ba byas shing / maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ klu las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mos dbang bskur byung / gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag gnang nas des kyang nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/ sa ra ha chen po'i lo rgyus ni/ yul ra snya na zhes bya bar/ bram ze rigs byed dang nye ba'i regs byed thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa'i (8na)mched bzhi yod pa las / rje btsun dam pa'adi sa riṭa sad pa'i dpa' bo chen po yin pas/ bstan pa la mngon paradad de/ mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung nas/mtshan yang mkhan po nyidadang mthun par gsol te sde snod thams cad lamakhas pa 'i pha rol tu son nas/ 'o na ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang gi mkhan po'i khur mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas bskul nas/ slob dpon chu su na pa'i zhabs la gtugs te gsol ba btab pas/ des kyang dbang bskur zhing 〈cing 〉gdams pa gnang ba la nges pa cung zad rnyed nas mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bor te/ bran mo mtshan dang ldan pa gcig phyag rgyar khrid nas/ nags su lhan gcig sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ chung ma la la phug 'tshad du bcug ste/ chung mas 'dren du phyin pas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gnas so/ de la bzhengs pa dang / bran mos zas drangs pas/ la phug gi tshod ma ga re

zhes gsungs ba / bran mos dab tu ba da pa la / da sgo gnas da na par sgrub pa la 'gro gsungs pas/ de'i tshe bran mo na re/ /lus ni dben kyang sems kyi 'khri ba ma chod na/ /dben par mi 'gyur lo ni bcu gnyis ting 'dzin bzhugs gyur kyang / /la phug tshod ma'i 'khri ba ma chod de 'dra'i ting 'dzin e ma mtshar/ /(8ba)zhes zhus pas/ mo bden snyam nas mda' mkhan mo gcig phyag rgya gnyis par khrid nas/spyod pa'i don du gshegasate mda' legs par bzangs nas gar 'phangs 'gro ba la dab byas nas/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs te/ mgur gsungs sa/ kha sang phan chad dge thong min/ /de ring phyin chad dge slong yin/ /don gyi dge slong da slong che/ /bye ru ku dpal dge slong mchog /ces gsungs pas/ skye bo rnams kyis 'phyas shing bzhad gad kyi gnas su byas pa las/ rdzu 'phrul gyis ma dad pa'i tshogs rnams zlog par sa te/ sgo ha skor gsum la sogs pa rtogs pa brjod pa'i mgur gsungs te/ dpal gyi ri la bzhugs nas dag pa'i gdul bya rnams btul te/ mkha' spyod chen por gshegs so/ de'i slobam mchog tu sa pa/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi rnam par thar pa ni/mdo rgyud nyi shu nas lung ba na pa gsal bar yod kyang / rje btsun 'di la da ldan du mi byed pa 'a 'a yang med pas/ tshad ldan du sgrub byed kyi lung rnams ni 'dir ma smos shing / da ni rnam thar dngos la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang rje btsun 'di lho phyogs ma ta zhes bya ba'i yul du/bram ze'i rigs shing sa la lta bu 'byor pa dang ldan pa zhig yod pa la bu mid bar sdug bsngal gyi (gyis 〉gtses par gyur te/ de'i tshe rmi lam ca/ zam ze brgya la chos ston ( na)drangs na bu rnyed par 'gyur/ zhes lha lung bstan pa ltar bsgrub 〈bsgrubs 〉pas/ zla ba bdun na khye'u 0

gzugs bzang zhing blta 〈lta 〉na sdug pa zhig btsas par gyur te/mtshan sakhan la bstan pas / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan mod/'on kyang zhag bdun gyi tshe las med/ bram ze brgya la bsnyen bkur na zla ba bdun dang / dge slong ba 4 la bsnyen bkur na lo bdun 'tsho bar 'gyur zhing / de 'a/sa gzhag pa'i thabs med do/ zer nas/ deltar byas ma/sa lo bdun du nye ba na yab yum gyi sras grongs bar mi bzodapas/ g.yog dang bcas pa 'khyam du btang bas/ rim gyis 'khyams pa las na lend+ra'i sgo drung du snyad ngag gyi 〈gi 〉rigs byed zengs pas/rje btsun sa ra has mtshan gsan te drung du gre bar sleb pa na/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan zhib par phul bas/ rab tu byung bar nus na 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal bar byed pa'i thabs yod gsungs pa la/ de ltar bya zhusapas/ tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing lo bdun du lon gyi bar du de'i gzungs 'don du bcug pas/ 'chi bdag gi bdud las nges par rgyal/ mkhan po de'i rjes su rab tu byung nas/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs pas paṇḍi tar gyur te/mkhan po de nyid dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bstan ba la yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing /( ba)mtshan yang dge slong dpal ldan zhes bya bar yongs su grags pa'o/ de nas mkhan po de nyid kyi drung du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'i dbang bskur rgyud gdams pa dag bcas pa sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i don la legs par sbyangs shing / yongs surdzogs pa dang mkhan pos/ yul der mu ge nyams nga ba zhig lo ba gnyis yong ba mkhyen nas/ dge 'dun rnams nyams nyes gran gyuran mirung snyam du dgongs ste/ dge slong dpal ldan zhal brda 〈ta 〉byed bas kos 〈bskos 〉nas/ mkhan po de nyid dpal gyi ri la gshegs so/1

de nas de'i 'og tu slob dpon 'dis/ rdo rje rnal 'byo ra mas no /'phrul chang 'tshong ma'i gzugs bzung ba zhig gis 〈gi 〉nang du pyo / nas/ de'i skye ba gser du 'dug pa mthong nas/ de la ga ser ('gyur gyi gdams pa yod par mkhyen nas zhus te/ gser 'gyur mdzad nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog byas nas/ rjes su de dag gi rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bsgos nas smras pa/ khyod kyi dge 'dun la ma zhu she par gser 'gyur byas ma/sa/log 'tsho la sbyar 'dug pas bshasas pa'i don du mchod rten bye ba gyis/gnas 'dir yang ma 'dug cig ces bsgo'o/ dus der bde byed ces bya ba'i dge slo nga zheg gis/ rig pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i gzhung luṭa 'bum phrag bcu sa/ nye sa byas nas/ paṇḍi ta rnams sun 'byin par byed pa'i tshe slob dpon 'dis sde (10na)sdod kyi don rnams rig pa'i lam la drangs nas yod pa dang med pa'i phyoṭa rnams 'jiṭa shing pham par mdzad do/de'i chos grwar klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i bu gnyis khye'u gzhon nu'i gzuṭa kyi 〈kyis 〉'ongs shing lus la tsan dan gor shī sha'i lde gu'i 〈gus 〉byugs nas 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon gyi (gyis 〉dri de gsan cing sgrol ma'i sku bya ba'i phyir tsan dan blangs 〈bslangs 〉so/ de gnyis kyis yabal zhus shing / slob dpon klu'i yul du spyan drangs nas lo drug gi bar du bzhugs shing chos gsungs te/ tsan dan gor ba sha yum rgyas pa yi genyung ngu rnams phul nas mi yul du byon/ klu rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉gros byas shing gnod sbyin gyi 'dam blangs nas mchod rten bye ba yang grub/ de'i tshe slob dpon 'di'i mtshan yang klu sgrub tu grags par mngon no/ de nas tsan dan gor shi sha la sgol ma'i sku yang grub nas sems can rnams la phan pa'i gyir seng ldeng dri ldan gyi nags 'dabs tu 〈su 〉brag dril bu1

gce/ra du bsgyur bar da gongs pa'i tshe/ sgo la ma mched lnga'i zhal gzigs shing de dab / gis dpal gyis 〈kyi 〉ri la sgrub pa gyis shig ces lung bstan nas mi snang bar gyur sto/ de dus sgol ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad nas/ rdzu 'phru sa gyis sgra mi snyan du bdud rtsi len pa'i phyir gshegs pa'i lam du/ khye'u dze ta na'i lag yig la bstan 〈brten 〉nas rgyal por 'akyur ba'i lu nga bstan mdzad de/ sgra mi snyan du gshegs ( 1 ba)nas sku khrus ma/nga da nga 'i byerdo/ chos gos/ shing la bkal ba gzhan gyis khyer ba la nga'i yi ne ce/sa gsu ngas ba sa/ nga bdag can zhes zer nas ngo mtshar du byas so// de mas slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi bsnams nas slar dpal gyi ri 'a pa dbyo na par dgongs pa'i lam du/ sngar lung bstan pa'i byis pa de rgyal pod gyu ri pa dang mjal nas/ slob dpon rtag par rgyal po'i khab tu /so /na 〈〈 /〉 /'ibazhugang ri par ba/ la ba btab pas/ da bcug gcugs pa dbang gis lo gsu ma bzhu /sa par gnang ngo / rgyar po'i btsun mo mdzes pa'i lang tshos/ skye bo rnam sa kyis 〈kyi 〉yid 'phrog par byed pa zhig yod pas/ slob dpom/ la chags pa 'i dbang gis bud med kyi sgyu rtsal du ma'i sga nas/ 'dod pa'i mda' 'phem par bzas 〈gzari she 〉kyang rngo ma thog pas/ btsun mo ngo tsha ba'i dbang gis/ slob dpon gyi (gyis 〉kho mo la byed do zhes bkur 〈skur 〉pa btab pas/ de'i che slob dpon 'dra ba'i rgyal bu gcig kyang btsas so/ de rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉skur pa btabapa la/ ā rya de was shog 'dag la byas pa'i ma bye'i gzugs dkar gsal mdzes pa sa/cig ma te 'du ba'i gnas su ba mas pas/ ma bye mo rnams de la chasas te/ phyis ma he'i bu rnams dkar gsal du byung bas/slob dpon gyi du ra nga/ pa /bas so/ de nas slob dpon dpal gyi ri la byon nas bdud rtsi sgrub pa bum pa gang / bram ze chen po la phul ba des 3

kyang rgya mtsho ( min)chen po bdud rtsir bsgyur pa'i zu 'phrul dbang du mdzad nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs rgyal bcag te 〈ste 〉rjes su gdams pa yang bstan nas/ yab sras lhan cig dpal gyi ri la lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad de/ slob dpon gyis phyi rol gyi rgol ba ngan pa rnams ni tshar bcad/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha dang klu'i byang chub la sogs pa'i bu chen zams ni chos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ 'khor lo dang po'i dgongs 'grel du rin chen phreng ba la sogs gtam sna tshogs rnams mdzad/ bar pa'i dgongs 'grel du rtsa ba shes rab la sogs ris pa'i tshogs/ dbu ma'i dgongs 'grel du chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs bstod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga mdor byas 'od snye mdo 'grel la sogs pa/ rgyud sde'i yig sna dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi rgya la po'i sras des rgyal srid thob pa'i byer du dbu blangs 〈bslangs 〉pa la/ dbu ku shas bcad de sbyin pa ra mdzad pa'i rtswa'i sgub nas tshigs bcaḥ/ gsum byungab sa/ nga ni bde ba can du 'gro/ phyis ni lus 'di la'ang 'jug par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs te/ sku lus rdo bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ da lta'i bar du yang yod do zhes grags so/ slob dpon ma tang ki zhes bya ba ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi 〈kyis 〉gdams pa mtha' dag gnang nas/ ma tang gi spyil ( 1 1ba)po'i nang du sgrub pa mdzad pas ma tshan yang de khar grags/ slob dpon 'di nyid kyis rje btsun te lo pa rjes su bzung nas skude nyid mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa zhe rnal 'byor gyi spyod pas phyogs kun tu rgyu zhing byon pa'i lam du/ khye gu 'chi la khad pa gcig 'dug pa la snying rje skyes te/ yul phyoṭa de da nye ba di ga na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phug gcig 'dug pa der lo bcu gnyis kyi bar sa 1

sgrub pa mdzad pas/ mngon par shes ba lnga la sogs pa thun mong ge dngos grub rnams brnyed de/ su cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i shul du khyi gu lus bas slob dpon khyi gu la thusar/ brtse —ba skyes ma/lha rnams kyis bzhugs par gsol yang ma gsan par sngar gyi phug tu byon pas/ khyi gu des gzus pa'i shul du chu mig gcig byung 'dug pa la thugs the tshom pa'i tshe/ khye gu de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gyur nas rigs kyi bu khyod lha rnams kyi dbang du ma song bas/ sngar gyi dngos grub de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dngos grub kho mos sbyin par bya'o/ zhes gsungs nas/ mkha' 'gro ma de dang lhan gcig tu spyod pa mdzad nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa sa skob dpon ku ku ri pa'i rnam thar ro/slob dpon tsarya pa ma/ shar phyogs snya 〈snyam 〉gra la'i bye brag u ru ho sha'i grong khyer du rje rigs las rab tu byung zhing / sde sdod ( rnan)kyi don la mkhas par mdzad de/ slob dpon dza lan snya ra ba dang / ku ku ri pa la dbang bskur dang rgyud sde'i man ngagarjes su bstan pa dang bcas pa mtha' dag mnos te/ sgrub pa ma da pas drod kyi yon tan cung zad thob nas slob ma rnams la spyod pa mdzad pa'i dus btab ste/ slob dpon dzo lan ho ra ba la zhus pas/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉yon tan thob bam gsung ba la/ stag la rengs pa'i lta stangs/ ma te la dbang du bya ba/ shing thog la dgug pa'i lta stongs rim pa ltar mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyis khrol dang gsungs pa la/ de rnams khrol 〈'grol 〉bar ma nus pas/ de rnams slob dpon gyis dkrol 〈bzo la 〉te spyod pa byed pa la rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis tshamanyam byung / bsad pa gso nus pa dgos pas ma 'gro gsungs yang 〈kyang 〉 ma gsan par 'byon par chas pa na/ thob dpon gyis za sa3

tog nas rgyan drug dang byu ma ru gnang nas cis kyang 'gro na'ang hā ri rkaṭar ma 'gro/ zhes gdams so/ de nas 'khor sum stong dang bcas pa mkha' spyod la gshegs te/ zhabs khru gang tsam sa la ma reg cing / brten sa med pa'i gdugs bdun nam mkha' la rang 'khrol 〈'khor 〉ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis byon zhing / gaṅga'i 'gram du sge ba pa na/ mdzo mo zhig 'dug pa des kho mo sgrol zhig 〈cig 〉smre snga ba/sa dag 'don pa la/ thuṭa dgongs btang bas/ mdze mo 'di khur na rgya narnams ( 73ba)chud za zhing grib kyang phog par 'gyur bas mi rung snyam nas/ tsham tshom/ med par chu bo'i steng du byon pas dkyil du sleb pa na/ bla ma la yang 'di 1 bu'i rdzu 'phrulamed dgongs pa na chu nang du bying zhing / mos gus byas pas phar khar thon no/ de'i tshe mdze mo dge tshul tshem bu pas khur bas/ chu bo'i dbus su phyin pa na mdze mo rdo rje phag mo dang / dge tshul de nyid ste ru nar gyur nas/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉spyod pa me 'ong / cis kyang 'gro na'ang hā li ko ṭar ma 'gro zhes lung bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas byon pa'i lam du rmos mkhan gcig gis chang sa 'og tu sbas nas 'dug pa blangs 〈bslangs 〉pas/ ster du ma 'dod nas/ rdo la chu cung zad 'dzag pa zhig 'dug pa la 'thung 〈thungs 〉zer mi mos 〈ngoms 〉byas pa la/ ngoms par bya yi 'byung 〈thungs 〉zer bas 'thungs pas zad par ma gyur to/ de nas glang gnyis sdig mdzub kyi 〈kyis 〉bsad nas gso bar ma nus pas/ sngar ltar zer zhing kho rang gis bsos 〈gsos 〉so/ de nas shing thog bsrung 〈srung 〉ba'i bu mo gcig 'dug pa la shing thog blangs 〈bslangs 〉pas/ khyod rnal 'byor par 'dug pas phob 〈phobs 〉zerabs/ lta stangs kyi 〈kyis 〉phab kyang slar mos 'byar bar byas te 'bebs par ma nus so/ de nas klog mkhan gcig 'dug pa la 16

ba ba byas/ pas/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉klog shes sam zer bas klog kyang klog pa sa myog nas ming / rim gyis bha 〈snyam 〉gra la'i rgyal po zla ba rol pa'i ma myo/ po'i chogs kyis (13na)bsnyen bkur byas shing / phyis nas rgyal po 'kho de bcas nang pa la bcud nas/ bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing bzhung drub brtsam sa te / mthar gyi zi byu sha ṭar gshegs te ma'i bka' bcab/ pa'i )sa dmigs kyi 〈kyis 〉mkha' 'gro ma'i bar chad byung ste/sku lu ga de bor nas/ sred pa bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/bka' babs gsum pa las/ slob dpon ṇḍa ji pa'i lo rgyus ni/ slob dpon 'di'i 〈'di 〉yul ma gra ta'i rgyal po'i rigs yin cing / thog mar slob dpon nag po spyo da pa la dbang bskur thob/ dgyes rdor la brten ba'i bskyod rdzogs kyi rna' 'byor ri sgom 〈sgom 〉zhing rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ phyis nas glu mkhan gyi bu mo mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig phyag rgyar khrid nas rgyal srid bor te nags su lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pas/ rdo rje 'chang gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs nas/mchog gi dngos grub brnyes sa / de'i tshe sras kyi 〈kyis 〉rgyal srid ma zin nas yab tshol du btang bas/ glu mkhan gyi bu mo chu la mi bying bar 'doms 〈'dom 〉bco lnga'i mas/ mas chu le ngas te/ slob dpon la 'dren pa mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur to / de nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe pa ba yum stas mo grus ma la bcibs te/ dug sbrul gyis lcag byas yul dubyor/ pa kha / rgyal srid 'dzim/ pa'i sa/sol ba btab pas/ rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang lha / cis/ spyad pas mos dag par (13ba)gyis shig ces bsgo bas ca —/ dan gyi me dang nyi — gyi me'i nang du / zhag bdun gyi bar du sres 〈bsres/sa 〉pas ma tshis ste/ padma'i ze 'bru nye ru ga yab yum du gyur nas 'dug pa ba/ yul mi rnams shin tu dad par gyur nas/rja —— ru na 17

zhes pa'i mtshan yang dus der gsol to/slob dpon 'dis mi yul du lobadun brgya bzhugs nas/ dpag tu med pa'i gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad de/mthar gyi lus de nyid dang bcas pa mkha' spyod la gsheṭa so/slob dpon chen po ji na sa'i lo rgyus sa yul ga'u rar rgyal bo'i sras gcig pur gyur te/ skyo ba gseng ba'i tshe rol mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu spyod pa las goms pa'i mthus/ tam bu'i 〈bu 〉ra'i sgra la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin sa thob ste/ dus der re shig 〈zhig 〉rgyal po de skyo bar gyur pa la/ slob dpon rta mchog gi 〈gis 〉rgyal po de 'dul ba'i dus la babs par gzigs nas/khyod chos mi byed dam zhes smras pas/ tam bu ra'i sgra dang lhan cig tu chos 'grub na rung / zhus pas/ dbang dang gdams pa mtha' dag gnang nas/ tam bu ra'i sgra la rtog tu bcug pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te/ ga'u ra'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi don byas nasalus de nyid dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du gshegs so/slob dpon chenapo la ba pa'i lo rgyus sa/ u rgyan gyi (14na)yul dang nye bar grong khyer sam sto la zhes bya ba'i yul du grong khyer 'bum tsho gsum la dbang byed ba'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ji na sas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang nas/ des kyang rgyal srid dang rigs kyi ces ༷ spangs ste/ dur khrod du skra'i la ba dang lcang kham gyi (gyis 〉'tsho zhing / dus re shig 〈zhig 〉na chos rgyal ind+ra bo di'i sgo drung du/ lam sum chen po yod pa der rdo leb kyi steng du lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gnyid log snganas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes ste/ dur khrod kun pa sgra sgog du 〈tu 〉gsang spyod mdzad pa la/ phyi pa'i khro ma rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉bar chad tsam 〈brtsams 〉yang 〈kyang 〉ma tshug 〈tshuṭa 〉1

par/ ḍake de rnams rgyal po'i btsun mor 'dug pa rnams btul ma/mgo la slob dpon gyi mchil lham dang / sna phug nas snas byu 〈sna bcu 〉brgyus pas bud med rnams la da lta yang rgyan gyi rnam pa de lta bu yod par grags shing / slob dpon 'di 'khor bdun brgya dang bcas pa lus de nyid kyi mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ gnyis med rol pa'i slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar sa/ de yang slob dpon 'di yi yul ni kun rtsi zhes bya ba yin la/ yab grong khyer 'bum tsho brgyad curtsa bzhi la dbang 'byor ba'i rgyal po ind+ra bo di de sras kyi 〈kyis 〉dbenapar gyur te/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ btsun mo dam pa mngal dang ldan par gyur pa'i rmi lam du (14ba)ri rab za zhing rgya mtsho 'thung dang nyi zla mid/ khams gsum ma lus rkang pa'i khyon gyis rdzis pa soṭa rmis pa'i don rnams rgyal po la ma legs par bsnyad/ bltams pa'i tsha na gter brdol ba la soṭa dge mtshan khyad par can byung / de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu de bskyed bsrings nas cher skyes pa dang / rgyal srid spangasanas rab tu byung zhing rdzogs pa'i paṇḍi tar gyur nas/ rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad de chos gsungs pa la/ bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa gcig gis/ res rgod pa dang / res ngu ba sogs rnam 'gyur mi mthun pa bstan pas/ paṇḍi ta the tshom du gyur te/ skog tu cis pas/ khyod kyi tshig rnams shes pas dga' zhing rgod/ don mi shes pas khyel te ngu ba yin/ zer bas/ 'o na don sus shes byas pa la/ u rgyan na nga'i ming po'i slob ma phag tshangs pa zhes bya ba/ rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pa gcig yod pas de'i zhabs la gtugs shig ces lung bstan pa bzhin/ phag rdzi rgan rgon gnyis bud med mdzes ma gcig dang bcas pa grong 'dab du 〈'dabs su 〉'dug pa la chos zhus pas rngo —

lan ma byung zhing / rol nang nas bu mos sgrugs pa'i 'bu tshod gsol zhing 'dug pa khong la yang gnang bas ma gas la bar ba tshom gyi gnas pa'i tshe/ rgad po na re/ khyod ni rigs kyi 〈kyis 〉dregs shing yo na tan gyi (gyis 〉snyems dang bcas pas sdod du mi rung gsungs/ de nas maṇḍal phul zhing nan gyis (15na) zhus pa las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing / rgyud dang man ngag ma lus pa gnang zhing bu mo de dang lhan gcig 〈cig 〉tu dpal gyi ri la sgrub pa mdzad de dngos grub brnyes nas/ yul du mu ge byung ba'i dus su/ klu'i rgyal po gzir nas 'bru char phab te 〈ste 〉rang gi yul du phyin pas/ rgyal pos rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang lhan gcig 〈cig 〉rigs nyams par byas nas 〈bas 〉tsan dan gyi me la sregs shig ces bsgo ste/ bsregs pas zhag bdun gyi bar du du ba steng ma chad par 'dug pa'i nang du bltas nga/sa/zil pa phrom me 'dug pa la/ rgyal po 'khor bcas 'gyod pa'i mas gdungs shing slar dad nas/ byu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i mtshan yang gsol te/ de rnams rjes su bzung nas/ lus de nyid mkha' spyod du gshegs so/de'i slob ma bskal ba bzang mo'i lo rgyus sa/ su ma sto blo gros bzang mo/ dpal gyi blo gros ma/ lcam legs min na ra rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pa las/ rgyal po ind+ra bo di'i lcam legs min na ra zhes pa/ mtshan dang ldan cing bstan pa la dad pa gcig yod pa la/sku mdze byung ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gsol ba btab pas sos par gyur ste/ grub chen mtsho skyes rdo rje la btud cing mos rgyusabyas pas/ rdo rje 'chang sogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems mang po'i zhal mthong zhing rjes su (15ba) bstan pa yang thob nas grub pa brnyes te/ lang na pu ri'i rgyal po'i sgo drung du byon nas/ smyon 20

/ri /mi/spyo tsal /sgo 11 / ma brtul shugs da pas rgyu zhang snan pa la/ ma nga snang sna gsapa dag byung ste/ la las lu sa la 'od kyis khyab pa dang la las lha'i bu mo/la las spyon mar mthong ba'i tshe/ rgyal po'i phyag dar ba dag la chos bstan nas/ khrom du rang gi dbu gri gug gi 〈gis 〉bcad de thod par bcug nas/ phyag dar ba dang kha sbyar nas mthar gyi mkha' spyod du gshegs so/bka' babs bzhi'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar rdzogs so/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang nyal 'gro kun/ /rnam dpyod hub kyis gcig 〈cig 〉car bzhes nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro la sbyin mdzad te lo pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i de nyid bstan du gsol/ /bka' babs de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun te lo pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam shig 〈zhig 〉brjod par/ /de yang grub chen 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni shar phyogs za hor gyi yul snya go yab bram ze gsal ba/ yum bram ze gsal ldan ma gnyis sras kyi〈kyis 〉dben pa la/ phyi nang gi lha dang rten rnams la mchod pa phul gsol ba btab pas/ dus re zhig yum sems can dang ldan par gyur pa las/ zla grangs rdzogs nas sras mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa'i nub mo yul thams cad 'od kyi〈kyis 〉gang bar gyur to/ (15na) mtshan mkhan la bstan pas 'di ni lha klu gnod sbyin sangs rgyas gang yin ma 'tshal bas/ skyes bu mchog gyur 'di ni gces par skyongs/ zhes zer zhing ming yang gsal 'od du btaṭa so/gces par skyong ba'i tshe bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa gcig nam mkha' la byung nas/ 'di skad gsungs par mngon no/ gces par skyangs 〈bskyangs 〉kyang mi 'chi ba ni yod me yin/ /skyes bu mchog 'di rab tu byung zhing rig pa slob 〈slobs〉//zhes gsungs so/ de nasaphyis rab tu byung zhing rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi tar gyur te/21

mtshan yang shes rab bzang po zhes grags so/ de nas sngar gyi bud chad des lung bstan cing byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa mo pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du zhabs la lcags sgog bcug nas/ lo bcu gnyis/ su sgrub pa mdzad pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes te/ ma dang mkhan po la/nya'i rnam shes mkha' la spar ba sogs/ rdzu 'phrul rnams bstan nas gnang ba zhus te/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub tshol 〈'tshol 〉du phyin pas/ lho phyoṭa 'jigs byed bzhad pa'i dur khrod du slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes matang ki'i spyil po na bzhugs pa dang mjal bas/ slob dpon dri za'i grong du gshegs/ kho bo sa khyod rjes su 'dzin pa la btang ba yin pas/ maṇḍal phul gsungs pa la bla mar bzung ste sngar smos pa ltar dbang dang gdams pa mtha' dag gnang nas/ sems kyi de kho na nyid ngo sprad te 〈de 〉(15ba)lung bstan pa/ za hor gyi grong khyer ha ri na zhes bya bar sprul pa'i rgyal po ud ma skyes pas byin gyis brlabs shing / rang bzhin gyis grub thag nya ba de'i tshong dus su smad tshong ma snya ri zhes bya ba yod pas de'i g.yog gyis la/ rtog pa sbyongs shig ces lung bstan pa ltar/ smad tshong ma'i thad du phyin te g.yog du 〈tu 〉khas blangs pas/ til brdungs su〈rdung du 〉bcug te 〈ste 〉des kyang til brdungs shing lam sbyangs pas/ rezhig til la mar gnas kyang brdungs brtsir ma byas na mngon du mi 'gyur ba bzhin du/ rang sems sangs rgyas su gnas kyang nyams su ma blangs na mngon du mi 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ nyams su blangs pas de kho na nyid mngon du 'gyur te/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos mngon sum du dbang bskur zhing / ( rgyud kyi gdams pa gnang nas grong khyer ba rnams la mthong snang byung tshul sa/ me dpung gcig la mar me ni/ /bcu bzhis bskor ba mthong ba dang / /'od phung dkyil du dge slong bsam gtan bzhuṭa/ /la las rnal lha

'byor dur khrod rgyan ldan zhig/ dzes ldan mang pos bskor 〈skor 〉ba byedapa mthong / /snya ri ma la snyad 〈bsnyad 〉tshe rings par sa/ /blta bar phyen ma nam mkha' 'od phung gi/dkyil na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhuṭa nas su//gtun shing lhung thabs myur zhing til 'bru thor/snya ri mo sa 'gyod pa'i meyis gdungs//phyag bskor 〈skor 〉byas shing maṇḍal phul nas/ ni/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa byas pa las//rje btsun des sa (1 na)thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /nga yi rgyud la skyes pa'i rtogs pa 'di/ /gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog /khyod kyi snying la yang dag gnas gyur cig /ces gsung 〈gsungs 〉me tog mgo la bzhag tsam gyis//rta rim sa 'khor bcas grol ba lags/ de'i ma smad tshong ca ri ma 'khor da bcas pa/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gis grol bar byas so/ zhes rgyal pos thos nas/ glang po che mchog la zhon nas 'khor 'bu phrag du ma dang bcas te yul der lhag 〈lhags 〉pa'i tshe/snya ri ma shing na la bdun srid kyi nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ til mar gyi dpes mtshon pa'i zab mo chos gsungs pa la rgyal po 'khor bcas dad de/ nyams blangs pa lus de nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉mkha' spyod du gshegs nas/ re zhig za hor gyi yul de stong 〈stongs 〉par gyur to/de'i tshe sto phyogs kyi rgyal po tsas ca pa zhes bya ba/ ma la gus pa zhig yod bdes ma'i don se phyi nang gapa sa thamasacad/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la spyogs gcig sdu ba'i pho nya btang bas thams cad 'dus te/ paṇḍi ta'i gral du 〈dbu 〉mkhas pa dang / ku su lu'i gral dbur grusapas byed pa la 'cham ba'i ma/bud zad mi sdug pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig na re/ tshogs dpon sus byed pa yin zer ba la/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gis da kho bo 'gran ma dang bral ba yin zer bas mo na re/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉mi (1 ba〉bong tsho

nga'i ming po spyan drongs zer ba la/ rgyu mtshan dris pas dzra lan snya ra na/shing sha pa'i yal ga la bam chen gyis (gyi 〉rkang pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis nas rta rnga gcig gis btags shing / lag pa'i mthe'u chung gi 〈gis 〉resamos 'jus nas nam mkha' la gar byed pa gcig yod pa der zhus zer /zlo/ pa/ pazlos / byed (byes gas/ pa//ma / bye dro byerdo bye//sa ju /sa ltos sdu mnyam por bzhugs su gsol te/ thog mar sgra tshad ba rtsod pas te lo rgyal/ de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis na / mkha' la dkyil 'khor bri ba/ seng ge zhon nas nam mkhar 'gro ba dur khrod kyi mi ro dgu 〈'gug 〉pa/ de nyid bdud rtsir bsgyur ba sogs rdzu 'a tsal 'gran pas/ khong cha/ 〈gis 〉ji ltar sprul pa bzhin rje btsun gyis bshig cing / rje btsu/ na gyis sprul pa rnams khong gi 〈gis 〉gzhig pa ra ma nus pas/ yang je btsun 'dis nyi zla thang la phab pa'i steng du rang gi lus phyi bsgyur zlog 〈 slog 〉nas ba spu'i bu ga re re —nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zangs med pa sprul zhig/ re re la yang dkyil 'khor du ma 'phro ba'i rdzu 'phrul ma ngon par 'du mdzad pas/ der 'dus pa rnams mngon par dad par gyur te/zhabs la btud pa'i tshe mgur gsungs pa/ ngas ni zhing khams brgyar /sde// /na/ ////rte rte bye ༷ /bye / bye /bye//da///pa /klu sgoX ngaX / / / /bye bye// / gyis (gyi〉rgol ba'i tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan nas/ shar phyogs za hor gyi 'gro ba rnams mkha' spyod kyi gnas su drangs shing / lan gsum gyi bar du stong 〈stongs 〉par mdzad cing sku lus de nyid dang bcas pa ཿ mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ji

/ bye tsho / / / / tsho / / / / / snye/ /phyu/ / / / dha |sgro / /// shā/༷/ bye / / byebye gdod nas yongs dag bum brgya skyes kyi khams/ /slar yang dka' byeX /// ༈ ༷ bye bye ga rdo /rjo bye /rdo /// dī bye /rdo ༷/ /bye/ / // /dī bye yang bdag nyid chen po 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul kha che/ rigs sa bram ze sbyi bye // gras ༷ bye/ ༷ bye bye bye ༷ /rdo/ byebye bye// snyu / ༷ / /rdo / bye 7

mdzad de/ yid skyo ba'i dbang gis mkhan po sangs rgyas bskyangs las rab tu byung nas/ snyan grags bzang po zhes bya ba'i mtshan gsoX ste/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i ngon la sbyangs shing yongs su rdzoṭa pa'i paṇḍi tar gyur nas na lend+ra'i byang sgo bsrung 〈srung 〉ba'i slob dpon gyi khur — mdzad cing / bshad nyan gyi (gyis 〉bstan pa'i bya ba ba ba 〈 ba 〉pa tshe/ bsam pa/ bdag ni yongs rdzoṭa paṇḍi tar gyur kyang / sems sa ba nga ba'i tshad tsam mi gnas ( can)gar 'gro'i btol 〈gtol 〉med ba/ da gsems la da nga 'byor ba'i bla ma btsal bar bya snyam du dgongs nas/'khor lo sdom pa'i nye snying yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag bcan bzas bas sagayos shing bu khyod shar phyogs ngos su te lo pa'i rigs yin no/ zhes pa'i tsang bstan thob nas blo bur ca 'chad nyan bzhag ste/ shar phyoṭa ngos su za ma tshol〈'a la 〉du phyin nas/ ste lo pa gar bzhugs dris pas/ la la na re rab byung gi cha lugs can/ la la na re spyod pa'i cha lugs can zer zhing / 'di yin 'dir bzhugs kyi btol 〈gtol 〉mi 'dug pas/ nags sag po zhig gi nang du rngon pa zhig 'chag pa la dris pas/ ri dgas bshor 〈gshor 〉grogs gyis dang gastan sgyu zer ba la/ ma nus pas mi snang bar gyur sto/ lam gtor bar gyur pa la 'khyams shing phyin pas/ mi gcig gis gcig snyel nas rgyu ma 'dren pa zhig snang ba la/ te lo pa mthong ngam dris pas/ 'a 'dren rog gyis dang bstan gyis (gyi 〉zer ba la/ mi nus byas pas mi snang bar gyur te/ za ngan 〈ngam 〉gyi thang chen po ci byed baspyol 〈gtol 〉med pag cig tu sleb nas 'dug ste/ bla ma'i sprul par ngo ma shes pas dka' bon ba da chus sgo nas btsal yang bla ma ma rnyed do/ re shig 〈zhig 〉rimasagad phog pa'i lha khang gi nang na dge 'dun rnams gdugs tshogs 〈 da 〉sa

— —gsol ba'i gral gyi phyi rol me dasang yod pa'i 'gram (1 ba)na mi sngo la rid pa nyi lhag gis brdungs shing 'doms dkris tsam las med pa zhig gis/ nya rlom/ pa kha cig khyer te sres pa las/ dra ro pas/ 'di ltar ma byed ces smras pas phus btab cing chur bcug pas sos par gyur te/ der nus ldan 'di/ te lo pa yin nam sems pa la/ dra ro pa yin sa zer/spyod lam la che tshom skyes pa'i tshe/ dra ro pa/ min min gsungs pas mngon mkhyen mnga' bar shes ma/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas bdag rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ zhus pas/ cang mi gsung bar snying gar rdog pas bsnun nas bzhud do/ phyi bzhin 'brengs 〈'brangs 〉pas gtsug lag khang nam mkha'i rtse mo snyigs pa 'dra ba zhig gi steng du byon nas/ bu snying stobs dang ldan pa yod na 'dir chongs gsungs pa la/ che tshom med par chongs 〈mchongs tshopas lus dum bu brgya stong du song zhing / zug gzer gyis 'chi ba la nye ba'i tshe/ bla ma byon nas/ khyod na'am gsungs/ na lags zhus pas/ ngar 'dzin lus kyi rdza ma 'di/ /chag kyang rung gi dra ro pa/ /ro snya na ha'i pho snya na ti'i/ /zhes gsungs pas sdug bsngal las grol lo/ de nas gdug pa can gyis 〈kyi 〉srin bus gang ba'i chu bo la/ bla ma'i zam pa byas pas chu bo'i nang bying zhing nyams nyes pa yang / sngar bzhin mdzad pas grol bar gyur to/ yang dge 'dun tshang (rna na)mang du tsan dan gyi me dpung rab tu 'bar pa'i nang du/ tsham tshom // bye / /shā /bka ngabs/ / / /sna rsham ga pa /rdo/ rnyi /ma gaX ཿ// kyi thur ma yang bcug cing yun ring du nyams nyes pa yang / sngar ltar yang sos par ma da pa yin no/ de nas dus re shig 〈zhig 〉na yul der skye bo da 'a stonachen bo byung pa'i tshod ma la nyung yung drang ba'i 〈drangs 37

pa'i 〉tshe/ rkan sgra dag mdzad de mnyes mnyes ltar 'dug pa la/ sgo ros yang yang drangs shing phyis nas zangs kyang khyer te bros pas/ mi rnams kyisaded de lcags kyi khang bur bcug nas sol dkar gyis 〈kyi 〉mes bsteṭa pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe/ bla mas sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs pas sdug bsngal las grol lo/ yang re shig 〈zhig 〉lam du gshegs pa'i phyag phyir byon pa'i tshe/ rgyal po 'khor bcas 'dug pa'i nang du btang nas btsun mo la sen mo 'debs pa dang / nu ma gnyid 〈mnyed 〉du bcug pas/ nyung 〈zhug 〉rum pa rnams kyis yan lag rnams so sor bregs shing / sdug bsngal gyi 〈gyes 〉gzir ba'i tshe sngar bzhin grol bar mdzad do/ yang dus re shig 〈zhig 〉blon po mchog gi chung ma blangs nas byung ba la/ skyes bu snying stobs dang ldan pa yod na/ blon po'i chung ma la 'o byed pa yin gsungs pas/ bka' bzhin du bgyis pa'i tshe/ gnye bo rnams (10ba)khros nas brdungs shing sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba'i tshe/ bla ma byon nas sngar bzhin sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad do/ de 'og tu rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa shing rta'i steng du bzhag ste/ mdzes ma'i lang tshodang ldan par 'dug pa'i tshe/ skyes bu snying stobs dang ldan pa yod na/ btsun mo 'di shing rta las phob cig 〈phobs shig 〉ces bsgo ba'i bka' nyan nas tsham tshom med par nga ba pas/ btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyis til bzhin du brdungs shing btsir ba'i tshe/ sngar bzhin bla ma'i bka' drin gyis sos par gyur to/ de nas rje btsun te lo pas/ smig sgyu'i skyes bu bla ma'i sku la brdo 〈sdo 〉ba ltar snang ba zhig sprul nas spru ro paskyes bu 'di ngal ma bsos 〈gso 〉bar ded cig gsungs pas/ mgyogs bar ded pas re zhig thang chad pa'i stabs kyis brgyal zhing 'gyel ba las /slar yang brgyal sangs par gyur te/ gad med g.yang med la de/da pa sa 88

/co ste /tho /sde / bye ga nga nga zab 'a gas su rung ba ga ga tu dra pa lhung nas sdug bsnga shā bar gyur nga/'i tshe/ sngar ba'i/na bla ma byon nas sos par mdzad do/yang dus re —ga ge che mi'i bu tsha gzugs bang lang tsho phu / sum tshogs pa dang ldan byu/nga gang thi 〈bis 〉mthong bar gyur na/ thub pa rnams kyang sen mo'i rtse mo 'akun ba zhig gzigs nas// dra ro pa 'di la las kyi phyag rgya gyis/ shig gsungs pa ltar byas pas bu mo'i (11na)khyo 'khor dang bcas pas na ro pa bzung nas/ 'dis lan 'dis nyes zer zhing dbras dru ba'i tho bas rdo rje gtun du bcug nas brdungs pa'i zug zus nyen pa'i tshe/ bla mas byin rlabs kyi 〈kyis 〉sos par mdzad do/ de nas re shig 〈zhig 〉bla ma'i zhal nas bu khyod gdams ngag 'dod na rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa 'di khug la phyag rgyar phul cig gsungs pas/ dra ro pa dga' ches nas 'gug par brtsams pa'i tshe/ rgyal pos bzung nas khri rgyogs 〈sgrogs 〉kyi 'khrul 〈'phrul 〉'khor du bcug nas 'phangs pas/ sha rus dum bur gyur cing kun gzhi ma 'phos tsam la/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi 〈kyis 〉sos par mdzad do/ de nas rje btsun chen po mya ngan 〈ngam 〉gyi thang chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig na gshegs shing / gdams ngag 'dod na shog cig gsungs pa la/ dra ro pas snyags 〈bsnyeṭa 〉kyang ma sleb par dbugs chad de 'gyel lo/ de nas brgyal sangs pa dang bla ma mdun na 'dug pa la phyag dang bskor 〈skor 〉ba byas te gsol ba btab kyang / cang mi gsung bar 'dug pa'i tshe/ shā ro pas gnyid dang kha zas spangs te gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab so 〈bo〉/de rnams kyi bar du dra ro pas dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad pa'i sgo nas/ste / dbrel yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag par mdzad cing / bden don rnamapa bcu gnyis mngon du mdzad pa yin rna/ zhes grags so/ de nas dra ro29

pas rtsi gcig tu gsol ba btab (110)cing mos gus byas pas/ ste dzapa/'i zhal nas/ bu khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉tsha grang gi sdug bsngal la ma bas ma par yu na ring du dka' ba spyad pas/ 'dod pa'i mchog smos la maṇḍal phul zhig 〈cig 〉gsungs pas/ der chu btsal yang ma rnyed par lus kyi rtsa chen brtol ba'i khrag gi chag chag dang / snyan mchog bcad pa'i tshom bu bkod de maṇḍal phul nas/ yang dag pa'i lam gyi gdams ngag zhus pa'i tshes/ chags 〈phyags 〉shing gis na ro pa'i gdong la rgyab 〈brgyab 〉pasabargyal nas sangs pa'i tshe/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod de/ de nas lho phyogs shi par pa ta a khang na ra'i yul ri bo bya rkang can du/ dra ro pa la sogs pa'i slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing gdams pa ma lusapa rdzogs par gnang ba'i rjes su mgur gsungs pa/ kye ho/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ /te lo nga yi 〈yis 〉ci yang bstan du med/ /rang rig nyid la mtshon te shes bar byos/ /zhes gsungs shing dam tshig phog pa sa/ khyod paṇḍi ta'i sa ma 'dzin par sgrub pa gtso bor gyis shig de lta na mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes dam tshig phog nas mi snang bar gyur to/de nas dra ro pas me tog mdangs 'phrog ces bya ba'i lha khar dang nye ba'i grong khyer zhig na/ rgan mo gcig la sbyin bdag bcol nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe mu stegs gcer bu (11na)pa rnams lhag 〈lhags 〉ste 〈te 〉paṇḍi ta rnams dang rtsod pa byas pas/ gcer bu pa rnams rgyal bar gyur te/pasangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jigs 〈'jig 〉tu nye ba na/ rgyal pos paṇḍi ta rnams la rtsod pa'i me tog brim 〈bams 〉kyang len par ma nus 30

nas/ rgyal por smras nga / khyod rang rna tsha gres gyi la rtsod pa mi nus ma gtsub la ga khang gcer bu pa rnams shar phul zhes/ dri da spra/bse / 〈bsgras/sa 〉pa sa/ paṇḍi ta rnams skya ngan bye zug zu dang ldan/ bar kyur pa la/ rgan —mos smras pa/ kho mo/'i khyim na dra ro ti ti bzhugs/ /rtsod pa pham na kho la zen 〈zan 〉par rigs / /zhes zer bas/ paṇḍi ta rnams yid dga' bar gyur te/ der byon nas mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab (pa/ )thub pa'i bstan pa 'jigs 〈'jig 〉tu ) ba'i tshe/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug khyod 'dras mi bzlos na/ /bdag cas rnam sa/ kyi skyabs su su zhig 'gyur//zhes zhus pas/ sngar gyi bla ma'i bka' bstsal bsnyel ste rtsod par zhal gyis ba'e/sa so/ der phyir rgol ba'i dpang po gsum gyi khri bshams te/ rtsod pas na ro pa cung zad zhan zhan 'dra ba la/ thugs dgongs btang bas /sngar gyi bla ma'i bka' bcag pa dran nas/ yid kyi 〈kyis 〉bshags pa byas shing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ste lopa mi thod rlon pa bregs ma thag gcig khyer nas/ nam mkha' la byon pa dra ro pas gzigs nas gus pas phyag yang yang btsal lo/ de'i tshe(23ba)gcer bu pa rnams na re/ srin bu'i gzuṭa can sangs rgyas pa rnams pham mozer ba la/ te lo pas pham pham zhes gsungs shing sdig mdzub mdzad pas/kho'i gtsug lag khang rnam sa zhig pas khong rnams rab tu skrag nas slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / gcer bu pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud do/ de nas/ te lo pa'i zhal nas/ na ro pa khyod la dze 'dir mchog gi dngos grub med pas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la phan par gyis shig khyod kyi slob ma las kyang yang slob ji bzang 'gro ste/ 'gro ba la pha / pa chen po 'byung byu/nga / khyod srid pa bar dor mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes lung bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de 31

nas sgo ro sgo sa / bka' bzhin bsgrub 〈bsgrubs 〉nas bstar pa la nga na par —4 /sgo /dri /me /kye 11 /ba sa da/ sa thugs dam 'khrung sa nas 'a sa da yul du da pa ṭanas glang 'i la ṅge du bye du zhes brjod pas/ khyod 'ju na 'a zo zer nas chu gre phul ba bzhu nas gsol bas ya mtshan skyes ste/ rgyal po ga bsnyad pa'i tshe/ bsru mkhan yin no zhes chad pa'i gsod las byed du byung ba la/dpung gi tshogs rengs par mdzad de 'khor dang bcas pa rje na su bzung ngo / yang dus re shig 〈zhig 〉na/ kha che'i yul du glang po che la grong dajug ma/dzad de rgyang grags su skyal 〈bskyal 〉nas/ grong mi rnams dbugs dbyung bar mdzad do/ de nas tshogs 'khor gyi 3/ man snya na dang shing thog dgug pa dang / sbyin (23na)sregs kyi thab tu yi dam lha 'i zhal blta ba dang / mngon shes lnga dang ldan zhing tshe gcig gi dngos grub brnyes shing bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad de mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ de nas re zhig lon nas rje mar pa rgya gar du phyi ma byon pa'i ma/ slar yang sku dngos su mi kun gyis mthong bar zla shas bzhugs shing chos gsungs pa sogs 'og tu gsal la slar yang mkha' spyod du gshegs so/de ltar rgya gar gyi grub chen bka' brgyud 'di la bka' drin che ba rnams kyi rnam thar zur tsam brjod pa'o/ 'phags yul 'gro ba'i mun sel dam pa'i chos/ /gang gi thugs bskyed rta bdun gyis drangs te/ /byang phyogs dmag 〈smag 〉rum sel mdzad mar pa rje'i/ /rgyud sde'i bcud kyi zang char dga' ston stsol/ /bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa de dag gangs canaljongs 'dir byung tshul mi/ paṇa chen 1 ro pa la slob ma 'phags yul sogs su mang ba yod kyang / de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur zhing / lhag par bod 'dir bka' drin che ba da/ mas te ru po'i rnam sprul mar pa —2

chos kyi blo gros sa/ lho brag chu khyer gyi gro bo lur gi mdar/ yab mar pa dbang phyug 'od zer dang / yum 4 za mo mardo sde bya ba byu ga cing 'byor ldan de nyid kyi sras/ su 'khungs /rta tsha chos kyi sho gros zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu gsu 7 bar khab tu bzhuṭa/ /ngo btu cha nga dang rtsod pa la (13ba)dgyes pa zhig byung bas/ der ya ba kyis/ thag ring zhig tu slob gnyer la phyin pa legs gsungs rgyags dang bcas brdzangs pas/ la stod mang mkhar myu gu lung du bla chen 'brog mi'i drung du lo tsā bslab 〈bslabs 〉shing chos zhus pa'i tshe/ rjes gnang re la yon 'bri re dgos par 'dug pas yon thang che bar dgongs te/ rgya gar la chos slob tu 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ rta gcig dang seng lding gi sga gcig bcas byang stab/ rtseratshong 'dus su gser la bsgyur nas 'byon par bzhed pa'i che /slog skya ston pa bya ba'i bla ma zhig stag sde mi mangs su ma ba ca ga3 ga gis gdan drangs nas/ 'bul ba dang bcas te tshu ra byon pa dang dus mtshung sha nas lam groṭa byas te/ gyes nar 〈khar 〉gser gyi rdzong ba yang btab/ de nas yab yul du phebs nas rgya gar la 'byon pa'i lo tsi sa gsungs pas/ yab yum gyis bshol ci 'debs rung ma gsan par nor ci yod gser la bsgyur nas bsnams te/gnyos lo tsha ba rgya gar du 'gro ba dang sdongs 〈bsdongs 〉nas byon te/ bal yul du pham mthing pa sku mched gnyis kyis chos gsungs pa la nyan pas/ gastos kyi 〈kyis 〉bal po rgas 〈rgad 〉po thig la chos nyan sa 〈pa bas 〉rgya gar du phyin pa drags 〈drag 〉zer ba la ma nyan pas/ khong khros te rgya gar du song / nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉tshad pa goms su 'jug pa dang / sgra slob pa'i zhor la spyi zer ba la gdan bzhi'i rgyud dang 'pho ba'i gdams pa/ dud (14na)so lha mo rnams zhus/ spenarta ba la/ gsang 'dus sogs zhus shing lo gsum bzhugs/ rgya gar du33

byon / mkhas grub sakun zla ma mchis pa dra ro pa dang mjal/ dgyes rdor sogs gdams pa'i chos gsan/ gzhan yang paṇḍi ta ye shes snying po/mnga' bdag me tri pa sogs bla ma mang du mjal/ dpal rdo rje gdan na lend+ra sogs gtsug lag khang rnams mjal du byon pa'i tshe/ gnyos lo myu dang yang yang 'phrad/ chos kyi rtsod gleng byas pa'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ 1ro pa sogs bla ma rnams las/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ zu ra rje/bde mchog gsang 'dus/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ thi ya'i skor sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i gdams pa yod do cog gsan/ khyad par ma hā ma ya'i bka' babs grub chen ku ku ri par zhu bar dug mtsho gling du bzhugs pas der byon pa sogs dka' ba dpag med spyad nas tshur bod du byon pa'i tshe/ chu bo gaṅga'i grur/ gnyos lo tstsha bas prag dogs 〈dog 〉skyes g.yo thabs kyis chos be bum rnams tshur bskyur bar brten khrol 'ded kyi mgur gosangs shing / bod du gser sgrub nas slar yang rgya gar du 'byon dgongs/ bal yul brgyud bod du byon nas/ gtsang gi dgyer thur myuralhan cig 'groṭa pa'i slong/ sbya ston pa dang mjal nas sde len bzang po byas chos zhus/ de nas lho bras/ tu byon/ rngog chos sku rdo rjes gdan (24ba)drangs zhabs ra gtug 〈gtugs 〉cing 〈shing 〉slob mar gyur/ mar pa mgo yag gis 'dam du spyan drangs par phan yul bsgyud nas byon/ na ra'i gser kha rdol ba dang thug gser gyi 'thu ba mang du byung / 'bul bsnye shā /ba /nge ཿpa ba gzhan dag dang sku cha 5 rnams gapa ra du bsgyu sa/ slar ya mdzil dang bal yu la brgyud rgya gar du byon/ tsā ro pa'i zhal nas chos sngar ma thob pa rnams zhu ba dang / thob pa rnams zhus dag yid ches par gyisagasungs/ der khye ro dang me tri sogs bla ma rnams la chos mas du zhus shing rgyud kyi don rnams la byang zhing chub par mdzad/ slar lan gcig 34

'a na pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ kha sar pa ṇi'i lha khang sogs gzigs/de nas bod du byon pa'i lam du/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po yang zhabs la gtugs cing 〈shing 〉slob mar gyur/ de nas lho brag gro bo lung gi dgon par gdan chags/ slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dus/rgyud sde'i chos rnams nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad/ 'phrin las tshad med pa rgyas/ rje mi la rjes su bzung ba'i phyir sras mkhar bzhigs du 〈su 〉bcug cing tshar bcad pa sogs mdzad cing / mthar dbang da ra gdams pa gnang nas bsgom 〈sgom 〉pa'i tshe/ mi lar mkha' 'gro'i lungab na byung nas 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa zhus pas/ nyid kyi ba bum nang btsal ba na/ grong 'jug gi dpe ma rnyed/ der rgya (15na)gar la yang bskyar lan gcig byon 〈'byon 〉pa'i zugs 'dun byung ba dang mthun par byon 〈'byon 〉par bzhed nas/ 'bul bar gang byung gser du bsgril nas slob ma rnams kyis bshol ci btab kyang ma gsan bar/ nyid gcig pur 'phags yul du phebs pas/ bal yul du spen snya bas/ na ro pa mkha' spyod la gshegs nas kun gyi 〈kyis 〉mi mjal ba'i lo rgyus bshad pas/ thugs yus pa bzod logs 〈thags 〉med bar gyur/ da mjal ba'i skal ba yod dam gsungs pas/ khyod dam tshig gtsang mar 'dug pas gsol ba btab na mjal ba'ang srid zer/ de nas putha ha rir byon pas/ dge tshul shes rab 'byung gnas dang mjal nas/ bu /ra /spyo /zhe /de/tsho /sgongs par gyur kyang pha mkha' da la ga gas/ 'a da byung na gtod gsungs zer nas/ dgyes rdor gyi bris sku gcig ga hā la rdo rje dril bu rnams gtad ba la/ da dung rje btsun dam ba ma lta skabs yod da dris pas/ dam tshig gtsang ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dag pa'i slob mas gsol ba btab na 'byon/ de min dus skabs med zer/35

der tsā ro pa'i slob ma re re'i drung tshogs 'khor bshams nas gsol btab pas/ thams cad mthun par mjal bar gyuras 〈'gyur ba 〉lung bstan/ de nas byu na ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang du gzigs togs mdzad cing bzhuṭa pa'i tshe/ rje btsun dra ro (15ba)pa dran pa'i thusas mda' dug can phog pa bzhin du mi bde zhing bzod blag 〈glags 〉medapar gyur te/ bla ma tshol 〈'tshol 〉ba'i phyir seng sder gi nags tshal du dro/ /sa groXng du/ zlo/ pa kri / gyu rdo rdo/la yardo / hā/ rdo 1 pa /// rdo bye /dro brtson 〈btson 〉du bzung ba la sa/bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis thar bar gyur te/ yang zla ba phyed kyi bar gom pa gya tshom du bor zhing nags tshal dang dur khrod kun tu btsal yang bla ma ma rnyed do/ de nas ri mu3 / pa can kyinags 'dab tu 〈'dabs su 〉shel gyi pho long la/ dra ro pa gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes dang / tsandan gyi sdong po la bye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' gur phub pa lta bur bzhugs pa dang / lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs sa nas sngags kyi 'khor lo skus mi sgribs 〈sgrib 〉pa gsal ba sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i lhas rnams gzigs so/ der zhabs rjes kyi rtsarazhag gsum gdung shugs ze ngag gis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par mdun du byon pa mjal te/ mthong lam lta bu'i dga' ba skyes shing / dkon pa'i rin chen gser bye phul bas/ nga sa de /byed / /sna pa /sa / rdo/nab ༷ gapa lazhu /chordo di/spyang me/ ///sa 〈 //she skye skyos tshe khyod rang 'dod na yod do gsungs/ thal sbyar snyim pa kha bye ba'i nang gser (25na)rnams ma nyams pa byung / zhabs kyi ma bong 36

sa la brdab 〈brdabs 〉te rdo dang gseg ma gser du bsgyur/ thams cad gser gling yin no gsungs nam mkhar lta stangs ma da pa'i 〈pas 〉nya ro yid du 'ong ba zhig byung / de bshad pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo zasamachog ro brgya ldan pa byung / de nas ma ro pa puṣṭha ha rir spyan drangs/mi kun gyis mthong bar bzhugs te/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa bzhi pa dang / khyad par rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rnams lhag med zhus 'pho ba grong 'jugazhus/ pa'i tshe/ de khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉dran nam lung bstan byung gsungs/bdag la slob ma thos pa dga' bya ba zhig yod par lung bstan byung tshul zhus par byang phyogs mun gling la gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra'i skyes bu yo da par 'dug gsungs/ tshigs bcad kyi bsngaṭa brjod dang gus 'dud kyi tshu chi mdzad par/ ri dang rtsi shing nags tshal rnams bod phyogs su cha go gu sa byung / de nas dgyes rdor kyi dkyil 'khor bstan nas ngo spyod ma dzad pa na/ bla ma'i sngon la yi dam la phyag mdzad pas/ shā ro'i zhal nas/ rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal/ /chos rgyud chu bo'i gzhung las rings 〈ring 〉/ /zhes lung bstan dang zhal gdams mang du gnang / de nas bod du byon pas/ bu slob yon bdag rnams/ bla ma sku na smin kyang nyes med du bod du byon grub pa sa khyad par 'phags zer/bsu ba dang bkur sti dka' sgo (25 ba)bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ gro dza lung du bzhugs shing / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi bye tshul 'jig rten pa dang bstun nas/ nang rim gnyi sa kyis 〈kyi 〉rnal 'byor zab mos dus 'da' ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo du ma 'a/la gzigs shing / phug ron dang / lu gu sha ba la sogs pa'i ro la grong 'jug gi nyams sad par mdzad cing / na ro'i 〈ros 〉lung bstan pa ltar sras dar ma mdo sde/bdud kyi bar chad g.yos te chibs dbas 〈brdabs 〉kyi 〈kyis 〉mya ngan —7

las 'das pa na/phug ron la grong 'jug mdzad de/ rgya gar du nyi ku pa gsang sngags sdong por 〈po 〉bya bar gyur pa sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa dpag tu med pa ni/rnam thar mthong ba don yod du gesal ba las 'dir yi ger bri ba ma nus so/ de ltar gdul bya mtha' dag thogs pa'i mthar/ /dgung lo brgyad cu gya brgyad bzhes ma sprul pa bas bar dgongs nas/ /paṇa chen na ro pa nga bsu bar byon byung / mchod ba bshoms 〈shoms 〉zhes gsungs/ mchod pa bshams pa'i mthar/ yum bdag med la sprul pa bsdu ran gsungs nas sku lus ma spangs par thugs gar jim/ de nas spyan nam mkhar gzigs shing phyag thal mo sbyar nas/cung zad bzhugs pa'i mthar 'pho ba mdzad pas tshangs bug gi thad nas/dbu thod mtheb chen tsam yar 'phar/ ring bsrel las grub pa'i dgyes rdor rigs lnga'i sku rang byon du byon/ dbu'i (1 na)nang nas 'od dkar po rdza ma tsam zhig ji mthor song /nam mkhar yal/me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od sogs ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / sku gdungarngog gi 〈gas 〉sras rnams la 'bul ba dpag tu med pa phul nas/gzhung gi ri bo khyung lding du gdan drangs nas bzhu bas/ zhun zig las/ dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu/ bzo bo mkhas pas kyang bskrun 〈sgrun 〉mi nus pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ de nyid la slob ma'i tshogs grangs las 'das kyang / gtso bor gyur pa/ gzhung gi chag ston chos rdor/ dol gyi tshul ston dbang nge / gtsang rong gi me 〈mes 〉ston tshon 〈tshom 〉po/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa/ 'dam snying drung gi mar pa mgo logs dang lnga'o/bzod 〈gzod 〉nas dri bral shel gyi mchod sdong che/ /ltar snang nyes dris sngag 〈sngags 〉pa'i tshul bstan pa/ /smin grol bdud rtsis legs ga

bkrus mi la'i zhabs/ /rtogs pa'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar gyur cig /de ming gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gran zla dang bral ba rje btsun chem po 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul la stod gung thang gi grong khyer skya snga rtsa na yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan/ yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su chu pho 'brug gi lor sku 'khrungs mtshan thos pa dga' zhes (1 ba)gsol/ phyis lcam sring zhig byung ba po ta mgon skyid du grags shing / yu la der kun las phyug cing kha drag pa yod pa'i ngang las yab snyung gci/ btab te gshegs par ste ba na yab spun ming sring gnyis la phyi nang gi nor rnams bcol te phyi sa pha shul bu 'dzin gyi kha chems bzhag nas gshegs so/ de nas rim gyis sku bskyed cher bsrings pa na/ yum gyis yab spun dang yul der yod pa rnams bsdus te/ ya ba kyi zhal chems thab/ 〈bkags 〉te dor bcol po tshur sprod pa dang mdzes se gnyen du byas te khye / bzung dgos byas kyang ma nyan par phyi nang gi longs spyod rnams 'phrog 〈phrags 〉pa la/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa phul phyin thuṭa nyams su bzhes cing 〈shing /〉 der yum gyes yul mi rnams kyi bal las bkal ba'i glas nyid lcam sring bsos 〈gsos 〉te/slob dpon rnying ma ba gcig la yi ge bslabs shing / de'i tshe glu len cing byon bas srang mdor yu ma dang mja shā bas/ bu rang re ma smad las sdug ba la ba sa thog na med pa la khyod glu len pa dran pa rang 'dug gam zhes ngus bas/ nyid kyang thugs mug ste/ 'o na ngas ji ltar bya zhes gsungs bas/ yum gyis mthu 'dra bslabs na yong ngam zer bas/ der mthu slob par khas blangs te/ yum gyi na ca gang yod rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉rta gcigatshos ldang gnyis khug pa bskur nas/ gzhan nas yong pas 〈ba'i 〉ma grogs 'ga' zhig dang bcas gung thang (18na)gi smad bar yum gyi 3

(gyis 〉skyel thung byas rte/ bu khyod yu ba du lag rtsis ma byed par dgra rnams kha phung thim nges pa rem cig 〈zhi da 〉byas nas phan tshun phreng ba /na pa'i ngang la gyes te/ dbus gtsang du lam bar du thams cad las ma thu su che zhes dris pas/ yar klung gi g.yung ston khro rgyal che zhes thos par/ der byon nas phyag rten rnams phul te lo rgyus zhus pas/khyod kyi gtam de la brtag par bya gsungs/ slar g.yung ston pa'i 〈pas 〉mthu slob zer ba mang po byung ste/ khyod las snying rje ba ma byung bas nges par mthu slob dgos par 'dug gsungs nas/ 'bul chas dang yi ge bskur nas rta nag tu lha rje snubs chung gi drung du btang bas/ der phyag rten phul lo rgyus zhus pas/ sgrub khang btsan po zhig brtsigs nas der gza' gdong dmar nag gi drag sngags bslab 〈bslabs 〉nas bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉pas/ zhag bdun phrag gnyis la 'grub te 〈ste 〉bka' bsrung 〈srung 〉rnams kyis mi'i don snying dmar rtsa re ba sum cu so lnga khyer nas sgrub rten gyi mthar spungs pa gzigs/ der yul du pha spun rnams bag ston la tshogs pa'i dus cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas mkhar 'gyel ba'i stebs 〈ba bas 〉'og tu pho mo sum cu so lnga 'chi bdag gi lto bar bcug der yul mi rnams gros byas nas/ thos pa dga' gsod pa'i gshed ma btong 〈gtong 〉dgos zer bar/ yum gyis rnal 'byor pa zhig la thabs mkhas kyi 〈kyis 〉gser dang (18ba)yi ge bskur nas/ bu skyes pa la don byung mthus rtags thon/ da dung ser ba phob 〈phobs 〉zer ba'i yi ge zod nas/ slar g.yung ston drung du byon/ ser ba'i gdams ngag zhus shing sgrub nas/ yul du byon ser ba gyang rim gsum phab/ da dung phu ru gtad/ mda' ru sel byas nas yul khams brlag par byed do/ zhes zer ba'i ngag phrin btang bas/ kun 'jigs nas yum sogs 40

la 'tshe ba byed mi nus pa byung / de nas dbus su sa/yu ra sto ma — 'idrung du byon zhabs rtogs 〈tog 〉mdzad cing bzhugs skang sa sa byas ga byu sdis pa'i las la 'gyod nas chos zhig 〈shig 〉mdzad dgongs pa byur ba dang bla ma yang gzhan rkyen gyis skyo ba skyes pa dang / du mtshungs chos la 'bad pa bskul bar/ rgyags dang bcas gtsang rong gi rong sto ga lha dga'i drung du byon/ chos zhus nas bsgoms pas bla ma'i zhal pho la brten/ le lo'i ngang chos dang gang zag tha dad du song / der bla mas khyed rang chos snying nas byed na/ lho brag gro bo lung gi dgon pa na/rgya gar gyi grub chen 1 ro pa'i dngos slob sgra bsgyur 〈sgyur 〉mar pa lo 5 zhes skyes mchog 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig bzhugs pa der song /nig ces gsungs par mar pa'i mtshan thos ma thag mos gus bzod blag 〈glags 〉med pa byung / rtse gcig tu der snyegs ste byon nas/ lho brag gi mda' ru mi rna mas la 'dri bzhin byon pas/ chos la sgang nas gdan sa mjal ba dang byis pa 'ga' la dris pas/ (1 na)mi shes zer/gcig na re nged kyi a khu blo gros la zer ba 'dug khong ni lung pa 'di yiphu na yod zer bas der phyin pa'i tshe 'phru rlogs 〈slog 〉pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshon po gcig 'dug pa la/ mar pa lo tsha ba bya ba gang na bzhugs dris pas ci byed zer ba la/ chos zhu ba yin zhes zhib tu zhus bas/ lo myu ba nye lam zhig na yod de/ nga min pas mi shes zer ba la/11 14 :ri /dri 13 〈〈 1— /mi 11gas ma da par zhu smras pas/ sa sa ga ga na 'a na nas 'a tsharab dang grogs bya zer myur du brkos pas/ bu khyod la 'ong bar 'dug zer nas chang gcig kyang byin/ de nas sngags pa de nang du song ba'i rjes su 'bod mkhan byung bas phyin pa'i tshe/ lhan cig 'grog pa ga pa'i sngags pa de dang mjal bas tshom me lus pa'i tshe/ khyod 41

'dod pa/ de nga yin gsungs pas/ phyag 'tshal zhing lus ngag chad gsum 'bul ba mdzad/ lho brag ga mdar bsod stoms slong 〈bslangs 〉pa'i〈pas 〉zangs dkar lung bzhi ma gcig 7yon phul bags bar gyis rgyab 〈brgyab 〉cing mar khus brkang / gyis phung bstan mdzad/ chos gnangadagos zhu ba phul ba dang / la ga pa'i rshangan 'ga' res kho bo'i slob ma bcom pas/ ser ba dang mthu thong 〈thongs 〉gsungs pas/ ser ba phab mthu btang nas gdams pa zhus pas/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉ser ba rdog gsum phab pa la/ kho bos dka' las byas shing rgya gar nas blangs pa'i dam chos de e yong ngam gsungs gnang du ma 'dod/ de nas rje mar pasasku mkhar (30ba)brtsigasapa bzhed nas/ ri'i sna kun tu mkhar rlum po zla gam gru gsum la so /sa pa brtsigs 〈rtsig 〉tu bcug cing phyed tsam re longs pa na / sa sa mal/ rdo rdo ma pa skyel du bcug de nas mkhar dgu thog gru ba'i/ pa/ rtse mo ga'i ra yod pa gcig brtsis/sa pa'i tshe/nyid kyi sku stod la cho/ dang rnag khrag chu bo'i rgyun bzhin babs 〈'bab 〉 cing / sor mo rnams kyang ma dang skum por song / bar bar du yusabadag med ma'i me bus 〈'bud 〉thal phyags zho dkrogs tshun gyi zhabs tog sgrub par mdzad pas/ yum gyi thugs zin par byung ste/ yum gyis bla ma la chos zhu ngo sgron pa'i bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas/ bu mthu chen khyod spre'u'i 〈spe'u 〉lag ngar tsam brtsigs pa bas/ nga'i paṇa chen dra ro sades chos phyir dka' chen bcu gnyis/ dka' phran brgyad cu spyad pa yin/ kho bos kyang lus srog la ma bltas par rgya gar du phyin/ nor la ma bltas par gser 'phangs 〈phangs 〉med du ra ro pa sogs bla ma rnams la phul nas gdams pa zhus pa yin pas/ khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉yong ba dka' mo yin gsungs/ gtsang rong nas mes ston tshom pos bde 42

mchog dang / dol gyi tshul ston dbang nges gsang 'dus dbang zhu dus dang / rngog ston chos/ rdor gyis dgyes rdor gyi dbang zhu dus yum gyis dbang yon la g.yu gceg gnang nas phul ba'i tshe phyag 'phebs dang /dbang gral nas bston pa sogs bka' bkyon drag po mang du byung kyang 〈yang 〉ma dad pa (30na)cung zad tsam yang ma byes/ de nas/ mkhar gyi khyams dang bcas grub tu nye ba na/ tshes bcu'i nub rje mar pa phud kyis dad nas mnal du song ba'i tshe/ yum gyis 1 ro'i rgyan drug thugs dam padma'i phreng ba gnang nas/ phyag rtags yeg rdzus mdzad de rngog gi drung du bsdangs te chos zhus pas rngog shin tu dgyes/ mthu chen yong ba legs/ dol gyi yal mo bas nga'i 'brog ru khyer bas ser ba phob gsungs/ phab pas thams cad log 〈brlags 〉par gyur te/ shing phung gcig gi rtsa ba na byi'u'i ro mthu 〈thu 〉ba gang rnyed pa bla ma'i drung du spungs te/ nga chos la yong bas dmyal bar 'gro ba'i gting e zab blta ba 'dra ba cig 〈zhig 〉byung zhes bshum 〈bshums 〉pas bu bla ma'i don yin pas khyod la sdig pa mi yong gsungs nas se gol gcig rtog 〈gtogs 〉pas thams cad rtsi di〈da 〉ri bya rnams 'phur/ byi ba rnams sa la 'dzul song bar sems can la phan pa byung / de nas dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang nas bsgom 〈bsgoms 〉kyang bskyed ma byung bas/ rje mar pa'i bka' med pas lan par mkhyen/rngog pas sku gsung thugs rten phyi nang gi nor rdzas du ma bsnams te mar pa ri drung du sabul bar byon pa dang mnyam du byon/ sras mkhar gyi dga'aston la tshoṭa pa dang / rje mar pas bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur gsungs pa'i rjes su/ nyid dang rngog yum bcas la (30ba)bka' bkyon drag po gnang ba'i mthar/ bu khyod las can gyis 〈gye 〉slob ma yin/ kho 43

bos brdungs thag dang dka' spyad rnams khyod kyi sdig pa dag pa'i phyir bgyis pa yin/ da ngas rjes su bzung ste chos bgyi ba yin pas dga' bar bgyis (gyi ri 〉gsungs nas/ dbu lo bzhar te mtshan da je rgyal mtshan du btags/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i gsang mtshan bzhad pa rdo rjer btags pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs te/ 'dag sbyar gyi khongs nas gdan sa ngag ma lus nga gnang zhing / lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor lnga gnad nas/ ba khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉long 〈longs 〉gsungs/ de'i rjes su 1 ro pa'i gdams ngag rnams la lhag chad dang / phri bsnan yod re'i 〈ri'i 〉dbu byung bzhes nas/ shā ro pa'i lung bstan/ rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal/ chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung las ring / gsungs pa'i don/ rmi lam bka' 〈ka 〉bzhi'i mgur bu chen rnams lung bstan nas/nang par mi la'i snying gar phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉btsugs te kho bos rgya gar lan gsum bskor te dka' ba spyad pa'i chas rnams khyod la gtad do gsungs nas/ de nas sgrub pa ma bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyid rmi lam ngan pa'i rkyen gyis yum dran nas yul du 'gro bar zhus pa'i tshe/ khyod yul du song kyang 〈yang 〉ma dang mi phrad 〈'phrad/ 〉sgo nga ma'i drod la 'tshar dgos pa yin kyang / yun ring lon pa'i skyo ba (11na )gyur na song la/ yul du zhag bdun las mang ba ma sdod/ deng sang ba ste na pa'i snyigs ma tshe thung zhing bdud rigs kha rgyas pas/ yun ring gi long med/ g.ya' khrod dang gangs khrod 'grim zhing sgrub pa snying por long 〈longs/〉 re shig 〈zhig 〉rtsa rlung gi gegs cig 〈shig 〉yong bas de dus 'di ltos gsungs nas be bum gcig gnang nas/ bla ma yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas/brkos dkar la kha'i bar skyel ma mdzad/ phan tshun 'phreng ba'i skyo shas kyi44
