mchi ma /gang nas phyi 'gras kyis 〈kyi 〉ngang nas byon nas zhas/ gsum song bas yab yul du phebs pas tshangs mang 'gyel/ yul tham / cad dri za'i grong khyer lta bur song nas 'dug tshangs mang gi nang zhig tu sa'i phung po sdo skyes pa zhig 'dug par g.yengs pas/ yum gyi rus pa rnams skya seng nge thon par/ rje mar pas/ pha yul zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i slob dpon yod/ /zhes (ces 〉gsungs pa'i don nges / shes 'drongs nas thugs lhag par skyo bar gyur nas yum gyi rus pa la sa tsha btab/ de nas yul gyi rgyab rir phug pa zhig gi nang bsgom 〈sgom 〉nga tshe/ a ṇi'i drung bsod snyoms la byon nas/ sprang po brla 〈bla 〉tshong zer/ khyi bkye/ bor gas rgyab 〈brgyab 〉cing ko mog tu 'gyel ba'i tshe/gnyen 'dun la kho thag chod pa'i mgur ma rnams gsungs/ a khu'i rtsar byon pas/ mda' rdo'i la ra phab/ de nas brag (31ba)dkar spo mtho la byon nas zhim mngar zas kyi 'khri ba bcad de/ za'i 'tsho ba la brten nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus/ re zhig na lcam byung pre ta mgon skyid dang mjal/ der zang zas dang myur gsum gyi lhag ma drangs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun sku khams rtas 〈brtas 〉te sgrub pa brnyes so/ de nas brag dmar 'phyong lung du bgegs kyi rgya ba po bi na ya ga dam la btag/sa/ pa bla ma dran /gabye// 1de rtere rte( /mi/phyo /phyi drug ra gsungs/ nas bla ma bka' bsgrub sgrub ra la la byon nas lha chen tshogs bdag dam la btags pa la phyi chu bzang kyis 〈gi 〉bskor 〈skod 〉gsu ngas/ de'i phyi lo la phyi gnas mthil du byon pa la brten nas yongs su grags pa'i gangs mgur chen mor 〈mo 〉gsungs/ze/ nas bla ma'i bka' bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉phyir mang yul gyi ri bo dpal 'bar dang bal yul gyi yal mo gangs ra la 'byon dgongs nas/ slar yang gung zang la khyon pas ling ba brag la thug song ste der re shig —5

〈zhig 〉bzhugs pas ling ba brag srin mo'i zar gsu ngas / de nas re bo dpal 'bar gyi 'dabs rab ma byang chub rdzong du bse'i lha mo gcig dang rag ma' gzhi bdag dam la btags pa'i skor gsungs/ de nas rkyang phan na mkha' rdzong du bzhugs nas mi ma yin mang po la phan 'dogs mdzad/ de nas yol mo gangs ra la byon nas sing ga la yi nags gseb stag phug seng ge rdzong du bzhugs te/ der yang (31na)mi ma yin dang mi 'ga'i don mdzad/ der bod la song dang ri khrod dang dbon par sgom bzhen pa'i ngang nas 'gro ba'i don gyis shig bya ba'i lung bstan byung ba ltar bod la byon nas sku thang gi phug zhig tu bzhugs ste phug ron gyis 〈kyi 〉skor gsungs so/ gnyis pa thugs sras rnams dang mjal tshul sa/ de nas brag skya rdo rje rdzong du bzhugs nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad ma/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rje btsun la spyir gyis 〈rmi 〉bu slob rnams 'byung ba'i lung bstan/ khyad par mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag len pa'i slob ma ras chung rdo rje grags pa gnas dang bcas pa lung bstan te/ gung thang ra la'i phu za 'og phug tu bzhugs pa'i thugs sras ras chung pa dang mjal/ de nas ras chung pa rgya gar la bsnyun gzhi 'chos su byon nas/ yang dpon slob gnyis mjal te ron phu'i 'od gsal phug tu rtsa phu ras pa dang mjal/ de nas rag ma byang chub rdzong du byon pas ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs dang mjal/ de nas byon ) snya nam grod phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ snga nas dad bzhin pa skyo ston shākya gu ṇa la dbang dang gdams pa gnang nas smin grol la bkod/de nas byang stag sgo la byon tshe phar res gcung gi ga da pa gle gsum du nya ma dpal dar 'bum dang mjal/ tshur res g.ya sa ru (33ba)byang gi mgron khang zhig tsu se pan ras pa dang mjal/ de nas la stod rgyal gyi46

byu la sgom du byon pas 'arde sgom ras pa dang mjal/ de nas ston ro snyoms kyi ldom bu la byon pas chu mig dngul 'bum du ras pa zhi ba 'od dang mjal/— de nas spyom khung du spa lcags kyi skor la ngan rdzongs ras pa dang mjal/ de nas la phyi la bzhugs pa'i tshe bla mas lung bstan pa ltaramakha' 'gros bskul te ti se la byon pa'i lam du dam pa rgyag phu pa dang mjal/ de nas yar byon ste glo bo ke re pa thog gi skor la mkhar chung ras pa dang mjal/ de nas dgun spu rangs kyis 〈kyi 〉rong 'bri rtse'i gangs 'dabs su bzhugs dus ras pa dar ma dbang phyug dang mjal te/sos ti se la byon nas dra ro bon chung rdzu 'phrul gyis zi gyis mnan pa ti se'i skor/ de nas mar byon slar yang brag skya rdo rje rdzong du bzhuṭa nas rong chung ras pa dang mjal/ de nas mkha' 'gros bskul te byon pa'i lam du sbas phug ma mo rdzong gzigs/ der zhag shas bzhugs pas rdzi bo zhabs phyir 'brengs pa la lugs rdzi ras pa bya ba'i tog ldan bzang po zhigabyung / de nas la phug padma rjong du gshen sgom mas pa dang mjal te/phyis glang sgo klu bdud rdzong dang sbas phug ma mo rdzong du bzhugs tshe zhabs tog kyang phul du phyin pa phul ba yin/ de nas cog ro 'byung mtshams la byon pa'i skor la ras chung pa dang 'jal/ de nas mon snyi shangs 'gur (43na)rta la bzhugs tshe khyi ra ras pa dang mjal/ de'i stobs kyis rje btsun gyis gyi 〉snyan graṭa chen po bal yul (la )khyab pa dang / sgrol masalung bstan te bskul ba'i stobs kyis kho khom rgyal pos mchod par gyur/de nas ras chung pa dang gshen sgom ras pas spyan drangs nas la phyi'i mdosnyan g.yon thug tu bzhugs/ de'i phyi lo 'chong lung brag la bzhugs/de nas chu bar du byon pas tshe ring ba'i skor gsum rim par gsungs/de nas brin sding mar byon pa'i tshe ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug dang mjal/4

de nas rje btsun dpon slob kyis snya nam grod phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/rgya gad gyi dharma bo di dang bal po rdzong du mjal bas/ rje btsun la phyag phul/ des sdu bsod rgyas pa'i stobs kyis/ mtshan nyid kyi ston pa dar blos phras dog gis rtsod pa byas pa rdzu 'phrul dang nus pas bzlog pa'i skor/ de'i byem gyis ras chung te phu'i skor/ de'i bar la grod phug tu me bsgom 〈sgo ma 〉ras pa dang mjal/ snya nam gnag /khrar ras pa sa le 'od dang mjal/ de nas rje btsun brag dmar spo ma thor byon nas bzhugs pa las/ ras chung pa tshur byon pa gzigs nas bsu ru byon te/ g.yag ru'i skor dang skyang 〈rkyang 〉mgur gyi skor gsungs/ de nas chu bar du byon nas dwags po'i glan sgom ras pa dang mjal/ brin gyi sgo bde bkra shis/ sgang du/ sngo / bcom ldan (33ba)'das kyis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen po thuṭa kyi sras mchog dam par gyur pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla 'od gzhon nu sems canagyi don du mir sku skye ba bzhes pa mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang mjal/de nas chu bar gyi 'om chung na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngar rgol du byung ba'i lo ston dge 'dun dang mjal nas rjes su bzung / de nas skyid phug nyi ma rdzong na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ brin gyi bre ston bkra shis dpal dang mjal/ spyod pa mdzad tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi nang nas li bskor phya ru ba phyag phyir 'brengs nas mjal ba yin no/ rje btsun rin po che la mkha' 'gros mi'i bu slob rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉nang nas grub thob rang yang nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba lung bstan pa de rnams ni thugs kyi sras brgyad/nye ba'i sras bcu gsum/ de rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉sring bzhi rnams yin zhing de dag dang mjal tshul kun la skor tsho chen po re re yod pa lags so/de nas gsum pa kha 'thor ba sna tshogs kyi skor la/ nang dang gsang sha

zloshā pa/ / dbye// / / / shāXs dpasanya rna pa /bye /shā pa rdo rdo pasko ljo bye ༷༷ bye/sna ༷rdoX byeX /rdo bye sa/ / /shā/ / /bye //de /shesaX kau / byerdo tshag ma'i skor/ de nas ras chung pa dpon slob gnyis la phyi la byon tshe zlo/ rdo 'a/rdzu sna / / mdabye sna mapa ngas ral/ byo/ rdodī / ram/ rnams bye spya rdo drangs te/ snya nam grod phug tu bzhugs tshe/ rje btsun rang gi rnam thar gsungs / de rjes ras chung dbus bzhud kyi skor/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyis mtshams sbyar te thong lar dam pa dang mjal ba'i skor/ las zhing du gshin don thugs rje'i lcags myu dang yum gyi drin lan gsab pa'i skor/ rtsar ma'i nya ma sogs snya nam pa rnams la mjug gi zhal chems kyis 〈kyi 〉skor/ de nas chu bar du byon pa'i khor 〈skor 〉la ding rir lha rje g.yang nge'i skor/ chu bar du phebs nas dbus bzhud phyi ma'i skor/ brin lha bror yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs kyi skor/brin brag mkhar du mdzes se 'bum dang khu byug la sogs te nya ma spyi'i skor/ brag dmar sgo mthor bdud bzhi las rgyal ba dang sngags pa'i zhus lan gyi skor/ bu slob yongs la sgo ba skyed pa bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul spra 'isko bye ral tshoso /shā / zlong pa sna bgra / 'ipa sgod/ pa sa/'a sdus dīpa dīXralda rdosko bye skyes bu dbang po rab rnams smin zhing 〈cing 〉grol bar (34ba)mdzad pa sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa dpag tu med pa rnams ni mgur 'bum rgyas pa nyid du blta bar bya ba las 'dir mdor bsdus sa

tsam las yi ger 'bri ba ma lang ngo / de ltar mdzad pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mthar/ snya nam du dge bshes rtsa phu ba bya ba zhib gis rje btsun la phrag dos skyes nas// rang gi lus 'brel gyis 〈gye 〉mdzes mo zhig la gla rngan byin nas zho la sbyar dug bstob te zhus pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis khyod la sdig pa mi yong khyod kyi rngan pa thob 〈'thob 〉phyir kho bo 'chi tshul ston pa yin gsungs nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhesapa'i/ shing yos da na za tha chung gi mas bcu bzhi'i nyin snga thun dang po la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su thim mo/ de'i tshe lha dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dngos ba mi mthong bar/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang / me tog gachar thag nyer bol nub tsam/ ring sar sa mdog 'gyur tsam babs pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas shing spur bzhu tshe ras chung pa rtson par me byu phyag gis mnan nas/ bsnyun bral gyi skur bzhengs ste/ mas chung pa yar shog gsungs pa dang gsung mgur yang mdzad cing / blar sku yal ba'i tshul bstan te rten yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon mod kyang / spur rdor 'bru gsum rang byon zhig ma gtogs rten tsam du ma zad spur khang gi sa rdo tshun chod (35na)kyang mkha' 'go ma rnams kyis dar gyis 〈kyi〉mdo lir btegs te mkha' spyod snye gdan drangs so/ 'di nyid la slob ma/ ras chung rdo rje grags/ ras pa zhi ba 'od sogs mang du yod cing sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gcigs pa lngatsamasang bar gags so/lta spyod sgom pa'i gzhung lugs 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shis man snya ras srub pa/ /rgyal bstan gsal mdzad mnya / med sgam po pas/ /bka' phyag chu bo gcig tu 'dres gyur cig /rje btsun bzhad la sa rje'i slob ma 'ams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa nyi ma lta byu'i sa

mi lam na bzhi'i brda' 〈brda 〉'khrol las kyang / rgod de la bu zhig byung ba ni/ 'gran gyi do med 8/ga 〈cig 〉yong ba'i rtags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba ni rje sgam po pa chen po 'pham gling grags pa yin te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan cing chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes dang / zla 'od gzhon nu sogs su gyur kyang / bod yul du sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel phyir/de yang / mtshungasamed chos kyi rje dwags po lha rje 'khrungs pa'i yul ma/ri bo gangs casagyi dbus kyi cha/ dmyal kyi se ba lung zhes bya ba/ bkra shis dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa der snyi ba'i riṭa las yab (35bste snyi ba rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / yum gyi rus la mtshan du gsol na yang ngal bza' zhes bya ba gnyis/ 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i sras su sku mched bzhi 'khrungs pa'i/ bdag sted chen po 'di chu stag lo (pa )yin cing 〈zhing 〉lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du khyem thabs mdzad de/ sras ming sring gnyis kyang yod cesagrags/ dus re shig 〈zhig 〉na yul der nad lams chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung bas/ sras ming sring gnyis kyang mabar byed kyis 〈kyi 〉sto bar song bar gyur to/ de'i dus jo mo yang bsnyung nas 'chi lathug pa'i tshe khyim thabs la yid chags pa'i dbang gis/ kho mo ni 'chi ba 'dug khyed chung ma mdzes ma gcig len sang zer ba'i lan du kho bo rab tu byung bar byed pa yin gsungasashing dbu byungabazhes pas/ jo mo yang tshe'i dus byas so/ de nasathugs skyo ba'i tshul bstan rte/ dge ba'i bshes ba/nye / sha wa gling pa'i drung du rab tu byung zhing mtshan bsod nams rin chen ba/so/la/ bshes gnyen de dang bya 'du pa ba 'dzin pa chen po'i drung du/ bka' gdamasagazhung drug 'dul ba la sogs sdosgod kyi chos la byang bar mdzad de 5

— mang yul blo ldan shes rab la 'khor lo bde mchog ge dab / rgyud grub yig dang bcas pa gsan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya yul ba dang /lcags ri gong kha ba dang / snyug rum pa (35na)rnams la jo bo'i gdams ngag gi skor ma lus pa gsan cing / bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la blo gros kyi snang ba phyogs med du rgyas par mdzad de/ yab mis bzang po'i phyag rjes/ las legs par grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang las 〈la 〉'gran par nus pa zhig yod pa'i nang du/sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i 〈pas 〉rmi lam dang / mngon sum du 'phabs pa sa bcu pa dang / gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i rtags rnams rim par byung zhing / de'i dpyid na lcags ri'i steng du skyo sangs la byon pa'i tshe/ sprang po gsum gyis smon pa'i gnas la brten nas/ rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i mtshan thos pas/ sred ldan gyis (gyi 〉khye'us lha'i dga' ma'i lang tsho mthong ba dam/ dri gzhon gyi tshogs kyis ku shu'i 'dabs 〈'dab 〉ma skyo da pa bzhin du yid long long por gyur te/ mig mchi mas gang ba'i dad nga 'i shugs chen po g.yos nas/ yun ring por 'gro ma shes shing ci byed dang 'di byed kyi btol 〈gtol 〉ma rnyed de/ de nas gom pa gya tsho du 'dor zhing rang gi gnas su phyin nas/ thugs dam gyi ba/tso bo ya na lag bdun pa mdzad pa yang 'phro gtor zhing song nas/ bdag yi sems/ 'di lta bu 'chang 〈'phyang 〉mo nyug tu gyur pa cis lan pa yin da /ngas shing (35ba)gzim mal du byon nas zab mo'i rnal 'byor la bzhu ri nga 'i dus su sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ phyi rol yul gyi snang ba rnams kyang to nga 'i ngo bor shar/ sems can thams cad kyi sems rgyud kyang shes pa snyam byung / de nas thugs nam 52

las bzhings nas sngar gyi sprang po gsum po de tshol 〈'tshol 〉du phyin pas/masan khang zhig yod pa der nyal nas 'dug pa la dri ba byas pa sa/ khyedatsho de ring gleng ba'i grub thob de gang na bzhugs/ de'i bla ma su yin/ chos ci gsung / khong la yon tan gyi khyad par ci yod gsungs pas/ rgan pa de na re/ khong mang yul gung thang bya ba na yod zer/ khong gi bla ma mar pa lo tsā ba zhes bya ba des/ tsā ro paṇa chen la thug te 〈ste/〉 de'i chos dra ro chos drug bya ba dgyes rdor gyi gdams ngag yin zer zhing / mi phal cher mjal du 'gro yi 'dug ste/mthong snang kyang 〈yang 〉mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma zhig 'ong ba 'dug zer/ nged kyi ma ma mjal zer bas/ der zan chen po gsum dang lo tshode mang pos/ khong rnams la bsnyen bkur bzang po byas te/ de nub rje btsun la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab cing nyal ba'i rmi lam du/deng sa nga dbus gtsang na 'di bas che ba'i rag dung med zer ba zhig bus pas/ skad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad khyab pa dang / rnga bo che brdung ba dang / bud med gcig na re mi rnams la rnga brdungs (34na)'di ri dwags rnams la byin cig zer bas/ 'o ma thod pa gang gtad la mi khyer snyam pa'i tshe/ khyod rang 'byung 〈thungs 〉dang ri dwags mi tshad pa 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la khyod yongs 〈yong /〉 nga sa nub phyogs su 'gro ze ra ba cig 〈gcig 〉mis nas/ nang par rnal 〈mnal 〉sad nas 'byon par thag bcad de/ pha zhing btsongs bas gser srang do dang / ja zi phol srang gang khug pa bsnams nas/ sngar gyi bla ma rnam sa la rim ba ra phyi phyag skyel du phyin pas/ zangs nged kyi 〈kyis 〉brdungs nas zangs skad gzhan gyis 'don pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug te 〈ste 〉thabs re da/ rma la phan na khye mtshil yin na'ang yin/5

nged kyi cha luṭa ma dor bar shog cig gsungs pa'i snang 〈gnang 〉ba thob nas/ rim pa ltar byon pas rje btsun gyis 〈kyi 〉bzhugs gnas dang nye ba'i grong bkra shis sgang bya ba zhig tu phebs pa'i nub mo/ na mo zhig la bla ma'i lo rgyus rnams dris pas/ mo na re/ kho mos kha sang rje btsun gyi drung du phyin pas/ rje btsun gyis (gyi 〉zhal nas/ bu dbus pa ston pa 'byon gi 〈kyi 〉yod pas/ kho bo dang phrad 〈'bod 〉pa'i mtshams sbyor sus byas pa de ngan song sha 'jigs pa las skyob par nus so/ gsungs pas/ nga'i bu mas mjal sna byed pa yin zer bas/ kho bo sdod ldan gcig yin mar 'dug snyam ba'i nga rgyal skyes ma bla mas mkhyen nas za ba phyed kyi bar du (1 ba)mjal kha ma byung bar/se ban ston chung gi 〈gis 〉sde len cung zad byas te/ de nas kro bde bkra shis sgang du mjal nas gser dang ja'i 'bul ba byas pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gser dang ban rgan lo mi mthun/ /ja la bskol ba'i thab chas med/ /khyed rang sgrub pa'i rgyags mdzod cig /ces gsungs nasatshur gnang ngo / de nas rje btsun gyis khyod kyi ming ci yin gsungs pa la/bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pas/ bsod nams bsod namasabya ba lan gsum gsungs pa'i rjes su/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung / /sems can kun gyi rin po che/ /gsungs zhing 〈shing 〉nang mchod bzhes 'phro na pā li gang gnang bas/ dge slong gi rtogs 〈rtog 〉pas bcings nas cung zad ze tshom pa'i gnas su gyur pa la/ bu khyod rnam rtoshā ma mang bar 'di la rol cig gsungs pas/ som nyi paras te lhag ma med par gsol te/ dus der bla mas rgyud 'dzin gyi gdams pa'i sdod du dgongs par mngon no/ de nas ston pa sde len gyis (gyi 〉mgur ma bzhengs nas/ rim pa ltar bla ma'i phyag phyi 〈phyir 〉54

'brengs nas sman lung chu pa ra du byon pa 'i tshe/ bla ma'i 'a/la nas/khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉dang nga bskur dang gdam sa pa 'dra thob bam gsung ba la/dbang bskur thob lus/ri ga sogs/ 'i/ba par zhus pas/ sngar gyi dbang da da gdams pa rnams zab (38na)mor 'dus kyang / nga rang gis 〈gi 〉 tsaṭa kyi byin rlabs bya gsungs nas/ sin rdu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i lhan skyes jo mo'i dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ nga la zhag bcan tsam mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod zhus pas/ ha ha bye ma btsir ba la mar khu mi 'a nga / til btsir ba la mar khu 'byung ba yin/nga'i gtum mo sa byung bsgom 〈sgoms 〉dang gsungs zhing 〈shing 〉 gtum mo'i man ngag rnams gnang nas nyin med mtshan med du sgoms nas/ du ba lta bu la sogs pa'i rtags bcu rim gyis rdzogs par gyur te/ yon ston brgyad la dbang 'byor ba'i rmi ltas sogs kyi mtshan ma byung ba rnams zhu don mgur ma'i tshul du phul ba'i tshe/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don byung 〈'byung 〉ba la sogs ma 'ongs lung bstan gyis 〈gye 〉mgur ma mdzad pa'i rjes su/ rmi lam dang mngon sum gyi bltas 〈ltas 〉gang la yang mchog tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri ba chod la/ 'di rnams yid la zhog la bden rdzun ltos shig mi rgan nga la'ang tshig tsam ma yi na pa'i dad gus (gyis )dang / khyod rang gis kyang sems kyi ngo bo da gzod mthong nas zlordo / /sbyardo /rdzun/ soga~X bye / / / / /ljo da/ cing shā/rdo /sbyo /rdo pa/ma dro rab 'byams gzigs shing / khyad par gza' (18ba)rta rnga tsam gcig /sdu /ma gas/ /sa dug/shā /// 〈cigapho cas sheX/ / zlo/ /// pa'i // da sna byu —ba la gnyis gsum gsungs pa'i rjes su dbyus su gshegs la 55

sgrub pa mdzod/ re shig 〈zhig 〉mngon par shes nga/'i 'phrang yod pas de la gzab par mdzod/ khyod kyi sgrub gnas dang gdul bya sgam po dar gyi ri la yod/ ces gsungs shing / de nas dbus su 'byon pa la slob dpon thams cad kyis skyel thung mdzad de mgur ma yang gsungs nas/ dus der dge slong 'dzam gling grags par mtshan gsol/ zhib rgyas kyis 〈kyi 〉zhal ta snying gtam du ma yang gsungs/ da ni khyod la gdams ngag zab mo gcig yod gsungs nas/ pha bong gcig gis 〈gi 〉rtsar khrid te 〈de 〉na bza' zlog 〈slog 〉ste spre'u'i phongs 'dra ba'i sha ros gang ba de bstan nas 'di ltar byas nas stan thog gcig tu sdod dgos pa yin/ mi gzhan la ma bshod 〈shod 〉gsungs pa'i rjes su/yos lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la brim 〈brin 〉dang snya nam gyi mtshamasasu cis kyang slob pa gyis shig gsungs nas yab sras so sor gyes te dbus su byon nas 'ol kha dang dmyal du rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pa las/lan gcig thugs dgongs btang bas bla ma'i gsung dran nas dus yol bar dgongs shing byon pa las yar klung gi mdar/ rje btsun (36na mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gtam dang / na bza'/ phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉dang bcas pa bskur bar tshong pa rnams kyis 'phrod de/ mya ngan gyis gdungs pas brgyal zhing bog par gyur pa cung zad sangs pa'i (tshe )smon lam zhal mjal gyis (gyi 〉gsol 'debs mdzad cing gser srang gang brin dang snya nam gyi phyogs su gtor te/ slar yang dmyal du log nas byon sngar lam du/ sprul pa'i bu mo gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / longs spyod kyi mnga' thang rgyas ba ltar 'dug pa zhig gisabasnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byas nas/ dmyalagyi se ba lung du lo zug dang / 'ol kha dge lung bya bar lo bcu'i bar 56

du chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs shing / 'khor 'das chos kun rmi lam sgyu mar gzigs te smos bral gyi ye shes mngon du gyur/ grub pa mnyes 〈brnyes 〉te rje btsun nyid kyi lung bstan te dwags lha sgam po'i ri la sgrub gnas btab te 〈ste/〉 dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dad pa dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ padma'i mtsho la ngang pa'i tshogs bzhin du 'dus par gyur te/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor los rang rang gi yid kyi rkang drug tshim par mdzad de/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyis 〈kyi 〉bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal ba ma da/dus gcig tu sku'i bkod pa du ma (tra ba)bstan pa dang / rab gnas mdzad tshe byang chub chen po'i skur bstan pa/ gzhan yang thugs rje chen po sogs yi dam gyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems sogs (kyi )skur bsgyur ba dang / chos gos nyi zer la 'gel ba/ zad par sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs tshe de dag dngos su mthong ba/ gtsang po'i steng du gsang ba bstong nasaphar gshegs tshur gshegs mdzad pa dang / lhung bzed nam mkhar 'jog pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyis 〈kyi 〉cho 'phrul du ma ston par mdzad pa'i rjes su/ da ni kho bos bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che ni byas/mig dang bral ba'i 'gro ba rnams la shes rab kyi snang ba ni phyogs med du rgyas par byas/ lus 'di 〈'dis 〉dngos su 'dul bar bya ba'i gdul bya rnams ni yongs su rdzogs/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don du rang bzo spangs te don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos ni byas/ kho bo la ltos pa byis pa'i bu slob rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa/ kho bo rang shes pa yin pas/ khyed rnams ca ngan bya mi dgos zhes gsungs shing bka' chem 〈chems 〉byon nas/sa

mnyam pa med po'i bla la de nyid dus kyi rgyal bo bya lo shar ba'i tshe/ hor za drug pa'i tshes bco lnga re ji thun dar pos/ sku'i dkyil 'khor sprul po'i gnas su bsdu bar mdzad pha'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rim pa ni/ 'tha'i (402)rgyur rol mo'i sgra/ me tog gis 〈gi 〉char la so pa sgoms kyis skye dgu rnams kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad cing / zugs myugs dang ring bsrel gyi tshogs rnams kyang / mtha' yas pa'i sims can rnams tshogs gnyis kyi longs spyod dpag tu med pa dang ldan bar zu ba'i phyir du byon zhing / ring bsrel rnams ni deng sang gi bar du yang rim pha bzhin 'phel bar rgyur to/ dam pa de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉na sas zug pa rnams rig can yin kyang / shi ba'i ma phung por 'ja' zug pa/ mi tog gi char sogs ltas bzang po byung ste/ gang gi thugs rjes ngan song las gro la te thar pa'i lam sna zin pa sha sag gothug pa 'khor 'jigs 〈'jig 〉zugs bskyed gangs ri las/ /byugs rje'i nyal 'gro'i sgron bza nyag babs pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i tshal chen gyis mdzad dzi/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i 〈pos 〉nges snying sgon me gsal/ /mnyam med sa po pa de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉slob ma'i gtso bo sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs 〈'jig 〉gi rnam 'phrul rtsod byud du graṭa pa 'gro mgonaphag mo gra pa sa/ mdo khams gre mdor zhes bya ba'i sa'i thig le 'bri phung mi shod sa ba der/ ris dang yab la mtshan du gsol ba sbas sa dar zhes bya ba bkren zhing 'phongs 〈phongs 〉la 'tsho ba ma dag pa'i rigs su rgyus ga lor 'khrungs te/ sngon gyi (40pa)dus su gaṭa kyi nang du spre'ur 'khrungs nas/ sbrul gdug tsan 'asar ba'i rnam min gyis da lta ya tshugastod la gzer zug 'byur ba dar / sngon gyi gnas du ma zhig rjes su dresate/ dkur lo gsu gyi ya byu gyi cha sha drangs phas 'gre par snyor tsho

to/ de nas phra sha du — nga ri ma kyang pa/ya nga 〉'a cha ba / ga da cho sangs par gyur pa'i 'os tu/ dgung lo dgu lo na pa'i tshe/ mkham sa / tshul khrim sa 'bar gyi drung du rab tu byung bar mjad de/ ma/tshan nga/ga rdo rje rgyal por gsol bar gyur nas rim kyis yis / klog dang lha res la so/gas la byang bar gyur nas/ sku lus kyang tsham/ pe che dri ma med pa'i stobs dang ldan par gyur zhing / yongs 'dzin bcu drug gi 'a/bas spyi bor blangs te mdo rgyud kyi don la sbya ngas shing / dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/sbas rdo rje dang sdongs nas dbus su byon pa'i lam du/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba la sogs pa yi dar du ma'i khya/la gzigs shing / rim gyis gsang phu'i gtsug lag khang du phyonanas/ dge ba bshes gnyen stod lung rgya dmar ba'i zur du ga na la phab nas/ phar tshad dang dbu ma'i tshogs la mkhas par mdzad de/ zur chos ca/ rams la yang gsan pa mdzad do/nge shig 〈zhig 〉migs mched raga'i rkyen la brten nas 'brog pa'i g.yag brkus ste/ bshes gnyen cha pas ram 〈ra 〉mda'i don du byon pa la rig pa chen po bsaṭa (dzi na)te/ lo du ma'i bar du bshags pa mdzad cing /phyis dgung lo nyer lnga pa la zur phu'i gtsug lag khang du/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen pos mkhan po ma da cing / stod lung rgya dmar bas slob dpo na dang lar gyis gsang ste mdzad/ dge 'dun grangs tshang gis 〈 〉dbus su/ bstan pa la yongs su rdzogs/ par mdzad do/ de'i rjes su mkhan slob de rnams kyi mdun du 'dul ba'i sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol cu son par mdzad de/ mkhas pa'i grags pas ni sa steng thams cad khyab par gyur te/ gsung rab kyi don ca/ ngoms/ pa med pa'i brtul zhugasakyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya yul ba la so gas pa'i mkhas pa rnams la bka' gdams gzhung drug gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa ma

1de bye pa — 14 /dza 11 ste sa nas/ —/ ga da ra sa/ tsa rgyal la/ dra pa nas brgyud pa'e bde mchog rtsa rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i don rams chub par mdzad de/ de 'og tu dpal chen po sga lo'i drung du/ bde mchog lha lnga/dpal ye the/sa mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub dkyil/ man ngag dang bcas/ pa ma lus pa gsan cing / gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes ga na kun dga' snying po/ bu sgom/ jo mo lha rje la so gas la las 'bras kyi skor rnams gsan/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ nyang sgom sangs rgyas/ dmyal chung rnams la gsang ( /ba)sngaṭa kyi gnad du ma 'dus pa/thabs lam gyi skor rnams gsan pa'i tshe/ ngam shod ri nag gi drung du 'gro don du ma yong ba'i lung bstan khyad par can yang thob/ de nas rgyal ba thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ lnga brgya pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la/ yan lag mchog gi gtsug gi nor bus btud de/ maṇḍal phul zhing dad pa'i yid kyis klu dbang mchi ma'i rgyun gyis gnang 〈b.rangs 〉bzhin/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa lhag par skyes/ sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams dang lhag par zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod tshul zhus pas/ de la yon tan du brtsi'am gsungs zhes lan gsum gsungs mthar/ de bas zan rdog 'di tsam zhig mi dga' ri zhes/ phyag brda' 〈bad 〉dang bcas pa mdzad pas/ zhi gnas kyi nyams thugs 〈mthug 〉po de hrul gyi zhig da khyod rang pha gi'i khar sdod la sem/sa ma bcos par mnyam par bzhog 〈zhog 〉gsungs pa sa// phyag rgya chen po'i don gyis 〈bye〉ye shes ma ngo na du gyur/ gzica spyil gnyis 'ja' 'od kyis 'brel zhing / cha ri tha sa cad kyi yin lugs ma nor bar byugs su chud/sgom po nyid du bzhubs ga sa/ nyid dang / dus ba/sum mkhyen pa/ sgom pa tsa —

sha ston gsu ma la khams pa mi gsum du graṭa shing / bas nga/ (42na)gso ba sogs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan/ mnyam med dwags po zhing gzhan du gshegs nas kyang / lo gcig bar du bzhugs/ shing dgongs rdzogs kyi 'bas tog mdzad/ de nas bla ma sa lung bstan nas dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du byon/ brag kha ba'i btsad pos sbyin bdag bgyis ste/ gdan sa chen po dpal gyi phag mo gru'i dgon gnas btab ste/ 'phrin las tshad med pa rgyas/ slob ma gdugs thogs lnga brgya 'dus/ 'bri stag 'brug pa/ tshal pa/ g.yem 〈g.ya' 〉bzangs/khro phu/ khams su dmar g.yel sogs bka' brgyud thams cad kyi chu mgo lta bu yin cing yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po gshen grong pa dang mjal ba'i dus su/ mnyam med bla ma rin po che dwags po lha rje dang /sa chen zhal sprod mdzad pa'i dbus su dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku bris pa'i ras bris gcig yod pa gshen grong pas gzigs nas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/dam pas tshe rabs du mar rjes su bzung / khyad par du/ ga nyang stod rtsibs kyi lha khang du zhi byed rmang lam la soṭa pa'i gdams pa du ma gnang nas/ rje sgam po pa dang / sa chen gnyis tshe rabs du ma'i bla ma yin/zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang 'gro ba'i mgon po (42ba)'das/ bram ze chen po dang / 'phags pa thog med dang / shasnya de wa dang / za ba'i zhabs/ la sogs pa'i grub chen du ma dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mal sogs pa'i yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs shing gsung byon nas/ skabs der dad pa dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams la rang rang gi snod dang mtshams 〈'tsham 〉pa da/ thub pa'i dbang po dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyugadapal 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul gyis 〈kyi 〉bkod pa du ma bstan te/ dgung lo zhe dgu nas sprul pa'i gnas su gshegs kyi ba ra 61

/pa 14 /) 〈(/) )mi 11/) /sgo 15/re du ra thams cad sa snga du sa tha ma chams dang / du sa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor ra sa zhe/du pa bya rnam sa smin par mdzad cing / mar ngo'i dus thams cad du bslab pa sa/sum gyis 〈rgya 〉bcas pa phra mo tshun chad ( nan tan du mdzad/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam gyi srol 'byed par ma dzad do/ de nas dus re shig 〈zhig 〉na sku des dngos su 'dul bar bya ba'i gdul bya rnams rdzogs par ra/khyen nas/sdon gyi rnam par smin pa mi 'dor ba'i tshul ston par bzhed de/ lus med kyi gnas nas 'phangs pa'i me tog gi mdas snying la zin pa'i mi zhig gis/ zhal zas la sbyar dug btab nas drangs pa'i mthus sku che'i 'du byed gtong ba'i dus la 'bab pa'i tshe/ skyo ba'i shugs kyis yid bskul zhing snying ste ba'i nye (43na)gnas kyis zhus pa/ dmyal ba'i bud shing du gyur pa'i/sdig can 'a lta bu'i skyabs su su zhig 'gyur/ zhes pa'i lan du/'a lha bu'i sems can ma rungs pa'i gnyer kha kho bo la babs pas/ dgeslong gi dge 'dun rnams la 'di'i don du bsnyen bkur zhing / rka ga nil sog pa'i gzungs zags khyad par can rnams zhus shig gsungs nas la —slong gi tib nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing lam bgrod de/rnal shabyor dang rjes su mthun pa'i rtag rnams rdzogs par gyur te/ dgung—4/0 1rdo / 14 ———4 /) 14 cu ga ga lcags stag / rgyu skar rgyal gdu bus nya ba tshes bcu drug gi dgong mo/ dad pa dang da // pa'i nye gnas rnam la bka' stsal 〈bstsal 〉pa/ kye ma 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ma'i mang gi mtshan nyid ston pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyang mar dang shu pa'i wab 〈gra sa 〉mdzod la/ phung khrol gyi rtsa ba nor la ma chags spyashā tshu/spya ga // /// / / rdo /sna / /rdo / snan ba zlo/ /〈kyi |rnyi/ dīrdo rje 63

rtogs 〈rtog 〉par lam sbyongs/ kho bo'i rnam shes kyi byi chung 'phur ba la thugs khral mi 'tshal te/ khyod rang dad pa dang ldan pa rnams shar phyogasardul dang bral ba'i zhing kha /sa su kho bo ma sangs rgyas mi bskyod rgyal po'i 'bas/ drung du/ byang chub (43ba)sems dpa' blo gros dri ma mid pa zhes bya ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen por gyur pa 〈'gyur ba 〉de la sa/sol ba thob cig ces soṭa/ gsung rnams rim pa ltar du byon zhing / nyer lnga'i nang par tshoṭa kyi dkyil 'khor du byon nas/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi sgo nas dad pa dang ldan pa rnams (la )zhal bkod gnang cing 〈zhing 〉snga dro'i cha la mdzad pa'i mtha' ma bstan par gyur to/ de'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul byung ba sa/ sa g.yo zhing 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang / spos kyi ngad ldang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul gyi 〈rgyas 〉skye dgu rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉yi da 'phrog par mdzad do/gzhan yang ring bsrel dang yig 'bru'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ ma sa ste/ rgyal dbar shākyas gzigs pa lngas gzigs tshe/ /rgyal bstan slar yang ches cher spel dgongs ste/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam par skur sprul pa/ /rgyal dbang ratna shrī gus phyag 'tshal/ /dpal phag mo grub pa la slob ma gdugs thob pa lnga brgya yod kyang rgyal tshab tu ma 'os pas/ kho bo'i gdan sa 'di dge bsnyen sa bcu pa zhig gi 〈gis 〉'dzin pa yin zhes yang yang gsungs pa ltar/ mnyam med mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po 'di nyid byon tshul la gdung rab 〈rabs 〉dang sku 'khrungs ( na)tshul / mdzad pa'i rnam thar soṭa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las dang po yab mes rgyud pa ji ltar byon pa ni/ bod kha ba can 'dir 'phags pa gsan ras gzigs kyi gdul bya'i zhing dnge byin rlabs kyi mthus/ ho/'u

gdong drug gi nang tshan mi'u rigs bzhi dang sbyar na bram ze'i rigs btsan po 'gru bam/ yang na byas pa lag rjes can 'gru zhes (pa'i )rigs la sa / 'gru stag rgod bya ba 'dzam bu blang du phyug pa zhig byung ba la bu bdun yod pas pha la gos khyad 'phags sgon rgyu'i sram/ gyi phying pa gleng 〈glings 〉nas za thog tu bzhag pa rlung gis khyer nas mtsho nang du thong ba bu bdun gcig la gcig 'chang / phyi mas/ ma 'e sna thag la 'jus pas mdzo sna bol te bu bdun mtshor bying bas/ 'gru mi rabs chad khar mdzo sna bol/ zhes pa byung / gru 〈'gru 〉stag rgod rgan por gyur na'ang / slar rongs bza' blangs pas bu gsum byung ba'i ming 'grunyi ma dkar nag khra gsum zhes/ de yang 'gru mi rabs chad khar kun par nyal ba'i bu byung nyi ma nag po/ res mis mthong res sbas skabs bu nyi ma khra bo/ dngos su nyi mar sdad 〈bsdad 〉pas bu nyi ma dkar po zhes grags/ 'gru ) ma dkar po la dpa' bo so gad/ ya gad/ ma gad byaba'i sras gsum byung ba'i/ che ba so gad rang lo nyi shu lon pa'i dus shar rma chen sgom ra'i (44ba)mgul du phyin pa na/ khrus kyi rdzing bu'i 'gram du nam mkha' nas bya rgod mang po 'phur byung bar/ grubs bu rnams phud /de /ri /tho / /sto lha bu gzugs byad phun sum gas pa byas khrus byas nas/ slar sngar gyi blubs bu so sor bzhugs 〈zhugs 〉te 'phur song ba las so gad kyis grubs bu gcig bzung bas lha'i bu mo gzugs byad can gcig lus byung ba la/ thabs shes kyi sbyor ba mdzad nas blubs bu gtad pa na/lha'i bu yo de blubs bur bzhugs 〈zhugs 〉te cung zad nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ de ring nas bzung zla ba dgu 'das pa'i ngo bcu'i nya tshes la gnas 'dir bu len du shog zer nas 'phur song ngo / der so gdakyis za grangs bzung nas tshes btsa lngar byon pa na/ nam mkha' 'ja' (4

'od 5 〈cas 〉sang zhing me tog sgo char dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang bcas te lha 'i bu dang du mo dpag tu med pas nam mkha' gang zhing /thog mar bya spu btags kyi bla breng 'phangs nas bzed cig ces pa'i sgra dang / de bzhin du g.yu 'brug nga na mo'i ze ba/ seng ge dkar mo'i g.yu ral/ gi'u dkar mo'i pag pa rnams 'phangs nas 'di dag stan du thing zhig khyod kyi rgyud pa'i no nga chen yin no/ zhes dang / khyod rang gi bu song yod/ ma 'ong pa na 'di'i rigs rgyud kyis sems can mang po'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ zhes lung bstan dang bcas te lha'i bu lha rdzas du mas rgyan 〈brgyan 〉pa zhig nam mkha' nas bsgyur byung ba la/ rgyalachen bzhis bzed grogs byas pa na/ so gad shed chung bas bla bres kyi snashor nas lha 'i bu sa la lhung ste mthe'u chung chad pas myu ra sor dgu pa lta ga po che gnam sbyin dpo ra po zhes grags/ de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉gdung rigs yar bzang 'brom sa/sum zhes gdung rigs gsum 'das pa na/ldan gyi yu la grong khyer tso du na byu ra'i rigs/ de nyid las sa mes tshulakhrims rgya ma tsho nge/sa gas nga sngags rnying ma 'i rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pa zhig dang g.yung drung rgya mcho zhes mched gnyis byung / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ byang gi phyogs kyi dur khrod du/ /sgrol ma'i ming can 'byung gyur te/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar dus der yab snya nam pa jo bo dpal zhes re ma nyi bran du 'khol nus pa'i nus gcan dang / yum byin bza' dar 'jam gnyis snya nam nas 'bri gung gi phyogs su byon nas bzhugs pa'i sras mor rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yang sprul chos kyi sa la ma 'khrungs te/ sa phyogs der skyes grags zhes da lta yang grags shing / mkha' 'gro'i mtshanartaṭa thams cad tshang zhing bskyed shin tu che bar gyur nas dbus kyi ja pa dang sbrags nas khams su sa mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i khab tu byon nas/— 65

dbus nas byon pa'i lo rgyus gsungs nas/ a mis kyi zhal nas (45ba)kho bo ni 'jig rten gyi zhen pa'ang med cing longs spyod kyang chung bas khyim thab kyi 'dun pa yang ma mchis shing / khyad par du gnyer ston dang / sna bon la sogs pa'i yo byad mi shom pas/ khyed rang gzhan gara'adod du byon na legs zhes gsungs pas/ yang sa phyi chos kyi sgol ma'i zhal nas/ kho mo yang 'jig rten gyi zhen pa che ba zhig ma yin ste/ ngedarang gnyis la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bya ba byed pa'i skyes chen du ma 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yod pas/ 'dir mchis pa yin/ longs spyod kyi 'byor pas 'phongs 〈phongs 〉pa'i dpa' zhum par mi 'tshal te/ kho mos sgrub par bgyi'o/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i nub mo nas sna bon pa yang bos/ phyi nyin nas/ chos kyi sgol ma'i zhal nas/ bdag gi pha ming yod pa rnams ni bod na yod pas sa thag ring /'dir yod pa la pa'i mgron po rnams yin zhes gsungs nas/ mgon thams cad la brda sbyar ba na/ sa mes tshul khrim sa rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa ci shin tu skrags skrag 〉te 〈ste 〉bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la ni rang 'tsho tsam las ma mchis na/ mgron po rnams ji ltar bya zhes/ ci bya tol 〈gtol 〉med par gyur pa'i tshe/ chos kyi sgol ma de nyid kyis zhal nas/ phaṭa gsungs zhing 〈shing 〉snam phrag ( can)g.yon nas na pā la gcig byung / yas zu gsungs nas/snam phrag g.yas nas zam ru gcig byung zhing / da sa tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad ci yod 'dir stsolacig ces gsungs te/ na pā la bzad ga / lug sha lag pa g.yas pa gcig yod pa de phul bas/ zhal nas 'o rten 'brel shin ku bzang / ngal bu bzhi byung ste/ de dag kyang dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i skyes chen du ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/66

gsungs ste za ma su dkrol/ bza' ba dang btung ba'i byi brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa char bzhin babs pas/ mgron po rnams la'ang gya nom pa'i bza' btung gis tshim par bgyis so/ sna bon pa la'ang / gzi chumig bcu gnyis pa zhig byin/ gong bzhin du lung bstan mdzad de/ de ltar 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang mthun pa'i tshul gyi khab tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/sras bzhi 'khrungs pa la/ nam mkha' dbang phyug dpe na dbang rgyal/na 'gags pa bsod nams dpal/ dkar gdung gru bzhi ste/ sras bzhi'akhrungs so/ de dag kyang bskyed bsrings te cher lon pa na/ rang bzhinagyi dbang po gsal zhing / skyes bu'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa sha stag byung ngo / de'i dus su a phyi nyid rang gi sgrub thabs rnams mdzad/ zhal nas (45ba)kho mo ni bsam bzhin du sred par skye ba'i tshul bzung nas/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bsrung 〈srung 〉ba'i phyir du smon lam gyi 'brel pas 'dir mchis pa ste/ thun mongadang mchog gi dngos grub byin pa ra bya'o/ gsungs te/ phyi bzhin 'brangs pa'i mi rnams/ ldan stod phug pa ting ring bar khrid nas/ dur khrod nas bam chang ba mtshan ldan gcig blangs pa tshogs 'khor du rol nus pa la thun mong dang / mchog gi dngos grub thob pa mang du byung zhing / skal pa dman zhing bsags pa chung ba dag ni log rtog gi sgribs 〈bsgribs 〉te tshogs la longs spyod ma nus pa dag la dngos grub da na par gyur to/mthar gyi tshe na/ kho mo'i lus kyi ni bya ba thams cad grub zin na/ da ni bdag gi bu rgyud 'dir bstan pa spyi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i snying po'i bstan pa zhig byung bas/ de dag gi bka' srungs 〈srung 〉bgyid cing / da ltar bdag gis sgrub thabs bgyis pa 'di rnams kyang /nyams su len pa'i mi rabs bco lnga'i bar du nga rang gi 〈gis 〉bsad — 67

skyobs 〈srung skyob 〉bgyid pas/ do gal che na nga la sngon sogs kyi gsungasgo tha ma bzhag ste/ sku lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod du gshegs so/— de la skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i yum nas yar la rtsis pa'i phyi mor gyur pas ma phyi zhes grags so/ sngags 'chang dpe na dbang rgyal gyi sras mkhan ( 7na)po dar ma/dkon mchog rin chen/btsun pa 'bar ba/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje dang bcas bzhi 'khrungs pa las/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la grub pa thob ste/ dregs pa can rnams bran du 'khol nus pa zhig ste/ de nyid kyis ra bza' btsun ma 〈mo 〉khab tu bzhes pa las/ de yang sngon 'das dus kyi bskal pa grangs med pa'i gong rol na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud zhes bya ba zhig tu gyur te/ sras stong bltams/ rab tu byung ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgon ma zhes grags shing / de ltar mngo par rdzogs par sangs rgyas su zin kyang /byang chub sems dpa' kun bzang dbang bskur rgyal po dang /sangs rgyas 'od srungs 〈srung 〉gi skabs rjo mkhan dga' skyong du gyur pa dang / gong du brjod pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i spyan sngar gtso 'khor tha mi dad pa'i li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa dang / slob dpon chen po klu sgrub sogs su sprul nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad la/ skabs 'dir yang snying po don gyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i phyir dgongs ste/ gnam lcaṭa rdo rje mchu'i po tir sprul nas yum gyi lhums su zhuṭa nas chu phag lorango mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te bltams/ dgung lo bzhi (4 ba)nas 'bri klog — da sa par mkhyen cing / yab las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor dang / gzhan yang khu bo mkhan po dar ma dang / rwa bsgrong 〈sgong 〉bsgom 〈sgom 〉chen/ rje btsun 'khor ba rlung khyer sogs las 68

mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan pa'i mtshan/ btsun pa skyabs dar jorje dpal so/gas/ su grags/ mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan la thim/ ༄ mang mod kyang yi ges 'jigs pas thams cad 'brir ma lang la sprin chem/las/ ma 'ongs/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la/ /byang phyogs sa yi phyogs cha ru//'byu zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su/ /rin chen dpal zhes bya ba yis 〈yi//〉bde bar gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes yongs/ surgyas pa'i mdo las/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ri rgyud du/ /rin chen dpal zhes bya ba 'byung 'gyur te/ /mi mchog de ni 'jig rten khams sugrags/ /nga yi bstan la bya ba byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ chos 'byung 'bri zhes grags pa ru/ /phag lo rin chen dpalazhes pa/ /sprul sku 'bum phrag tshogs kyis bskor/ /de phyir mngon dga'i zhing khams su/ /bde gsheṭa dri med dkar po zhes/ /'dus pa'i 'khor dang bcas la snang / /zhes sogs mdo rgyud nyi shu nas lung bas na pa dang /gter chos kyang mang po nas lung bstan cing / khyad par shin tu gsal (42na)ba/ rgyal po bka' yi thang yig las/ rje gcig rgyal po khri srong lde btsan de/ /dpal gyi bsam yas 'di nas byang shar mtshams/ /chos kyi'abyung gnas 'bri zhes grags pa ru/ /bde gshegs phag lo rin chen dpal zhes pa/ /sprul sku 'i sems dpa' 'bum phrag tshogs kyis bskor/de rjes mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /bde gsheṭa dri med dkar po zhes bya ba/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mngon rdzogs rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes gsal por lung bstan pa yin la/ sngon ma 'ga' zhig gis 'og tu lha sras kyis 〈kyi 〉skyes 〈skye 〉mtha' ma 'ongs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i gras kyi/ zhing khams rnam dag sogs drangs pa ni legs par ma rtags 〈brtags 〉pa'i skyon yin no/ de nas mi ring bar yab gshegs nga/sa longs spyod srab par 69

gyur nga/sa klog gi 'khyos 〈sgos 〉mas yum dang lcam sring sogs skyong bar mdzad/ skabs shig klog yon du ra zhig phul ba/ sku na phra bas ma thub ste/ pha bong zhig gi steng du ras grud 〈drud 〉par zhabs rjes byungabs/ zhabs rjes ra grud 〈drud 〉mar grags/ dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ rjo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal gzigs shing / sku mdog mthing byunag dang ma he'i zhal gti mug dag pa mtshon cha bsnams pa dang khros pa'i nyams zhe sdang dag (42ba)pa/ mtshan ma gyen du bgreng 〈bsgrengs 〉ba 〈pa 〉'dod chags dag ba'i brdar mkhyen/ rtsibs klung mo cher bzhugs tshesgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad me long gi gzugasabarnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin ma grub par gzigs shing / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe zhal dngos su gzegs shing dngos grubabarnyes/ khams su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yang grub thob kyi grags pas khyab/tshad med pa'i snying che chen po thugs la mnga' bas nyid kyi lcam sring ma zhig khyim bdag zhig gis 〈gi 〉chung mar song bas/ khyem bdag des 'barabs sdug grags 〈drags 〉lcebs nas shi bar ro sus byel ma 'cham te 〈ste 〉pha tshan gnyis 'khrug pa chen por gyur nas mi mang po zhig 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe/ snying rje drag po tshad med pa 'khrungs te / rtsis mkha na la skog tu brngan 〈ngan 〉pa byin nas ro 'di phag lo pa zhig gi 〈gis 〉skyel dgos zhes zer du bcug nas nyid kyis khur nas skyal 〈bskyal 〉bas rtsod pa rang zhir 'gro bar mdzad do/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yang 'khrungs shing / mnal 'od gsal du tshud pa'i ngang nas sangs rgyas ma chags pad ma can gyi zhing khams yang 〈kyang 〉gzigs / sngon bshad pa ltar ra bsgong 〈sang 〉bsgom 〈sgom 〉chen las bka' gdams kyi chos thams cad gsan/thugs rje che bas mdze zang sogs ma cas pa thams cad la thugs shin tu 70

/ nga smos sazasagyi ma ma rnams dang / sto sardo ) ba sa la gsang 'dus sogs chos kyang mang du gsan/dgung no dgu nas gzhan phan kyang 〈yang 〉mang du mdzad/ klog mdzad pa'i tshe yi ge gcig yin na yang 'phul byed dang sa mgo ra mgo sogs la sgra tha dad du 'byung ba'i bod kyi legs/ par sbyar ba'i skad du gyur pa krog thams/ cad kyi nang nas mchog ku gyur pa 'di'i rgyun la thel klog tu grags/ gzer byung drag pos btab pa rnams la byin rlabs mas da pa 'i chang gi 〈gis 〉bsos 〈gsos 〉pa dang /phyag gis byugs byuṭa mjadapas mdze bsos 〈gsos 〉ba dang / bden stobs brjod pas char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma mnga'/ skabs shig lo nyes byung ba'i tshe/klog gi yon rnams rang nyid kyis cher ma gsol bar mu ges nyen pa rnams la gnang ste/ skye bo mang po'i srog 'don par mdzad/ jag khyi sug cesabya ba'i jag pa zhig gis brnyas pa byas pas kho grir shi zhing / shul mi thams cad kyang spyo ste nus mthu che ba'i grags pas kyang khyab/ khams kyi mi chen thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs te dbang khrid la sogs pa zhus/gzhan phan gyis (gyi 〉'gro don mdzad/ de nas dbus nas byon pa'i mgo zla paṇḍi tas phag gru'i lo rgyus brjod pas/ phag mo gru pa'i mtshan gsan pa (4 ba)tsam gyis thuṭa keng shu'i 'dabs 〈'dab 〉ma rlung gis g.yos pa ltar gyur te/ dka' ba dpag med spyad/ khams nas dbus su byon pa'i tshe khams dbus kyi bar thams cad 'jas 'brel ba dang / rdo rje leṭa pas kyang ri bong dang byis pa soṭa su sprul nas zhabs tog sgrub/khyad par du yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas bla ma — phag gru tsong bas / cing /lam gyi shul mtshon dang zhabs tog mdzad/ gye re yar 'phrang gi yig drug 'gro mgon phag grur zhal gzigs/ de nas nam nyin mtshan med ma

par byon pas/ phag mo gru nas yin zer ba'i bud med gcig dang mi serapo gcig byung bar bla ma'i sprul par dgongs te phyag mdzad/ de nas nam gung tsam la dgon 'dabs su phebs nas/ skad chen pos nga bsusazhes bos nas/ khams pa gcig gis bsus nas der stan phab ste/ca nang par nam sangs pa'i tshe bya wang zhigaskad 'don pa la gzigs nas/ 'di ni bla ma'i rnam sprul yin ang dgongs pa byung / de nas rje 'gro ba'i mgon po mjal ba'i tshe/ 'gro mgon rin po ches 'khor thams cad dering rdzogs so gsungs/ phyag rte na du rta rgod ma/ za 'og yugs 〈yug 〉gabyug dar yugs 〈yug 〉gcig rnams phul ba'i tshe/ kho bos rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba mi len pa khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉ma thos sam/ zhes gsungs shing bkyom pa yang mdzad pas bshums shing (50na)rgod ma mi bzhes na/ri la rgyab 〈brgyab 〉nas 'jog pa yin zhes zhus pas/ kho bos khyod la lugs gnyis kyi sgo ma gces par skyong ba yin/ des ma chog pa kyang 〈cang 〉yod dam gsungs// 'thud rkyal zhig phul ba/ nang gi sbyin sregs 〈sreg 〉'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs 'khor du mdzad nas bzhes pa'i tshe/ cung zad ma rdzogs bar 〈par 〉nye gnas stag lung thang pas/ gso 'phro zhus pa'i tshe/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi tshogs skal chad pas/ khyod kyi mi rgyud la mig 'chus kyi nad yong zhes gsungs/'khor gyi dge 'dun rnams dang / gdan sa'i nags sogs thams cad kyang bla ma'i sprul pa yin snyam par dgongs shing / tshad med pa'i mos gus chen po thugs la 'khrungs/ bla mas kyang thog mar smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnang zhing / mtshan yang byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi zab chos thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / skabs shig dge bshes bsam yas pa'i mdzad73

par brten nas 'khor gyi dge 'dun rnams la mos gus snyams kyang 〈rkyang 〉cung zad byung ba thams cad kyi gtsug tu bla ma bsgom 〈bsgoms 〉nas mthong phyag gsum gsum mdzad pas mos gus sor chud cing /gzhan rnams kyis thog mar tshul chos 〈'chos 〉can zer/ mthar mos gus mthar zug zer ba byung / 'di skabs zhig 〈shig 〉phag (50ba)mo'i sprul pa'i bu mo zhig yod pa stag lung thang pa'i mdzad par brten nas sku tshe'i 'du byed gtang 〈btang 〉ba grub thob gling ras pas dbu thod bcad nas phyag du 〈tu 〉yod pa/ lan gcig tshogs par bur ston zhig byung bar gling ras phyis/ pas sku skal chad nas tshogs pa thams cad la thod pa bsnams te slong mo mdzad pas/ thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉cung zad re phulamathar 'gro mgon phag grus che ba zhig gnang ba kha la rgya pheb 〈thabs 〉bkal ba lta bu byung ba phyag du 〈tu 〉bsnams nas bstod pa nyi shu pa'i mgur ma mdzad cing / tshogs gral du yar 'byon mar 'byon mdzad skabs bu chen gzhan rnams nged ra gtad e yong dgongs tshe rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che khams nas phebs nas cher ma song bas skya ra gro thul can du grags shing / gral mjug tu bzhugs par phul bas thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉gling ras kyi spyo spyod yin zer/ skabs shig 'gro ba'i mgon pos rten 'brel brtag par dgongs nas rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa dang / gling ras pa dang / stag lung thang pa gsum la/ snam phrug dmar po 'dom re gnang nas/ khyed rang gsum gyis bsgom 〈sgom 〉 re bzos nas khyer shog gsungs pa'i tshe/ stag lung pas snam bu de rang la bcos pa'i rta mig 〈rmig 〉mar graṭa pa'i chung ngu da lta stag lung pa'i luṭa 'di byung /gling ras kyi 〈kyis 〉snam bu'i sna mo nas cung zad bcad pa ma da nar bsgyur nas bzhes pas ma ldangs te ngo sgo (51na)ras kyi 〈kyis 〉byas pa73

zhig byung / rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pas rten 'a layod sa dgosabarasar dung phrug 'dom /nang nga 6 ga / 〈bsnan 〉nas bzos bas zag yor mar gra pa shin tu che ba 'di nyi da byu nga ste rten 'brel mchog tu gyur/ yang nyin gcig rje phas/ thus stag lu nga thang pa dang rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa gnyis la khyed rang gnyi song la ltos cog yar chab gtsang po 'di de ri nga gyen du los/ yod pa 'dra gsungs pa ltar gziṭa nas slar sku mdun du byon skabs stag lung pas/ yar chab gtsang po mthur 〈thur 〉du bab ki 〈'bab kyi 〉'dug zhus/ rje 'dis gsung de dgongs pa can zhig yin par 'dug pas rten 'brel yod dgongs nas/ gtsang po gyen du log na dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad chus gang 'a gro ke 〈yi 〉'dug zhus bas/ 'phrin las rgya chen rten 'brel 'a ṭa 〈'grig 〉cing rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pas rten 'brel mthar phyin 'bri gung pa zhes grags/ de skabs rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che nyid dge bsnyen las/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa ma bzhes pa'i skabs yin pas 'gro mgon phag grus sngon dus gsungs pa ltar/ kho bo'i gdan sa 'di dge bsnyen sa bcu pa zhig gi 'dzin pa yin zhes yang yang bka' stsal 〈ba la/〉 nyin gcig chos ra grol skabs/nyid la cung zad sdod ces gsungs nas sku lus ma snang gi chos bdun ma da du bcug nas/ 'gro ma na rin (51ba)po che )da yar bzhengs nas/ mdun du byon te phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉gyi sa gnas gsum du btsuṭa te ma/ āḥrgyu/ zhes gsung chen pos lan gsum gsungs pa'i mthar phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉zugs sar btsugs nas khyod la bsgom 〈sgom 〉chen zhig yong / sgom chen tsam las bzang ba zhig yong / de la kho bo dga' ba gas mod/ ces gsungs/ de ltar lo gcig dang / zla ba drug ma gtogs bstan 〈bste 〉pa'i yun ma byung yang chos thams cad bum pa gang byor 7

sa/ma/nga sgong zugs dam gyis 〈 〉rtsal rdzogs/ gong du bshad pa ltar rgyal tshab du 〈tu 〉'u/nga bstan/ 'gro mgon phag gru mya ngan las 'da' khar/gser gyi do rje rtse nge pa 'od 'bar ba zhig byung ba nyid kyi thugs kur thim /mu ga bas pa 'i rjeri gsu sngo / phyag rten la rta sul ba ma bzhes pa dang /tha ma/ nyid zhe cibs sa'i spyil bu'i rdo tshum/ chod sku 'bum dang gtsug lag khang ji/ phyob/( su gtang 〈btang /〉 lam gyi yon tan 'byung ba'i snga ltas su/ rtsa rlung cha gegs drag po byungasasnyen nam mkha' sa gzhi tham sa ca / mes gang ba/ chus gang ba dang / sa 'dre'i dmag gis gang ba/ ser ge'i kha nas mdung byung ba na pa sogs/ cho 'phrul mang du byung ba'i tshe/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa sa ma bzhugs pas/ slob dpon rtsi lung pa las/ jo mo sa rje ma'i man ngag (51na)gnang bas cung zad phan/ ga na yang jo mas btsan nyi dang / slob dpon lung mo ba sogs dang ma la zhing chos gsan/ dwags po sgom tshul la rnal 'byor bzhi'i man rag gsan/ de nas sgrub pa la rtse gcig ku gzhol bar dgongs nas/ bla ma yal gyi 〈kyis 〉rgyas/ drangs shing / dbye chung ri khrod du byon gas/ 'tsho ba sgo ba'i yon bdag mo rang zhig yod pa tsho 'ang / rje nyid dge bsnyen gyi skabs kyang / bud med kyi phyogs na su mi khabyon pa'i dam bca' dang / zon cher ma da pa yin pas/ yon bdagarngo la khye / kyis 'tsho ba sbyor/ khyed rang ma yong gsungs pas/ yon bdag mo de ya nga dad pa khyad 'phags zhig 〈shig 〉yin pas/ bla ma nga gzhan dang mnyam por ma gtogs/ nga gcig por mi mong / lo gsum gyi sgrub rgyas/sa 'bul zer nas/ lo gsum gyi bar du sgrub rgyags mdzad/phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel rabs par 'khrig tshud/ 'khor ba 〈bar 〉'khyams pha rlung dbu mar ma tshud pas lam/ par dgongs nas rlung 75

bar ra da /kye /ze 1ri /gcu /pa rig sa za' rgyas byang sa ca/sa dpag mad sa/ ga sa/sa/ bsadrug ji/ ga /( sbyongs thar/ de ska das sngo/ bla mas gsungs pa'i chos rnams la thubs kyi go ba cher ca/ song bas/ sngon ge //sa byung ba'i dus bla mas yang (ya nga )gsungs 'dus kyang ma go ba 'dug dgongs nas mang du bshums/ lo gsum lon nas/ phag mo gru sogs rten (51ba)la phyag/ mchod kyang mdzad nas/ slar yang dbye chung phug tu sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i tshe sngon gyi rnam smin gyi lhag ma rnams lhongs te/sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'tshang rgya khar bdud kyi dmag yong ba dang / rje mi lar yang ro gcig gi rtogs pa rgyud la 'khrungs khar/ tshe ring mched lngas gtsos pa'i 'dre dmag byung ba ltar snyan mdze drag po zhig byung ba/rten 'brel gyi rdzas 'ga' zhig 'dzom na drags 〈drag 〉'gro bar 'dug kyang ma 'dzom par thugs mug ste/ ra phug shin tu dben pa sus kyang mi shes pa zhig tu 'pho ba bya dgos dgongs nas phyir byon pas/ dbu sngas su thugs rje chen po'i zhal thang zhig yod par phyi phyag 'tshal dgos/ nga na ba yi dam gyi (gyis 〉ma lan dgongs nas yar byon/ phyag mdzad pa'i dang po'i skabs/ sa chen po 'di'i thog la nga las sdug pa med nad 'di lta bus 'chi dgos snyam pa thugs la shar/ gnyis pa'i skabs nga 'chi yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis 'pho ba dang / bar do'i gdams pa sogs phyi ma 'jigs mi dgos pa yod de/ de bas sems can 'di rnams snying re rje dgongs nas snying rje drag po thugs la 'khrungs te/gzims mal du yang ma byon par de nyid (du )lus gnad bcas nas snying rje de nyid drag tu bsgom 〈sgom 〉par mdzad pas/ thog mar zhabs mdzub rnamachi sa nas byu na gzhi nag nu ru ru thon/ de nas gyi ba mang po dang / de nas mi khur po khur ba'i rigs mang po/ (53na)de 76

nas phyi 'khor/ de nas nang 'khor/ de nas blon po/ de nas gdon gyi rgyal ngo/ de thon/ de nas sbrul nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhig thon/de skabs/ nam zla dgun yin kyang dngos su rabrug sgra dang ser ba ya nga byung / de rjes snyun gzhi med du legs par dwangasate/ chos spyi dang bye brag gi gnas tshul dang mdo sngags/ kyi dasangs pa dngos su gsungs pa tshams dang / mtha' drug tshul ba spe/'i tsal gyis sbas pa thams cad kyang /sa ru ra lag ma la du bzhag pa ltar ji lta ba nyid du mkhyen/ phyis nang gzim spyil gyis 〈kyi 〉phyi rol du skyo sangs la byon tshe rje btsun ma sgrol mabadun zhal gzigs nas skyabs/ bdun ma mdzad cing / thog mar thugs la snying rje drag po 'khrungs skabs/ nyi ma ri rtser shar tsam yin cing /mjug tu snyan dwangs pa yul pa rnams kyi ra lugs 〈lug 〉nang bsdud pa'i skabs tsam yin kyang ga dan gyi spor mi chud dgongs te/ zhag gsumanyi ma dros bzhi na/ mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag rgyu 'bras kyi rtena'abrel tshan gcig go zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye/ zhes soṭa gsungs/ mdze pho mang por byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis ba sos 〈gsos 〉shing 'ga' zhig zhal mthong ba tsam dang / 'ga' zhig mtshan thos nas mos pa byas pa tsam gyis kyang mdze nad las grol bas (53ba)mtshan mdze 'ur 'ded par grags pa byung / bcas dang rang bzhin gyis〈kyi 〉kha na ma jo ba gcig pa dang / phyag chen tshul khrims gnad gcig sngar dgongs te/ zhang gsum thog pas mkhan po/ 'on rtsi lung pas las kyi slob dpon/ gnyal pa 'dul 'dzin gyis gsang ston mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang gis 〈gi 〉dbus bsnyen par rdzogs shing / rdor dkar gdan gcig gi rtul zhugs mdzad de sku btsun pa'i mthar thus/ par snar cing / bstan rtsa 'dul ba la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ de 77

nas 'gro mgon rin po ches lung bstan mdzad pa ltar slob ma'i gtso bo thams cad kyis gsol ba btab nas phag mo gru'i gdan sar bzhugs//de skabs yar lha sham pos gus pas btud/ tshogs pa skyangs 〈bskyangs 〉pa'i skabs shig grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis nged mi la ras pa'i tsha bo yin zer nas chang 'thungs par tshogs su bka' bkyon cher byon pas/ khyod btsun du gyis/ btsun yun ring du gyis/ btsun 'khyer mkhas su gyis/btsun mi la ma gnod pa gyis zer nas skur pa 'debs su byung bas/rje phag mo gru pa mdun gyi nam mkhar dngos su byon nas/ khyed rang za 'og gi 'bol stan rnying pa 'di bsgyur la/ dbu ru byang phyoṭa su song dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang phyogs su byon nas/ gnyan chen po thang lhas bsu ba byas// de nas byang nam rar byon te btsan gyi rgyal po nam ra (54na)'khor dang bcas pas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos shing gus pas btud )da pa'i rten du phyag zhabs kyi rjes kyang bzhag bya rgod nam ma/ba'i dbyings su 'phur ba la/ bsgom 〈sgom 〉btab pas bsgom 〈sgom 〉skyes/ rta cang shes bang gtang 〈btang 〉ba'i tshe/ gsung tshig gcig gis go ba blangs nas tshur log de skabs rdo rje gdan du du ru po'i da ga byung ba sprul pas bzlog skabs shig 'dam du phebs nas chos gsungs shing / 'bul ba yang bsam las 'das pa byung bar nyi ma yang shin tsu ring bar gyur pasachos gsung ba sogs grub tshe nyi ma bzhud phral 〈'phral 〉tho rangs su songab nyi ma stod la gnon par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas yang lan gcig byang nam ra'i rir bzhuṭa pa'i tshe lha'i rgyal po tshangs pas sems can rnams la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos 'khor bskor bar gsol ba btab pa'i 〈pa 〉'bri gung du byon pa'i tshe lam du lha chen bar lhas bsu ba byas/ thog 7

mar rdzan thang pa'i byis/ pa rnams kyis ba ga khri brtsigs pas rten 'phelalegs par 'grig cing / der bzhugs nas chos gsungs pas sems med kyi 'byung ba chus kyang chos nyan pas/ chu klung 'di shā gardzu na'i sgra sgogs 〈sgog 〉pa sgra shin tu che yang 'di thad du da sa yang dbyar dus kyang sgra cher med pa mngo na sum mthum grub du 〈tu〉 yod/ de nas rdzan thang zhes pa'i grong khyer der/ rnga bong mi ro khyer ba'i sa dgra'i gnod pa yod par lha khang dang nyid kyi (54ba)sku bzhengs par rab gnas mdzad pas yun ring po'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cing / phyis rkun pos gzungs bzhugs ston 〈bton 〉par brtem/ grong khyer rgyad pa yin la/ denas rim par thel du phebs sto/ rtog ldan mi nyag bsgom 〈sgom 〉rin gyis (gyi 〉dgon pa nye gnas kyi 〈kyis 〉phul bar phyag phab ste 〈ste 〉dang por brag rin chen can kyi phug par bzhu /sa/ dgung lo so bcan pa sa phag lor gdan sa chen po dpal 'bri gung byang chub gleng gi chos sde 'di nyid btab cing thog kha gser khang dang / bla g.yel chen po sogs rim gyis brtsegs/ dpon sgom pa do rje seng ge 'phrin las kyi byed por brkos 〈bskos 〉dge 'dun yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus shing zab chos kyi char tshad med pa phab ste sems can thams cad smin cing khrol bar mdzad/ bod kyi lha chen dgu'i nang tshan bar lha/ btsan rgod sog cha/ /rtse /ste /sgo /bo /tsa /re 14chu 'a na klu dbang / ga ra ma sman / ga sna rnam rgyal dka ra sogs kyis zhabs la gtus/sa shing skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus par bar lhas sa dkar/ sog ras sa dmar/ sman mos sbyor sde mi dgos pa'i zhal ba'i sa/ chu 'phen gyis yon chab phul te/ de yang sa phyogs 'di shin tu grang zhing / yas mas thams cad du khyag 〈'khyags 〉pa che yang / gling gi mdun thad drang por/ dgum yang khyag 〈'khyags 〉 79

po mi yong ba mngon sum mthong chos su yod/ skabs shig chu (55na)dkon par byung bas/ nye gnas rin chen grags la g.yu rdog brgyad rtsa brgyad bskur nas sbar bcug pas/ g.yu rdog brgya dang bdun sbas pas chu mig de ltar byung zhing / g.yu gcig ma sbas par snam phrag tu bcug pas/ sbal par 'dug par 'jigs nas 'phangs pas/ sbal pa'i mig zhar bas chu mig zhar mar grags shing / gling log gi skabs mes tshig pas phal cher med par gyur cing / da lta yang 'ga' zhig yod/ gso sbyongs 〈sbyong 〉yang dus rtag tu mdzad par/ lan gcig dge 'dun 'ga' zhig gis cung zad phyis pas bzhog 〈zhog 〉thong 〈thongs 〉gsungs par/ tshangs pa chen pos gsol ba btab pas slar yang sngon bzhin du mdzad/ 'di skabs 'bri gung du bzhugs kyang / gdan sa thel gyi thugs khur kyang 〈yang 〉mdzad pas skabs shig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/tsa ri dag pa sa lha nyis stong brgyad brgya'i lha tshogs rta rnga'i ba ba la gdan drangs te gzigs lam du phab pas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i dgongs rngogs su dmigs nas gser zangs las grub pa'i bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs par ma da cing / 'di nas bzung sgo mang bzheng ba'i srol tshugs/ lan gcig sgam por phebs pa'i tshe/ zangs lung gi dwags po rin po che'i byu 'bag gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer byung nas nyid dang thadad med par 'dres nas mchog (nga ba)dang thun mong gi dngos grub / /se /dzo /phyi/rithams da dbul la nam mkha' ma da lta bur gyur/ snang ba thams cad nang gi rten 'brel du gzigs nas/ 'khor 'das kyi rgyu 'bras thamasacad mongon du gyur/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo mngon sum gzigs nas gsung rab thams cad kyi sgo 'dogs bcad/ lan gcig gi ma bla ma zhang gis gsungs nas/ 'di lo nged dang 'byu gung pa gnyis80

la/ o rgyan nas mkha' 'gro ma'i gdan 'dren 'ong / khong rten brel la mnga' brnyes pas gshegs mi dgos te/ nged ni 'gro dgos pa yong 11 /kye 1do /re rtenagasungs pa ltar/ mkha' 'a ma rnams sa ma ra ba gas nas gdan 'dren du byung bar/ kho bo mkha' spyod du bzhud ri shi bzhud ri skanagasungs pas/ mdo le bzhugs khri dang spyan 'dren pa'i tshig rnams zhabs brtanagyi tshig tu bsgyur nas slar yang bzhuṭa par gsol ba btab/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis kyang phyi nang gi mchod pa dang rang rang gi snying po phul te mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub cing gdong 〈sdongs 〉grogasabyed par dam bcas/ de'i tshe nyid kyi slob ma byon snga rnam gnyis dang / mkhan chen gu ra ba/ mastos dag ra chos gsum dang / gzhan yang sngon gyi grub thob nyag se dang / gtsang gtsang gnyis sogs mtshan nyid kyi tshogs dpon mang po/ thag ma 'dul 'dzin 14 :dzi zhes :dzi 14 /sgo1 1—dang dwags 'dul 'a na gas 'dul 'a na mang / (5can)snying po sogs bka' gdams kyi dge bshes/ snubs dang 'phaṭapa sogs lo tsā ba/ kro rngod gnyis sogs sngags pa'i tshogs dpon mang po/ bdud rtsi dang bal po sogs rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs dpon mang po sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus shing / chos gsungs pa'i tshe lha rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing / 'ja' 'od sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung zhing / rma chen spom ra dang dge bsnyen bzhi sogs bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis kyang chos nyan cing / de skabs grub thob nyag ses/nga'i bla ma phag mo gru pa dang rje 'bri gung pa chen po 'di nyid dbyer ma mchis zhes shin tu gus par mdza / de ltar tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu skyongab la/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas sbyin bdag byas longs spyod kun sum tshogs pa 8 1

'ab/ zad lhun grub tu 'byung 〈byung /〉bod kyi sa skyong chen po thams cadadang / rgya dkar na mi nyag gar log hor la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po thams cad kyis kyang zhabs la gus pas gtugs shing 'bul ba bgyis/'di skabs tshoṭa 'dus pa chen po byung ba'i thog ma yin cing / mnyes chen po rgyal ba lha nang pas 'bul mo che dang / bur 'gyen mdzad ga 'i skabs 'dus pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga (55ba)brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ste/ log rtog can 'ga' zhig gis lnga kho na sgrig pa 'thad leṭa yi na nges smra da mi bden ste 〈te 〉yab sras gnyis kyi phun sum tshoṭa pa'i rteca/ 'brel kyi ma/thu las/de ltar ma sgrig lhun grub tu byung ba yin no/ 'di skabs ngal shod kyi btsad po rnams 'khrug pa cher byung ba rje nyid phebs te lo bco brgyad kyi bar du 'khrug pa bsam bar mdzad cing / bsam yas kyi zhis/ bsos 〈gsos 〉kyang mdzad/ skabs shig byug po bu med pa zeg gis rte gsum da ra yod gdan sa phag mo grur phul bas ngam shod pa rna ma sa kyi ri 〈kyi 〉snying la bdud zhugs te/ 'di ltar na nged yul pa rnam sa la shim/ tu gnodapas gdan sa bshig dgos zhes bshig par thag chod cing / zabs gzhan ci yang ma rnyed pa'i ma/ bla ba'i thuṭa dgongs bla mar phul bas rdzogs zhesagasungs nas chos rnams sgam por gdan drangs/ nyi da kyis bzhengs pa'i bza shis sgo mang yang shing rtar bzhugs te 'bri gung du gdan drangs/ rje nyid kyis kyang zha bas rjen gyi 〈kyis 〉tsog sna'i yar nang nas dge 'dun bcas ser zengs kyis bsu ba mdzad cing / gling rin po cher re zhig bzhugs bas/ gdan sa phag mo grur ngam shod pa 'i gnod pa dang bral ste zhabs tog rmad sa byung ba 'grub kyang / stag lung thang pa'i thugs la sa shong bas/ sgo mang slar kun tu (5 na)bzang po'i nag 〈naṭa 〉khrod nyid du gsan 'ongs shing / de tshab byang gling 'dir brag seng 2

ge spu ras pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzis/sa shing / de'i thad du gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas bkra shis sgo mang gser zangs las grub pa'i thog tshad lnga pa lha nyis stong brgyad brgya sogs sngon ltar las/lha rer yang ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bstan pa rgyas shing sems can gyis 〈byi 〉bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel can rmad du byung ba bzhengs nas zug du 〈tu 〉zhugs pa'i rten khyad par can gang yod kyang der bzhugs su gsol/ sngon thugs dam gyi lha rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pa bshad zin pa ltar dang / phag gru dang mjal nas dbang dang gdams pa stsal 〈bstsal 〉ba bzhin/ yi dam kyi gtso bo bde mchog dril bu lugs lhan skyes lha lnga nyid la mdzad cing / 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ gdul dka'i gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar mdzad/ 'di skabs shig hor dmag gis mi nyag gi rgyal khams bcom/de'i mi rnams srog gi 'jigs pa las skyobs 〈skyabs/〉 'di skabs 'dusapa sngon ma las kyang cher rgyas te/ 'khor phyogs gcig 'dus pa bdun khri la/ rab tshe lamar sangs rgyas thob pa mang / 'bring sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad nas/ dbang sems nyid rtogs pa yan chod la/ 'khor khri phrag bye ba bsam yas kyang zhes (nga ba)rnam thar mthong ba don ma nas gsungs pa ltar/ tha ma rnams kyang sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba sha sag yin zhing / de yang gong gi lung bstan las/ sprul sku'i sems dpa' 'bum phrag tshogs kyis bskor zhes pa/ sprul sku zhes pa ni/ thams cad rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims rnam par dag pa kho na dang / sems dpa' ri thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' yin par dgongs pa/'o/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa rna/ dus skad cig ma re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad byu gshegs shing sangs rgyas thams cad la chos 83

gsan cing / sku'i bkod pa dang rnam sprul sna tshogs pa bstan/ mtshan thos pa dang bla g.yel du phyin pa tsam gyis ngan song du mi gter ba'i dbu snyung bzhes/ gdul bya'i sems can la nye ring med par gang gisagasol ba btab pa de'i mdun du byon nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad/dge 'dun rnams kyi pha ma nye du tshun chad kyang 'chi ba'i tshe gdung shugs kyi 〈kyis 〉khyod dran cing / de'i rkyen gyis nga dran nas rnam shesabla mar 'pho ba'i tshe phyi ma ngan song med ces pa dang / rje nyid la gsolab btab na/ stong nge 'dzin rgyud la skye nges zhes pa dang / 'bri gung gi ri 'di la gnas pa'i srog chags grog zur tshun chad kyang ngan song du mi skye ba dang / rgyang ring por gnas pa'i mos gus can rnams kyang / mos gus kyi bsam pa dang ma bral na/ ma 'phos/ (58na)ma thag tu bde ba can du skye ba dang / spyir mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ngan song gsum las grol zhing / sgos zhal mthong gsung thos thams cad thar pa thob pa dang / 'bri gung thel du gang shi ba thams cad ngan song du mi gtong ba sogs nges don gyi bka' du ma stsal 〈bstsal 〉zhing /mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi gsal byed thun mong ma yin pa dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa dang / lhan thabs bzhi bcu pa bcas snga phyir gsungs pa rnams spyan snga sher 'byung gas bka' bsdu ba mdzad pa sngon du yang brjod pa ltar/ lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ dus rtag tu gsol ba 'debs cing 〈shing 〉'di skabs mas bco lnga'i nub mo bod kyi sa thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing / bde sdug thams cad 'byung ba'i ga ra gyur pa/ klu'i rgyal po mal dro gzi can rang gzugs kyis chos nyan du yong bar mkhyen pas/ rdzu 'phrul thob pa rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉klu rgyal la 84

phar gsad pa byas kyi dogs pa dang / ma thob pa rnams la klu chos nyan par gnod sems med kyang kha rlangs kyi dug phog gi dogs nas do nub 'ur sdig gi sgra drag po ji ltar byung yang sus kyang ma blta 〈lta 〉zhig ces nye gnas phrin skyel du gtang 〈btang 〉bas/ gzhan ma thams cad la phrin skyal 〈bskyal 〉rung / grub thob mgar dam pa bla g.yel phug rings su bzhuṭa pa/ bla g.yel phyi sna (58ba)sgo dang / phug nyid gser khang gi 'og tu yod pas phug shin tu ring bas gsan mi yong snyam pa nas gtang 〈btang 〉snyoms su bzhag pas de nub zug choms kyi sgra chen po byung ba/mgar dam pas gsan nas/ ci yin snyam phyir byon nas gziṭa pas/ sbrul sngo nag 'jiṭa su rung ba zhig gis gling rin po cher lan gsum bskor te mgo gzim chung gser /lang gi bar snang gi thad der 'dug pa brtag par mamadzad par/ khos nga'i bla ma rin po cher gnod pa byed pa yin 'dug dgongs nas/ khyung chen po zhig tu sprul te ded pas rol pa 'phrang gi mar zur pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du sbrul gyi rjes shin tu gsal ba 'jam zhing gzhan las sngo ba dang / de nas sder mo mig tu pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du khyung babs pa'i rjes kyang shin tu gsal bar yod cing /der ma zad khyung ngar rgal du chu 'gram du byung dang sbrul rjes mang du 'dug phyis rje chos kyi graṭa pa'i sku thog gi bar du res 'ga' bco lnga'i dus chen gyi skabs/ nya khra khyug ge ba zhig tu sprul nas gser khang gi yon chab nang du ja yun re tsam sdod pa khungs thub tshad ldan gyis 〈kyi 〉gsungs rgyun yin no/ sing snya gling gis 〈gi 〉dgra bcom pas pad dkaragyi skyes bskur ba sngon du brjod pa ltar/ paṇa chen shākya smi nyid kyi nye gnas la bskur te 'bul du gtang 〈btang 〉bar gzho rong gi mdar sleb5

dzi/ (5 na)chu klung gi 〈gis 〉na gardzu na'i sgra sgogs 〈sgrog 〉pa gsal por thos shing / me tog padma yang kha bye bas pad dkar skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po cher phul zhing da lta yang 'dzam gling rgyan du bzhugs so/ slar 'bul ba mang du bskur nas paṇa chen gdan 'dre'e / 'a dzad kyang bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mdzad de tha nyed da ngos su ga da byon te de yang dgra bcom pa nyid kyis paṇa chen gyi gcung po la gsung phrin dang me tog bskur ba'i 'phro las/ 'bri gung du gdan 'dren du yong yang ma byon pa skyes lan tshigs su bcad pa zhig bskur zhing / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ slob dpo klu sgrub nyid/ blta 〈lta 〉ba'i snyigs ma rnams gsal 〈bsal 〉nas yang dag pa'i blta 〈lta 〉ba la 'dzud pa'i phyir bsam bzhin du byon pa yin pas/ de'i ston par khyed mi dgos pas shes par gyis shig ce gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa yin cing / 'di skabs paṇa chung rnams la yang bka' gros kyi rnam pa tsam mdzad tshe/ bi khyu ti tsand+ras de skabs rgya ma dbon ston gyi gdan 'dren yang byung bas/ nged rang rnamasabaka' gdams pa'i thad du 'byon/ phyag chen pa 'di tsho rdzun che zer zhes byus pas/ ji ti sa ) de skad ma zer/ nged kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa thams cad la chos gos re ster bar go nas/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i ga par gtogs tsam gyis 〈rmi 〉khams pa ci yang mi shes pa zhig chos gos (5 ba)'dod nas bsnyen rdzogs zhur byung ba/ de skabs chos gos gzhan med pa dang thug nas chos gos kyi rgyu byin sang ma chog par nged kyi 〈kyis 〉gyon pa'i chos gos la 'jus nas 'di gnang dgos zhes zer bar/ nye gnas jo sras nyi mas 'phul brdeg byas par khams pa 'gyel zhing sna khrag shor bas/ nang re yan lag bdun pa'i skabs sgol ma dngos su 'byon par/ zhag drug gi bar du rtsa ba nas ma byon zhing /86

bdun pa'i nang mor sku rgyab bstan nas byon par/ bdag gi ci nyes zhusapas/ khyed kyi nye gnas kyis klu sgrub kyi grwa par 'phul brdeg byas nas khrag byung bas yin gsungs/ da bshags pa ji ltar dgos zhus pas/paṇḍi ta nyid kyi lo grangs dang mnyam pa'i dge slong chos gos med pa la chos gos byen zhes gsungs pa yin/ yul shin tu gnyan pas bshags pa gyis gsungs nas/ ba byu ti tsand+ra 'bri gung du byon nas bshags pa yang dag par mdzad/ da dung yul gnyan pas bshags pa'i 'phros drang srong srin po rir 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bzhengs/ nyid kyi mtshan dngos rin chen dpal yin mod kyang / rje phag mo gru pa la che brjod mdzad nas/rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang skyobs 〈skyob 〉ba rin po che zhes gsungs pa slob ma rnams kyis rje nyid la gsol bas/ mtshan de ltar graṭa pa yin cing / (50na)'ga' zhig gis spyan sa 'bri gung gling pa zhes pa/rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che yin par sems pa ni 'khrul pa chen po ste/mtshan de sher 'byung gi mtshan yin la/ sher 'byung grags 'byung sogs slob ma'i gtso bo tshogs chos kyi skabs ma yin par yang sku mdun du bzhugs nas/ chos kyi zhu ba mjad pa rnams la spyan snga zhes grags shing gyis su rje bcu gnyis pa dang nyer gnyis pa layang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi spyan sngar bzhugs pas spyan snga zhes mtshan du gsol 'duga'adi skabs sa skya nas mkhas pa 'gru skya mo zhes pa shin tu mkhas pa rte rtsod par gtang 〈btang 〉bas rje nyid kyi zhal mjal tshe bstan pa'i bdagapo dngos dang / spyan snga sher 'byung dang grags 'byung gnyis shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bur mthong nas rtsod pa'i skabs dang bral bar gyur 1 mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ma/sa slob ma'i mchog tu gyur cing / rje 87

kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa gsal bar mdzad pa'e bstan nyid bcos/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po mdzad/ 'di skabs tshogs pa sngon / bye snang /de rgyas /dī /rdor ba/dris pag// /gi rdob sna bye spya // /ra de bas kyang tshogs pa cher song ste gnas gsum (50ba)sogs gnas khyad par can rnams ri pa nyis stong bdun brgya brdzangs pas phyi lor khri zloshā /ba/ /shā rdordo /sa // shā /// /bude zha pa // /rdo rnyig /la ༷ sbyo/ pa/ /nyis stong bdun brgya ri la song / /de gcig dus kyi deng sang na/ // rdo / /shā /byi dro/rdo sdu // pa/ ga/// /sna /rdzus bye /'debs pa bas byebyebye bye/ bye / da bye/ /de bye / bye / / bye / da bye/ bye slar gser khang du phebs pa'i ma/ rje nyid shākya'i rgyal po sngon ltar dang /spyan sdo rnam gnyis byams pa 'jam dbyangs/ 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gzigs ste/ dus mkhyen gyi 〈kyis 〉bstan pa'i bdag po dngos yin par //)pa )rdo /dro/ gus zlo/ // rnyi/ sdus hākho/ ra lo chosam ga~Xn da/rdo sa /dro du gzigs shing / dur khrod brgyad kyang bskor thabs su tshang bar 88

yod cing mi 'gyur / ga'i rta ri su phyong/'a bzhir zhabs rje dang / 'dzam geng rgyan kyi rgyab brag ti shā ci 'dzin spungs pa'i ldebs su zhabs rje ri/ kyang yod/ 'di'i gong tsam du bu slob che ba rnams thog mar 'dus pa'i skabasashig bu slob rnams kyi sa/dan sa re zhig slob ma chen po rnams kyisaskyong bar nus mod kyi/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus na ring mo zhig gi bar dponargyud kyi 〈kyis 〉skyangs 〈bskyang 〉 na legs par dgongs te rje 'jig rtenagasum gyi mgon por/ dbon rgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed du gsol ba btab pa bzhin gnang ste/ dpal chen sa phug pa khams su bsdangs te/rje nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉khu bo dkon mchog rin chen gyi sras/ sa nye a drag yab sras rnams la dpal chen gyis rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan cing /chos rje'i bsngags pa brjod pas/ dbon gcung sogs chos rje'i sku drung rim par byon nas/ bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por gyur pa 'og tu bstan pa ltar yin no/ stag lung pa'i yig char stag lung thang pas chos gsungs pas/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po ches phyag 'tshal zhes brjod cing / slob ma'i gras su yang / rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po cher 〈che 〉'dren pa ni shin tu (51ba)ma das/ ste/ rje phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rdo rje'i spun du gyur pa yin mod kyang / sngon bshad ltar rten 'brel gyis 〈gye 〉dbang gis rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i 'phrin lasakyi cha tsamayang / stag lung par ma byung zhing / phag mo gru'i gdan sar bzhugs ma bzhugs kyi dbang gis rje 'jig rten gsum mgon la stag lung pas phyag 'tshal zhing bla mar bkur dgos pas/ lan gcig stag lung thang pas 'bul ba chen po bskur nas khyed bla ma bsten yun thung bco khyed kyi 〈kyis 〉ma gsan pa'i gdams pa mang po bdag la yod kyi zhu bar byon zhes zhus pas/ 'bul ba las lhagaya'i skyes lan bzang mo gnang bas/89

bde mo drug gi dbyangs dang / mjug tu bla ma bste / yu thung snyam bdag la med/ gdams ngag gnangazhes bya ba thugs la btab/sa/ zhes gsungs nas ma byon zhing / 'bri gung gi yig cha lo nar yi na la/ rang 'dod yin du chug kyang / 'brug pa thams cad ra/khyen pa padma dkar posamadzad pa'i chos 'byung las kyang gsal por gsungs pas smyon 〈bsnyon 〉du med do/ 'di skabs shig grub thob mgar dam pa la // khyod rang song la sog zam khar gar thob la/ gru la gtor ma zhig byin dang /nor khyad par can chag yong ba yod kyis 〈kyi 〉song zhig gsungs pa ltar byon nas/ gtor ma gnang bas klu'i rgyal po sag ma (51na)med kyi 〈kyis 〉sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba bzhi pa dang / nor bu khyad par can gsum yang phul te/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba bzhi las/ bzhi pa sgra sgrogs klu'i rgyal pos mchod/ ces pa na klu'i rgya po sog ma med yin te/ klu'i rgyal po chen po rnams la rgyu ba'i sgo du ma zhig mo bas/ klu rgyal sog ma med gtso cher rgya gar ma ga cer gnas mod kyang / rgyu ba'i sgo sog zam kha yin pas der byon nas phul ba yin cing / nor bu tshems dang bcas pa bsnams nas rje 'jig rten gsu ma na gyi drung du sal bas/ nor bdag po la sprad pa legs/'on kyang khyod rgyu'i bas can zhig yin pas kho bo'i 'dra 'bag cig gyis la de'i nang sa bzhugs shig zhes (ces 〉gsungs pa ltar/ grub thob 'gar gyis rgya nageg bzo bo bos te/ thel zhol du bzo thab btsug sa nas chos rje rin po che'i sa bzhengs shing / de'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ma sa bzhugs/ rje nyid kyi rab gnas brgya rtsa sogs ma da pas gser khang chos re zhes rje nyid dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i snyen khyad par can 'a ra nyid yinal/ gdan sa na rim phal cher dang sku gnyer 7

yang mang por gsung byon zhing / lhag par sku gnyer zla ba zhes pa zhig la chos drug gi khrid kyang gnang / gling log gi skabs dbu ru bye gshongs su sbas (71ba)pa/ 3 ri ga che nga lnga/—/ bapa do ri/ 〈 nasos 〉grub nas btsal bas ma rnyed pas/ nga 'dir yod sa/sungs nas phyag steng du brkyang 〈brkyangs 〉ba 〈pa 〉sogs ngo mchar mtha' yas pa mnga' ba yin cing /pa di skabs dam pa 'gar gyi (gyis 〉rje nyis kyi sku 'dra mang du brte/ngas par mdzad pas/ da lta hor skur grags pa rnams yin cing / bzo bo rgya yinakyang rgyal po hor gyis byas pas hor skur grags so/ sngon du brjodapa ltar gdan sa thel gyi chos rnams/ gas por phul ba'i tshe/ stag lung thang pas/ nga'i bla ma'i gdan sa la 'di 'dra byas gsungs shing thugs chad mdzad pa' tshe/ 'di skabs su khru ba/ra son pas 'bri gdan gnyis phan tshun du phebs ma grub pa dang / du / la babs par dgongs nas spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas rgyal tshab du 〈tu 〉mang ba gsol te/ phag mo gru'i gdan sar brdzong bar mdzad cing / kho bos gdan sa brgya 'gyur gyis bzang du gtang 〈btang 〉ngo / zhes gsungs pa ltar byung ba yin sa/lha'i rna ba'i mngon par shes pas shar phyos/sa mngon dga'i zhing nas/mgon po mi 'khrug pas chos gsungs pa yang dngos su gsan cing ye shesakyi spyan rnam par dag pas/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams dang /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi da so/sa/ba/ kyi zhal dpag tu med pa dus rtag tu gzigs/ skabs shig rta 'chag snang du skyo sangs la 'khor nyung bsdus bcas phebs nas/ 'khor rnams (73na)la thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉rdzu 'phrul sna re ston gsungs pas/ mnyos chen pos rgya gar nas a ru ra rlon pa blangs nas phul/ dpal chen po chos kyi ye shes kyis/ nyid kyi thugs gar gnyis su med par thim/ 'gar mi

dam pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku bzhengs/ ja ma spo spo bkra shis seng ges chos gos dang ja tshags gzar bu rnams nyi zer la bkal/gzhan rnams kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul sna re bstan/ 'di skabs spyan snga rnam gnyis dang mkhan chen sogs med par mngon/ nye gnas rin chen grags kyis rdzu 'phrul ston ma spobs par bskyengs 〈skyengs 〉nas gshegs ming /bla mar thugs chags nas re zhig sku gdung yang byang bar ma gyur bas chos rje rin po che nyid phebs te phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉snying gar btsugs nas/ rta 'chag steng kha ma'i gsung mgur mdzad pas gdung 'phral du byang zhing 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi gur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / ring bsrel yang 'chag 〈'phyag 〉rgyu byung bas phyis rten 'chag du 〈'phyag tu 〉ming 'gyur zhing / sems can rnams la tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos rdo bcal gyi 'og tu ngan song spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye zhing / bskal pa'i mar me yang sbar bar mdzad cing / keng rus lnga sogs yod par grags shing / 'dir phung po skyal 〈bskyal 〉ba thams cad ngan song las thar ba'i rten (63ba)'brel mdzad/ skabs shig 'than 〈than 〉pa cher byung bas yul mi rnams kyis char zhu byas pas/ pha rgan bdud rtsi zhig po la dpal chos dbyings ma'i gsung mgur gnang nas dbyangs su gyer bcus/ pas char cher babasashing lo shin tu legs par gyur/ gzhan yang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha/ bstan pa la mngon par dad pa dge sbyong me rteg dang /nor rgyun ma sogs kyis 'bru'i dngos grub phul bas/ nas sogs 'bru shin tu mod par gyur te/ skyid shod dang / dbu ru ba rnams kyis nas 'bri gung nas sgrub pa'ang byung / 'di skabs tshogs shin tu rgyas te/paṇa chen gu ya gangs pas gtso byas pa'i lnga khri dang lnga stong lnga brgya nyer 92
