/sto/ces 1 /zhe /) 〈〈/kye /mi /rgya41 / tsho ba ba ba/pa ba/ rngasnye ra/nga 'ab sa/ba/sa ba ba/ rngamabab pa'i lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyer lnga la phyi/ rdor 'dzin mgo bo ches gtso byas pa'i lnga khri lnga sta ri lnga brgya nyer lnga tsa rir brdzangs shing / 'di'i sngo na tsam la/ sngon dus tsa rir sgam po pa chem pos skyes bu ye shes rdo rje brdzangs te gnas/ sgo bye mod kyang / rje 'dis kyang ri pa rjes ma gong bshad 'di ma brdzangs tsam gyis 〈kyi 〉skabs su/ mnyos 'gar chos gsumabardzangs te tsa ri'i gnas sgo sngon ma bye ba rnams kyang bye zhing / bye ba rnams kyang legs par gtan la phab/ ri pa 'di rnams b.rangs nas (54na)mi ring bar slar yang tshogs pa khri tsho bco brgyad byung zhing / 'di la rtsod pa med kyang blo chung 'ga' zhig gis/ 'di lta bu mi shong snyam na deltar ma yin te 'di skabs naṭa 〈nag 〉yod pa'i 〈pas 〉'dul ba'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi gnas kyis 〈kyi 〉skabs su/ shing drung pa dang / gzhi ji bzhin pa gsungs pa ltar g.yem 〈g.yam 〉spyil chung ngu rangashong tsam dang / shing drung / brag phug gad phug bya skyibs sogs su tshe 'di blos gtang 〈btang 〉gi sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas bzhin bzhugs pa las/ da lta'i skyid chos kyis 〈kyi 〉longs spyod dang 'byor pa 'di lta bu med pas mi shong ba'i dogs ma mchis so/ skabs 'dir tshogs pa la thams cad kyis rtsod med du grags shing / gong sa lnga pas mdzad pa'i deb gter las kyang / tshogs pa khri tsho bco brgyad gcung gi dus tshogs par gsungs pa ni 'di skabs kyang 'phrin las shin tu che bas sngon gyi tshogs pa ma nyams par bzhugs pa la dgongs pa yin cing / don du che brjod min par tshad mar bzung ba mdzad cing / gzu bor gnas pa thams cad kyis bsta / pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba mdzad ces bsngags par mdzad cing / 'di skabs tshogs che ba'i mthar thug pa yin 93

cing / sngon bzhengs pa'i sgo mang la rab gnas bskyar ma mdzad pa dang / gso sbyong sogs kyi tshe snam sbyar gyi 'od kyis (cas ba)'bri gung gi thad kyi nam mkha' yang ngur sprig tu gyur/ ltar snang tshogs pa ltos 〈gtos 〉che grags 〈drags 〉pas thugs sun pa'i tshul dang / nges don du sgrub gnas khyab par can gyi sgo 'byed par dgongs te/ gsang thabs su tsha 'ug tu byon/ tshogs khang chen mo rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum gyis (gyi 〉dbyibs yod par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /lhag par de'i nang rol zhig tu/ ting 'dzin phug par grags pas 〈pa'i 〉gzim spugs 〈sbug 〉tshul khrims kyi dri ngas ldang zhing / dbyibs legs ngo mtshar ba dang / gzhan yang phug chung du ma dang / rang byon sogs khyad par du 'phags pa mang po gtan la phab cing / khyad par rdo rje glo dkar du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ phug pa 'di dog 'dug gsungs nas yar bzhengs nas byu rgyab kyi 〈kyis 〉'phul bas/ na bza'i rnal 〈snal 〉ma'i rjes tshun chod dod pas 〈pa'i 〉sku rjes shin tu gsal ba dang / phyag 'khar gyis phug pa'i skar khyang dang / yo byad 'gel ba'i brag la phyag gi 〈gis〉'dam ltar bcangs pa'i tshom bu mtho gang lhag tsam pa dang /zag la phyag gis bcangs nas bzos pa'i sa phad che ba tsam shong ba'i skyongs 〈kong 〉mo zhig dang bcas ngo mtshar bar yod cing / da lta masan gyi sog ra'i rdzong sngon zhesapa nas/ dbyar gyi dus bzang zhig gi nub/dkar mo lta bu'i 'od gsum lnga bdun sogs thon nas tshogs khang dang rdo rje glo dkar yod sa'i bar snang la (55na)'gro ba gnas der rtag par sdod pa rnams kyis mthong zhing / gnas 'dzin dge sbyor mar ba re gnyis kyis/ dge bsnyen sog ras gsol 'debs bde chen kun bzang ma 'don pa yang thos pa byung 'dug de nas tshogs pa rnams kyis 94

btsal bas tsha 'ug tu bzhugs/ par shes te der byon/ da / 'dul 〉ri ri rdo re skyal 〈bskyal 〉nas chos khri chen po brtsigs pa der bzhugs nas zab cing rgya che ba'i chos 'khor dpag tu med pa bsko ra zhing / slar ya nga gdan sa chen po byang gleng nyid du phebs nas bzhugs par mdzad/ ma/bas shig chab gzhi'i snyan byung ba ja mthur 〈thur 〉song tshe nam mkha' nas mgon po phag mo gru pas gsung tshiṭa bcad bzhi pa/ lhag ma rlung yi/ sbyor ba yi 〈yis/〉 /skran dang dmu chu 'byung ba byed/ /rdo rje srin po'i sbyor ba yis/ /nyepa ga pa pa ma ( cad dbyung ba ra bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rten 'brel dang 'khrul 'khor mdza ) pas// zhag lnga nas snyan gas med dudwangs/ bka' 'bum du 'khod pa ltar bstan bcos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gegs se la/ ri chos sogs zab chos kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang la gang 'dul mtshad cing / da lta glegs bam du bzhugs pa 'di rnams yongs rdzogs ni ma yin la cha shas tsam mo/ thun mong gi 'khor rnams la/ gsang sngags rnying ma 'i chos zab mo gsung bar mi mdzad (55ba)kyang / dge bshes lto chung par snying ga'i rtsa 'dabs 〈'dab 〉brgyad la bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bkod de sgrub pas mtshon/ gang la gang 'dul gyis 〈kyi 〉chos rang blor mtshams 〈'tsham 〉pa ris su ma chad par ston par mdzad/ snyan pas rgya gar sogs phyogs kun tu khyab cing / lhag par rgya gar du slob ma dang yon bdag rgyal po yang mang du byung bas/ rje nyid kyi sku/ rgya gar li ma 'khrul med byu smra tsha gser can dang cha dmar tsha gser can/li dam/ra la li dmar gyi phra 'dzud can sogs 'ga' zung nges par yod pa yin no/ de nas re zhig sku dngos kyi gdul bya phal cher rdzogs par mkhyen nas/ sngon lag sardo rjer sprul te bdud kyi gnas 55

na (che pag bco 6 pas rgyu 'bras / mi bslu bas/ kho bori rngo ganga'ade ra yang re zhig chags/ 'ji / sa zhig 〈shig 〉'ong / 'on kyang phyir bsring thabs su/ thang la lha khang bye 'dra ba ma bzhengs/ de la rgyal mtshan bzhi ma 'dzug bye ma dung 'dra'i ngo ma bshu/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo la gnya' ga ma gtod/ sgrubs la gdan sa ma 'chol/ raka shi la lha rje ma 'tshal/ 'on kyang chos brgyud yun ring po'i bar du gnas par 'gyur ro/ zhes ru /gas bka' chems rgyas par bstsal zhing / gzhan yang ma 'ong 〈'ongs 〉pa na kho bo'i gling 'di nyams shing / ba ra bong dang /sgom ma ma lo can (cacan)gyis bzung ba dang / tshems shing btsugs pa 'a des sta yu dang ste'u yu nyan pa'i dus/ kho bo gling 'dir bskor 〈skor 〉ba/cag yang zhes/ kun dga' rin chen lung bstan/ gzhan yang/ma /ra/dze /de/lo /bo /sdebrag nga myo/ spungs pa 'a dang dus gsum du 'bral ba da/kho bo'i rjes su gser dngul las grub pa'i rten chen po ma bzhengs/phyag chen tshul khrims gnad gcig pas/ tshul khrims ri na po che la gces spras su kyis zhes pa sogs gsung gi tha ma rnams bstsal te/ le locan rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir ltar snang du gsung khro'i snyum byung bar sman pa rnams kyis byang g.yag gi glo ba skam po bzhes thug ge sdor la btab na phan zhus kyang / gdan gcig sdor dkar kyi sha brtul shugs〈zhugs 〉kho na mdzad pas/ ma gnang bar snyun ji cher 'phe / tsha de sngon nas lan gsum du spyan snga sher 'byung la gdan ri sa/ nye da par mdzad kyang / nan gyis gsol ba btab pas 'dir ma/bam/ ches/ gu ra ba la gdan sa gtad de/ me mo glang gi lo dgung lo doji / re bges pa 'i nag pa zla ba'i nyer lnga'i srod la sprul pa'i dkyil 'kho ra nga ri ga bye da byi sa su bsdu bar mdzad cing / de nas bzung ste phyi lo'i bar du 'ja 'a zhod 96

dang mi tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis (75ba)mi khyab pa byung zhing / sa ga zla ba'i tshes gsum la sku gdung zhugs la sbyangs pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma dkrigs shing / me tog gi char bol nub tsam du babs/ dbu thod ma nyams par dbu thad zhun thig gi 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis 〈kyi 〉dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bzo bo mkhas pas ri mor bris pa las kyang ches lhag pa 'bur dod du/ mtshams rnams ring bsrel gyi 〈 sa 〉spras pa dang / thugs ma nyams pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas de da mtshungs ra 'a la gdung dang ring bsrel 'dres pa/ thel gyi bre dkar gyi za brgyad bcas byon/ de yang srod la gshegs pa'i tho rangs de nyid du sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis mi khyab par byon zhing /ga cher sa shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing gi grangs su gtogs pa rdul dang bral ba'i zhing khams su mgon po phag mo gru pa'i spyan sngar sprul pa gcig byon/ mngon dga' nyid du yang mgon po mi 'khrug pa'i drung dusprul pa gcig byon nas bzhugs shing / dga' ldan du mgon po byams pa'i 'khor gyi tshul du bstan nas/ mdo rnga bo che'i dgongs pa zhu zhing bzhugs/ gzhan yang bde ldan dang / lcang lo can sogs su sprul pa re re bzhugs shing / sprul pa'i gtso bo (5 na)ni/ shar phyogs khyab gdal chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhes bya ba/ sa gzhi thams cad gser zhun ma las grub pa sogs/ dag pa'i zhing gi bkod ba phun sum tshogs par rang byung gi dge slong sku mdog dkar po'i tshul bstan nas/ 'khor bas ma gyis mi khyab pa la chos ston cing nyid kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa rnamasakyang / 'chi ba'i tshe rje nyid la dad pa brtan97

po bgyis na shi ma thag tu skyes bu stobs po ches lag pa brkyang 〈rkyang 〉bskum 〈skum 〉gyis (gyi 〉tshad tsam gyis drung du phyin par 'gyur zhing /de ma thag tu phyag g.yas pa 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa spyi bor bzhag nas bu khyod bde bar 'ongs sam/ zhes dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa /rnam thar mthong ba don yod ma nas gsungs pa ltar yin cing / zhing khams thams cad la gshegs pa yang / rnam thar phyogs bcu dus gsum ma las/ khyab brdal 〈gdal 〉mngon dga' bde ldan lcang lo can//zhingakhams tha dad kun tu gshegs bstan pa/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ de skabs dgongs rdzogs kyi zugs khur spyan snga sher 'byung gis gtso bor mdzad de/ de yang seng ge spungs pa'i steng du 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khoradang / 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyang dngos su bzhugs par gzigs nas/ 'dir yang rten bzheng bar dgongs pa'i tshe/ skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin (tsa ba)po che nyid brag ting 'dzin phug pa'i steng du dngos su byo / nas/ bu khyod ltar yin gyis 〈gye 〉nga ltar gyis/ zhes gabangasanas mi snang bar yal bas/ bu khyod ltar yin gsungs pa ltar/ sgo mang du thusapa khams gsum zil gnon bzhengs te thugs dang ring bsrel bre gsum bzhugs/ nga ltar gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ rin po che'i phye ma dang sman sna/ dri bzang sogs bsres pa'i 'jim pa las sku gdung 'dzam gling rgyas / banangs te/ de'i nang du dbu thod las byon pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang ring bsrel bye lnga/ jo bo rjes rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i rten mchog 'dzam gling rgyan/ 'dul ba 'dzam gling rgyan/ 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan sogs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / gser zangs las grub pa'i sgo mang / rmang ge'i phyogs bzhir 'dom lnga re yod pa zhig kyang bzhengs te/ nyid kyi thugs dam rten sgo 98

meng da mnyam du bzhugs so/ dam pa 'di nyid la slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / gtso che ba mchog tu gyur pa gong du bshad pa sa/ra/ rje nyid bstan pa'i bdag por bstan pa'i skabs/ res byams pa 'jam dbyangs dang / res pa chog zung du ston pa/ spyan snga sher 'byung dang grags 'byung gnyis yin la/ grags 'byung gi rnam thar da 'og nas/ (58na)gsal cing 〈zhing 〉sher 'byung la rnam thar rgyas pa yod mod kyang / lo rgyus mdor bsdus brjod na/ khams sga stodadu a phyi ca bzhi'i sngon nas gyes pa'i sgyu ra'i rigs su 'khrungs pa/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin bo che'i slob ma dpa da ldan ngad phu ba'i drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ zab chos phal cher ba/san/ phyis ngad phu ba sku gshegs nas/ dbus su rje 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi drung du byon/ mi ring bar gzim g.yog mdzad/ zhabs tog phul du byung ba sgrub bas thugadu dam bye ru la rdzogs/ cung zad tsam yang 'bral ba med par bzhugs shing rdo dro'i gsung sor/ sa ba 'a tha /sa cad kyi bka'i bsdu ba /dzad/ phyi chu ngam/ las 'das nas kyang dgongs rdzogs rnams yongs su grub pa mdzad/ gang du phebs kyang phyis sku nar son skabs do ma res 'gab tsam mdzad pa las / rtagatu chibs spangs nas zhabs thang / mkhar 〈'alar 〉bsil 〈gsil 〉bsnams nas dgra bcom pa rnams ltar mdzad/ cung zad tho da pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems dang zhing khams dpag tu med pa 'a/la gzigs/pa'i nad 'dis zhing spyongs sogs nges bar dgos pa zhig yi na gsungs/de nas gnam mtsho brgyud stod phyogs su phebs/ mang yul/ gu ge sa rangs rnams kyi btsad (58ba)po dang / stod hor/ gar log ya ca ba zhes pa da lta 'dzum lang du gras/sa pa dang bcas pa' 99

rgyal po rnams kyis gu rig pas btud de/ sto da phya /ri kyi 'phrin las kyis 〈kyi 〉rgyun yang rje 'di'i bka' drim/ las byung ba yin/ ti se dang /g.yu ru sogs kyi dgon gnas kyang 'debs par mdzad/ slar yang dbus gtsang du byon/ sa paṇa gyis kyang gus pas btud cing chos zhus/ mtshan spyan snga 'bri gung gleng par yang grags/ de nas sgam po'i gdan sa yang re zhig mdzad/ lho brag phyogs su yang phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/ dngos su 'bri gung pa'i sa/dan sar ma bzhugs kyang bka'i bsdu ba mdzad cing gdan sa shin tu dar zhing rgyas pa yang 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉bka' drin las byung ba yin no/ mkhan chen dang dbon chung sogs kyis 〈kyi 〉rnam thar sa 'og tu gsal la/mnyos chen po rgyal ba lha nang pa ni/ lo tsā ba dang grub pa brnyed 〈brnyes 〉pa rim par byon pa'i rgyud/ mnyos grags pa dpal zhes bya ba/khyim pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa shin tu mkhas shing grub pa mnyes 〈brnyes 〉pa/ slob ma yang mang du yod cing / stobs 'byor shin tu che bas/ 'di skabs lha sa sogs kyi bdag po yang mdza da pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ chung dus lo tsā ba bslab 〈bslabs 〉nas rgya gar du 'byon par bzhed (tsa na)kyang / yab kyi 〈kyis 〉ma gnang zhing / de nas rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i snyan pa gsan nas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med par gzigs nas/ rab tu byung bar dngo/ngas pas /yab kyis kyang bkas gnang nas/ 'bri gung du byon na sa rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ gong bshad ltar yab gzhis longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yin kyang skyid chos kyi grub pa mi thob par dgongs nas/'tsho ba sogs kyis 〈kyi 〉brtsol 〈rtsol 〉ba gtan nas ma mdzad par/tshogs chos dang nyid kho na las kyang thugs sras su gyur pas/ sger chos 100

ma nga du gnang ba gsan pa'i bar thams cad la/ dka' thub dang ba rtson 'grus drag pos sgrub pa mdzad pas thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzob /sa shing / phyis rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i drung du/ brgya thog stong bzhag stong thog khri bzhag gi 'bul ba yang lan gsum mjad cing /mnyo sa kyi bur ston zhes dper grags pa byung / phyis yab gshegs nas gcung po la gzhan gyis brnyas pa dang / sngon gyi mnga' thang rnams shor yang / chos brgyad kyi snang ba gtan nas zhig pas/ dgra gnyen phyogs ris kyi dbye ba cung zad kyang ma mdzad/ de nas gnyan chen po thang lhas sbyin/ bdag bgyis te/ lha'i nang zhes pa dge 'dun sto/nga nye bar tshogs pa'i dgon gnas chen po zhig kyang 'debs par mdzadapas mtshan(tsa ba)yang rgyal ba lha nang pa zhes grags/ rten 'brel 'a mnga' brnyes pas rten 'brel gang bsgrig 〈sgrig 〉thams cad mo sa de nyid la 'byung ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i ste ri thar rtsod med du grags/ phyis mya ngan las 'das pa'i ma/ thang lha sa kyang mya ngan byas te/ gangs shel ltar dkar ba lo mang po'i ba du mo // por gyur cing / hor dmag lhag 〈lhaṭa 〉nas mi nyag rgyal po bcom pa so/gas/sa'i bcud nyams pa'i ltas mang du byung ngo / dpal chen chos ye ni/sngon du rta 'chag tu rdzu 'phrul bstan pa rnams las gzhan rnam thar ma mthong la/ rnam thar mthong ba don yod las/ khong rtso da med kyi grubathob chos sding pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar (ro/) grub chen 'gar sa ma da khams dme mdor gdung rus 'gar las/ gsang sngas/sa/ kyi grub pa bsnyes pa sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa yang lnga tsam byung ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med byu mnga' bas/ yab kyis kyang sngags chog la 'byon pa'i tshe/ nad pa 101

gsos mi bsos 〈gsos 〉sogs 'dri bar mar da/ re'u skyes zhes bya bas bsnyad 〈brnyas 〉pa byas par thugs khros te byu ba brdab 〈brdabs 〉pas kho spyo ba sogs nus pa chen po mnga'/ sngags pa zhig gis tsakra glang bu zhes bya bar gtad byas pas/ sngags pa kho rang dang /klu dang / dgra bcas phung bas thugs (la )tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po 'khrungs/ ( ༷na)de nas 'bri gung du ston nas/ chos rje'i spyan sngar lto gos la rgyang bskur nas chos gsan cing / sgrub pa yang ma da/de nas tsa rir phebs te sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ rje mi lar la phyi tshe ring mched lnga'i cho 'phrul byung ba ltar/ 'dre dmag gi cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa byung bar bzlog sgom dar thog ris/ rtags drug brtul zhugs ro snyoms kyis 〈kyi 〉spyod pa mdzad pas rang zhir gyur te/zugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs shing / khyad par du rdo rje 'jigs byed la grub pa brnyes/ de skabs rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ yi dam gyi lha rdo rje 'jigs byed las lhag ba med kyang / khyod kyi de bzhin ra lugs yin pas pa lo bla ma dang dam sel yod cing brgyud pa der ku stegs kyi paṇḍi ta 'bar ro lag rdum yang yod pas cung mi legs/ mnyosanas brgyud pa 'di brgyud pa rna par dag pa yin pas khong nas zhus gsungs pa ltar mdzad/ de skabs shig dpal chen thi phug pa'i 'bul ba'i rjes su/ nad bdag mo 'brangs te byung nas/ gling rin po che'i dge 'dun rnams la rims byung bas/ grub thob 'gar nyid dang /rin po che gan mtsho ba gnyis/ dge 'dun bsnyung ba rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉sngas bsrungs 〈srung 〉su 〈du 〉rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pas bka' //rdo / //〈(1 ga 'a bye ——— rdo/ zhig gi de bye / ga/ga dzis bye/ sna /03

pas mad bdag mo dpral ba na mig zla ba tsam yod pa/ mgo bo nam mkhar sleb pa zhig gis khrag gi kha phrur 'debs pa gzigs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i skur bzhengs nas zhal du gsol bas phyi rteng ser lhag gi song bas phyi nang nas rims nad chad/rje 'jig rten mgon pos kyang shin tu mnyes par mdzad/ gzhan yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim brtan po mnga' bas/ bla g.yel gyi gdung ma dang / nyid kyi bang khang gi ya them bcas la yang ra yis 〈yi 〉rjes yod par grags/ phyis phrin 〈'phrin 〉las kyang nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur nas/ chos rje rin po che'i drung du 'bul mo che lan mang dumadzad/ lhag par bal yul tshun chad du byon nas/ gser gdugs ngo mtshar can sgrub nas dbu thog du 〈tu 〉bul/ bal yul gyi gzhi bdag sbrang gdong ma dang / bya zhu sogs gzhi bdag gdug pa can rnams dam la btags shing / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rtsal 〈bstsal/〉phyis khams su phebs pa'i skabs shig rje 'jig rten gsum mgon nam mkhar byon nas mjal bas zhing gzhan du gshegs pa mkhyen nas gsol 'debs kyi gdung dbyangs mdzad cing / myur stabs su 'bri gung du byon/ 'bul ba chen po ( 1na)mdzad/ mi nyag du 〈tu 〉khrims gcod kyi mi bco brgyad rengs par mdzad pa dang / byang 'brong spyon pa'i thog tu chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bas byang 'brong re zhig brgyal zhing /brgyal sangs tshe spyo ba 'khru grol ba dang / mdo khams byang phyogs kyi smad du phebs tshe hor dmag byung ba nub gcig la yang kha ba chen po phab ste 'ga' zhig non cing / byings rnamasaslar log pa dang / 'ol tsha 'brong bu gnyis chings mdzad pa 'ol tshas cung zhig bka' la ma nyan pas mi shis pa sna tshogs byung / nag 'du'i khri tshos stod ca phebs tshe sku la 103

brdo 〈bsdo 〉bar brtsams pas ming gis 〈gi 〉lhag ma tsam du sang ba nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab cing grub pa'i rtags dang / ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa yang shin tu mang bas yi ge 'brir ma lang / chos sdings su dgon pa btab/ nyid bzhugs pa'i tshe tshogs pa stong dang nyis brgya tsam 'du ba byung / de skabs bka' gdams kyi ston pa zhig gis phrag dogs 〈dog 〉byas pas mi 'gyang ba med par gyur/ ser ba brag thog pas mi mnyes pa cung zad byas pas khyod la rtags 'ong de dus 'byu gung du song / zhes pa gsungs pa ltar/ spyang ki ngu ba dang gdung ma chag pa dang / khro chag pa dkar yol chag pa gsum dus gcig tu byung / mkhar tshal pa brgyad du song nas gcig ma gtogs 'gyel bas (71ba)'jigs nas rje 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi drung du phyin nas slob mar gyur/ mang ra rta sha ba zer nas 〈ba'i 〉dmag mi gdug pa can sum brgya lhag tsam gyis/ bstan pa la 'tshe bar byung bas mdo li ba bcu drug la bka' gnang nas de dag gis rgyugs pas/ lung pa thams cad btsun pas gang bar mthong nas/ dmag mi rnams 'jigs grags 〈drags 〉nas go mtshon rnams sku mdun du spungs shing yon bdag byed par khas blangs/ de nas sku 'khor lnga brgya tsam khrid/ byings rnams chos ring nyid du bzhag nas/ nyid 'khor bcas dwags por phebs/de nas kong po skyem du phebs te/ da lta'i 'gar sa dgon du grags pa 'di btab/ de nas spu bor byon nas phu lung dgon 'debs par mdzad cing / de nas mi ring bar sprul pa bsdus so/ dpal chen za phug pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing chos sde chen po yang btab/ 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab/ dpal ldan ngad phu ba ni/khyis zug par snying rje bsgom 〈sgom 〉pas/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa zugs 104

/sgo /cho /sdo /dri —— /zhil 'khrungs/ lnga / du ga nas sa btab nga na las kyang na tu che/ rdor 'a jin ga ga /ga ru dpal grags kyis la phyi btab cing /gzhan yang skyid grang du sanas bka brgya rtsa brgyad btab pa 'ga' byug da lta yang yod/ ngo pa je dros ba 'i lo rgyus ( 1na) sa sngon du gsal/ skyo rdo rje snyeng po ཿ khan sa skya'i lha khang chen mo bzhengs shing /'dus sde yang mang du btab/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i rnam thar ni rgyas pa gzhan du 'byung zhing / paṇa chen shākya za/ paṇa chen bal bu bu rgyu nye/ rje mi dra 〈( 〉jo ki bcas paṇa grub gsum gdan drangs/khro phu dga' ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen po btab/ rgyal ba ma pham pa'i sku ma 'ongs pa na nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sku tshad bzhengs/ thag ma 'dul 'dzin sa/ 'dul 'dzin chen por gyur cing / thag ma lha khang du slob ma yang 'dul 'dzin lnga brgya tsam byung / spyan snga rdo rje shes rab ni/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che dang / spyan snga shes 'byung thun mong gi slob ma yin cing / dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i 'grel pa do she ma mdzad/ thub pa bsod snyoms pa ni/ spyan snga sher 'byung gi gcung po yin cing / 'di nyid kyi mtshan dngos rin chen byang chub zhes (ces 〉grags pas dgongs gcig gi 'grel pa mdzad pas / dgongs gcig gi 'grel pa rin byang mar grags shing nges don gyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ spyan snga rnam gnyis dang dbon sogs spya na snga brgyad/ mnyos 'gar sogs thugs /kye /cho (pe (〈 /tshe 11 1—— /sto/ste sras brgyad/ sa gu ra gas dpal na brgyad/ ra sogs ras pa ( 1ba)brgyad de/ sto tsho ras pa 'di nyid kyis mi nyag rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad pas ti shīr grags/ gu ya gangs pa soṭa gangs pa gsum/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ sgrubs lo tsā ba sogs lo tsā brgyad de/ de 105

yang snubs lo tsā ba 'di stag phu' chos grwar bzhugs thong snyen tu mkhas la gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pas dge bshes chen po yin cing / rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po cher dad pa thob ste zhabs la gtugs shing slob mar gyur/ khrid gnang ba rnams la sngon du chos kyi sgo 'byed pa'i dbang bskur gnang ba por bsko bar mdzad pas chos sgo bar grags shing / 'di nas chos sgo ba rnams rim par byung /thag ma 'dul 'dzin dwags po 'dul 'dzin la sogs pa'i 'dul 'dzin bcu/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin rgo 'dul 'dzin chen por gyur cing /gam po'i gdan sa 'dzin/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che sgam por gdan drangs shing gdan sa yang phul/ skyo khroms sogs bka' gdams kyi ston sgom chen po brgyad/ nyi ma seng ge dang / bdud rtsi zhig bo bcas zhig po lnga sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung yang / phal cher gyi rnam thar ni ma mthong la/ mthong ba thams cad sa yi ges 'jigs nas 'dir ma bris so/rgyal ba'i bstan rtsa 'dul ba'i dbyig 'dzin la/ /( yin)bslab gsum kubyu ma yi tshal rgyas shing / /tshul khrims dri bsrung 〈bsung 〉bzang pos 'gro kun gyi/ /nyon mongs nad se mkhan chen pa yis skyong 〈skyongs/〉 /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi rgyal tshab tugyur pa gdan sa dang po mkhan chen gu ra ba ni/ de yang 'di nyid se'u gangs dkar mo bya bar/ sum pa do rje dpal zhes bya ba'i sras su shing pho khyi lo la 'khrungs shing / cher skyes pa dang grogs mkhar gtsang ston zhes bya ba'i 'dul 'dzin zhig la rab tu byung zhing / mtshan yang tshul khrims rdo rje zhes gsol te/ lo shas mkhan po de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉drung du bslab bya'i phyag len la bslabs shing btsun pa'i grags pa thob pa ya nga 106

—byung ngo / de nas rim pa ltar stod lung du byon nas dpal chen dza thagom ba'i drugadu bsnyen pa rjogasabar mdzad nas/ mdo rtsa la sogs pa 'dul ba'i bstan bcosarnams la yang byang bar mdzad pa'i 'og tu lung sde bzhi'i tshigadon ma gyas ba la mkhas par gyur nas/ dbu stod gu ra'i gnas gzhi bzung nasamakhan po'i bya ba mdzad/ lo mang du tshogs pa skyong zhing bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉pa'i tshe/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon bo'i mtshan thos nas/ dgung lo zhe drug pa la( lnga )'byu chung byang chub kyi gling du byon nas bzod klag 〈gas 〉 da pa'i mos gus 'khrungs nas/ chos rje nyid dang 'bral ba med par bzhugs shing / gdams pa ma lus pa gnang bas mos gus kyirtsal rdzogs shing / grub pa brnyes te lo mang du mkhan po'i thugs khur bsnams so/ ma ra gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs shing yon tan rin po che'i gter mdzod rdol nas/ 'jig rten mgon pos de bzhin gsheṭa pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam 'phrul du lung bstan pa'i rjes su/ thabs lam rtsal rdzogs nas tshogs su sprul bsgyur sku'i bkod pa du ma yang bstan/de nas dgung lo re bzhi pa la 'jig rten mgon pos bka' gnang nas/ lo gsum gyi bar tshogs pa skyangs 〈skyongs 〉la/ de nas dbon risapho ma la gdan sa gtod gsungs nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu lo bzhi'i bar du gdan sar bzhugs shing / zab pa dang rgya che ba'ichos kyi 'khor los gdul bya rnams smin pa dang grol bar ma da pa'i mtha / bla ma'i bka' bstsal dran nas dbon rin po che gdan sar mnga' gsol ste/ de nub srod la cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas te byu ngan las 'das so/ 'di'i bu chen dang slob ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung tshul rnams ni/ yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas107

( tren)'dir ma bris so/klu zhabs gnyis pa'i bsil zer ngang nyid las/ /'dul bya'i mos blo'i gtsang byed snod dang por/ /sprul pa'i 'od dkar gzugs brnyan 'gog med du/ /'char ba dbon ston bsod nams grags de rgyal/ /de nas gdan sa gnyis pa dbon rin po che bsod nams grags pa 'di nyid/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i yab kyi mched dkon mchog rinachen gyi sra a nye sa grags la sras dbon rin po che/ dpon brgyud pa rdo rje seng ge gcung rin po che bcas gsum 'khrungs pa las che ba dbon rin po che nyid/ sga yul non 'jam 'om bu lung zhes par/sa mo lug gi lor sku bltams/ skyed rim gyi bsrings nas/ yig brtsis 〈rtsis 〉la sogs/ ba 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams la mkhyen rab phu sa du phyi na/ dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa na/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por/ bu slob rnams kyi gdan sa dbon rgyud kyi 〈kyis 〉'dzin par gso/la ba btab par/ bstan pa'i gsal byed du dgongs nas/ dpal chen sa phug par lung bstan te khams phyogs su brdzangs/ a nye sa grags yab sras rnams la rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ rje'i snyan pa brjod pas bag chags sangs te/ nged ( treb)sa khu'i drung du 'gro ba yin gsungs/ yab kyis kyang da lo dbon 'di gtong ba yin/ phyin chad kho bo cag 'khor dang bcas 'bri gung du yong ngo zer/ dbon nyid rdzong ba du ma dang bcas dpal chen dang mnyam du 'bri gung du byon/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i drung rabatu byung / mtshan bsod nams grags par gsol/ bka' brgyud kyi dam ri 'i chos mang du gas na/ gzhan yang snubs ston yon tan grags pa las dgyes dor la sogs pa gsan zhing sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu 108

gsum lo —/ pa kyi/ 'a dag sbya ra mdzad cing sgrub pa la bzhugs/ rdor dkar dang gad na gcis/ ji brtul zhugs la gnas nas/ lo bcu gsum bar rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i zhal nas/ da res dka' spyad sgrub pa la brtsom pa 'di'i 〈'dis〉/ mi rabs bcu gsum bar du sgrub pa mi dgos par 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung ngo / da gzhan snang bstun par/ stag phur slob gnyer byed pa 〈par 〉byon dgos gsungs/ de bzhin byon te/ jo bo yon tan grags las gsang 'dus bde dgyes la sos/sa rgyud sde'i ma na ngag mang du gsan zhing sbyangs/ slar 'bri gung du phebs/ rje 'jib rten ba/sum gyi ma ba ma/ po nyid dang bu slob rtsod bral rnams las/'du — ba dang / mdo ( sman)khyud la sos/sa pa gsan cing sbyangs pa'i 〈nga/ri 〉mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab/ slar yang lo drug bar 'dag sbya ra mngad cing thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs/ de nas dgung lo so sa/ 3ga bzhe pa ba pa'i tshe/ mnyam med stobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che dgongs pa chas dbyings su thim pa na/ chu slob rnam sakyi 〈kyis 〉gdan sar gsol ba btab kyang / lo bzhi'i 'dag sbya ra dam bca' ma thems bar ma gnang ste/ mkhan chen gu ra ba gdan sar mnga' gsol/de nas dgung lo so lnga pa la/ mkhan po rin po che'i 〈ches 〉dbus 'bri gung pa'i che dgu thams cad kyis nan gyis gsol ba ltar chos srid kyi khrir rgyal tshab du 〈tu 〉mnga' gsol/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang dbang por mtshams 〈'tsham 〉pa'i gang 'dul zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor la bskor zhing snying po'i bstan pa 'di nyid ches cher gsal bar mdzad/ de nas dgung lo so dgu par/ rin po che sna bdun las bkra shis sgo mang rgya khyon tshad las 'das pa lha grangs nyis stong ba 7da 109

brgya phyag tshad tshang ba/ nang bzhugs rgyud sde'i lugs bzhin mtshan nyid ldan pa bzhengs te rab tu gnas par mdzad/ dus kun tu yar ngos thams cad la snga dro sku mtshams dang / phyi dro zab mo'i chos kyi 〈kyis 〉bskal 〈skal 〉bzang sdod ldan rnams tshim zhing smin cing grol bar mdzad/mar ngos thams cad la( 'ab)smra bcad 'dag sbyar gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad pas/ chu 'phen gyi ri thub pa'i dbang po sogs snod bcad thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems yid dam 'ba' zhig me chu sogs 'byung ba bzhi dang sems can gyi za sogs sgra grags thams cad sngags/dran rtogs thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pa las mi 'da'/ rje 'ji / rten gsum mgon gyi 〈rgyas 〉kho bo'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med/ ces nyid kyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ dbon bsod nams grags pa 'di nyid/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa me mo lug gi lor smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyer ba/nyis kyis 〈kyi 〉snga dro sku mya ngan las 'das so/'di'i dbu g.yang la rje btsug rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byon pa sogs ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa ni yi ger 'god ma nus cing 〈shing /〉 slob ma'i tshogs ni bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rnam thar yod pa phal cher da lta mjal ba'i yul du ma gyur to/mkha' sogs 'byung ba bzhi la dbang bsgyur zhing / /zag pa med pa 'i ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul brnyes/ /mngon pagashes mnga' chos rnams kun gyi don//ma 'dres thugs chud grags pa 'byung gnas rgyal/ /gdan sa gsu ba phyin snga rin po che grags pa 'byud gnas ni/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul mdo khams bye lung rag ( can) bya bar/ dpal ldan glang gi 〈rlangs kyi 〉gdung las/ yab lha gzigs yon sgom/ yum 'bro gza' 〈bza' 〉khyi gu lcam bya ba gnyis kyi sras su/ shing mo lug gi 110

lor sa 'khrungs/ rim gyis bskyed bsrings nas/ 'jig rten gyi bya bar snying po med par dgongs te/ thog mar sangs rgyas yel pa'i drung rab tu byung / de nas rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i drung du byon rab tu byung nas/ mtshan grags pa 'byung gnas zhes gsol/ rje'i spyan sngar gzim g.yog mdzad cing lo nyer gcig gi bar du bzhugs/ dam pa'i chos ma lus pa gsan pa'i chos mdzod kyi bdag por mnga' brnyes/de nas rje'i drung bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes te sku btsun pa'i mthar thug par gyur/ de skabs chos rje nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉'bri gdan gnyis na'i gdan sa mdzad pa na/ sku nar son pas ma lcogs te/gdan sa jil gyi mkhan por brdzangs/ kha sang phan ཿ da nga bla ma yin/de ring phyin chad khyed bla sayin/ gdan sa brgya 'gyur gyi bzang du gtong ba yin gsung 〈gsungs/〉 'khor sum brgya dang bcas pa dpal gyi phag mo grur phebs te gdan sar dbang bskur/ phyag chen tshul khrims gnad gcig gis dgongs pa yang gsal bar mdzad cing ( cab)phrin las shin tu rgyas/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i dgongs rdzogs su gser zangs las bkra shis sa mang thog tshad gnyis pa zhig bzhengs/ rje 'jig rten mgon po dag zhing du gshegs nas gangs ljongs 'dir dge bshes thamasacad kyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba yin zhes/ sa skya paṇḍi ta'i yab rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan can gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur spyan drangs/ de nas mi ring bar 'bri gung du dbon rin po che bsod nams grags pa zhing brjes nasagacung rin po che'i gsung gi 〈gis 〉kho bo them spangs kyi dam bca' ma thems par smra ba'i seng ge spyan snga rin po che gdan drongs gsungs pa ltar/ bu slob che dgu thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉nyid 'bri gung gi gdan sar mnga' 111

—mol dam/ nga ri tsha spyi dang bye brag thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mja zhe sa / ra zang pa bas bkra this sgo mang sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhengs/ ba zabs po do du hor dam ga byung nas mi thams cad srog dang bral/gtsug la ba nga nga ga cher mer bsres pa'i tshe/ hor gyi dmag dpon thogamar byung bar 'a kyi /thong ba tsam gyi / dad pa skyes nas yon bdag byed par /nga ri blangs / sla ra dor tob/ ces pa gdug rtsubs 〈〈ba 〉can byung bas/ ma pa/ mo/da kyang dpon sgom pa shag rin khrid par brtsams pa na rdo char phab te 〈ste 〉btul/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos gsungs pas hor nag po yang ( 7na)cho rig ga 'gyur te/ gling rin po cher gnod pa cung zad tsam yang ma byas pa sosas bod kha ba can pa rnams mtha' dmag gi 'jigs pa las skyabs/ 'phrin las shin tu che bas lo mang por gdan sa bskyangs/ sngon gdan sa bal du bzhugs skabs/ ngam shod kyi btsad po zhig gis 〈gi 〉lto bar 'bru sha rig 'dzin zhes pa'i nus pa can gyis ma gnod pa sogs sku'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / dgung lo gya gcig pa shing yos lor rgyal zla'i tshes brgyad la cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas sprul pa bsdus so/ slob ma ma rgyal ba yang dgon pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab so 〈bo/〉dkyil 'khor kun gtso dpal ldan ste ru sa/ /ngur smrig gar gyi rdzu bag la brten nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong zhing gdug pa can//zhal mthong 'dul mdzad rdo rje grags par 'dud/ /gdan sa bzhi pa gcung rin po che rdo rje grags pa ni/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul dang yab yum sogs gong du smos pa dbon rin po che'i rnam thar ltar yin la/ rje 'di nyid lcags pho rta'i lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drus/ tu gre ba na/ yab yum sras dang bcas 'byu gung du phebs/ rje skyobs 112

(skyob 〉pa rin po che'i drung rab tu byung / mtshan rdo rje grags par ( ba)gsol/ chos rje'i zhal nas 'di nyid ste lo pa chen po'i rnam 'phrul yin/ nged rang thams cad las bstan par phan zhing phrin las rgya che ba yong gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bdun gyi tshe/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa gzhan don du gshegs pa na/ nyid kyi bdag rkyen thams cad dbon bsod nams grags pas mdzad cing / rim gyis bris klog dang 'jig rten gyi bstan bcos thams cad la byang bar mdzad/ dbon gyi drung / snying po'i chos thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshu ba du gsan/gzhan yang dge bshes du ma las/ bde dgyes gsang gsu ma sogs rgyud sde du ma dang / mdo rgyud mang du gsan cing sbyangs pas ma/bas pa'i mchog tu gyur/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rta ra yon tan steng kha bya bar/ 'dag sbyar gyi lo bcu gsum bar rim gnyis zab mo 'i dus 'da' bar mdzad/ yi dam gyi lha mang du zhal gzigs/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brnyes/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa la/ dbon rin po che dag zhing du gshegs par/ gdan sar phebs pa gsol yang / lo grangs dam bca' ma thems par zhal gyis ma bzhes/ der thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs shing / de'i tshe/ grub thob dam pa nam pasar gong ma se chen rgyal pos khrim sa kyi rnam grangs du ma bcad pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi 〈gyes 〉skyon ma byung yang / tsan dan gyi mer zhag (78na)gsum bsregs pas sku che'i 'du byed gtong bar nyi ba na/ rje nyid rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing seng ge la chibs ste mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bzhin/ yi ge gsum gyi rnam pa garma pa la bstem 〈bste mas 〉nas sku lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ narma pa khyed ma 'jigs par zad par me'i ting nge 113

'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa zhu gsungs pas/ rkarma pas khyod sku su lags zhing khams gang du yod zhus pas/ kho bo sngon 'phags yul ) 'o pa/ da lta 'bre gung na spyan snga gcung rin po che bya ba yin/ zhing khams brgya na kho bo'i sprul pa re yod gsungasanas mi snang bar gyur/de'i tshe grub chen kerma pa ma me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na mgur gsung gi 'dug pa la/ rgyal po 'khor bcas dad shing 〈cing 〉bshags pa dul zhing rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nam pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus 'dri gung pa/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon rdo rje grags/ /khong seng ge dkar mo'i steng du bcibs/ /mi kho bo'i mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//gsung lhang lhang bdag la 'a skad gsungs/ /'gro ba'i mgon po kurma pa/ /sbyangs pa mthar phyin thu /sa rje can/ /lam byang chub sems la —— /sgo ( )/sto /ste :)—— 1— /stenan tan ma da/ / da 78ba nga da nam mkha // gsungs shing slar yang mkha' la gshegs/ mi kho bo 'byung bzhi'i / /ri / /phyo / /gribadud las rgyal/ / sa pa mgur yang ba ngas/ sa narma pag 'gung du byon/ tsog sna'i zhol nas/ gling rin po che rgyal ba rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor du gzigs/ nyid la 'bul zhabs dang / dge 'dun la mang 'gyed sto bas che ba gnang / zhi byed mang lam la sogs pa'i zab chos du ma gsan/ thugs yi da gcig 'dres tu 〈su 〉gyur/ de nas dgung lo zhe drug pa la 'dag sbyar gyi dam bca' zas 〈thems 〉pa na/ 'bri gung pa'i che dgu thams cad kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos khrir mnga' gsol ste/ 'dul bya rnams ga 'dul zab rgyas smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po ches lung bstan pa ltar/ bod thams cad zhi ba'i sgo nas dbang du bsdus/sngon gyi dus ltar dge 'dun tshogs pa khri tsho bco brgyad che brjod tsam 114

min par rta tu 'dus/ tshangs pa'i ga'/lamed khang la 'gran par nus pa'i/ lha khang chen mo na ba brgya dang brgyad cu pa nang gi zhal ba rnams gser gyi sde gus khyab pa/ gser zangs las grub pa'i de bzhin gshes/sa pa'i sku chad las 'das pa bcu phrag gcig dang gdeng 〈gdengs 〉can gyi grangs ldan bkra shis ( na)sgo mang dbang po'i grangs ldan/ gtsug lag khang shi steng du/ rin chen gsum par 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi (gyis 〉g.yogs pa'i rgya dzibs bzo bo phal gyi lag pa'i 'du byed las 'das pa lta bu dang / gser phru bgrang bar mi nus pa sogs so skye'i blo'i ra ba las rgal 〈brgal 〉ba dag ring por mi thog 〈thoṭa 〉pa skad cig nyid la grub par mdzad de/ rje nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉dbusadage slong sdom ldan khri phrag bcu gsum gyis rgyud sde du ma'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ skabs zhig 〈shig 〉hor gyi rgyal po khas te kha zhes gdug pa can dmag mi mang po dang bcas/ 'dam du lhag 〈lhags 〉ste 〈te 〉dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshesaganyen dang / mi dpon thams cad khrems la gtugs pa'i phyir bsdus pa'i mar rgyalab nyid kyang gdan drangs pa'e ma/ sku 'khor rta dkar po kho na la zhon pa lnga brgyas thog drangs/'khor tshogs ca dzad bcas phebs pa'i gzi brjid rgyal pos ma bzod nas khri nyam par brtsegs te bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rgyal pos rje nyed ste ru nar mthong ste/ blon dza rnam sa la mas pa/ de ring gi bla ma 'di mig gsum mche ba dang bcas 'ji /sa su rung ba zhig 'dug sang zer zhing /rtog lung ba'i sangs rgyas sar byon de ( ba)skabs sku khams shin tu ma bde ba zhig byung yang / dbang med du 'gus su byung bar/ rje 'dis/hor gyi rgyal po la stag lung pa gad na drangs na sku gshegs par gyur 〈'gyur 〉bas gdan sa 'dren/ khong gi dgongs pa thams cad kho bos 115

sgrubs 〈sgrub/〉 nged dwags po bka' brgyud kurma pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ kho bo gsum 'dra ba yi na gsungs ngo che / mdzad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyi mnal lam du/ grub chen te lo par zhal gzigs nas/khyod hor gyi rtsa —/ byon 〈'byon 〉mi dgos pa kho bos byas yod/ kho bo rgya dar na ste lo pa dang / bod 'dir spyan snga gcung rin bya ba yin gsungs shing / mnyes/ mnyes ltar mdzad pa la thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu zhus pas/ de tsam mi dgos khyod kyang kho bo'i sprul pa gcig yin gsungs mi snang bar gyur te/ 'khor rnams la kho bo 'dam du 'gro mi dgos par 'dug gsungs lo rgyus zhib tu byon nas/ de'i tshe gcung rin po che nyid la bstod pa nyer bdun pa mdzad do/ de nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas zhabs la btud cing / bod khams 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad de/ slar 'bri gung du phebs nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos gangs ljongs su 'gyur ro cog gis 〈gi 〉 glegs bam bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs pa mdzad (80na)cing / dge 'dun gyis 〈gye 〉tshogs pa 'bum phrag lhag pa la/ pha chos lnga ldan chos drug la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / gangs ti se la phyi tsā ri tra sogs gnas gsum gyi ri khrod 'dzin pa la sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa rnams brdzong ba dang /'bri gung byang chub gling rin po che 'di nyid du smra bcad 'dag sbyar gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa sgyub rgyud rin po che'i ring lugs kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa mang po 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa mdzad/ de nas skabs shig gnas chen dpal gyi tsā ri tra ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du phebs nas /gzigs snang rnams gtan la phab cing / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / der gnas pa'i skye dgu rnams la chos 116

dang zang zing ma / nas 〉tshim par mdzad/ yul smad las ma sha 〈tshan 〉bco brgyad sas/sa dang rdor 'dzin 'gro mgon phyag chen bcas bsko dro ///dro rdoX/ gan/ /nas dwa/pa spya'ihoX gazlo / ma ngache rdokā kyi〈 // / /bu sa /shā bye /shā rjo /rdo rdo pa /sa rdoX /ma/ ga logarje pa da/ la gsobye/da bkyi ba/shā na sa da ni kho bo brgyal sangs pa lta bu zhig byung gsungs zhing 〈shing /〉// 0ba/dhi /rdoX rdogo/ sal bsta/ba nardo / / // / / rnyi rdo/ rdo pa rnyi sa / dwags po lung pa dang / nor gling khang gsar la sogs gzhis chen mang du phul bar/ brgyal sangs dgon pa sogs da lta yang cung zad yod/de skabs sgom pa la khri dpon gyi lung las byung / byar dwas/sa kong gsum phal cher la dbang bsgyur zhing / mnga' thang yang shin tu rgyas so/ de nas 'dzam dang gu ling bya ba dben gnas rnams su rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor la bzhugs te/ de nas dgung lo re dgu par 〈pa 〉sa pho stag gi lor/ ston zla ra ba'i nyer gnyis kyi nyin dzam zhes pa 〈pa'i 〉gnas de nyid du sku'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings su bsdus so/ sku gdung las ring bsrel mang du 'phel ba ni/ da lta ther gyi gcung sku 'bum grags pa der bzhugs/ tshems byon sgol ma ni da lta sgo lung gi shā/ :rdo / /rje spya pa/'i tshog dzi spya bye / bye/zloshā / bye pa : sab ://gas pa byang chub thugs bskyed 'od dkar 'bum/ 'phro zhing / /mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i cha shas ngo ngas su rdzogs/ /bsla ba gsum/ rigs dwags kyis mtshan ratna phyi/ /bsta na pa rgyas mdzad rin chen seng ger 'dud/ /117

gad na sa lnga pa thog kha ba rin po che na/ 2di nyid byu 'khrungs (81na)pa'i yul 'dan stod kyi grong khyer tsong ngu na/ myu ra'i rigs/ dbon rin po che dang / gcung gi mched 'a bang ba dpon brgyud pa rdo rje seng ge bya ba'i sras su sku mched lnga byung bar che ba nyid dang / de 'og rdo rje dang / de 'og gcung sa nu rgyal/ de 'og spyan snga ma mas bcad pa rin po che/ chung shos dkon mchog tshes yin la/ de yang rje thog kha ba 'di nyid/ me pho khyi'i lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs ma thag 'phags pa snying rje'i lha'i yang snying yi ge drug pa gsungs pa sogs skye dgu kun gyi blor mi shong ba'i ma da pa ma 'a las 'das pa bstan/ bskyed bsrings nas yig brtsis 〈rtsis 〉 sogs 'jig rten gyis (gyi 〉gtsug lag kun la mkhyen rabs 〈rab 〉phul du phyin/ de nas dgung lo dgu la/ nges 'byung drag pos 'khor ba'i bya ba la thugs byung ste/ gcung rin po che'i drung ru rab tu byung / mtshan rin chen seng ge zhes gsol/ rim bzhin gcung gi drung nas/ zab mo lnga ldan/ chos drug mos gus srog 'khor/ zab chos la sogs pa dam pa'i chos ma lus pa gsan/ gzhan yang dge bshes du ma las bka' bstan mdo rgyud sogs mtha' yas pa gsan cing sbyangs/ chos je bla ma'i /zim khang thog kha gser khang du lo bdun gyi bar 'dag byer smra bcad (81ba)mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'phas/sa pa gru 'dzin dgyes da nga / yi dam gyi lha du ma dang / bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mang du zhal /ze /de mo kyi /cig gas/ dus ra sa gus rtsal gas nas gnyug ma lhan ga skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur nas/ chos gos nyi zer la 'a la ba/ba rlabs gyen du ldog 〈bzlog 〉pa la sogs grub rtags mang du bstan/de nas gcung rin po che zhing brjes pas/ rgyal tshab tu gsol ba btab 118

ba rtse cikyang ma gnang / da na gnas rnams su sgrub pa la ga ga bzhus/sa shing / thun bar bka' chos thams cad bug sgo nas sa/nang ba sogs /sgrub rgyud 'di'i ring lugs mig ltos gyen la 'dren par ma/dzad cing / rdzu 'phrul du mas skal ldan gyi 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams dad pa'i mtsho rdol bar gyur/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum par gdan sa chen po'i gser khrir phebs/ bshad sgrub kyi ring lugs mi nyams shing ches cher rgyas par mdzad/ 'dzam gling che dgu thams cad kyis 〈kyi 〉gtsug gi nor bur bkod de/ phyi nang gi nor rdzas dpag tu med pa phul bas de dag la snying po len pa'i phyir/ bkra shis sgo mang la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rteg du ma dang / gsung rab kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs shing / dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang gnas gsum ri khrod du zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bsnyen bkur (81na)bla na med par mdzad pa sogs/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor spel ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po ches dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ de nas gdul bya mtha' dag rdzogs nas dgung lo nga dgu pa shing sprel lor sku'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su thim so 〈mo/〉dka' spyad ha lu mcha ye shes kyis 〈kyi/〉 /nyag phran dag gi 〈gis 〉mda' lnga'i 'og 〈'bod 〉sgrogs mchog /bcom nas bde chen mata slar blangs pa/ /mtshams bcad grags pa bsod nams bdag sogs skyong 〈skyongs/〉 /gdan sa drug pa spyan snga mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams ni/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul dang yab yum ni gong du smos pa thog kha ba rin po che ltar yin la/ rje 'di sa pho khyi'i lo la ngo mtshar ba'i rtaṭa mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ rimagyis bskyed bsrings pa na/ rigs rus kyi snyem pa sapas nas yi ge slob 119

pa'i grwar bzhugs shing / ring por ma thog 〈thogs 〉par/ yi ge rigasami gcig pa ji snyed la bris thos/ phul du gyur/ dgung lo bcu gsum nye ba na/ skye rgas 〈rga 〉na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las nges par 'byung ba'i lam gcig pu pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan la rab tu byung bar bzhed de/ nyid kyi (81ba)gcen po chos rje thog kha ba rin po che'i spyan sngar rab tu byung ba'i mtshan graṭa pa bsod nams zhes gsol/ de nas rim gyis de'i drung /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mdzod ma lus pa gsan cing byang zhing chub par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes tshe bsam gtan gyi khang bur lo gsum bar sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ de nas gcen thog kha b.las bsnyen par rdzogs shing gdan gcig dang rdor dkar gyi 〈kyis 〉dus 'da' bar mdzad/ slar yang lo bcu gsum bar zab mo'i rnal 'byor las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa'i nyin gcig dgong thun la bab 〈babs 〉pa na/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i cho 'phrul chen po gcig byung bzhi mod la/ thugs dran med brgyal ba ltar song ba'i mus rigs drug gi gnas ma lus pa gzigs shing / de dag gi sdug bsngal nyams su myong snyam pa gcig byung bas rkyen byas/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po 'khrungs te zhag mang po'i bar gsol zas kyang ma dran par spyan chab chu bo'i gzhung bzhin shor ba'i tshe skad cig la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ skyes bu lag pa brkyang 〈rkyang 〉bskum 〈skum 〉gyi rnam pas gsung lhang lhang byon pa'i rnam pa gcig la brten nas/ slar shin tu dad pa'i dbas gis brgyal bar gyur pa'i (83na)tshe nye gnas byed nas gser khang nang mar/ chos rje thog kha ba rin po cher zhu ba 〈bar 〉phyin pas/ rjes mkhyen nas zhu ma dgos par/ kho la gnas sbyong gi rnam pa gcig shar ba'i sna drangs nas/ dag pa'i snang ba ban bun re yong 120

bar 'dug khyed rang /ga mi dgos sngon kyi grub thob gong ma rnams ti〈kyis 〉dka' ba spya/da pas las ngam lhongs pa'i rtag 〈rtags 〉de lta bu byung zhing / kho bo yang ma na sa/ kyi du ri su sran gye 〈gyes 〉mi bzod pa'i na tsha dang / klu nad kyi ra / pa gcig yang 〈kyang 〉byung ba de 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang ma jal ba'i snang ba gcig la brten nas sos shing / yon tan gyi rnam pa cung zad shar ba yin/ khong la yonatan cung zad skyes par yod 'dug pas/ mthar ma phyin bar gsang ba ces 〈gces 〉gsungs shing / slar ste gnas sgrub khang du phyin nas bltas pas/ gzim mal stong par 'dug ste/ byu ngag shor bas de nyid du snang bar gyur nas/ khyod ci nyes gsungs nas zhal ta dang mgur ma yang mngadu gsungs/ de nas 'phags pa 'jigs rten dbang byug 'od 'phro ba dus rtag par gzigs pa dang / thig le 'od lnga'i nang bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / rgyal ba'i zhing khams du ma gzigs ste/ rdul gcig steng du rdul (83ba)snyed sangs rgyas rnams zhes pa 'di lta bur yin 'dug dgongs pa dang / bla ma dang sangs rgyas rang sems gsum dbyer med du rtogs pa'i mos gus kyi rtsal rdzogs te/ gnas lugs kyi rtog 〈rtogs 〉pa mngon du gyur te/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/ de nas shing sprel lor gcen thog kha ba rin po che zhing brjes par dgongs thogs rnams legs par grub pas/ lo der nyid dgung lo zhe bdun bzhes pa/'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos khrir mnga' gsol ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas me tog gi char dang / lha'i rol mo glu dbyangs skye dgu rnams kyis dngos su thos pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas pa byung / denas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la zab mo'i chos kyi sgra chen po sgrags 〈bsgrags 〉te rgol ngan gyi wa tshogs thams cad thaṭa 〈thag 〉bar mdzad

cing / ya dag pa'i lam nyams su len par byed pa 'i sgom cherngo/ yangs/ su khyab pa mdzad cing / lo de nyid la rin po che sna bdun las bkra shis sgo mang rgya khyon lhag par du che ba bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ gling 'dir dge 'dun gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bltams 〈gtams 〉te phal cher smra bcad 'dag sbyar gyis(gyi 〉brtul zhugs/ la gnas pa 'ba' zhig dang / nyid kyang dus rtag par sgrub pa la rtse gcig bzhugs (84na)shing / zab chos gsung dgos rnams bug sgor zhal yol bshams te mdzad par brten/ mtshan yang mtshams bcad pa rin po che zhes grags/ de ltar lo gsum gyi bar du tshogs pa bskyangs te/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa me khyi lo'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/bka' brgyud ring lugs rin chen 'byung gnas dbus/ /lam gyi snying po theg mchog lhun po'i thor/ /shel gyi spyan stong ldan zhing ye shes kyi//rdo rje 'phyar ba dge ba'i bshes te 〈de 〉rgyal/ /bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen sku mched rnams sku na phra ba la brten/ gdan sa bdun pa jo snubs rdo rje ye shes kyi 〈kyis 〉mdzad pa yin la/ de yang de nyid snubs nam mkha'i snying po dang / sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rgyud las/ chu lug lor tha bltams/ gzung rdo rje grags pa las rab tu byung / de nyid dang / thog kha ba las 'bri gung gi chos thams cad gsan/ de nas ringazhig lon pa na/ mtshams bcad pa rin po che dag zhing du phebs par/bcu gnyis rin po che dgung lo bdun las ma lon stabs/ nyid dgung lo re gnyis shing sprel lor gdan sar rgyal tshab du 〈tu 〉mnga' gsol ba'i (84ba)tshe/ de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal chems la/ 'ja la lha khang byu 'dra ba ma bzhengs/ de la rgyal mtshan bzhi ma 1ma

mdzugs btsu ngas pa la/ gong du smos pa gcung rin po che pa gling rang la lha kha bakhe/ras/ par bzhed pa'i tshe/ srid kyi phrin las pa sgom pa shag rim/ gyis nan gyis zhus nas thang la lha khang chen mo bya ba gru bzhi bre 'dra ba dang / de'i steng phyogs bzhir gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan bzhi btsugasapa dang / sgrubs la gdan sa ma 'chol zhes pa/ jo sgrubs pa chen po nyid gdan sar spyan drangs pa sogs zhal chems las 'gal ba mang du byas par rtem/ 'brel la gnod de/ jo snubs pa nyid dgung lo re drug pa sa byi lo la/ sngon bsgom 〈sgom 〉pa shagarin gyis 〈rgya 〉blon po sa chen rdor dpal/ ga ma rdo se sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉bod shing sgo can shag rin shes zer nas mnga' 'bangs su 'jug bzhed kyi rkyen gyi (gyis 〉sgom pa gsum gyi ring sa skya'i dpon chen rim pa dang ma mthun pa'i rgyus/ mda' lngas snying la zin pa'i mi ngan 'ga' zhig gis gong ma se chen rgyal po'i snyan du phra ma bcug pa la brten/ gong ma'i bkas bskul te/ rgya nag dang / bar khams sogs kyis 〈kyi 〉dmag mi shin tu mang ba/ dmag dpon a ye shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'gru thar pa (85na)rgyal mtshan/ go 'jo bla ma rgyal mtshan/ gling bsod nams rgyal mtshan te bzhis mgo byas dpung che bar lhag 〈lhags 〉ste 〈te 〉gling rin po che rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pas bzhengs pa bkra shis sgo mang / dbon dang spyan snga grags 'byung gi 〈gis 〉bzhengs pa sgo mang dang rten gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gong smos gcung rin po ches bzhengs pa'i lha khang chen mo lha chen bco brgyad/sgo mang bdun sogs rten grangs las 'das pa rnams me lha'i dga' ston du byas/ dge 'dun mang po mthar byed kyi lto bar bcug pa na/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po'i rigs dang / gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag lhag tsam ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dabs123

〈'dab 〉'a brkyang ba 〈brkyangs pa 〉ltar/ chu 'phen gyi ri rtser 'phur tem/la' spyod du gshegs so/ de'i tshe/ jo snubs pa chen po nyid kyis/bcu gnyis pa rin po che sku mched dang / 'bri gung gi nang rten khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhig dang bcas spyan drangs te gong po'i phyogs su phebs nas/ nyid dgung lo don gcig pa chu sbrul lor sku gshegs so/de skabs 'bri gung gi mi sde phal cher yul 'khyar/ khang pa thams cad kyangaral/ sa zhing thams cad 'jag skyar 〈skya 〉'chur 〈'phyur 〉'ga' zhig gis sa sde tshams su btsam/ rdzong mang du (85ba)brtsigs/ mi log rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉dus mi bde ba mang du byas so/ratna sa bstan pa dbyig 'dzin khyon/ /mda' lnga'i dug can 'jing du da〈'jings su 〉bying gyur kyang / /thugs bskyed stobs kyis sngon bzhin 'degs mdzad pa//rdo rje rin chen zhabs la lan brgyar 'dud/ /gdanas brgyad pa bcu gnyis pa rin po che rdo rje rin chen ni/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ 'dan stod byu ra'i gdung las dpon sgom pa rdo rje seng ge'i sras/ thog kha ba'i gcung ma nu rgyal zhes pa de nyid 'bri gung gi phyogs 'dir byon nas gzhu smad kyi sa'i cha las 'jon ma zhes pa der bzhugs nas sras gnyis 'khrungs pa ni/ che ba bsod nams rdo rje zhes dang / chung ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes grags la/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyikhab tu sras bzhi 'khrungs pa'i che shos rje nyid dang / de 'og nyer brgyadapa rin po che/ de sag rdo rje dpal zhes pa dang / chung shos kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa rnams las/ rje btsun 'di nyid sa pho stag gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku 'khrungs ma ga dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge go rim ma 'khrug par gsungs nya/nga / yu — —/'ang sku khams bde 'am/gnod pa ma mchis sa ma gsung pas / ya ba lursha dang mchog dman thams 124

cad yid the tshom du gyur pa'i 〈pas 〉chos (85na)rje mtsham sa bcad pa rin po che'i drung du zhu bar btang bas/ 'phags yul gyi bras ga ze sa ra hachen po bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don la byon pa yin pas som nyi ma byed gsu ris pa mar/ bskyed bsangs pas 〈pa'i 〉thabs bkur ste phun sum tshogs pa sgrub cing dgung lo drug tu nye ba na/ rje mtshams bcad parin po che'i spyan sngar gdan drangs nas rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rdo rje rin chen zhes gsol/ lo gnyis kyi bar zab cing rgya che ba snying po'i chos thams cad gsan/ de nas rje mtshams bcad pa mya ngan las 'das pa na/ rje nyed sku na chung bar brten/ jo snubs pa rdo rje ye shes (kyis )gdan sa lo lnga mdzad pa'i tshe/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la gong du smos pa ltar/ gling log byung ste/ rje nyid sku mched dang bcas pa jo snubasapas kong por gdan drangs lo gsum bar bzhugs/ de'i tshe ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam 'phrul tsa ri tra'i ri pa nag po zhes dpa' brtul des/ mi log rnams bsdus ste rgya mchams bar phyin/ dmag mi thams cad srog dang phral/ se chen rgyal por blor mi shong ba'i springs yig drag po mang du btang ba dang / sgom pa dbon po bya bas stod phyogs su phyin/hor gyi dmag drangs/ sa hor mchod yon gyi gser zam bcad pa'i tshe/sa skya bas 〈ba'i 〉khang gsar ba nyi sa grags (85ba)pa 'od zer gyi (gyis 〉pho brang chen por gong ma'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ zhu ba mthar phyin par phul bar brten/ gong mas phyi nang gi nor rdzas dpag tu med pa gnang sbyin mdzad de / dbus gtsang gi khri bskor 〈skor 〉gcig mnga' 'bangs su bcug ste/ 'bri gung gling rin po che myur du bsos 〈sos 〉cig 〈shig 〉pa'i bka' byung / nang 'gag pa slob dpon ye shesadang ga ba rgyud pa nas rargyu da par shes pa'i 'ja' sa/ stag mgo tham kha 125

gnang nas bsgom 〈sgom 〉pa'i khur 'dzin du bskos/ de nas rje nyid dgung lo bcu gsum pa la kong po nas spyan drangs/ mtshe'u kha thang du bde ldan zhes pa'i pho brang chen po mthong na mi mthun pa med pa skye dgu kun yid 'phrogs 〈'phrog 〉par byed pa zhig myur bar grub ste/ der bzhugs shing re zhig bar thos bsam gyi sgo 'dogs thams cad bcad cing / rgyal ba'i gsung rabs 〈rab 〉kyis 〈kyi 〉don la blo gros kyi snangab phyogs med du rgyas par gyur cing / dpal mgon bong sgrub pas des dngos grub dpal gyi chas brgyad rje'i sku la gsol/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa me sprel lor gdan sar mnga' gsol nas lo der byang chub kyi gling rin po che bso 〈gso 〉bar mdzad cing / thog mar ston pa'i dngul sku bkra shis 'od 'bar du grags pa zhig bzhengs/ de nas gzim khang thogakha gser khang / bla g.yel chen mo (8 na)sgo mang lha khang / dge 'dun gyi bsam gtan khang bu stong dang brgyad brgya lo bdun gyi khongs sugrub/ sngon du bzhugs pa/ thub pa khams gsum zil gdon/ sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan/ gcung sku 'bum/ a phyi dkor mdzod sogs gling log skabs me gdugs la bzhugs pa rnams la yang bskyar nyams bsos 〈gso 〉dang / lha dang mchod rten rnam sa la gser gyi lde gus byugs shing / rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku brnyam/ gser khang chos rjer grags pa 'di nyid/ de skabs sngo ru bye gshongs su sbas pa yangaspyan drangs shing / rab tu gnas pa yang nas yang du mdzad/ dgung lonyi shu par tshogs pa bskyangs/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyang khri phrag bcu gsum tsam 'dus/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo dus rnam pa kun tu bskor bar mdzad pa dbyar cho sa/ dgun chas zhes grabs pa la dbyar chos ni mdun thang sogs thang yangs sar sgar btab ste phya ga rgya chen po lnga —126

na / gyi khridagasu ri ga nas/ dge 'dun rnams spyogs 〈co ga 〉bu'i brtulabazhu rwa 〈zhugs 〉la gnas te/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom 〈bsgoms 〉nas rtogs pa'i don mngon du gyur pa mdzad pa dang / dgun chos la bla g.yel du dra ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyis smin par mdzad de/ dge 'dun rnams ras (87ba)rgyang gi brtul bzhugs 〈zhugs 〉kyis gtum mo'i bde drod kyi lang tsho ngos nga/ra mdzad/ de dag gi chos snga phyir rgyab chos su/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcigapa/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i zab chos sogs gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum/bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa/ rje btsun do rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang sogs smin grol chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ de dag gi rgyun bzang po dam pa gong ma na rim bar yun ring du dar cing 〈zhing 〉phyis ra/khan slob chos gsum gyi mdzad rgyun yang 'dug rje nam pa rang byung rdo rjes/ rje rin po che 'di nyid sa ra ha dngos su gzigs shing /bsngags brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / gling rin po che bsos〈sos 〉pa'i gtang rag du 〈tu 〉gser dang za 'og gi skyes che ba phul/de'i skyes lan rgya che ba dang / thugs dam nyams myong gis 〈gi 〉tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig gnang / de nas dgung lo nyer gcig pa la/ thog kha gser khang du lo bdun gyi bar 'dag sbyar mdzad cing zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi lhur len pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad pa la sngon gyidus ltar/ gangs ti se/ la phyi/ tsa ri tra sogs la sgom chen stong lasami nyung ba bsdangs shing / dge 'dun rnams kyang thos bsam sgom gsumagyi bya ba la brtson pa sha stag gis (88na)khyab par mdzad pa sogs bka' brgyud spyi bye brag la bka' drin bsam brjod las 'das pa rje — 'di nyid yin la/ de ltar lo bco brgyad bar tshogs pa bskyangs nas/137

bdang lo so bdun pa shing stag lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la du 'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su thim so 〈mo/〉'dren pa mchog khyod 'od stong ldan pa nyid/ /yin yang tsha gzer (zer 〉gdung ba sgo ba med/ /chu gter min kyang na bkra 〈kra 〉ba tshwa so gas/ /skyon kun yongs spangs rdo rje rgyal po myongs/ /gdan sa dgupa nyer brgyad pa rin po che rdo rje rgyal po ni/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yu ga dang yab yum/ sogs gong du bcu gnyis pa rin po che'i skabs su smos pa ltar yin la/ nyid shing pho spre'u lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin 'khrungs shing / de yang yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pari tshe/ yum sku lus bde zhing / mnal lam du slob dpon padma'i gzhal med khang yin zer ba'i nang du/ khye'u mtshan dpe dang ldan pa zhig sku kha thim zhing / bud med chas bzang mang pos gu ru'i yang snying bzla bzhin phyag dang bskor 〈skor 〉ba byed pa sogs dang / (88ba)bltams pa'i ma na/ me tog gi char dang / rol mo'i sgra du ma byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa byung / de nas rim gyis bskyed bsrings nas/ 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag la mkhyen rab thog 〈thobs 〉pa med par gyur cing / skabs skabs su/ kho bo rgya gar du ma — pa/ o rgyan yu la du padma 'byung ga/sa dang / /gtsang gi phyos/sa su dge legs rgyal mtshan yin/ /deng sang bod 'dir gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams/ /'dul bar bya phyir skye tshul bstan pa yin/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa du ma gsungs/ de nas gcen rin po che de rje rin chen gyi drud du rab tu byung / mtshan rdo rje rgyal po zhes gsol / dgung lo lnga pa la gling log byung ste/ kong por grub thob ar rtse la sa nas pa rnam ste kyis spyan drangs/ slob dpon padma la sogs bla ma na sa dang /ཿ

sa/ khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhal gzigs pa/ de dag sa tshu sa skye dgu kun gyes thos par skyes bu dam pa ridi ni gu ru padma ga ra yin par the ga ma med ces gleng / grub thob mar rtse las/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos mdzod kun gsan cing / byed nyams len la brtson pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas (8 na)'bri gung du phebs nas/ dgung lo bcu gsum par/ gcen rdo rje rin chen gyis gling bso 〈gso 〉bar mdzad pa'i phyag phyir bzhugs shing / gcenanyid dang gzhan yang mkhas grub dge bshes du ma la/ mdo sngaṭa rgyud sde'ichos ma lus pa gas / cing / don rnams la byang zhing chub par mdzad/de nas gnas chen gter sgom gyi dben gnas rnams su bzhugs shing /gnas gsar ma la sogari pa gnas sgo yang mang du bye/ gzigs snang rnams gtan la phabs 〈phab/〉 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku dang / tshogs zangs glang lung ma sos/sa rnga/ra gter kha shas bzhes/ chos gter ni skye dgu rnams bsod nams chung zhing / dus la ma babs pas ma bzhes/sding rgyal gyi dben gnas su zu ba sde 'debs pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo so gcig pa shing stag lor/ gcen bcu gnyis pa rin po che dag zhing du gshegs par/ nyid gdan sar chos srid seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol ste/ paṇa chen shākya shī'i ring lugs 'dzin pa chos lugs tshogs pa'i mkhan chen las bstan pa la yongs su rdzogs cing 〈shing /〉 'dul ba'i gnas la byang bar mdzad nas/ mkhan chen dang dge 'dun rnams la zab chos kyi bzhed pa (8 ba)bskong 〈skong 〉bar gnang / sngar gyi lha khang chen mo'i shul du na ba brgya dang brgyad cu'i 〈cas 〉'degs pa 〈bstegs pa'i 〉gtsug lag khang grub te 〈ste〉rten gsum bsam—gyisaske khyab par bzhengs te/ rab tu gnas pa soṭa de dag thams cad lo gsum 139

gyi khongs su grub bar ma dzad/ mthing shog la gser gyi 〈gyes 〉bris pa 'dul ba ma do sde so gas/ bde bar deb/sa pa'i sa/sung rab mang du bzhengs/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa ra bkra shis ljongs kyi gtsuṭa lag khang rten gsum dang bcas pa bzheng sa cing / gling gi mgon khang da lta sa phyi khang du grags pa 'di yang grub cing / ye shes kyi ma/gon po phyag bzhi pa bya seng bong yul bcas bzhengs/ gong du zos pa mgon po nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉rnam sprul ri pa nag po'i mdung la srog shing dang ral gri la phyag ral ma dzad/ rje nyid dge 'dun khri phras/ ba/nga bcas pa rab gnas bka' badzā gnyer gtad legs par mdzad/ gzhu smad g.ya' ma rir mgon khang dang sgrub sde yang btab/ gnas gsum gyi ri pa yang stong las mi nyung ba lan mang du brdzongs 〈brdzong 〉ba/ ri khrod phal cher rim gnyis la brtson pa'i sgom chen gyis khyab par mdzad cing / dbyar chos dang dgun chos kyi phyag srol ma stongs pa dang / dus kun tu chos gal che ba rnams bug sgo nas gsung ba ma (9༷na)gtogs/ smra bcad 'dag sbyar la bzhugs shing zab mo'i rnal 'byor las skad cig tsam mi g.yo zhing / dbus gtsang gi che dgu zhal mjal la yongs 〈'ongs 〉pa rnams kyang / yol ba phyi nang gi mjal lugs tsam ma gtogs dngos su zhal mjal dang chos kyi 'brel pa ma gtogs 'jig rten gyis 〈kyi 〉gsung gleng tsam yang mi mdzad pa sogs 'phags chen dam pa'i mdzad pa kho nar dus 'da'/ de ltar lo mang gdan sa bskyangs shing / dgung lo drug cu re bdun pa stag gi lo/ dbyar zla ra ba'i nyer brgyad la bkra shis ljongs su cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas ste mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdur phal cher gdung sha ri ram la sogs pa ring bsrel rnams bre la 'jal ba tsam dang / yig 'bru la 130

sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ deng sang rtog ge pa mu cor smra ba rnams kyis/ sgom pa kun dga' rin chen gyi lung bstan/ rje kun dga' rin chen yin smra ba ni/ sgom pa kun rin ni/ rje nyer brgyad pa 'di'i srid kyi phrin las sa yin la/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che nas bzung / 'bri gung dang gdan sa thol zung 'brel yin rung /sgom pa kun rin 'dis gong ma tā si la 'bangs gyen ldog gi rnam pa byas pas/ de nas gdan sa phan (90ba)tshun 'brel lam ma byung 'dug cing bka' gdams kyi dgon pa gser thog can bcu gsum dus gcig la me la bsres/sa pa sogs dus 'khrug kho nas dus 'da' zhing / slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan du/ 'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs su/ /kun dga'i ming can sdig sto can/ /lus la mtshon cha'i ri mo yod/ /shi nas dmyal bar skye bar gyur 〈'gyur/〉 /lho'i phyogs nas 'jam dbyangs kyis 〈kyi/〉sprul pa gcig gis 'dul bar byed/ /zhes (ces 〉kun mkhyen klong chen pa chen po dbur stod du gdan drangs pa sogs de skabs kyi dgon pa kun rin bya ba 'di yin la/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen la ngos bzung ba ni snga phyi dang mi mtshungs pa rtog ge pa rang gi nang cha ston pa'i gtam du zad do/gangs 〈gang 〉sku mtshan dba'i 'od zer rab 'bar bas/ /nyin mo'i mgon la skyengs pa ster nus shing / /dmag 〈smag 〉rum rjes 'gro gdul bya'i nyes tshogs kun/ /sel mdzad 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /gdan sa bcu pa/ nyer gnyis chos kyi rgyal po ni 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul/ gzhu smad 'jon mar grags pa der/ yab ni gcungs/nyis pa dang / nyer brgyad pa rin po che'i gcung po kun dga' rgyal ba tshan dang / yum dbur pa dar 'jam zhes pa (91na)mkha' 'gro ma'i 131

mcha na rtags / dang lda da pa gnyis ri kyi sras su shing phab lo'i ——/ drug ku ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi dza dro sku bltams / de'i tshe sa ga yo ba dang /'ja' tshon kyi gur phub pa dang / pa sa/ cho/ gru'i'agro ma ngo na rin po che'e sku brnyan las 'od zer 'phros te 'jo / ma' bar du gsal ju dang /'khrungs ma thag tu dbyang byu kyi mi/ ge ngo rim ma nor bar gsung / pa so ṭa/bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'i ltari ga bzang gis/ skye dgu rnams kyi yid 'phrog par gyur/ de nas rim gyis bskyed bsrings te dgung lo gsu pa la/sgol ma mched bdun la sogs pa yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs/ ring por ma thog 〈thogs 〉pa yig rtsis sogs shes bya'i gnas la pha rol tu son par gyur te/ dgung lo brgyad bzhes tshe/ chos kyi rje rdo rje rgyal po'i drung rab tu byung / mtshan 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal por gsol/snubs ston gzhon nu dpal zhes bya ba'i drung / bde mchog gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor la sogs pa'i dbang dang gdams pa gsan cing /dgung lo dgu la lha khang chen mor 'dul 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang / chos sgo ba gzhon nu dpal gyis slob dpon sogs kha bskong grangs tshang kyi 〈gi 〉(61ba)dbus su dge tshul du sgrub /stag phur chos rje stag chen pa las dgyes rdor la soṭa rgyud 'grel du mar gsan spyangs 〈sbyong 〉mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gcig par chos rje nyer brgyad rin po che las/ zab mo lnga ldan/ shā ro'i chos drug mos gus srog 'khor/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po/ dgongs pa gcig pa/skyobs 〈skyob 〉nga/'i zab chos sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos spyi bye brag ma lus pa gsan/ de nas stag gi lor nyer brgyad rin po che chos dbyings su thim pa'i da gongs rdzogs kyi rim pa mngon mtho gnang ste/lcags yopa ga lor nyid gdan sar chos srid seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol/132

gling rin po cher 'chad nyan gyi bya ba khur len pa mdzad cing phrin las chad med pa rgyas/ nyer brgyad pa'i dgongs rdzoṭa su rin po che du ma las bkra shis sgo mang lha nyis stong dang sum brgya yod pa bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa lha khang gi steng la gser thog bya 'dab gaspyo ra sogs grub cing rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ dbus gtsang gi 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la 'god phyir/ sku 'khor lnga brgya lhag tsam dang bcas/dpal ldan sa skya la sogs par 〈pa 〉nyang stod rnams su phebs te chos kyi'akhor lo du ma bskor bar mdzad nas/ slar 'bri gung du mtshe'u kha bdeldan gyi pho brang (11na)du phebs nas/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la/ chos lung gi tshogs pa spyan drangs shing / mkhan po sa skya pa 'dul 'dzin kunadaga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / slob dpon chos lung pa sde sdod 'dzin pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gsang ston pa bde legs bzang po sogs/ dge 'dun gyi dbus su rgyal ba'i bstan pa la yongs su rdzogs pa mdzad/ nyid kyiyab kun dga' rgyal mtshan la rje nyid mkhan po mdzadanas/ grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas mkhan po de nyid las/ 'dul ba/ byams chos sde lnga/ spyod 'jug la sogs gsan cing / gzhan yang g.yag sde paṇa chen/ rtse chen pa don 'grub dpal bzang / lo chen tshul khrims mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyalamatshan sogs rtsod bral gyi mkhas grub du mar brten nas/ mdo sngags rgyud sde sogs du ma gsan pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la mi mkhyen pa'am/ mngon sum du rtogs par ma mdzad pa gang yang med pas/'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po zhes mtshan don dang mthun pa kho na'o/ de nas thog kha gser khang nyid du/ gsung rab kyi don la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i bshad nyan (11ba)gyi bstan pa 'dzen par dgongs/ nyin 133

mtshan yol ba med par chos kyi char phabs te 〈phab ste 〉ska sa lda / gdul —bya rnams byug/ par mdzad cing / byang chub kyi gling rin po che 'phags pa'i me tog gi phrum ra ltar gyur cing / de rnams kyi nang nas rtog 〈rtogs 〉pa mngon du gyur pa rnams gnas gsum gyi ri khrod 'dzin par brdzongs ba mdzad pa dang ldang mdo rgod rdzong gi sgrub grwa 'dzug 〈'dzuṭa 〉pa sogs sgrub brgyud rin po che 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉ring lugs ches cher 'phel ba mdzad/ gdan sa nyid du'ang dbyar chos kha phyag chen lnga ldan/dgun dus zab lam tsā ro chos drug la brte / na na drod kyi kha ra cho ngom pa'i mas pa sum brgya las mi nyung ba/bla g.yel chen mor ras phud mdzad pa sogs sngon gyi phyag srol mi nyams pa rgyas pa'i steng / dpyid kyi dus theg chen bstan snying dgongs pa gcig pa/ ston gyi dus mos gus srog 'khor sogs dus bzhir zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chog kyi 'khor lo bskor ba kho nar dus 'da'/ thabs zhig 〈shig 〉byang phyogs su blo gsal gyi 'khor du ma dang bcas sgar chen pheb nas/ 'jam zhe g.yu mtsho bya bar/ rje kurma pa/bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje dang mjal phrad mdzad de/ chos kyi 'brel gtam dang / mad ( 3na)sngaṭa kyi chos zab mo 'ga' zhig dang / snyan ngag sdeb sbyor saṭa tha snyad du ma gsan cing phan tshun zang zing gi 'bul ba stobs che bas/ skyes 'bul mdzad nas byang phyogs kyi 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la bkod cing / slar 'bri gung du phebs nas/ yig mkhan ba'i/ brgya mas nges / kyis / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam bzhes sa nas/ rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po dang / yig rig pa rnams la zang zing gi yon gyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes skabs sku 'khor mi nyung ba'i sgar chen dang bcas/ rgyal ba'i bste gnas ri bo shārnyi zangs lung 134

du phebs mnya rimed rin po che'i sku brnyan la gser chabs 〈chab 〉dang mchad pa'i sprin phung rgya chen po zo ba dang / sgam po chos rjeri 〈rjes 〉dbus der 'dus rnams dang kong phyogs phal cher du phebs nasadad ldan rnams la chos kyi 'brel pa gnang / gnas chen tsa ri trar phebs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo lan grangs du mar bskor/ gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung / lo shas bzhugs par bzhed pa las/ 'bri ༄ nga nas/ mkhan slob chos gsum dang / che dgu kun gyis gso — ba (93ba)btab par mi ring bar 'bri gung du phebs/ de dus rtogs denago yu ba bya ba la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bsta na ga sa /byang phyogs 'bri gung nabs khrod du/ rje gtsun te lo pa bzhus/ca pas mjal bar bgyis 〈kyis 〉zhes dang / rtsibs ri gnam lding zhes par grub chem/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan bya ba la/ nam mkha' nas dbang zhu 〈gzhu 〉dang / me tog gi char dang bcas/ 'bri gung dpa ba gyi nags khrod du te lo pa chen po slar ya nga mi yi srid bzung ba yodapas der chos nyan du song zhes pa'i sgra byung ba dang / rje nyid lha ldan du phebs du / jo bo rin po che'i drung du/ gcung rin po ches phul ba'i gsed kong ngos 'dzin pa dang / gcung gshegs khar kho bo thel logs skya bo 'dir slar lan gcig yong gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags yul grub chen te lo pa/'bri gung 'dir rje gcung rdo rje grags pa nyid slar mi'i tshul la ston pa ni/spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po nyid yin par the tshom dang bral/ skabs 'dir shar tsong kha pa blo bzang graṭa pa mdo smad nas phebs par/ 'bri gung du rje'i zhabs la gtub/sa shing chos kyi 'brel pa gnang / ri bo dga' ldan 'debs pa'i mthun byen mdzad/ (94na)dgung lo nga gnyis pa shing glangalor/ yig mkhan du mas shog dkar gyi ngos la bris pa/ bstan 'gyur 135

dang / dwags po bka' brgyud kyi skyes mchog rim byom/ gyis 〈gye 〉rnam/ ba ra gsung 'bum bcas zla ba gsum gyi khongs su grub pa ra mdzad/ de nas dgung lo re gcig par chos srid kyi khur rnam/sa chos rje don grub/ rgya pa por gtad de/ gdan sar dbang bskur/ nyid gter sgom dang lhun po la sogs pa dbeen gnas nyams dga' ba'i gnas rnams su/ snying po'i rnal 'byor gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ de nas dgung lo re bzhi pa sa stag lor/ gser bangs las dag pa ste lha nyis stong dang sum brgya lhag pa bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs pa mdzad pa ra/ lcags 'brug lo'i ston zla 'bring po tha skar gyi yar tshes bcu gsum la grub cing / de'i nyin res gza' spen pa dang rgyu skar khrums mad 'dzom par/rje nyid dbus dge slong snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa brgya phrag lngas 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i nyin rgya nag gong ma chen po nas chos rje don grub rgyal po la kwan nying spyo gu sa dang /sgom pa bsod nams rin chen la dzong ji'i lung las tham kha sogs byung /de'i (94ba)sngon tsam sgom pa shākya bzang po la tā si tu'i lung las byung bar grags/ de dag gi skabs dang / gnye bo'i phyogs su bzhugs dus nyi ma 'dzin pa mdzad cing / gzim mal du phebs pa tho rangs kyi cha la zin pa dang / gser khang du bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bsgyur ba dang / lhun po zhes par bde mchog dpa' gcig gis 〈gi 〉 bye bzhengs pa dang / mtshe'u kha bde ldan pho brang du skulus kyi bkod pa gsem snang ba/ tshal du legs ldan nag po'i thangs nas bya rog gi tshogs byung ste nyid la thim pa/ kong yul du chu bo chen pogyen la ldog pa sogs dang / rgya nag tu 'gro mi 'bum dpon pa la chibs chen sha rkyal ga pa zhes pa gnang ste lam du hor gyi 'jigs pa yong tshul 136

bcu ngas pa'i/ 'bre chu khar rang re'i mi nor chibase sha rkyal sa pas sna drangs te chu tshur thon bde ba byung / gzhan gye mi nor rjes la lus pa rngam sa hor gyi 〈kyis 〉bcom pa sogs grub rtags/ dang mngon par mkhyen pa sgog gyur ma yin pa/ skye dgu kun gyi mngon sum spyod yul du gyur te/da pa'i byu gu gsar pa rdol lo/ lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba lhan cig skyesasbyor/ chos drug gi khrid yig ye shes mgon po dang / ( gan)a phyi'i sgrub skor/ rtog 〈rtogs 〉brjod dang nyams mgur sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad kyang da lta phal cher mig gi spyod yul du ma gyur to/ de nas sku de 〈de'i 〉'dul 〈gdul 〉bya mtha' dag rdzogs par nye ba na/ gshegs bzhugs la rang dbang thob pa'i 〈pas 〉bsnyel ba'i rnam pa med par mtshe'u khar gzim khang du phebs nas zhal chems ba 'a rgya ma du ma phebs pa phyis gang gi 〈gis 〉thos pa na don dang ldan pa nyid du gyur cing / de nas lhun po'i dbon gnas su phebs te/dgung lo donagasum bzhes pa/ me phag lo'i dgun zla 'bring po'i nyer gnyis la yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ de'i tshe sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu/ rdo 'dzin gzhon nu grags kyi 〈kyis 〉dbus dge bshes du mas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs phul ba'i tshe gdung las ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga dang / dung dkar 'jam dbyangs kyi sku rang byon sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma byon/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya che ba dag grub cing / gangs ri nyi ser gser 'bum bzhengs shing / de nas da lta'i bar gdan sa rim byon gyi gser 'bum bzhengs srol byung 'dug gong dusmos pa nyer brgyad pa dang / 'di nyid nyer gnyis pa brjod pa sa/ mya ngan las 'da' (95ba) ba'i tshes kyi dus de la brten nas mtshan brjod pa 'dra'o/ 'di nyid la slob ma ni mgon po 'bri gung pas 〈pa'i 〉137

5 chos zab mo rgyun 'dzin chos rje la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni mdosmad rgya nag dang nye bar/ lho'i shar rong / khang gsar bya ra na/ smug po gdong gi rus su chu khyi la 'khrungs/ yab mes bom pa ra so nga bas/dgung lo brgyad dgu bar bon lugs la thos bsam mdzad/ba de skabs ras pa 'ga' zhig mi la'i mgur 'chen pa thos pas sngon gyi bag chags sad de/ chos la mos pa thob kyang bstan la zhugs pa sa ma byung / ngan slong la sbyin pa/ 'bu srin la snying rje sogs tshad med par mnga' 'jig rten lugs kyi 'phong dang sgyu rtsal sogs phul du phyin/ dgung lo bcu dgu tsam la/ du dbeen sha zhes pa rang gi khu bo bon po zhig gi zhabs phyi byas nas dbus su byon/ dben sha dang 'bri gung pa kha mchu shor/ slar mdun bsgrig /sa kyi bu rta 〈gta' 〉la/ dam pa 'di 'bri gung du phul bas/ lo gsum tsam 'bri gung gi dpon skya mdzad/ sgom pas thugs la btags pas gzim dpon du gyur/ kun gyis bskur 〈bkur 〉zhing mi chos phun sum tshoṭa kyang nges 'byung gi bsam pas rab tu byung 〈'byung 〉 bar bzhed ( can)nas/ 'jig rten gyi lugs skyong ba kun gyi 〈kyis 〉bsholakyang ma nyan par dgung lo nyer lnga la/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi na sbya cha na mkhan po/ 'dul 'dzan pa grags pa rgyal mtshan las slob sogs dang /gung bzhugs rje rim/yo che chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad nas/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta yu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ de nas lo gsum tsam/ rje chom ra dza dang / bshes gnyen don grub rgya da po/ sman sgom 'od zer seng ge sogs las lnga ldan chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gsan/ gzhan yang rtogs ldan gyi bla ma tshun chod bla ma brgya dang nyer lnga tsam brten 〈bstenayi khyad par du138

'phags/ pa'i bla ma/ 'bri gung rin po che sku mched/ mardza/ ba de ba'i / gshegs pa/ sa skya pa chenapo/ theg chen chos rje sob/sa yongs 'dzin bcu rnams las/ grub mtha' ris med kyi dbang chos ma lus pa gsan la phyi dpal gyi chu bar du sa phar lo sum cu rtsa gcig sgam por lo ba dbazhugs pa/ phal cher bsnyen sgrub rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyi (gyis 〉dus 'da'/ dgung lo so lnga tsam la chos rje de bzhin gshes/sa ( cab)pas sems nyid zos bral chen po ngo sprad/ dgung lo drug cu re drug gi bar bzhugs shing / skabs su snod ldan la chos kyi 'khor lo du mar bskor cing sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur/ mthar sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor la dbang thob/ la phyi nyid du sku mya ngan las/ 'das pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur cing / mchan yang la phyi pa chen po grags so/ gzhan yang sman sgom 'od zer seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ 'bri gung lo tsā/ rje blo bzang grags pa sogs skyes mchog khyad par du 'phags pa du mar byung ba ni yi che/ra 'jigs so/gser gyi lhun po yongs 'du'i ljon pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dren pa mchog khyod nyid/ /lhar bcas 'jig ten kun gyi rtsa lag ni/ga cig pur gyur pa don grub rgyal pos skyongs/ /gdan sa bcu gcis/ pa bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po ni/ 'di nyi da 5khrungs pa'i yul 'jon mar grags pa der/ yab ni nyer gnyis pa'i sku bya/ched rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes sam/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bya ba'i sras su ru mo bya lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar mas brgyad la sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ ngo mchar ba'i ltas bzang du ma byung / rim gyis babyed gras/'a 〈drag 〉par gyur (64 na)mas/ mngon par mkhyen pa 'a thos/ 〈thog /(/ 〉dzad mnga' ba dang / skyes rabs gong ma'i lo rgyus du ma gsungs pa — bsten 〈brten 〉139

'phags yu ba gyi grub chen bir wa pa bsam bzhin mi'i zol la ston par grags/ dgung lo dgu nas bris klog la soṭa 'jig rten gyi gtsug las jisnyed la mkhyen rab phul du byung bar gyur cing / der bo mched gzhan med pa la// mtshan dang ldan pa'i rigs ma zhig khab tu bzhe ri sha pa la ring poram thog 〈tho— /sa/ 〉par rigs sras zhig 〈shig 〉'khrungs pa ni/ bdag po wam zhes pa de nyid yin la/ dus der 'jig rten gyi glu gar kun las mchog tu gyur pa rnams/ rje 'di nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉zlos gar bsgyur ba mdzad pa grags/ de nas thar pa'i ngogs su phyin par byed pa'i rtsa ba dgeba'i bshes gnyen la rags 〈rag 〉las pa dang / de'i phyir rab tu byung 〈'byung 〉bar dgongs te/ pa ṇa chen shākya ze'i ring lugs 'dzin cing /rdor dkar dang gdan gcig gi brtul bzhugs 〈zhugs 〉la gnas pa dge slong gtsang ma'i rnam thar mchog tu gyur pa/ chos lung tshogs pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag gcig spyan drangs/ mkhan po nam mkha' rgyal mchanadang / slob dpon rin po che rgyal mtshan/ dus (la ba)sgo ba bsod nams rin chen/ gsang ston pa grags pa gzhon nu sogs kha skong grangs tshang gi dbus su/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob par mdzad de/ mtshan yang don grub rgyal po zhes gsal/ 'dul lung sde bzhi la sogs par gsan sbyongs 〈sbyong 〉mdzad/ sman sgom 'od zer zhes bya ba'i drung / lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba/ dra ro'i chos drug sogs gsan/khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po nyer gnyis rin po che las/ 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum zab chos la sogs pa chas spyi bye brag ma lus pa gsan nas/ snying po'i rnal 'byor gyis lhur len par mdzad pa'i grub pa brnyes so/ de nas dgung lo so dgu pa shing phag lor/ gdan sa chen po 〈po'i 〉chos kyi seng ge'i khrir mngon par 'phags te/ gnas 140
