gsum gyi ri pa rnams bkye zhing 'chad nyan gyi bya ba mdzad pa 〈par 〉dgongs pa la/ chos ltar bcos pa log pa'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis/ drung 'khor rnams bslus ste snying po'i bstan pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rnams bshol te/ 'phrin las kyi 'od zer rnams kyang 'grib par byas so/ 'on kyang 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉thugs rje'i shugs drag pos/ lnga ldan gyi don brgyud ma chad cing / gdung rgyud gser gyis (gyi 〉phreng ba la skyon du ma gyur to/ (98na)dgung lo zhe bzhi par gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i 〈pos 〉kan ting tā gu rngo'i lung las kha sogs gnang bas mtsham yang de khar grags/ de nas byang phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ nag shod lung par phebs te/ der gnas pa 'i bye dgu rnams kyis dad cing gus pa'i zang zing gis 〈gi 〉'byor tshogs dpas tu med pa phul ba'i tshe/ skabs shig nyi ma cung zad phyis pa la/skye dgu rnam/sa kyis bsam pa ma rdzogs dogs nas nyid la gsol ba btab nga 'i 〈pas 〉thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis spyan nam mkha' la sdang mig tu gzigs shing / sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i phyag gi 〈gis 〉nyi ma g.yo 'gul med par mdzad nas/ thams cad bya ba rnams zin pa dang /da ni thun tshod yol ba yin pas/ mtshan mo'i bya ba gyis shig gsungs phyagasor bsdus pa la/ nyi ma yang btsan thabs su bros par gyur te/ cung za tsam nas nam langs pas/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa'i shugs kyis // /sna mardo sna shā / / /shā / pa /rdo rdo pa/ na/ /rdodī / mar/shā /rdo par mdzad pa'i tshe/ nyid bzhugs pa'i sa der nyin mtshan med par bar snang 'ja' gur gyi (gyis 〉g.yogs/ (98ba)pa byung / de nas 'bri gung du phebs nas gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 14/

phul ba dang / dge 'dun gyis 〈kyi 〉tshos/sa la mang ba sko ba 'gyes chen mdzad/ mtshungs med nyer gnyis rin po che mya ngan las 'das par/dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gyi rim pa rgya che ba dang / bkra shis sgo mang rgya khyon che ba bzo bkod khyad par du 'phags pa mi ring bar grub cing rabatu gnas pa mdzad pa da lta nyid kyi thugs dam rten du grags pa 'di yin/de mas sku 'khor sgad chen dang bcas dwags lha sgam por phebs chos rjes thog drangs dge 'dun rnams mchod rdzas mtha' yas pa thogs pa'i ser stengs rgya chen pos mdun bsus/ mnyam med rin po che'i sku 'bag la sogs rten rnams la gser chab/ na bza'/ bla bye sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'bul ba gnang / dge 'dun rnams la 'gyed chen sogs chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ de nas nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpalagyi tsa ri thar phebs/ gzigs snang du ma byung / dpa' bo rnal 'byor gyi tshogs rnams la lan mang du tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / der gnas pa'iri khrod pa rnams la chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya che ba mdzad nas/ kong por phebs/ lta ba rgyal 'dzin zhes pa'i grong khyer (195)du phebs dus/ yar chab gtsang pos grong khyer mang po 'jigs 〈'jig 〉la thug par/ der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams mgrin gcig par/ kyi bla ma sbom po thugs rje can/ /gtsang po bsam med 'dis ni bdag cag la/ /yun ring bar du gnod pa mang po bskyal/ /bshar pho bshar mo mang po'i srog kyang 'phrog /chu bo 'di sa bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ chu bo'i 'gram du kho bo'i khri brtsegs/ /gtsang za canagyi gtor ma bshoms 〈shoms 〉shig /gsungs pas sku 'a/bor rnams byed cing / chos rje phud kyi 〈kyis 〉bad pa yin bdag cag rnams ji ltar bya zhes gleng zhing yod pa la/ phyis 〈phyi 〉nang chu bo'i 'gram du phebs nas 143

klu gtor gnang nas bden tshig gis gzir ba'i tshe/ gtsang po blo bur du bskyu nas ga ga gas phyo — /sa su song bar/ der sa/nas pa'i skye bo rnams dad pa lhag paradu skyes/ bla ma khyed lta bu sa steng gzhan na med do zhes gleng / rang rang 'byor tshogs kun 'bul ba byas so/ de nas 'a bri gung du phebs pa'i tshe/ chu srin rgyal mtshan gyis yid myos pa kha drag pa'i dbang gis/ gling gi grwa rgyun rnams kyang phyi tshul mjes pa bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'breng nas/ zab mo'i rna 'byor ( ba)gyis nyams len sgrub brgyud kyi ring lugs rnams dor nas rje nyid la tsha rngams kyi rnamapas 'phrin las la sgo bgegs par bya sa pa na/ snyigs dus skye bo rnams 'dul dka' zhing / skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams la thugs skyo bas/ sgrub rtags/ kyi lang tsho ngom par bsta da nas sprul pa'i gnas su bsdu bar bzhed nas/ lha ldan du phebs nas/ ngo bo rin po cher gser chab sogs mchod sprin rgya che bar phul/ smon lam rnam par dag pa mdzad nas phyi bskor (la )phebs pa na/ kho bos rdo ring chen mo bcus nas 'jog pa yin gsungs pa la/ phyag phyi rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉phud kyi 〈kyis 〉bad pa'i dbang du song ba yin pas mi 'byung ngo zhes sku la bzung nas bzlog go de nas phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉gyi 〈kyis 〉rdo ring thag 〈'big 〉par bzhedakyang gtong du ma 'dod do/ de'i tshe thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis phyag rjes dang zhabs rjes bzhag nas/ bar bskor 〈skor 〉la phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉bdab〈brdabs 〉shing byon pas shul du phyag mkhar 〈'khar 〉gyi rjes byung / derame tog kha dog lnga ldan byung ba ni yun ring po'i bar du kun gyis mthong ba byung / der gnas rnams sgrub rtags kyi 〈kyis 〉yid tshim par mdzad nas // yar 'bri gung du phebs pa'i lam du/ stag rtse ba'i mi dpon gyis rdzong du spyan drangs/ 'bul (100na)nod legs par phul nas thugs 143

bskyed chen mo zhus pa'i tshe chos khri'i steng du phebs pa na/ dpa' dza da rngamakha' 'gro ma rnams bya rgod la sprul nas bskor 〈skor 〉ba lan bdun byas nas radzem pa med par khri'i zur du babs/ chos gsungs tshar ba dang / nam mkha' la 'phur te so nga ba kun gyi ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur/ de nas 'bri gung du phebs nas rim gnyis zab mo'i dus 'da' bar mdzad nas/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga dku pa lug gi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sku'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings zhi ba chen por thim par gyur/ sku gdung las ring bsrel gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs ma bshams shing / /bstan pa'i go cha rno ba'i mtshon med pa/ /bdud tshogs chag med bcom nas 'chi med kyi/ /grub pa mnga' brnyes bdag po wam de rgyal/ /gdan sa bcu gnyis pa 'chi med grub pa mnga' brnyes bdag po wam sa/'di nyid gong du smos pa/ chos kyi rje bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i sras su/ shing mo phag gi lor sku 'khrungs/ rim gyis cher bskyed pa na/ yig brtsis 〈rtsis 〉sogs bstan bcos dang / sgyu rtsal thams cad sred med (100ba)kyi bu'i stobs dang ldan zhing / dregs pa can gang gi 〈gis 〉mthong ba na dpa' zhum par gyur la/ de'i tshe/ gong du byu ra'i 'byung khung du byed—〈khungs su 〉brjod pa ltar/ a phyi chos kyi sgol ma'i sras bzhi'i bsod nams dpal gyi sras mkhan po dar ma zhes dang / de'i sras a nu rgyal/de'i sras slob dpon tshul rdor bya ba gcung rin po che'i bu slob yin la 'dan du nang 'gags gis 〈kyi 〉gdan sar bkod pa la nang 'gags pas 〈pa'i 〉gdung rgyud ces pa byung / de'i gcung a dpal bya ba la sras/ slob dpon ye shes dpal sku mched dang / de nas sgom pa kun 144

rin sogs rim par byung bar/ 'bri gung gi srid skyong gi khur bzung bar sgom pa zhes brjod la/ de skabs gdung chad pa la/ nyid kyis srid skyongs 〈skyong 〉sgom pa'i khur bzhes chab srid bskyangs nas/ smin legs dpal 'dren zhes pa bud med phal las mchog tu gyur pa zhig khab tu bzhes pa la chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang 'khrungs/ gong ma'i 〈mas 〉lam gyi lung las gnang ba'i mtshan du bdag po wam zhes grags/ skabs shig nag sog gi skrang nga ba rnams kyis/ 'bri bstan la mtho 〈tho 〉mtsham 〈'tshams 〉byung bar rje nyid nas dmag dpon gyi khur bzung nas khri dmag drangs nas pha rol gyi dpung tshogs thams cad pham par mdzad nasatshur phebs pa'i tshe phyi ltas gziṭa pas (101na)skye bo mang po srog dang phral bas 〈ba'i 〉mgo lus kyi phung po la nyi 'od phog nas sa gzhi thams cad 'od kyi 〈kyis 〉gang bar gzigs pas du yongs 〈dben 〉sha rgyal ba bzang po bya ba blon po'i mchog la bka' bstsal pa/ sgar khyog pa'i shul 'od dang / nag po'i phung po 'dug pa ci yin gsungs pa la/ 'od 'di bshas byas pa'i grod pa dang / nag po 'di rnams mgo lag kyi 〈gi 〉phung po yin zhus pas chibs gong nas lhungs te/ kye ma kyi hud sgyu ra'i gdung rgyud la/ /sdig can bdag 'dra skyes so grogs po dag /da ni bdag 'dra gson pa 〈pas 〉ci zhig bya/ /da lta nyid du gum na ci ma rung / /'gro sa dmyal ba nyid las med do bye/ /sa steng 'di na bdag las sdug pa ni//mthong ngam thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /grogs po khyod rnams dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /ce ri gsungs shing brgyal bar gyur sto/ de nas blon po rnams kyisag ba ༷ grang mo gtor/ khyog 〈sgogs 〉la bstegs nas la kha 'da' — du pa ba sa ba rgya sangs pa da gyur ta / rim bzhin gling rin po cher po pag nas sgo na pa'i snga ra rnams bzhag nas/ yab chos rje 145

don grub rgyal po las rab tu byung nas mtshan rin chen dbang gi rgya da poragasol/ 'bri gung gi che dgu thams cad kyis dgra thul ba'i (101ba)skyes 'bul ba dang / sgom pa'i khur mdzad dgos gsol ba nan gyisabatab kyang ma gsan par/ sngar yab las lnga ldan dang chos drug gsan pa rnams la dgongs pa btang bas lam mar 'dug nas da ni tshe gcig gis 〈gi 〉nyams len ni chos 'dis chog ngag gi smra ba bcad nas 'jig rten kyis 〈6 〉re ba byung bar dgongs/de nub rang du thog kha gser khang gi yang thog gzhal yas khang bya ba der sku mtshams bcad nas them pa 'da' bar ma mdzad/ yab chos rje dang / che dgu rnams kyis zhu ba ci phul yang ma gnang bar/ lo bcu gcig bar rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhur len pa mdzad/ de nas nye 'khor rgyal ba bzang po la gsung bag re byon pa kun gyi 〈rgyas 〉tshor zhing / lug gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ chos kyi rje bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab du 〈tu 〉spyan 'dren byung ba la/ gsung ci yang ma byon pa la/ 'bri gung khri skor thams cad blo 'dun gcig tu byas te/ skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa rnams kyis mdo le'i steng du bzhag ste spyan drangs shing khri thog tu mnga' gsol zhing / zhu ba 'di skad phul lo/ kyi ma gson dang ma tshungs med chos kyi rje//'bri gung khri skor skye dgu (101na)thams cad sa//skyabs dang bral ba khyed kyi 〈kyis 〉ma gzigs sam/ /da ni khyod kyi 〈kyis 〉skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i dus la babs/ /'bri gung khri skor rin chen bang mdzod du/ /khrel med skye bo'i 'gong po zhugs nas sa/ /'jigs snang 'tshe ba rdustan na ji ltar byed/ /rang gi sras mchog 'di yang mi dgongs sam/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bdag 'dra thos chung shes rab shin tu dbul/ /gzhan gyi la sna 'dran pa'i cas pa'ang med//kho bo ngan146

'go'i sa/mas su lhung gyur na/ /khri skor dang ni bu yi 〈yis 〉ci zhig bya//zhes gsung sa nas zla ba phyed gnyis tshogs dang gdan sa btsa ngas nas/btsan thabs su bros te rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon/ 'chi med kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes te da lta yang bzhu ba nges la/ sngar rje ratna'i skabs rgya gar gyi grub chen badza dra tha ri bo rtse lnga ra byon pa'i 〈pas 〉dngos su mjal zhing / phyis rje chos kyi grags pa'i sku che'i sgang tsam la se tsa 'bul dpon sa'i bla ma zhig ri bo rtse lngar song skabs 'jags 〈'jag 〉spyil zhig gi nang dngos su mjal/ 'bri gung gi lo rgyus zhib mor dri bar mdzad/ mnyes mnyes/ ma da pa'i mthar phyag nas ku wa zhig shor ba ltar mdzad/ (101ba)de long 〈longs 〉gsungs nas len du song skabs sku dang 'jag spyil bcas blo bur du mi snang bar gyur zhes grags so/padma'i 〈padmas 〉lung bstan grub thob brgyad cu yis/ /mngon sum byin rlabs don dam phyag rgya che'i/ /rtogs pa dri bral lha lam ltar gziṭa pa/ /chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang zhabs la 'dud/ /gdan sa bcu gsum pa chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po sa/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul gnas chen gter sgom dang nye ba'i gzhu stod tshu zhes par bste gnasabrag tshab rgya gar gling chung bya ba'i dben gnas su/ yab sngar smos pa chos kyi rje bdag po wam/ yum dpal 'dren gnyis kyi sras su lcags mo glang gi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bcas 'khrungs / shing / mtshan yang chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang por gsol/ sku bskyed rim cher /tha /sto /tha 14 14/re /ste/ /mi//zab zugab / daṭa/pa/ lnga/ pa sbyo/'ab 'ab/ pa/ zab rgya'ab ga zab ba/ pa tā shing chen po 'khor brgya phrag dang bcas lhag 〈lhags 〉ste 〈te 〉rnam thos bu'i longs spyod la 'gran par nus pa'i 'bul ba phul te mjal 147

ba'i tshe/ dgung lo lnga pa'i gsung gi 〈gas 〉'di skad ces/ tā shing chen spo lam la 'o rgyal 〈brgyal 〉ba mi mnga' 'am/ zhes pa la sogs (103//)sa/sung 'phrod rnams dang / lnga ldan gyi rtsa tshig rnams zhum pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sgra dang ldan pa'i chos gyi 'brel pa gsungs pas/ tā shing gi 〈gis 〉legs bar brtags pas/ mtshan bzang po gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cu tshang bar mthong nas/ dad pa'i myu gu gsar pa skyes ste/ slar yang dngos po bzang ba'i khyad par dum phul/ bsngags brjod kyi tshigs bcad dang phyag mang du 'tshal/ phyi mig yang yang blta bzhin rang gi gnas su song ngo / dgung lo bdun la/ chos kyi rje don grub rgyal po dag zhing du gshegs pa dang / yab nyid ri bo rtse lngar byon nas gdung rgyud gser gyi 'phreng ba'i nyag thag rin po che nyid la thug nas/ thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉nyid sku khams bzangaba'i thabs la 'bad pa'i tshe/ sku khams cung zad bsnyung bar gyur pa la thams cad mya ngan gyi khang bur zhuṭa shing rtab rtab por gyur nas gom pa gya tshom du bar zhing / ze ngag 'don cing sman pa rnams ci bya gtol medapar gyur pa la/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams mya ngan ma byed par/ri rgya klung rgya/ ba/zha / yang rim gro mang dag dang / bdag gi grib ma'i snying gar me tsha 〈btsa' 〉rgyab 〈rkyobs/〉 de ltar byas na ba bo nad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ gsungs pa'i 〈pas 〉thams cad (103ba)kyi 〈kyis 〉gus pas lhur blangs te bka' bzhin bsgrub 〈bsgrubs 〉pa las zla ba sgra gcan lhas rgyal ba bzhin bsnyan las grol te/ sku'i gzi byin ches cher rgyas par gyur/ de'i tshe 'bri gung khri skor gyi skye dgu thams cad sro ga gi dbang po rnyed pa'am/ sred ldan gyis khye'u'i 'dod don 'grub pa lta ra dga' nas tshigs su bcad pa'i glu dbyangs du ma len 148

cing / bro shon sogs rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston gyis dus 'da' bar byas so/ de'i dus rje nyid kyis/ spru'i lung pa thams cad dpal gyi ri'i snang ba dang / rang nyid sha wa ri dbang phyug gi thugs snang shin tu gsal zhing mdun gyi nam mkhar grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byon nas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu snying stobs dang ldan pa khyod gar 'dug dpal gyi ri yin pas/ 'gro ba'i don kyi khur khur bgyis/ da lta stod phyogs phal cher mda' lnga pa'i dbang du song nas dngosasu snying po'i chos spyod pa'i skal ba med/ khyod kyi lus mthong ba dang /ming thos pa tsam gyis skye bo mang po la phan par 'gyur zhing / gdung rgyud gser gyi 'phreng ba spel shig 〈cig 〉dang / rim gyis nges don snying po'i chos kyang dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur ste de dang tshu ba mthun pa slob dpon padmas lung bstan pa ni/ shawa ri pa mi'i gzuṭa su sprul/ /(104na)blo gros stobs ldan glang gi lo pa gcig /mi'i dbang po chos rgyal ratna'i mtshan/ /gter sgom dang ni 'bri yi phyogs su 'byung / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ dam pa 'di ni sha wa ri dbang phyug gdung rgyud gser gyi 'phreng ba'i nyag thag 'dzin pa'i phyir/ mi'i zol la ston pa ni ba tshom med la/ de ltar dgung lo bco lnga'i bar brag tshab rgya gar gling chung nyid du bzhugs shing / yig rtsis la sogs pa bstan bcos thams cad la pha mthar son pa mdzad/ denas dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa yos kyi lor/ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi 〈kyis 〉thog drangs 'bri gung pa'i che dgu thams cad kyis blo 'dun gcig tu byas te/ rje nyid 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos srid zi rdo / sgo ༷rar rjo sa// rdo sdu dī/sa/ ngo /rdzu dro /shā /pa /rdo /rdo /nga / 143

khyab pas skye dgu thams cad yid 'phrog par gyur/ de'i — sgo ma pa'i khur 'dzin pa'i sku mched gzhan med par chos srid lhan gcig 〈cig 〉bskyangs ste de nas 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams thar pa'i sa bon bskrun phyir/ byang phyogs su 'khor tshogs du ma dang bcas sgar chen phebs pa na/ gdung rgyud nyag phra ba'i dbang gis skye bo thams cad skom pa'i skyes bus chu (104ba)klung mthong ba bzhin du/ thams cad yid ring 〈rings 〉rings ltar dad pa'i dbang gis mig gnyis mchi mas gang bzhin du/ rje'i zhal la yang yang blta zhing / longs spyod dngos po ji snyed 'phangs pa med pa phul lo/ der 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams mthong thos dran reg don ldan du mdzad nas slar 'bri gung du phebs nas/ dadams kyi dngos po de dag chud mi za zhing tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho spel phyir/gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam rnams/ mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa zla ba gsum gyi khongs su yongs su rdzogs par grub ste/ rab gnas byin chags par mdzad/ de nas rim par rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la thos bsam gyi gru rdzing 〈rings 〉bca' ba 〈bar 〉bzhed kyang / yid srub bdag po'i brgyud nas 〈kyis 〉loms 〈brlams 〉pa'i sku 'khor gros la dbang ba rnams kyis log pa'i bshes gnyen rin chen 'od bya ba zhig la sbyar nas/ rnam dag gi bshes gnyen rnams ring du dor bar gyur pa na/ skyes bu dam pa rnams sa log pa'i slob dpon gyis bsru bar mi nus pa chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ des bstan pa'i lta ba rnams la thugs yid ma ches shing / bskyed rim gyis 〈kyi 〉don rnams rgyud sde rnams dang ma mthun par gzigs nas (1༷ngan)'di skad gsungs so/ bdag nyid sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i ring lugs la/ /slob par 'dod kyang yum dang chen po rnams/ /sku 150

dbang chis pas/ bshes gnyen 'di dang sbyar/ /skong gis bstan pa'i lta ba'i ba/nad rnams dang / /grub chen gong ma rnams dang 'gal bar snang / /khor gi 〈gis 〉phog pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog dang / /bdag la gdod nas 'char ba'i bde mchog gnyis/ /'jigs dus ba la ba'i tshul yang mi mthun 'a tsug bdag gi sems kyang phyang 〈'phyang 〉mo nyug tu gyur/ /'on kyang grub chen rnams dang 'bral med phyir/ /gtsugs 〈gzhug 〉ma'i don la the tshom med mod kyang / /mtshan ldan mi'i bla ma ma brten 〈bstem 〉pas/ /'dren las chung bar bsam nas de skad smras/ /khyed rdzus 'di dag gzhan la ma smra cig 〈zhig〉 /zhes (ces 〉pa'i mgur byon nas/ kho bos 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rim bsgom 〈sgom 〉pa'i tshe zhabs g.yas rtsog sna'i steng la bzhag pa'i 'og tu dus mtshan ga 'gyel du 'ong zhing g.yon cung zad skum pa chu 'phan gyi rtse mor bzhag pa'i 'og tu/ 'jigs byed nag po kha bub du 〈tu 〉'ong zhing 'dug gar stabs byas pas 'jig rten gyi khams te ru na'i dkyil 'khor (105ba)du las lam 'char snyam byed cing / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gral dbu re yang byas/ slob dpon gyi 'chad pa'i bde mchog de g.yas pas 'jiṭa byed dang g.yon pas dus mtshan mam/na pa gcig 'chad kyi 'dug khong pa la 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' 'bum gyis 〈kyi 〉lung gcig nyan pa des sems la phan pa zhig byung zhing / lta ba dang bskyed rim kyang 〈yang 〉da rang la gsal snang skyes shing / grub chen rnams kyi 〈kyis na 〉ba/sungs pa dang mthun ba ra 'dug ha ha de rnams rtsed mo byas pa yin/ ma ma ṇi pa rdu/ zhes gar stabs yang 〈kyang 〉mang po mdzad par grags yo/ de'i tshe sku mched dang gdung rgyud gzhan med pa la/ ma na ris sa po'i 15

mas mo chos rgyal bzang mo zhes pa zhig kyang khab tu bzhes pa la sras che ba dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po 'khrungs so/ yang ma gar lung pa'i rigs las sgrol ma sngon mo'i rnam sprul mtshan ldan zhig khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras chung ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ de nas mtshe'ukha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bka' brgyud kyi grub chen ho ru na bya ba'i slob ma rtog 〈rtogs 〉ldan (10can)rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'ja' mo dge 'dun mgon po zhes pa des lta sgom gyi sa/nad zhus shing / sgru ba brgyud kyi bstan pa gso dgos pa'i snyan sku la yar yang phul bar shin tu mnyes kyang / bdud kyi pho nya ba rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉rje'i drung du 'gra skabs med pa byas nas/ gcod pa nam — /rje /ga rje —— /ste/mkha' rda sa bya ba no / phyag 'a ra pa la da gas pa phul bas snyung zug phral 〈'phral 〉du ce/ bar gyur pa la/ zhor du bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉chos gso dnge /sa zhes zhu ba phul ba'i tshe/ bdud kyi pha nya ba rnams mgrin gcig gis/ chos rje nyid sde srid kyi khur bor nas dben pa'i ri be rnams la shor na/ khyod la khag yod do zhes dam sgag 〈bsgaṭa 〉shing byen 'dzin dang bcas nas dmigs pa 'bul ba ma gtoṭa snyan bskul 'bul ba'i go ga/ bas med par byas so/ de'i 'bras bu sgrub brgyud rin po che de nyi ) kyis 〈kyi 〉chos rnams dang gling 'dir rje nyer gcis nga 'i sku tho / na sa rgyud sde'i cho ga sgrub mchod mang du yod pa rnams phal cher yu na ring po'i bar nub par gyur te/ rje'i thugs dgongs la da ma yun ring sdad 〈bsdad 〉kyang bshad nyan gyi bya ba byed pa'i snod mi 'dug par dgongs/ kho bo tshe ring yang mi ring zhe dgu yin/ byung yang mi (105ba)byung zhe dgu zhes gsungs shing / rin po che sna bdun las khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi sku mi tshad tsam/ bzo'i rig 152

byed mkhas pa'i dbang po sne'u chung pa bsod nams rgya ba bya bas/ byi b.lo'i dbyar zla ba gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉legs par grub cing / de mnyam rin po che dang sman dar gyi phung po las thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor bcas kyi sku bzhengs pa rnams/ gser khang gi mdor bzhugs su gsol zhing / rje nyid kyis dbus dge 'dun rnams kyis rgyud sde'i lugs bzhin rab gnas byin chags bar mdzad nas/ lhun grub gling bya bar phebs te/ nyin gcig dga' ston chen po'i gral dbus su seng ge'i khri chen por bzhugs pa la/ thugs 'ur ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas gan dkar gsol ja dang bcas pa phyag gi 〈gis 〉shugs drag pos gyang logs su rgyab 〈brgyab 〉pa/ ja yang ma bo da /ra yol yang chag gas med pa'i sgrub rtags bstan te/ skad cig nyid la bzhengs nas/ chibs kha ba la kho bos 〈bo'i 〉rta mchog sga srab ldan par gyis la khrid shog gsungs/ de ma thag chibs rgyugs mdzad nas phebs pa'i lam khar/ zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs pa la thugs dam gyi rin po che'i zer (10 na)ba thag pa bcad de nam mkha' la gtor zhing mchod pa phul nas/ skad cig nyid la mtshe'u khar bde ldan gyi pho brang du phebs pas/ so so skye bo rnams kyis thugs rlung byung ba yin no zhes gleng / de nas snyigs dus kyi skye dgu rnams zab mo'i don la rgyab kyis phyogs shing / phyi tshul mdzes pa tsam la chog shes nas de dag gi dbang du song bas sku de'i 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams rdzogs par dgongs te/ dgung lo4 zhe dgu pa glang gi lo'i smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu la sku'i dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyingasasu rdzogs so/ de'i tshe lha las me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / 53

gsung rab rgya masa'i tshogs la sgom rim sogs/ /gzigs dang mkhyen dang rtogs pa mngon gyur ba/ /ngo mtshar dus mnyam grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang rgyal//gdan sa bcu ba'i pa/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpa ga ngazang po zhes sam/ chos rje bco lnga pa sa/ 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul gzhustod sgru'i bkra shis steng kha zhes yul spyongasadang pho brang nyams dga' ba'i dbon gnas su/ yab (10 ba)yum gong du brjod pa ltar chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po dang / yum bsod nams sgol ma gnyis kyi khab tu/ sa mo sbrul gyi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ phyag rdor sprul pa pha rjes bu yi 〈yis 〉'dzin zhes lung bstan pa ltar phyag rdor gyi sprul par grags/ mtshan rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ ring por ma thog 〈thos/sa 〉par sku bskyed stobs dang ldan zhing / gzi brjid kyis thams cad zil gyis gnon cing / gong smos log pa'i slob dpon rin chen 'od ces bya ba las yi ge rnamasapha mthar son kyang / khong dang thugs 'dris ches pa'i dbang gis/ rnam dag gi bshes gnyen dngos su brten 〈bsten 〉pa'isku dbang ma byung / skog gyur du grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma bstan 〈bsten/〉 dgung lo nyi shu'i bar skya rtsar bzhugs/ de nas 'khor ba'i sdug ba la (gyis )yid byung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ chos lung tshogs pa rnams sbyan drangs )/ mkhan po bshes gnyen bzang po la sogs grwa tshang gi dbus su rab byung dge tshul nyid du sgrub/ de nas thos bsam mdzad bar bzhed kyang sngar yab gyi skabs su smos pa ltar gros la dbang ba rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉rngo mi thog par de ltar byas so/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa glang gi lor/ yab chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po dag 154

pa'i zhing du gshegs (108na)ba'i dgongs rdo /sa kyi rim pa rgya che ba mdzad/ dngul gar blugs las gzims mal sku bston mi tshad lhag pa grub cing / rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ de nas 'khor du ma dang bcas/kong yul gyi sbas lung rnams su phebs pa'i tshe/ bu byung lha khang du phebs dus/ chu bo'i gnod pa chen po byung bar skye po rnams kyis gsol ba bstob bas/ dam pa 'dis rab tu khros pa'i cha byad khro bo'i gzigs stangs kyis 'bur tshugs su gzigs nas/ rig mdzub dang bcas byon pas chu bo chen po sgrog lugs kyang blo bur du bros pa ltar rgyang grags tsam du song ste 〈ste/〉 der gnas ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs chu'i gnod pa las thar bar mdzad/ de nas 'og shod kyi phyogs su phebs tegru khar phebs pa dang / gnyan pa med pa'i gru bo che gcig ga nas byung cha med par byung ste/ phar sgrol tshul sgrol lan gsum gyi bar byas/ rje nyid phar khar phebs pa dar mi snang bar gyur pa la/ der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis mgrin gcig ku/ 'di mig 'phrul yin nam 'on ste chu lhas bstong ba'am/ chos skyong rnams kyis bsu ba byas pa'am/ ji ltar byas kyang chos rje khyod nyid grub chen sgom por snang ngo kye/ de phyir khyod la skyabs su mchi/ zhes zer zhing thams cad (108ba)lhag par dad par gyur te/ bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas/ chos zhus pa la/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub skor/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bshad du ma gnang / 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams thar pa'i lam la bkod/slar yang 'bri gung du phebs nas/ yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su gser zangs las grub pa'i thub pa'i sku thog tshad ma zhig bzhengs pa yang myur dugrub cing rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ chos 'khor sgang zhes bya pa'i gzhi mdor/ sa 'bum las mchod rten chen po dag kyang bzhengs/ de'i tshe 155

'bri gung gi che dgu thams cad kyis blo 'dun gcig tu byas nas gdung rgyud spel bar gsol ba btab pa las/ bram ze khye'u nama'i rnam thar bzhin du/ 'gro don du 'gyur bar gzigs nas gnang ste/ re zhig gi bar du bslab pa gsum 'bul ba'i tshul ba na nas/ rang gi mnga' 'ogatu gyur pa mgar lung pa'i gdung rigs stag rtse rdzong dpon bsam 'grubabya ba'i sras mo rin chen dpal mo zhes bya ba smin legs lha mo si tā'i gzugs ltar lta na sdug cing / mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i lang tsho can zhig khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras su 'brug gi lo la rin chen rnam rgyal 'khrungs pa ma/ rim gyis cher bskyed pa na phag mor khab tu phebs telang gsar nang so'i sgom pa'i (1༷ na)khur bzhes/ lug gi lo la rgyaladabang kun dga' rin chen dang khyi'i lo la chos kyi rgyal po bstan pa rgyal 4tshan rnams 'khrungs/ sras mo 'gro ba'i sgrol ma bya ba byung bar 〈ba〉stag lung gi tha /dung gi btsun mor song ngo / de'i tshe gcen po dbang rin po che sa/dan sar phebs par zhus kyang ma mdzad par rje nyid 'bri gung gi gdan sar mnga' gsol/ chab 'bangs rnams dga' gyid kyis dus 'da' ba 〈bar 〉gyur cing / de nas lo 'ga' yar song ba na/ mda' lngapas brgyud nas rlabs 〈brlams 〉pa'i 'khor gyis (gyi 〉gtso bo 'ga' zhig dang sne'u'i rdzong nang du rgyal ba'i gdung rabs gcod pa la zhugs pa sa/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdung rabs gcod pa'i phyir zhal ngo'i mgul zhus shing / sde srid phag mo gru pa la zhabs 'dren du ma sgrub pa/ rgyal ba rkarma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dug gis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa po dang lhan cig gros kyi mdun sar tshogs te zhabs 'dren du ma ru ba pas/ rje 'di nyid ni rdzi bar ma nus shing / gdung sras rnams byugs rjes nongs par ma nus kyang / rje nyid156

byugs skyo ba'i dbang gis thugs dgongs la/ kye ma snyigs dus skye bo rnams/ bdud kyi dbang du song ba 'gro ba la phan phyir ji ltar byas na yang / ska — med dmus long (10 ba)rnams la phan par ma 'dod cing / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bstan pa dar ba'i phyir/ rigs sras khye'u 'di rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang nyid sbrul pa'i gnas su bsdu bar dab /ngas nas dgung lo sum cu so drug bzhes pa shing pho 'brug gi lo/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas sprul pa'i snang brnyan bsdus so/ der zhag zhe dgu'i bar du 'od gsal 'gro 'ong dang bral ba'engang du bzhugs shing / de nas sku gdung rin po che zhugs la phul ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char babs pa/ rol mo'i sgra/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas/ thugs ljags ring srel 〈bsrel 〉yig 'bru'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing / gdung rus gar khyer 'ja' gur dang / gdung thal gtor bas lo mang po'i b.raser ba'i gnod pa ma byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba dpag tu med pa byung /'di nyid mnyam med dbang gi gcung po yin yang gdan sa'i stabs kyis gong du sgrigs pa'o/theg gsum chos kyi nor 'dzin khyon chen po 〈por/〉 /rnam dpyod gom stabs gcig gis zil mnan te/ /log shes stobs ldan sa 'og 'ching mdzad pa/ /mnyam med rin (110na)chen chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po sa/ 'di sa gdan sar dngosasu ma bzhugs kyang / chos brgyud la bka' drin che ba yin zhing / 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul gzhu smad kyi cha/ mkhar thog gzhis khar/ yab ni sngar bye / sa pa ltar — sa rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po dang / yul mnga' bdag rgyar po'i rgyu na las sgol ma dkar mo'i rnam sprul chos rgyal bzang 157

tsha gnyis kyi sras su/ sa pho 'brug gi lor sku 'khrungs// rim gyis bskyed bsrings zlo na/ 'byu klog mtha' dag la phul du phyin zhing / dgung lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang sgrub brgyud rin po che 'dinyid kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed par dgongs/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan las/ 'khor lo sdom pa lu lte pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang lu nag dril gsum gyi rgyud dang / gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub dkyil man ngag gsang 'dus kyi rgyud 'grel dang / sgra snyan rtsis dkar nag sogs tha snyad rig pa mtha' dag gsan cing byang bar mdzad par/ dgung lo nyi shu'i bar bshes gnyen de dang 'bral ba med par mdzad do/ de nas gong du smos ba ltar/ cho sa rje bshesashagarten don grub rgyal po'i sku dus nas 〈110ba〉bzung / rang sgogs phal cher bdud kyi dbar du song nas 'chad nyan gyis 〈rmi 〉mdzad pa cher ma dar bar brten/ snying po'i don rgyud tsam mgatogs 'bri gung gi chos da phal cher chad pa la/ rje 'di'i 〈'dis 〉sgrub brgyud kyi bas pa mi nyams shing gso ba'iphyir/ chos kyang nye rgyud dang dam tshig gtsang ba'i slob dpon phyogs kun tu tshol bar pho nya gsang 〈btang 〉ba na/ ji zhig na chos kyi rje nyer gnyis pa rin poche'idangos slob yon tan dub dang lda pa chosarje nam mkha' rgyal ma na zhes dang / de'i thogs 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/de'i slob ma stag lug pa ngag dbang grags pa zhes/ dam tshig gtsang zhing mkhas grub stod sal zhi thang 'chag na bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus zhus par/kheng 〈khengs 〉gragasaspangs te skad cig nyid la de nyid kyi drung du phebs pa'i ma/ bshes gnyen dam pa des kyang bsu ba bkur ste'i khri la blangs te/ rje nyid nas phyag dang gral dbu la 'jog pa sogs mdzad pa la/158

'bri gung gis 〈gi 〉mnga' ri pa ga su rtogs 〈gtogs 〉pa tham pa cad —/nga /khyad par bdud kyi 〈kyis 〉rlams 〈brlams 〉pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba la/ chos brgyad dang kheng 〈khengs 〉grags spangs te dam pa de'i drung du mos gusasrog 'khor gyi khrid/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ dra ro'i chos drug 'jig rten gsus (111na)mgon gyi zab chos ma lus pa/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa/ dwagasabo bka' brgyud rnamasakyi bka' 'bum/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i rnam bar/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos ma lus pa gsan nas 'bri gung du phebs/ gzhanayang yongs 'dzin du ma las gdams pa'i chos mtha' yas ba gsan —cing / mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyugadu 〈tu 〉gyur/ de nasamachagadang ldan pa'i rigs ma stag lung pa'i gdung las byung ba zhig dang /rje'u rigs khri khang pa'i rigs las byung ba mtsha ldan zhig bcas khab tu bzhes te/ mkhar thog gzhis khar sbas pa'i brtugazhugasakyi gsang spyod thugasanyams su bzhes shing / rigs kyi sras 'jog bar ma sa da/thugs dam gyi rtsal las/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes thogs ba med ba'i 〈pas 〉sku chas rnams rkun pos khyer ba la skog gyur ma yin pa'i 〈bas 〉phyis de ltar mi byed pa'i dam bca' bskul bas/ thun po rnams ngo tsha zhing dad par gyur cing lha khang chen mo'i steng shod thams cad nyams nyes su song ba la zhig bsis 〈gso 〉ma da de/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khangabazang la 'gran par nus pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de rjes gcung po rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan 〈111ba〉zhing brjes pa la/ gdan sar mnga' gsol yang ma gnang ste/ bya bral gyi brtul shugs kyi 〈pyis 〉dman sa bzung nas/ rang gi gsol skal byang ma dang / bod gzhes 159

rnams log par spyod pa 'ga' zhig gis khyer nas longs spyod cing / su la brnyas pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan par/ rang srid rnams kyis tshar gcod par zhus kyang / chos brgyad kyi snang ba zhig pas dgra gnyem/ gyi dbye ba gtan nas ma mdzad/ rgya nag gong ma chen po'i 〈pos (wam gyi lungalas gnang bar/ mtshan sam mkhar thog par grags/ )se razangs las thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan mtho bcu gnyis pa zhig bgeng bar bzhed pa'i tshe/ 'gus mkhan med par bal yul nas 'ong sha pa'i tshul ba 'i lha bzo du ma zhig zhabs drung du sleb 〈glebs 〉pa na/ bzo bab 'dzu ri par bzhed pa la/ 'bri gung gi phyogs 'dir skye dgu phal cher log pa'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang du song ba'i cha rkyen mi 'byor par gzigs nasasgar chen btegs nas long po'i phyogs su phebs nas/ bkra shis chos lung bya ba'i dgon par gdan bab nas/ bzo thab btsugs pa'i nyin nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang mi tog gi char babs/ der gnas skye dgu thams cad dad par gyur nas longs spyod kyi dngos ga dpag tu med par 〈pa 〉phul nas/ ring por 〈111na〉ma thogs par bzo'i khyad par rnams grub cing / 'bri gung du phebs nas thub sku lha khang chen mor gdan drangs/ nang bzhugs zhabs sdom dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par grub nas/ rgyal ba nam pa chos grags rgya mtsho spyan drangs te/ spre'u lo hor za drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rgyud sde chen po'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa shis brjod dga' ston rgyas par grub/ rje 'di gsung rab la thos bsam ngom pa med pa'i brtul zhugs can yin pas/rgyal ba chos 3gas rgya mtsho'i drung du/ theg chen bstan pa 'i snyeng po dang / dra ro'i chos drug sogs snying po'i chos rnams dang / bstan bcos du ma gsan/ bka' brgyud bstan pa nyag phra ba'i skabs yin pas/160

rgyal ba rkarma pas sde nyid la thugs dam la nge 〈nges 〉shes bskyed pa'i ngo rjod dang bstan dgongs gis 〈kyis 〉phyag dpe gnang nas 'a bri bstan sor chud dgos pas 〈pa'i 〉bka' nan gnang / mkhan slob brje len/chos khrims bsdam 〈bsdams 〉pa sogs mdzad/ rjes kyang wam gyi las go sna ma sbyar sogs rnam thos kyi bu'i khengs pa 'phrog nus pa'i 'bul ba'i khyad par gyi 〈kyis 〉mnyes par mdzad nas phyir phebs/ slar yang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan bcos 'gyur ro co ga gi grags bam rnams shog dkar gyi ngos la bzhengs par mdzad pa yang tsa na ring (111ba)ma thogs par grub cing rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ de nas ska zhes shig rgyal ba'i bstan pa smang 〈rmang 〉nas bsko 〈brko 〉bar 'dod pa/ log pa'i bshes gnyen gyis 〈rgya 〉rjes su 'jug pa zhig gis nang mchod la sbyar dug btab nas drangs par/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i bso 〈gso 〉dpyad kyis 〈kyi 〉gzi la 'gong bar nus pa'i sman pa mkhas pas/ bsnyung 〈snyung 〉ngos bzung nas/ bsos 〈gso 〉sman bzhes su tha/sol ba la ma gnang ste thog rdzis lam khyer kho nas zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa'i 〈pas 〉zhag bdun gyi bar bsnyung 〈snyung 〉gzugs kyi 〈zug gi 〉rnam pa sku lus me dpung du 'bar zhing / zhabs khol bas/ chu'i phung po dbu skra dang ba spu'i rtsa ba re re nas babs pa'i tshe mgur 'di gsungs so/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /'gags med zug gzer ji ltar che na yang / /gnyis 'dzin nam mkha'i mdud pa zhig pa'i tshe/ /ba/nyis med 'od gsal chen por shar shar shar/ /kho bo'i 〈bo 〉dug lnga'i bdud las rgyal bas na/ /'jig rten dug gi 〈gas 〉za bar ga la nus/ /de phyir rin chen snod gcig khyer la shog /yi / mi na kho bo skyus/sa nas bstan par bya/ /khyod rnams the tshom bral bar 'gyur ro kye/ /gsungs 161

shing li sder nang du byugs ste/ sla nga'i nang du kha spub nas 'ji (113na)pas bsams 〈btums 〉te/ me lha'i dga' ston du byas pas li sder sla nga gnyis ku dum por 〈bur 〉gyur cing / nyi zla sgra gcan las rgyal ba ltar bsnyung 〈snyung 〉las grol te/ sku'i gzi ba da thams cad rgyas par gyur to/ de nas 'bri gung byang chub gling rin po che nyid du bzhuṭa nas/ sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉chos thams cad dang gzhan yang rgyud sde rgya mtsho/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos zab cing rgya che ba rnams/rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen la gnang nas bstan pa'i gnyer gtad pa mdzad cing / dus de nyid nas nges don snying po mgon po 'bri gung pa 'di nyid kyi chos kyi pha rab 〈rol 〉zin pa yin la/ de nasamakhar thog gzhis kha nyid du phebs nas zhing gzhan du 'gro don che bar dgongs nas zhal bkod du ma'i 〈mas 〉'khor gyi bung ba rnams rang rang gi gnas su bkye zhing / shing pho byi ba'i lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis la gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad/ de'i tshe ltas bzang du masaskye dgu kun yid 'phrogs 〈phyogs 〉so/ 'di yang rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che dang nyeraganyis pa sogs ma gtogs 'ga' zhig la rnam thar rgyas pa ma mthong ngo /sgrub brgyud snying po'i nyi ma rtog ge yi/ /nasamakha'i glang pos cung zad sgrib pa gang / (113ba)/thuṭa rje'i dri bzhon can gyis rab gsal ba/ /rgyal dbang kun dga'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de yang jo snubs pa dang chos rje bdag po wam gdan rabs su ma bgrangs pa'i gter chos sogs kyi lung bsta na bcas yongs grags gdan sa bcu gsum par brjod kyang / gong gsal bzhin go rim ltar gdan sa bco lnga pa rgyal ba gnyis pa kum/ dga' rin chen dpal bzang po ni/ mnyam med sgo sa 162

〈skyob 〉pa rin po che bas mas〈bsam 〉bzhin du bstan pa cung zad nyams pa das/ 〈gso 〉ba'i phyir byon pa yin te/ de yang 'jig rten gsumagyi mgon pos gling gi shar du tshems shing btsugs pa 'dis/ sta yu dang ste'u yu nyan pa dang gling 'dir ba ra bong dang / sgom ma ma lo can gyis 'dzin pa'i dus/ kho bo gling 'dir bskor 〈skor 〉gcig yo nga das/sa pa yin gsungs pa star/ sgru bkra shis steng khar grags pa pho brang nyams dga' ba'i dben gnas su/ yab ni sngar zos pa ltar/ chosakyi rje renachen chos kyi rgya mtshan dpal bza ra po dang / yum ni stag rtse'i mi dpon gyi sras mo re / chem/ dpa mo gnyis kyi khab tu/ shing mo lug gi lor sku bltams pa'i tshe/ sa g.yo ba dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char babs pa/ byang chub gling gi gser khang chos rje rin po (114na)che'i sku lasa'odazer sna lnga 'phros te/ sgru bkra shis steng kha'i pho brang bar du 'brel ba mchog dman kun gyi 〈kyis 〉mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de'i tshe bshes gnyen bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya bas rigs sngags kyi btsas pa'i cho ga legs par sgrub zhing 〈cing 〉mtshan rin chen lhun po zhes gas/la/ rim gyis cher bskyed bsrings pa na/ gzhon nu'i rol rtsed ma dzad pa'i tshu — sa/gtsug lag khang bzheng ba dang / gyis pa'i 'khor dang de'u'i tshogs la chos 'chad nyan gyi bya ba'i tshul dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba'i tshul sogs byis pa phal gyis (gyi 〉spyod tshul las rnam par 'das cing 〈shing /〉 'jam dpal mtshan brjod zugs las shugs 'byu ra sa gsungs shing / dgung lo bdun la babs ba na/ slob dpon sbyin gragasazhes pa las yi ge bris klog mthar son pa mdzad/ skabs shig 'bri stog gnyis 'khrug pa'i tshe/ dam can rdo rje legs pa byis pa'i tshul kyis/ ri1 3

bong gi mgo mang po sku mdun du spungs ste/ da dung gsod dam zer bal rje'i 〈rjes 〉snying rje chen pos da chog ces gsungs pa na/ rang srid kyi sdes pha rol gye dpung pham par byas/ de nas dgung lo bcu bzhes pa 'i tshe yab rin (114ba)chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sa/zhan don la gshegs pa na/ yum la thugs las ma mdzad gsungs pa dang /dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa bka' bkod mdzad/ de skabs bsnyung 〈snyung 〉cung zad byung bar/ mdun mkhar sangs rgyas sman lha'i sku gsal bar gzigs nas/ de nyid las 'od zer 'phros nyid kyi skur thim pa'i snang ba byung bar sku khams dwangs/ de nas dgung lo bcu gcig pa la ba/zhan phan thos bsam gyis 〈kyi 〉bya ba byed par dgongs te/ gling du phebs pa'i lam du/ sngon gyi rten 'brel gyi 〈kyis 〉drug rtsa'i byis pa rnams kyis mchod rdzas thogs pas bsu ba'i rnam pa dang / de nas cho ri/ rje dbang rin po che'i drung du phebs nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams zab malus pa gsan/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la/ rgyal ba nam pa chos grags rgya mtsho klung shod zur re bkra shis thang du phebs pa na/ rje 'di sku 'khor du ma dang bcas te phebs nas mjal 'phrad dang / zang zing gi skyes kyi 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad nas/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po la sogs pa gdams pa'i bdud rtsi du ma bzhes/ slar chos rje dbang rin po che'i drung du phebs te/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos mdzod ma 'a dag gi don thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson pa la ngal med bskyang 〈bskyangs/〉 (115na)khyad par zab mo lnga ldan gyi nyams khri da kyis phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor bzhi rim rtogs pa mthar thug pa brnyes/de'i tshe nub gcig mnal lam du sku lus las sna 〈snag 〉khras/ gi rgyun mang du thon pa zhig byung bar/ chos rje dbang rin chen la zhus pa'i 14

(pas 〉khyed kyi las nyon shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa byang ba'i ltas yin gsungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa spre'u lo la/ chos rje dbang rin chen gyi thugs dam du lha khang chen mor thub pa'i sku bzhengs ba 〈par 〉mdzad pa'i rab gnas la rgyal ba rkarma pa chos graṭa rgya mtsho spyan drangs par rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe rje 'di'i gzigs snang la/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas lha rnams kyis glu gar rol mo'i sgra sgog pa 'ja' mtshon 'bar ba'i dbus su thub dbang nyan thos kyi 'khor dang bcas pa rten la thim pa dngos su gzis/sa / der chas kyi gsan pa kha shas mdzad nas phan tshun zang zing gi skyes gya ma/ ༷ / pa mdzad/ slar yang lo der sgar chen byang du phebs pa'i dus/rgyal dbang kurma pas rje nyid sna bas 〈skyob 〉pa 'jig rten /sum mgon nyid du ngos 'dzin par mdzad do/ de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa la chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ slob dpon blo gros bstan pa/ dus sgo ba leb/sa (115ba)pa ren chen sogs kha bsgo nga da ge 'dun grangs chang gis 〈ga 〉dbus su bar ma rab byung dang dase/ tshukha du grub/ mtshan kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ slar mkhan chen de'i drung nas/gsang sngags kyi rjes gnang du ma dang / las slob blo bstan las 'dul ba'i mdo rtsa sogs mang du gsan/ ma/ na slob kha bskong bcas la yon dang bkur ste du mas mnyes par mdzad/ de nas klung shod ma sa kyi phu/ mkhar rdzong bya ba'i da na gnas su/ 'jam dbyangs da ldan rirno chen pa'i drung nas/ shā ro'i chos drug gsan nas nyams su bzhes pa'i tshe/ bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'khrungs/mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs du ma zhal gzigs/ yang 16 sa

mgon pa'i 'khor lo lnga pa'i dus dgongs/ 〈dgong 〉thun zhig la mkhas grub ras chen pas/ rje 'dis ye shis kyi mgon po'i skur bsgyur bar gzigs/ mgon po'i chos skor rnams gas na pa'i tshe 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mtshan ma mang du byung / dgung lo bco brgyad pa la phag mo khang gsar nang so'i mi dpon zhig dus las 'das pa na/ gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbur spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ der phebs nas chos gsungs pa'i tshe dang /bsngo ba'i skabs yon bshad dang bsngo ba rnams (11can)dus gcig la gsungs pa sogs sku'i bkod pa du ma bsnyan/ de nas 'bri gung du phebs/dgung lo bcu dgu pa la/ dben gnas khra ba kha zhes par slob dpon gtsang pa bya ba'i drung du/ bka' gtad rjes gnang gi tshogs du ma dang /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i nyams khrid gsan pa'i tshe/tag 〈rtags 〉bcu dang yon tan brgyad pha mthar son cing gzigs snang mang du byung / rgyal ba rta bdun dbang po bya ba yongs 'dzin zhig las/rngog dkyil bdun la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor duma'i dbang dang / de dag gi rgyud 'grel sogs gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu pa shing stag lo chos lung tshogs pa spyan drangs te/ mkhan slob 'a gral grangs ra gi dbus su rgyal ba'i bstan pa la yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub 〈bsgrubs/〉 mkhan chen de nyid las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud 'grel la sogs pa gsan nas/lo de nyid la ji 'di dpa gyi 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen po'i chos srid seng ge'i khyer ma nga' gsol ba na/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang bsam brjod las 'das/ bar skabs yun ring por 'bri gung gi snying bo don rgyud tsam/ ma gtogs chos rgyud phal cher chad/ gling rin po che shug// (kyi nyams nasastongs la byug pa na/ rje (115ba/ sgo /sa

〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i khri thog bcu gsum pa la nyid byon nas 'bri gung gi chos srid nyams par 〈pa 〉bso 〈gso 〉ba lung bstan pa thog tu babs nas/ gong smos mtshungs med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po las 'bri gung chos mdzod rnams gsan ba ltar/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la chos kyi mngon par mtho ba'i gser khang du/ dge 'dun gyis 〈gye 〉tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu la/ zab cing gting dpag par mi nus pa rgya chen gsung rab kyi tshig don la ma lus pa mnyam med skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa yab sras rnams kyi zab ba'i chos su gyur pa rnams/ zhum pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sgrogs par mdzad de/ lo de nyid la khang gsar chen mor dra ro'i chosadrug gi dgun khrid gnang ba'i tshe ras pa brgya phrag lhag pas bla g.yel chen mor ras phud mdzad cing / rje nyid kyang kun gyi mthong sar ras rkyang gi tshul 'dzin nas drod kyi che ba ngom par mdzad pa na/ chu bo chen po'i dar dang / gling gi chu mgochu ra tshun gyi khyag 〈'khyags 〉pa rnams zhig nas/ dbyar gyi dus ltar nam zla dros/ nam mkha' la 'ja' gur la sogs mtshan ltas du ma byung / de nas mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi pho brang du brtan chags shing / yig mkhan du mas mthing shog kyi 〈 〉ngos la/ gser dngul gyi 〈gyes 〉spel bar bris ba rgyal ba'i bka' gangs can (117na)ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam rnams zla ba gcig gi khongs yongs su grub cing rab gnasamanga' gsol byin chags par mdzad pa'i tshe/ me tog ga char dang 'ja' kur sogs ltas bzang gi 〈gis 〉skye bo rnams yid 'phrogs phrogs 〉so/ de nasatsho lang dgon khang gsar du zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ der 'dus pa rnams phal cher tshe mtshams dang / lo gsu phyogs gsu gyi sgrub ba'i dam bca' phul ba sabarten/ 167

gling ge stod du dar rgyas rtse bya ba ba/sam gtan gyi khang bu bcu phra / lnga 'debs par mdzad pa'i chos 'chad kyi khur 'dzin du grub 74'i dbang phyug 'bri gung ras chen rin chen rgya mtsho zhes sam/ ras chen ratna zhesapa bu slob kun las mchog tu gyur pa de nyid dang / gling stod smad gnyis kyi cho ga'i lag len dang chos spyod ngag sgrigs 〈sgrig 〉gi slob )dpon du ngaka' bcu ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnams sgrags 〈bsgrags 〉shing / rje nyer gnyis rin po che'i sku dus kyi rgyud sde'i cho ga sogs ji lta ba 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa dang / gling smad du dgongs pa gcig pa'i bshad grwa'i srol chen bstod 〈gtod 〉par mdzad/ rje btsun sa rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyilachog mos gus sros/ 'khor gyi khrid/ bde mgon gyi las rim gsal sgon sogs bstan bcos 'ga' zhig mdzad/ de nas stod mnga' (11 ba)ris nas rigs rus mngon mtho'i bu slob mang ba dang / smad ta'i tu'i pho brang nas 'bul dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs kyis rang rang gi zang zing 'byor pa'i 'bul ba du ma phul ba dang / phyogs 'dus grwa rgyun stong phrag lhag byung bar/ slar yang sgrub sde tharapa'i gru chen zhes bsam gtan gyi khang bu sum brgya las mi nyung ba 'debs par mdzad/ spre'u loraskyid shod du nad yams chen po dang / 'than 〈than 〉pas lo 'bras kun 'joms par gyur pa la/ sa skyong rin sprungs pa don yod rdo rjes/ sa dmar chos kyi grags pa dang / sde 'di lhan cig skyid shod du sbyan drangs pa'i lam du brag dkar mi dpon sri gcod pa'i 〈pas 〉bsnyen bkur zhabs togs 〈tog 〉rgyas par byas/ de nas glang ra zhes pa na/ mi bdag de nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉pho nya ba mngags te/ ngag gi zhu bar/ da lta dus snyigs ma'i segs 〈sred 〉can rnams nyon mongs dug lnga la bag med par spyod pa'i dbang gi 〈gas 〉rgyal khams byings dang 16

khyad par sked shod 'der nad yams kyi 'tshe ba rgya chen pos 'gro ba kun — la mnar bar byu ra cing / char med 'than 〈than 〉pa yun ring gi 〈gis 〉lo 'bra sa ma smin pa'i 〈pas 〉yu ga/'i da jigs pa chen po'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa la/ rgya bakhyod bye thugs rje'i 〈rjes 〉skyobs du〈su 〉gsol/ zhes zhu ba nan can byung bas/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams la 'phre na 'a sa / bcol te/ klu rnams (ri 'dod yon gyi (gyis 〉(118na) tshis par mdzad pa'i mthus/ thugs rje'i bden stobs la brten de'i mod la/ nad yams kun chad cis char chen po phab ste lo 'bras legs pa so gas skal pa nga na pa ca/thapa dag las thar bar mdzad/ sa skyong 'khor bcas phyag (mtshar sga sa du bsu ba la byon te gus 'dus 〈'dud 〉 chu na pos mdun bsus te/ smon grong gzhis khar bzhugs/ nang par smon grong dang / 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gi bar skye bo pho mo rnams kyi rig sgyu mari rol rtse da du ma dang mchod rdzas rol mo dpag tu med pa thogs nas spyan drangs/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa 'khor dang bcas pa yang gtsug lag khang gi sgor phebs pa dang lhan gcig 〈cig 〉'a nga ma par phan tshun mnyam phyag mdzad cing / khyams ra chen mor yon mchad ma mas gdan 'dzom te 〈ste 〉dga' ston gyis 〈kyi 〉mchod pa 3 ba na por rol nas/ jo po rin po che'i dbus rten rnam sa rim sgo sa/na ri jal ba'i tshe/ jo bo'i thugs na nas 'od zer 'phros te rje nyed kyi thug( nar thim pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung /rten rnams la zhal gser dkar me snyan dar na bza' so gas mchod sprin du ma 'bul ba dang / sa skyong chen po 'khor bcas la yid dang mtshams 〈'a ma 〉pa ri zab rgyas cho pa ga kyi bzhed pa ba skong 〈skong 〉bar mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i dru ri du (118ba) //sang sngags kyi dkyi ba 'khor du ma'i 16

dbang dang gdam sa pa mang du gsan/ slar yang khyams ra chen mor — btsun rnam ga nyi༄ she lhan rgyas par mi dbang 'khor bcas/ kyi 〈kyis 〉sku gsung thugs rten phyi nang gi nor rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam thos kyi bu ya nga khengs pa 'phroṭa 〈'phrog 〉nus pa dag 'bul bar mdzad nas/phyag 'dzi da gore bad zhabs skyel dang / chu rag 〈rags 〉la phyag nas gnad ba'i/ byis/ klu'i gzugs dngos kyi 〈kyis 〉me tog blangs par mchogadaman kun gyis mthong / de nas 'bri gung du phebs nas/ skal ldan gyi tshogs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing gser khang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/skabs shig mdun mkhar rdo rje 'chang nas/ phag gru yan gyi bla ma rnams shin tu gsal bar gzigs/ mnyam med sgam po pa'i phyag nas mu tig snyim pa gang gnang ste khyod kyi grwa pa yin gsung ba zhig byung ba ma/ rje 'di'i slob ma rnams rang rgyud yongs su dag pa gzhan don nus pa sha staga'abyung ba lung bstan pa'o/ yang dgun chos kyi dus shig mnal lam du 'bri gung gi thang 'di thams cad mar me'i kong bu sdong bu'i 〈bus 〉 brgyan pa 'ga' zhig la/ gcig sgon pas thams cad sgon pa lta bur gyur ste/ kun 'bar bar gyur pa gzigs/ de ci rje 'di'i thugs rje'i 〈rjes 〉slob ma rnams bde drod kyi yon tan 'byung ba'i rtags su 'dugayang bla nga kha dar rgyas rtser sang phebs rgyus 〈rgyu'i 〉do (11 na)nub ma la lam du/ nge nyed sku chos dri ma med pa zhig bzhes te/ me tog gi ljongs chen po la la shar ba dang / la la 'char la khad mang du gzigs pa ni/ sgrub sde 'di la sgom pa rnams nyams rtogs yin tan gyi tshal chen rgyas pa mngon/ de skabs byang phyogs sgom chung gi skye bo phan tshun 'khrug pa la/ rje 'di'i byams pa'i stobs kyis/ zhi bar mdzad/ de nas yab mes gang ma'i srol ltar gnas gsum gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa ri khrod pa 170

mi nyung ba brdzong ba ga nang / skabs shig mtshe'u kha'i thang la dbyar chos kyi dus/ mgon po 'khor lo lnga ma'i lta khrid skabs chos 'byung lnga'i dmigs/ rim la thug the tshom byung bar/ mi nag po zhig gi 〈 sa 〉'di ltar zhes/ byu 'i dkyis 'khor mi sgrib pa/'i chos 'byung lnga brtsegs kyi bsod pa bstan pa dang / bka' chos skabs dpa' bo dang mkha' 'go la rnams kyis bya rgod kyi gzugs su sprul nas chos nyan pa dang /ba/ser lang du bzhugs skabs/ chu 'phen gyi ri la me mched pa la phyag gi 〈gis 〉sdig mdzub mdzad pas zhi ba dang chu bo 'bab ngos su phyag nas gnang ba pha rol du 'gyur ba sogs 'byung ba bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba dang / gzhan yang ye shes mgon bo gtso 'khor tshang ma lan mang du gzigs/ de'i tshe sgom pa'i khur (114ba) / nyid skyes nga 'i yum rin chen dpal mos mdzad pa la/ skabs der sku nar son pas ma lhogs te/ klung shod rtse ba'i gzhis khar zur bzhugs mdzad pas/ srid skyong sgom pa'i khur ni/ bod chos rgyal gyi gdung las byung ba/ 'bri gung slobadapon pa zhes rim par byung ba/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen gyis (gyi 〉dbon po mgon bo rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa la phog pa mdzad pas/ de nyid sa le shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi sprul pa yin nges las dang skal ba dang ldan pas/ rje 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉zhabs 'bring tshul bzhin du mi 'doraba'i brtson pa drag pos/ bka' bzhin du bgyis te/ gling rin po che'i gtsug lag khang dang / rten mchog rnams kyang zhig bsos 〈gsos 〉kyi bye brag dag/ mtshe'u kha'i pho brang gogs 〈gog 〉pa rnams kyang bso 〈gso 〉bar mdzad de/ 'phags pa rnams kyi rdum ra ltar mdzes par gyur de nasasangs rgyas dkon ca/chog yan lagagi ngo bo zhwa dmar cod ban 'dzin pa bzhi ba chos kyi grags pa de nyid 171

spyan 'dren par dgongs ste/ pho nya'i rtsol bas bskul ba la/ rgyal ba denyid phebs par nye ba na/ rje nyid 'khor dang bcas pa bsu pa re ba ga/ da pa du ma dang bcas rdzan thang du mjal phrad mdzad nas/ rim pas mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi pho brang du phebs nas/ tshur la skyes kyi 'bul ba'i bye (110na)brag du ma dag kyang gnang ste/ gling rin po cher rten mchod rnams la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mkhan slob chos gsum gyis thog drangs dge 'dun 'dus pa dang bcas pa rnams la'ang gnang sbyin mang 'gyed rgya che ba bstsal/ slar mtshe'u khar rje nyid nas rgya ba de'i drung du/ bde mchog lu dril gyi lugs la brte na pa'i bskyed jo 'a/ / kyi gdams pa du ma dang / rgyud sde rin po che bod 'dir 'gyur ro cig mtha' dag kyang gsan nas/ zang zing 'bul ba'i bye brag dpang 〈dpa ngas 〉mtho ba gnang nas/ zhabs skye ba sogs bkur pa rti du ma dang bcas phyir phebs/ mnyam med dbang rin chen chos/ kyi rgya pa po sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa (la )dgongs rdzogs kyibya ba rlabs po che dag kyang myur du grub cing / nang rten du thub dbang gi sku jo tshad bzhengs par 〈pa 〉lha khang chen mor bzhus / de nas spre'u lo la rje ) da sgar chen dang bcas/ nyang phyogs 'a gas pa ra gan ba'i tshe / gad pa mkhar du phebs pa na/ bya bral kyi brtul zhugs dang ldan pa rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can zhig gis/ gsang sngags rnying ma'igadams pa mang ba dang / sku bsrungs 〈srung 〉kyi 〈gi 〉man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa zhig phul te skad cig la mi snang bar gyur pa (130ba)o rgyan gyi sprulha pa/ra mngon/ de'i dus su sang sing sgang la phebs pa'i la / /bar/ 7 grub mtha'i 'ching bas dkris par gyur pa'i blo ngan rnams kyis / mi rig pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po bstan kyang thugs brtse ba chen 173

po'i ngang la sa yol ba mi mnga' yang / bka' bsrungs 〈srung 〉rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ klung shod rtse ba'i gzhis khar yumagashegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa gnang ba'i tshe/ nang gcig gzim 3)1— rngos :)shes /spyo rten —— 3) /spyoma'ab du ra ga pa da sa bskul / da zhal nas spru' pa'i bya rog gsum thon ste/ dus der snying rje 'khrungs pa'i 〈pas 〉bya rob/ gnyis slar zhal du mid par mdzad/ gcig sgo bshad 〈shad 〉skyang〈brkyangs 〉bcas shar phyogs su 'phur song bar dus mtshungs sang sing sgar du rlung dmar chen po langs nas khang pa rnams 'gyel/ dam can chos rgyal gyi sku brub khung du lhung ba sogs ltas mi rung ba du mas der 'khod pa rnams sems khong du chud de drag po'i dpung gi 〈gis 〉rlags 〈rlag 〉par byas so/ mtshe'u khar phebs nas zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi /ri /po / /spyo /gongang la bzhugs pa dus snga thun dang ga la/ bsam yas da ra bsrungs 〈bsrung 〉sngags pa'i cha lugs su byas pa'i mi zhig dang / de'i 'khor srab mo ngur kha'i a rag rgyan pa rab byung gi (111na)cha byad can gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉dkar po kun grags kyi lung bstan dang mthun pa bsam ya par zhig bsos 〈gso 〉grub pa'i rab gnas la phebs dgos zhus par/ da la na dngos kyi 〈kyis 〉mi slebs pas 'di kha nas rgyas 'debs byed ba/sungs nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rab gnas gnang zhing / de gnyi sa sa bstan pa bsrung ba'i bka' bsgo ba mdzad/ lug gi lo la rgya 'a ba'i sa/su nga rab rin po che gangs can thongs 'jir 'gyur ro cog bzheng bar bzhed nas/ yi ge'i rigs 〈rig 〉byed la mkhas pa bzhibargya lhag btus pa la/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang por dbu btsugs te / mthing shog gi ngon ga la gser dngul spel mas bris par/ glegs shing glegs thag na bza' dang bcas pa rnams myur bar grub te 〈ste 〉dus 173

mas dge b.rarab gnas byin chags par mdzad cing / yig rigs 〈rig 〉pa rams la rnam thos kyi bu'i khengs ba 'phrog nus pa'i dga' stonadang yon gyi (gyis 〉tshim par gnang / yang mtshe'u khar mgon khang rnying mar ye shes kyi mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i ma sa gtso 'khor dngo sasu gzigs/ de nas slar yang phyogs stod smad bar gsum gyi dad ldan 'dul 〈gdul 〉byar gyur pa rnams kyis/ rang rang 'byor tshogs 'bul ba dpag tu med pa phul ba rnams chud mi (111ba)za zhing / de dag bsnying po'i mchog len phyir/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyidagongs 'grel bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam rnams bzhengs 〈bzheng 〉bar dgongs ste/ bya'i lo cho 'phrul zla ba la yig rigs 〈rig〉ku du phyin pa mang pos mthing shog gi ngos su gser gyi 〈kyis 〉bri bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ sa chu dros ste rtsi shing lo ma thams cad rgyas pa sogs ltasabazang du ma byung / de nas ring por ma thog 〈thogs 〉par de dag kyang legs par grub cing / gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la rab tu gnasapa'i cho ga mdzad pa'i nyin gtog gi char chen po babs/ yig mkham rnams la zang zing gi dngos po du mas yid kyi shing rta gang ba sa/nang / de nas byi ba'i lo la dbus gtsang 'khrug 〈'khrugs 〉pa'i dbang gi 〈gis 〉'bri bstan la mtho 〈tho 〉mtshams 〈'tshams 〉byung bar/ rje nyida'akhor dang bcas pa dbu ru na tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du phebs pa'i tshe mdun gyi nam mkhar thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stongadang ldan pa 'ja' 'od kyi dbus su bzhus/sa pa gzigs shing / lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas 'bri gung dang gdan sa thel 'brel chags tshul lo rgyus rnags gsungs ba la/ da res dmag dpung gyes bde tsam las gzhan —74

pa'i rtsi bzhab/ ma byung / de nas mtshe'u khar phebs pa'i tshi mi ring b.rasde gdong nga ri dpung chen po btegs ste/ skyid (111na)g.yor 'phan gsum gyi dmag dpon dga' ldan pas byas/ yar klung lho byang 'ol kha ba sogs/ phyogs ma 'a nas dpung gi tshogs chen bo bshams nas mal gro'i mda' bar 'byor pa na/ rje'i 'phrin las kyi gas bo mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis dmag dpon gyis 〈kyi 〉khur bzung ste rang srid dpung dang bcas myur stabs kyis phyin pa na/ pha rol gyis (gyi 〉dmag dpung ni rgyu skar gyis (gyi 〉tshogs lta cis/ dkar ba'i go dang gnags 〈nag 〉pa'i gzhon 〈bzhon 〉pa dang ldan pa/ kha dog ri tshogs pa'i ru dar 1ga ltar du khyug pa/ rnga dang rkang blang bso sgra drag po 'byug ltar sgogs 〈sgog 〉pa/ ma na mdung gri rdo la sogs mtshon cha'i tshogs ser chen 'bab pa ltar/ shin tu rnga /sa shing g.yo la 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang yang rang srid dpung rnams dpa' zhum par ma gyur te/tshan po ches g.yul bsres pa na na 'amang yam mi ro dang rta ros gang ba byung / de nas rang srid rnams dngu ru ma/ cha la du lhag 〈lhags 〉te/gung mkhar sna gdong bas bzung ba khag snying sto bas chen pos g.yul sprad pas tshegs med par tshur lon/ de 'phral ba/ga' ldan pa'i dpung rnams na tshal gyi phyogs mtshams 'khor mor 'dug pa yang g.yul bsres so/sa'i sa phyogs thams cad phyis mi rabs gsum bar srin yul (113ba)ltar rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur cing / de'i tshe dpung thog mar byu ba nye ba na/ rje 'di'i gze sa snang du a phyi chos kyi sgol ma/ yulamanga' bdag rgyal mo'i tshul sprul nas/ 'jigs pa med pa'i gsung gi〈gis 〉dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa zhig byung / de dang du sa mtshungasarje nyid bker bsrungs 〈srung 〉la rbad bskul gnang ba'i tshe/ gzim 175

chung 'phyong rtse'i dkar gsal nas/ sa phyi cho ཿ ri kyi sgo ra ma bya rgod skya snro/rdo pa/ so/zi / / / /ba ga drapa'i tu phri / darngob shā/ |/ zi /rdo/ pyo bas rdo bltar rang srid kyi dpung gis pha rol dmag gi sde tshogs ma lus pa pham pa ra byas shing / de yang / dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan rin po che'i lung bstan zin pa ma/ zhang tshan 'khrug pa'i 〈pas 〉dbus gtsang sil bur gtong / /mi mthun sde la gnod pa sna tshogs byung 〈'byung 〉/ /snang mdzad mi g.yo rab tu brtan par gnas/ /de ci 'bri gung spya4 da snga bcu/snashā / /yos/ /sa lo sa/ tho/ spya / /rdo /// / /zhwa /maXs chos gu bye /ga spru pa mjal bar/ bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa chen por phebs pas/lam klung shod brgyud stag lung nas chos rje khu dbon gyi 〈kyis 〉bsnyen bkur (134na)'bul ba rgyas par mdzad nas shul lam ma thog 〈thoṭa 〉par phebs pa'i tshe/ dbon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis thog drangs/ bla ma dge bshes du ma dang / 'phyong rgyas stag rtse ba'i nang sog/shā // /rdo /rdo rdo sna pa bye bye sna / dro rngo/ bye sdu sdongad bye rdo /rdo / rdordo'i 'a ja ( zlophra / pa/ dro (sdo rdoca/sa gnas 'i/ drung du rdo la ba ba de/nga dru/nga rnadu gsang sngags kyi dbang rjes gnang du ma gsan/ tshur la yang 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya che ba gnang / de nas bra rongs 〈rong 〉gi yul du spyan drangs pa ltar phebs/ sde so so nas rang rang gi 'byor dngos ji snyed pa phul/ rim gyis 'bri gung du phebs/ skabs shig sku grib kyis rkyen pa'i gnyan 'brum gyi rnam par bsnyel 〈snyung 〉ba'i tshul bstan te/176

drung du 'khod pa rnam sa ci bya gtol med par gyur pa'i tshe/ gung thun zhig la sku zur g.yas la 'khor lo sdom pa byis pa lo bdun gyi tshod tsam dang / ba/yo zhe/ du kud med gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldam pa zhig yi dam gyi cha lugs su bzhugs ba/ de dag gis dbang gzhi 〈bzhi 〉rdzogs par phul ba'i tshul thugs nyams byung ba dang sku khams de ma thag dwangs/ de nas (114ba)bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog ba/zhan las khyad du 'phags pa/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i khyad chos su gyur pa bkra shis sgo mang ratna tsarya'i mchod sdong ched po zhig bzheng bar dgongs/ sprul pa'i bzo bo bi sha garma la 'gran par nusapa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan bya ba bya yul du gnas pa la/ 'gug mi btang bal cung zad 'gor bar gyur pa na/ rje'i mnal lam du/ phyis ji ltar mjal ba dang mtshungs par/ bzo bo nyid drung du lhag 〈lhags 〉te/ngag cha zhu ba 〈bar 〉da ste bdag 'khor bcas zhag bdun gyi nang khongs su zhabs drung du sleb par bgyi'o/ zhes zhus pa zhig byung ba dang mtshungasapar zhag yas nas 'byor pa'i tshe/ zhal nas lha bzo 'di sngon gyi smon lam dang rjes su mthun par rang re'i dgos pa sgrub pa sar gnas kyi byang chub sem sa dpa' zhig yin gsungs/ rje nyid bzo pa bcas zel du phebs te/ sngon gyi sgo mang rnams la 〈las 〉ches lhag cing bang rim gcis/ gis mtho ba'i thig tshad lem/ pa gnang ba'i nyin/ me tog gi char bang daja' gur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / lcags sbrul zla ba sa/sum/ par lha khang chen mor bzo thabs 〈thab 〉btsugs shing / bzo rig nga rnam/sa kha/ ba /'a bsgo bsrung 〈srung 〉'khor dang / chos bsrungs〈srung 〉rnams la ba/nyer gtad mdzad/ de (114na)dag gi skabasasu me tog gi char chen po babs pas/ skye dgu kun dad par gyur cing /—77

rang gzhanagyi bla ma mi dpon mchog dman mtha' dag dang grwa slob yo na bdag thams cad kyi legs skyes dga' ston 'bul ba 6na mi chad pas/——/ mchog 'di nyid bzhengs 〈bzheng 〉pa'i 〈ba'i 〉cha rkyen tham cad dbyar mtsho ltar gang bar gyur/ de'i skabs shig 'ol kha stag rtse — 'i rdzong dpon dpung bcas 'bri gung chos srid la mtho 〈tho 〉mtshams 〈'tshams〉par chas nas/ 'bri gung bal mthong sar sgar 'debs pa'i bsam pa skyes nas nye bar slobs pa na srid skyong mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis dbus rang srid dpung dang bcas chas te/ rgyab dpung la mkhar rtse ba'i dmagami klung shod phu nas mar bsgril ba la/ tshur 'geb byung dogs mel ma 'grim 〈sgrim 〉par btson 〈brtson 〉pa la/ nyang po gzhi nang nas yin zer ba'i pho nya ba gnyis stab stab 〈rtab rtab 〉por byung nas/ kong po nas nged rang gi dpung ltos che ba nyang po stod phyogs nas 'grim yong gi yod pas/ 'di phyogs kyi dmag dpung rnams 'ol kha ba'i sgar la gtodabyon zer nas mi snang bar gyur pa ni rang re'i bka' bsrung 〈srung 〉rnams kyi sprul pa yin 'dug de nas dpung bstegs phyin pas/ pha rol gyi dmag rnams kyi mthong snang du dpung shi na tu che ba (114ba)ban dmag gi 〈gis 〉sna drangs te mig gi 〈gis 〉lta mi phod pa tsam du mthong nas/ ha cang bla 'dar ci bya gtol med ra gyur cing / de sathag rab srid rnams kyis 'ol kha ba'i mi nor thams cad shi gsad 〈bsad 〉med par lag tu byung / mi dpon dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig mi ste 〈gta' la 〉khrid/ gtam dang nom pa chen po byung / rje'i zhal nas/ ma phyi chos kyi sgo 'a/ mas sna drangs/ dmar po dgra zor gyis mdunabardar 〈bdar/〉 ye shes mas/na pos rgyab brten byas brdzangs pa yin/dmag thog tu song ba de tsam la ngo so mi dgos zhes ku re'i tshul du rngo

gsungs/ de skabs ba rol gyis (gyi 〉dpung rnams kyis/ mi dbang mgon rgyal 3da mi nag po lag bzhi yod pa 〈par 〉mthong ba dang /dmag khrod gas byis pa lo gsar bya bas/ ma phyi chibs zhon dmag sna labyon pa dngos su mthong / de'i ma rje'i thugs nyams su 'o de gung rgyal mi dmar gyi cha lugs su byas nas/ rje'i drung lug khyu mang po zhig phul byung ba dang mtshungs pa/ pha rol gyi dpung rnams pham te 〈ste 〉rang re'i 'phrin las mngon du gyur pa'o/ yang skabs zhig 〈shig 〉sde pa mgon rgyal gyi 〈kyis 〉gtso byas dpung rnams/ 'phan yul mkhar rtse ba'i grogs la byon/ zhag 'ga' song ba'i skabs shig rje nyid byed thun la bzhug sa (115na)pa'i tshe/ ma phyi chos kyi sgrol ma zhal ras gnag pa'i gsung gis/ rang gi bstan byus la 'gro 'ong yod dus mi gtong bar srid bus gzhog gshol bar 'dug ces gsungs pa ni/ de dus dbus gtsang gi chings chen grub pas/ dmag dpung gyes dgos pa byung ngo / de nas dgung lo lnga bcu mar/ o rgyan rigabo che'i sgrub gnas gter sgom brag dkar gyi tshogs khang chen mor phebs te gzhan phan gyi sgrub pa snying por bzhed pa'i tshe/ gu ru rin po che'i sku las 'od lnga 'phro ba/ phyag gnyis lcags myu dang zhags pa bsnams pa zhig gis sku tshe'i tshad dang mthun pa'i rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhig nyid la gnang ba dang / gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i tshe 'od kyi gur khang nang gu ru yab yum bzhugs pa sogs gzigs/ de nas phyir lam chab tshan gnang ba'i tshe/khrus kyi rdzing bu de nyid gur gum gyi mdog su 〈tu〉'askyar ba/ dri bzang gis phyogs kun khyab pa la/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'di ltar mkha' 'gro'i man gyi mchod pa bla na med ba'o/ zhes gsungs/ de nas mtshe'u khar phebs pa na/ bzo rig pa dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ zla

dang / gsol ja ba gzungasadar zhes pa rnams/ nad drag po ri bzin 〈zin 〉nas skrun ring du song ba la/ byin rlabs gnang ba / (135 ba)phral 〈'phral 〉du zhi bar gyur/ thugs dam gyi rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa yang / bzo rig pa rnams la nyer 'tshe med cir / zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus bzang la ston chen dang gnang sbyin rgya chen po bstsal ste/ bzo rig pa rnams kyis kyang dus kun yengs bam dang khengs pa'i sla chos spangs ste/ brtson pa drag pos bzo 'bras khya na thang/sa/ cad bral zhing / ra tsarya'i mchod sdong chen po phyi gzhal yas /ba ra ge khyad par/bang rim drug ba/ ngos ring ngos byung dang / zur ring zur thung / bar /bar du 'degs byed kyi sa ba dang / ze tsug rin po che'i phra rgyam du cha sa spras/ shing / bla rgyud grub pa'i rnal 'byor du ma dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs ma tshang med pa/ bka' bsrungs 〈srung 〉dam can rgya ma tsho bcas lha sum stong dang nyis brgya lhag pa sku brnyan mtha' dag lugs su blug pa dang / gdung rten chen mo nyi zla bya ru rin chen 'bar ba'i dbus su chos rje bla ma'i dngul sku khri rgyab dang bcas ba grub pa'i tshe/ nang bzhugs kyi khyad par sa/ sangs rgyas byang sem nyan rang bla ma yi dam chos srungs 〈srung 〉rang rang gi mtshan sngags sang bo grangs las 'das nga dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang / grub chen te par pa'i phyag mdzub sogs/ 'phags yul dang bod kyi skyes chen du ma'i gdung rus/ dbu spya na bza' (11can)sogs byin rlabs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / shing bya khrums zlar yongs su grub pa la rje nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad cing / snam sbyar gyi bsgo 〈bgo 〉ba dang ldan pa dge 'dun bcu phrag lngas rgyud sde chem/ po'i ko na rab tu gnasab tsha ga gzhung dang mthun pa mdzad cing / de dag la ga

rab ston dang / bzo rig pa rnams la rnam thos kyi bu'i longs spyod la'agran par nus pa'i zang zing gi nor dzas la dbul ba'i ma da dang bral ba'i chog shes par gyur te/ rang gzhan gyi skye dgu rnams kyis gru bzhas 4〈gzhas 〉bro shon rtsed 'jo'i rnam 'gyur ji snyed yid 'phrog par bstan cing / rol mo'i bye brag du ma sgrags 〈bsgrags 〉te de'i tshe nam mas/ 'a 'ja' 'od kyi gur me tog gi char la sogs dge mtshan du ma byu da / de ltar dgongs bzhed rnams grub pa dang / sngar ri bo dga' ldan pa dang /'bri gung pa lugs gnyis ga nas 'brel zab yin rung / srid skyong mgom po rgyal mtshan pasa'aphan yul gyi sa ris rnams bdag tu mdzad pas mkhas grub smon lam dpal ba'i thugs la ma man nas/ dga' ldan pa'i ser dmag byung ba dang / 'bri phag nang khul du re khang 〈'khang 〉byung /rang srid gros dbang sku 'khor ba rnams kyis 'khrug long gi rgyu mang du blang ba 〈bslangs pa 〉(115ba)mnga' zhabs (na )yod pa'i dge ———dgon rnams zhwa stabs bsgyur ba sogs la thugs chad te 〈de 〉zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad cing / dbyar chos dang dgun cho ri skabs/ chos thams cad thog par gsungs ste/ chos sras kyi gtso bor gyur pa rgyal dbang ratna/ mkhan slob chos gsum bu slob rnams 'a ma / ngag gi snying po ches che ba rnams gdams shing gnyer gtad pa mdzad cing / mi rtag pa dang nges 'byung gi 〈gis 〉bskul ba'i 〈bas/〉 bstan pa mchog gi snying po sgrub pa lhur len dgos pa'i bka' nan che ba gnang bas/ der 'dus rnams 'jig rten 'di snang gi bya bzhag la blo sna thung ste/ mos gus rtsol med du skyes nas mchi ma 'khrug par gyur/ de nas chab tshan la phebs pa'i tshe/ sku la bsnyung 〈snyung 〉gzugs 〈zug 〉gi rnam ba med kyang sku shed chung zhing gsol dwangs cung zad 'grib pa'i tshul 181

bas / chab tshan gnang ba'i bar laspyan na mkha' la garigs nang zhal 'dzum pa'i ngang nas/ saṇi'i tsu brdungs〈rdung〉dang mgur kyi rnam pa lhang lhang gsungs pa'i tshe / drung du 'khod pa rnams kyang rtsolamed du mos gus skye ba byung / do na ma chu khar phebs/ der sa la bsnyung 〈byung 〉zug garnam ba gtan nas ma mchis na'ang / gas 4dwangs 'grib pa'i 〈pas 〉sku shed shigatu zung bar gyur (11 na/po /dgu gtor la mgon khang rnying mar phebs nas/ nang nub thugs dam sgrigs chags kyi rim pa la'ang ci khams kyi 〈kyisas 〉ma 〈mi 〉rtsogs bzhin du nus thon par gnang sa tsugasar ba'i tshul ma mchis/ de dus sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan la bka' lung zhib rgyas mang po zhi gnang ba'i rjes su/ tsan dan lasagrub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'di myur bar e grub snyam yang 'gyangs pa zhig byung ba 'di ci 'grub byas 'phral/ gser khang gi thog 'di stod pa dang chos cha rin po che'i sku brnyan 'di la pad gad na zhig 'bul ba dang / bdag gis bzhengs pa'i rten mchog gang 'dug kyang der bsgril ba dang / khyad par gser gdugs gser thog 'di rnams 'phro can du ma lus ba ci kyang gyis zhes bka' chems mang po bsru ba te/ dgung lo/ lnga bcu nga gsum bzhes pa me mo phag gi lo hor zla dgu pa'i tshes drug gi snga dro'i cha la thugs dgongs zhi ba chen po'i chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs par gyur ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur khyim phyogs mtshams bkram pa/ sa gdung rin po cher lus med rnams kyis phyag dang bskor ba gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgra dang / ri bong gi gzugs kyis phyag 'tshal ba sogs kun gyi 〈kyis 〉mthong ba dang thos pa (11 ba)byung / slob ma mchog tu gyuras mas kyis nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi dbus su dpa' bo mkha' 'tho ma mtha

/ sha 11 rten ——rta) sgo mdzurnas da das gas da ga gas pa da sa su mjal/rang gzhan gyi dge 'dun gyis (gyi 〉tshogs grangs las 'das pa rnams kyis rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgo nas dkyil chag la brten pa'i mchod 'bul mdzad par/ bsnyen bkur yon 'bul rgya che zhing dpang 〈dpangs 〉mtho ba dang / thang ston skye bo tshogs la 'gyed chen dang / ris su ma chad pa'i da na sde che chung rnams la mang 'gyed/ gangs ri ) ser gser 'bum gzhangs pa/ gnas chen rnams su mchod 'bul sogs dgongs rjogs kyi rim pa brjod las 'das par grub/ sku gsang rin po che lo gcig bar ma 'u kha'i gzim khang nyid du mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus su rin chen gsum pa'i za ma tog gi nang du bzhugs/ bka' chems ltar mdzad bcu/ ga ra thog gser gdugs sogs pa lus pa dang / gzim mal man sku dar sku bcas kyang myur ba nyid du grub/ khyad par sku gdung rin bo che nyid bzhugs pa'i yul dngul las grub pa byang chub mchod rtenalha mi'i rin po che du mas phra rgyan mtshar 〈tshar 〉du mngar 〈dngar 〉ba dag bzhengs nas/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu ril por bzhugs su gsol nas/ thog (118na)kha gser khang du bzhugs/ chab ser las 'phel ba'i ring bsrel dang / dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs bsamagyis mi khyab pa byon sgo/ de ltar rje 'di 'bri bstan rin po cher bka' drin zla ma mchis pa yin la/ rnam thar rgyas pa le tshan 'ga' zhig logs su yod/ de yang mkhan chen gu ra ba man/ rje 'a di ya na la bu slob rnams gyi rnam thar ma mthong bas ji snyed byung ba rnams lo rgyus 'bri bar ma slob 〈sgobs/〉rje 'di man la 'ga' zhig sa dpyad tsam re brjod par// zhi/nga ra/pa rdo / mi rdo/ / pa/ na mdzo shā rmi pa/ / rjo nga/ sa

gzim khang dmar po'i 'du khang yang bzhengs/ sbub pa 'i rgya / mtshan 'dzan pa 'i chos 'chad sems khrid kyi slob dpon mi na la/ spangs kyi phugs lung gi ri khrod 'debs pa sogs bstan pa'i zhabs tog rlabs po che mdzad/ mtshan 'bri gung mas chen pa'am/ gzim khang pa zhes gras/sa la 'di nyid la rnam thar rgyas pa sngar dus yod 'dug kyang / da lta thor bar gyur pas zhib cha ma mchis/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen ni/ rigs rus mngon mtho bod chos rgyal gyi rgyud las (118ba)'khrungs shing / rje nyid kyi drung du rab tu byung / 'bri gung gi chos mdzod spyi dang dge bshes du ma las thos bsam rgyas cing 〈shing 〉gling rin po che'i mgon khang gi bstan bsrungs 〈srung 〉chos kyi sgol ma'i sku chibs zhon ma 'di nyid bzhengs pa dang / gzhan yang rten gsum mang du bzhengs/gling smad slob dpon gyis 〈kyi 〉khur bzung / gzim khang nub kyi bla brang btab pas/ de nas nub par grags pa 'di byung / sngar rje nyer brgyad rin po che'i sku dus/ slob dpon mtshams chen pa grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes pa nas 'bri gung 'dir rnying ma'i ring lugs cung zad dar ba'i tshe/ mtshe'u khar sos gtor la mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gton bzlogadang / phur pa'i rtsa 'a mas 〈'cham 〉sogs gling smad slob dpon pas mdzad pa'i rgyun byung la/ rje ratna'i skabs bstan pa gnyis ldan ches cheragasal bar gyur pa la/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs pa 'dis gling smad du sos gtor dang / bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉bcas phyag rgyun mdzad pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad paragrags so/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgya mtsho ba ni gzhu'i sgru sgang gi dgon gnas btab pa dang / gzim khasadamar por dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhes pa sgogs 'phrin las kyang shin tu che/ ga na/ ya 1

(11 na)ba chen rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rab 'byams pa blo gros rgya mtsho/khra ba kha'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho soṭa rim gnyis mthar son yon tanadu ma dang ldan pa'i slob ma'i tshogs mang du mchis kyang lo rgyus brjod pa ma spob 〈spobs/〉 chos sgo ba sa/ sngar rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i bu slob du 〈tu 〉brjod pa ltar bla ma rim par byung zhing / rje kun dga' rin chen gyi sngon tsam du/ chos sgo bla brang btab 'dug cing / rten gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'phrin las kyang shin tu che ba byung 'dug bar/ phyis zhig 〈shig 〉bla ma rnams nang ma dan pa dang / lhag par nub slob dpon pa rim can dang ma 'cham par brten/ bla brang shig te 〈ste 〉rten gsum rnams gdan sa yas mas su bkram/ bla ma rnams phyir khyar nas stongs par grags so/bad ma na ra'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /gzhan phan chos sgo 'dabs 〈'dab 〉brgya rnam grol nas/ /dam chos zang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa/ /gnam lcags me 'bar zhabs la lan brgyar 'dud//gdan sa bcu drug pa rgyal ba'i dbang po rin chen kun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po ni/ de yang 'phags yul du bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ chos rgyal dharma sa sho na/ rig 'dzin rdu na (11 ba)ra la sogs pa dang /bod 'der lha sras mu tig btsan po khu ston pa sogs rgya bod kun tu chosargyal paṇa grub du ra/ra sku'i skye ba bzhes shing / khyad par 'bri gung 'dirarje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i spyan sngar shes rab 'byung gnas/ de rjes gling gsar chags la bka' drin che ba gcung gnyis pa rin po che/ rje kunadaga' rin chen gyi gcen po sgom pa rin chen rnam rgyal sogs dang /mar — dbyi // da' sna 'aspyo ngapya rig/'a// ( sa da tshos pa /sa

ratna'i ming can 'byung / /zhes dang / skye ba mang dpyad 〈spyad 〉dusakyi tha ma la/ /'bri zhes byang phyoṭa kha ba'i klong meb 〈gseb 〉tu/ /sa rgoda'agro 'dul byang chub sems ldan pa/ /thuṭa rje chen pos byin gyis brlabasapa'i bu/ /zhes pa la sogs lung mang ku bstan pa ltar/ 'khrungs pa'i yul ni gzhu'i sa cha las sku gnyer sgang zhes par/ yab rje kun dga'i gcung po chos kyi rgyal po ba na pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / yum ni bsod nams sgrol ma zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su sa mo sgrul gyi lo la sku balhams/de'i tshe yu gyi ma la lam du mi dkar mo zhig gis me tog gsum khyen — nas 'di khyod kyis legs pha skyed cig ste ba dang / (130na)yang bde ba can gyi zhing khams sa phebs pas/ pad sdong chen po sa tsam snang ba gzigs pa dang / ba ma pa'i ma dbu zhabs ma log cing yum la gnod pa ma mchis par sa pa dang / tshangs khur gzim skabs rang gzhan kyis 〈rmi 〉bya ba rnams khyim su nges pas gsal bar gsungs pa dang / thog mkhan gyis gsung ra sgrogs 〈sgog 〉pa dang / gzhan rmis kha ston 〈'don 〉byed pa dag la re gsan pas kyang tshig mang po byug nas thon pa sogs ngo ma ra ba ma 'a yas cing 〈shing /〉 de nas dgu lo lnga lon pa na/ srid skyong mgon po rgyal mtshan pas rje nyid rngos je rngos rgyal ba'i mas yin min gyi mtsham la/ zhwa lha khang du sa 'a sa ga 〈bgags 〉te/ re zhig phyoṭa gzhan du phebs dgos shar bar/ sku 'khor nyung bsdus dang bcas yar klung phyogs su phebs pa'i lam du dur khrod bdag po'i ba ma byas par gzigs/ yar 'on rnams su phebs pa'i tshe/ma gdos nas nod ma rngos kyi rgyal pos kyang bkur bste 〈ste 〉zhabs stog / ju (1 pa shā //ga /shā rta/ ga ma pa /pa // rlo sa pa/ / /shā mo

grogari / byed par 'bral med lta bur gyur/ de nas dkar po kun grags pa'i 〈pas 〉khra 'brug zhig bsos 〈gsos 〉kyi rab ston gral (130ba)dbur spyan drangs pa'i ma/ me tog gi char babs/ rgyal po pe har gyi 〈gyes〉phri na las sgrub par khas zangs/ de nas bkra shis do bo kha zhes pa'i dpal sna lo'i gnas sheg tu tsub brgyud rin po che 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉zab mo'i chos rnams rje 'jig rte na gsum ma na nas spyan snga gragasa'abyung dang snubs ston so sa nas ga dan sa thel gyi spyan snga 'ga' zhig dang / chos je nyer gnyis pa nas man sgom 'od zer seng ge sogs brgyud dam mag gtsang zhing brgyud par sel ma zhugs pa'i chos rnams mnga' ba/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i thugs sprul/ mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis kyi drung du byon te/ de nyid las dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu'i lugs lhan skyes lha lnga dang ye shes mgon po/ gzhan yang bka'abargyud 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉zab khrid dbang mang du gsan/ mgon po daramar bas 〈ba'i 〉dbang gi dus mkham chen pa nyid la spyan gsum mnga' ba ga gas shing / gdan sa bal pa'i ri pa rnams la chos 'brel gnang ba'i ma/ me tog gi char babs/ de nas dgung lo brgyad lon pa'i tshe gdanas thel du zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas mkhan po dang / las slobadus sgo sogs kha bskong grangs tshang gi dbus su/ bar ma rab byung sa sgrub pa'i (131na)mtshan rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal por gsol/de nar ga dbus gtsang gi dus zing chen po langs par gyur pa'i tshe gdong gong mas bskul rte bka' bsrung 〈srung 〉rnams kyi bskar gso sa/nang ba'i tshe/ bya rog chen po zhig gis thang rkyal chen po zhig gi nang /khrag dang sa sna'i rigs kyi 〈kyis 〉gang ba zhig sku mdun du bzhag pa zhig byung bar/ nag phyogs pa rnams pham par gyur/ de nas 'phyong rgyas su 187

ji zhwa dmar bzhi pa dang lhan cig phebs te/ de nyid las/ gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum la sogs gsang sngags kyi chos skor du ma dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen sogs dbang rjes gnang mang po gsan/yar 'on/ 'phyong rgyas/ sde'u gdong rtse rnams su lo bzhi'i bar bzhugs/de nas 'bri gung du yud tsam phebs nas/ spun drug rdzong / yar bon/bkra shis do kha/ gser la sogs brgyud/ stod lung bde che na dang yangs pa can du phebs/ mtshungs med snyarma kerte'i drung du/ dpal dusakyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim rnams gsan pa'i tshe/ du ba la sogs rtag 〈rtags〉bcu mngon du gyur cing / phyag mtshan ma rdzogs pa'i dus 'khoranus ma brgyad bcas gzigs/ khyad par sprim/ med nam mkha' lta bu'i rtag 〈rtags 〉che na nyin mtshan (131ba)'khor yug 'da' ba'i skabs su/ kor ra ma rgyan gling chen du gu ru'i sgrub gnas mjal bar phebs —pa'i tshe/ snang ba rang sems gtan la phebs shing / de'ang yongs su dag pa nam mkha' dri bral lta bu'i thugs nyams shar te bzhengs pas/mug pa'i steng du zhabs ting nub pa'i rjes kyang byung / yang dus shig mnal lam du gu ru'i paṇa zhwa zhig nyid kyi 〈kyis 〉bzhes pa'i snang ba la brten/ skyes rabs gong ma 'ga' zhig gi lung bstan du ma dang / dgung lo bcu gsum par 'phag ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen bsgrub /〈sgrub 〉gnang ba'i tshe yid bzhin sar mchog gi gdams pa rnams byung / de ltar lo bdun gyi bar yangs can nyid du bzhugs nas/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i pa dang / yongs 'dzin du ma bstan 〈bsten 〉cing / gsang sngagasakyi dbang rjes gnang du ma dang / narma pa zhwa dmar nag na rim gyi bka' /'i/cho /) 'bum/ gzhan yang gdams pa sa/ mang du gsan/ gsar nga rgyud sde'i bskyed rdzo gas dkyil chag dbang las rab 'byams sogs rdo rje slob 188
