dpon gyi bya ba dang / sgra tā la pa dang dus 'khor gyi rtsis sogs 'jig rtenalugs kyi bstan bcos ji snyed la brda' 〈brda 〉bstan pa tsam gyi 〈kyis 〉zugs su chud/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug pa spre'u lor 'bri gung du phebs nas/ mtshungs med rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' rin chen gyi (133na)drung du mos gus srog 'khor dbang khrid zhal gdams bcas pa dang / phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ dgun chos skabs zab lam dra ro chos drug gi khrid gsan cing ras phud mdzad pas/ sgrub rgyud rin bo che'i lama'adir nges shes nyams myong gi gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa'i donamangon du /ci 1—— /ri /sa /lha /phyo / gyur nga / kun dag ma na zhal snga nas bu da bstan pa bdag po gyis zhes chos thams cad kyi bka' gtad kyang mdzad/ dus zing snga phyir byung ba'i tshe/ bstan bsrung 〈srung 〉ma'i phrin las sgrub par gzigs/ dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa phag gi lor/ rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gzugs sku'i snang brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshulabastan pa'i tshe zhag bcu'i bar 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga zhig rje nyid kyi thugs kur zug cing / mthar thugs kur thim pa'i thugs dam la bstan 〈brtan 〉pa thob/ de nas dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rnams grub pa mdzad cing / khyad par dngul gdung bzhengs 〈bzheng 〉phyir/ rje nyid bu slob dang bcas rngod rgyal shod sogs khams stod rnams su byon/'bul ba'i bye brag kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de nas dngul gdungadang bkari dgongs rdzogs rnams myur bar grub/ dgung lo nyi shu pa sa byilo la chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen grags pa rgyal (131ba)mtshan dang / slob dpon bsod nams dpal bzang / gsang ston grub chen tshe'aphe pa bzang po so/ sa kha bskong grangs tshang gis 〈gi 〉dbus su bsnyen par rdzobs/ pa 'i sdo ma pa ba6/sa/ mkhan chen de nyid la ga kya ra zab cho ri kha 189

shas gsan/ khang gsar yang dathon gyi sa bye dkor mdzod du/ de nyisakyi bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉gnang ba'i tshe mtshan ltas ngo ma tsha ra ba byung /yang skabs shig gter sgom du sgrub pa zhig gi skabs/ mnal lam du rje kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid gu ru'i sku chas mdzad nas 'khor 'ga' zhig dang bcas nam mkhar byon nas/ tshigs su bcad pa'i lung bstan du ma gnang ba zhig byung / lo der gdan sa chen mor chos srid seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol/ gangs ri ti se/ la phyi/ tsā ri tra sogs gnasagasum gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa ri khrod pa brje len brko 〈bsko 〉bzhag dbyar chos dgun chos sogs sngar gyi mdzad srol ma stongs pa je rgyas dang / rje kun dga' rin chen gyi skabs/ 'bri bstan rin po che sor chud kyang /rje 'dis slar yang rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i thugs dam thun mong ma yin pa bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i dkyil chog mdzad pa dar / dam pha'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i gsung par bzhengs te rgya cher spel ba (133na)sogs 'bri bstan la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad/sa 'u khar/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ stobs ldan nag po sogs yi dam chos srungs 〈srung 〉rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub gnang bas gzhung dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan du mabyur / khyad par rgya ston dbon po rig 'dzin gsang ba las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor ji snyed pa gsan cing / bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉mdzad pa'i ma rtaṭa mtshan gzhung dang mthun pa mngon du gyur ste/zhal dngos su lan grangs mang bar gzigs te 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i snying po'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad te 〈de 〉'bri gung 'dir /bye/ /pa gshes / spya /shā pa pa ༷/ /bye zlo dri sa/ /rdo pa // bye /sas sna190

kyi lung bstan bslab bya mang du gnang ba zhig byung /chu pho 'brug gi lor/rgya nag nas gong ma g.yung lo chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po/ cing za rin chen rgya ra tshan dang / ci thi rin chen bzang po 'khor du ma mngags te/rgya nor dngos po dpag tu med pa dang bcas chen kya'u wam gyi lung las phul/ bstan srid la log par 'khu ba'i mi bsrun pa'i tshogs la/ kengasang dmar nag gi las sbyor gyi 〈rgyas 〉mngon rtag 〈rtags 〉phyung (133ba)ste tshar bcad/ grub chen dzā ha bar kyi dngos slob/ gu rubadzra na tha las/ rlung khrid kyi gdam/sa pa gsan te nyams su bzhes pa'i tshe/ sku lus lhar bsgyur ba dang / mdun mkhar rnam bzhi'i mgron gyitshogs gzigs pa dang / 'gro drug gi bya spyod dang sems rgyud gsal bar mkhyen pa sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / de yang gu ru rin po ches lhasras la/ nga yi gdams pa 'dod chags rang grol la: gces par dgos pa'i rlung zas lag len : lha sras skye ba brgyud de chos 'di dang :phrad〈'phrad 〉tshe nga dang mi gnyis dzo wa ri:rgya gar yul 'byung grub pa'i riga'adzin brnyesaX zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar drung khrid nyams len 'di phyis dgongs pa yang zab kyi tshe sgrub kyi cha lag tu sgril ba mdzad/ de'i tshe rje nyid lung bstan dang mthun pa dbu lo ma bsil bar bzhag na sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gong 'a la du yongs 〈yong 〉rgyu la/ gzhan snang dang bstun dbu lo lan kha yar ba la bar brten/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams mkhon pa'i gzigs rnam mar ba dang / khyad par sku ma'i 'du byed gtong bar nye ba'i sku kham shin tu bsnyel 〈snang 〉ba la/ man lam du o rgyan rin dza che ma ma'i cha lugs su bstan nas khyed kyi sku ma'i rten 'brel sgrigs 〈 ga 〉bar 'dod na/ rgyal ba'i bka' (134na)gsung sgrogs 〈sgrog〉 ga mo dmar nag la tshogs brgya dang //

srungs 〈srung 〉ma'i thugs dam bskong 〈skongs 〉la/ gter sgom tshogasakhang gi mkha' 'gro gsang ba mchog grub gi 〈kyi 〉phug pa'i sgo bye nas/der tshe grub zla ba gcig mdzad na/ bar chad la sa rgyal bar gyur ces pa'i lung bstan pa na/ de bzhin sgrub te 〈ste 〉tshogs khang gi yangs 〈yang 〉rtser tshe sgrub gnang ba'i 〈bas 〉 zhag bdun song ba'i nub mo o rgyan rin po che'i sprul pa'i sngags chung zhig gi rkyen la brten/ 'od sdudhi bye pardong ma /ba ma dang /la rdogā// spya sa spya/ / bye / / ju / sa kyi 〈kyis 〉gang ba'i dbus su/ 'ja' tshon las grub pa'i zhal yas khang gi dbus su/ rig 'dzin chen po zer ba'i sngags chas can gyi dbu skra'i rtse mor mi 'khrug pa/ rked par rta mgrin/ rtsa bar phag mo dmar nag bcas nyag ma re re la yod pa zhig bstan nas/ sngags chung gi 〈gis 〉dbu skra'i rten 'brel 'di ltar yod pa yin zhes lo rgyus mang du gsungs nas thams cad 'ja' ltar yal bar gyur/ de nas glang ma lung du sgo ga rakṣa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phyag rgya thob pa sogs drod rtags mngon du gyur/ de nas bal du phebs nas snga gong 'i/ga na/rje (144ba)kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid sngags chas kyi rnam pa can zhig byon nas/ tshigs su bcad pa'i lung bstan dang bcas khri thog gi 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba dor la bya bral tshul gyis 'gro don bgyis na bstan par phan par gyur 〈'gyur/〉 zhes lung bstan ltar/ rje rin chen rnam shā sa snar deb nyisag shā da /bye cho/ sa kyi /sna /rdo /rdo bye bye dbye / //nga mcho sa rnams gnang nas gdan sa'i gnyer gtad pa mdza / nas/ gzhu smad spro lung du sngar yab kyi pho brang gsar du btab pa der bzhugs / de mi

skabs dgung lo nyer drug bzhes shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan bdage 'dun gyi sde la ras/sa 〈ra / 〉las/ pa ci phyir/ mnyam med 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa la ga dam par thub bstan cho chi grwa chen po yangs ri sgar gyi spyogs 〈spyog 〉gra 'dus sde dus der 'jug 〈'dzugs/ 〉pa mdzad/ bde mgon gyi las rim gzhung sogs la gdangs dbyaras — dzad shing 〈cing 〉gad dbyangs kyi rnam bzhag sogs dar zhing / mi re bar sgar pa dang bcas rgyal shod/ a pa rngod gangs shod rnams su phebs nas/ der gnas pa kun gyi 〈gyes 〉rang rang gi 'byor gyi gas kyi dngos po dpag tu med pas mchod cing / gang la gang 'dul chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par gnang / zla dgon du phebs te (135na)lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas dngo/na gnas 1la sa pa bsos 〈gsos 〉shing sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyi ga 〈kyi 〉ring lugs dar bar mdzad/ de skabs gu ru padma sam bha dang rā snu la sogs zha da gzigs/ rgya ston du sbya ga 'dren byung ba bzhin phebs/ rgya sto na chos rjes thog drangs der 'dus grwa slob mi sde rnams nas zang zing gi 'bul ba grangs lag 'das pa lta bu phul/ so sor gsar rnying gi chos du mas skal ldan rnams smin grol la bkod nas 'bri gung du phebs/ thel gyi gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod 'bul/khri rin po che rnam rgyal gyis dbus 'dus pa la sku skyes gya nom pa gnang / gter sgom gyi yang dben 'brong ngu sum mdor gzim spyil yang btab/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i bka' 'bum rnams mthing shog la gser gyi (gyis 〉bris pa bzhengs/ de nas stod lung bde chen du phebs/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul lnga par zang zing gi sku skye sa stobs shin tu zub dang / yangs pa can du dpal chos kyi grags pa'i dngul gdung la mchod pa'i bye brag rgyas par mdzad/ de skabs drang srong dri med dge ba 193

dngos su nam mkhar byon nas thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam gyi gdams pa dag snang du bstsal/ ba byung / log tre sa la'i sgrub pa zhig(145ba)mdzad skabs nyams bye snang bar ri bo kun 'dus kyi rtser drang srong nyid kyis 'das ma thongs da lta'i 'byung tshu gyi lung bstan bslab bya mang du mdzad/ dngos su drang srong nyid yang yang dang /gzhan yang gzigs sna nga mang du byung bar snang / khyad shar rje nyid sngon stag mor 'khrungs skabs dang / 'phags yul du chos rgyal pa grub sogs sngon gyi dran snang du ma byung / sku 'dis sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams du mar sku re sprul pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mtha' las 'das/ zha dmar sprul sku dpon slob la bka' brgyud spyi bye brag gsar rnying gi dbang chos mang po gnang bas skabs shig gtum mo btsan thabs su 'bar ba'i gdams pa dag sna nga yang byung / de skabs byang glang gdor brag nas gter gyi kha byang banas/ de na sa 'bri gung du phebs nas 'brong ngur gzim spyil du sa mtshams gnang ba'i tshe gzigs snang du ma byung / skabs shig rtsam skya brag nas gter sgrub kyi lde mig kha byang rnams bzhes/ dgung lo sum cu pa sa khyi lo khrums stod za ba'i yar ngos mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin tshogs khang gi yang steng ke ru yangs rdzong nam mkha'i phug pa zhes sam/ mkha' 'gro /sna zlo / dro/ //ba kyi // /tsa // (rnyi dro'im ༷pa /spyang /ga pa 'a sna za du / rdo//shā //sa la/ sa/ byang /byer lus sa ba/'a / brgyad sa/ / sa pa/gyur /rdo dag dpal bzang las yang bskyar bka' brgyad dang / snying thig ya bzhi sogs dang / mnga' ris paṇa chen la sa kyang sa 'gyur gyis 〈kyi 〉/mi

chos mang du gsan cing / khyad par bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub khro rol gar 'phyams 〈'a ma 〉sogs phyag bzhes mdzad pas dus de nas bstan pa gnyis ldan gyi bdag por gyur/ bka' srungs 〈srung 〉sprug nag rgyum dral ha ra/ pe har/ gnod sbyin ci dmar/rā snu la / sngaṭa bdag dreṭa pa bcod brgyad soṭa drag rtsal can gyi bsrungs 〈srung 〉ma du ma brten 〈bsten 〉cing bran sa khol/ skabs shin nya (dī zhu ngasna parnyi phya pha // /zhi byeb / di / // /dro byed/ kyis lha tho/'i ri na chen rnam rgyal gyis dbus rang phyogs cho phra thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉ma/ma/ /rdo /sbyardo / // / /shā /thob/sa pa 'a / /na/ nga zhi /no bzas sdo /shā /rdo shā sogs dkyil chog du ma gsar 'dzu / 〈'dzugs 〉ge ra ba'i cha rkye / du phyag rdzas gang yod sbyor ba mdzad/ stod lung 'de chen du phebs pas skabs shig sku khams (135ba)mi bde ba zhig byung bar dad ldan gyis bye ༷ bye bye/ bye bye ///byer cha snangs ༷ sa / / bye/ bye/ ༷ rteX // sna byeX chos mang du gnang / rje nyid kyis dpon sa'i sku las me 'bar ba pa gor phug tu ba ro dngos su gzigs pa sogs gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung / dpon sas kyang rje'i sku 'od kyi phung po dang / dbang gi dus yi dam gyi lha ru ma'i skur bsgyur ba sogs dag snang mang du mjal/bshags ram sgrub sde 'debs pa'i sbyin bdag khas len zhus/ der gnas pa kun la dbang chos kyi 〈kyis 〉tshim pa ra gnang / lha sa bsam yas rnams su phebs/ mchod 'bu ba bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i smon lam1 5

mdzad/ bsam yas su mnga' ris pa ṇa chen la 'dus pa mdo sogs sngaṭa rnying ma'i dbang chos du ma gsan nas slar snye mor phebs/ bshags ram sgrub sde'i sa blangs byin rlabs mdzad/ skabs der lcam gser khang ma rje nyid kyi yon bdag gi rtsa bar gyur pas/ rin spungs dpon blon dang chos rje 'chi med pa mchod yon thugs ma rang 〈rangs 〉nas/ 'chi med pas drag po mngon spyod kyi las sbyor ma du rtsams 〈brtsams/〉 rinaspungs nas bshags ram sgrub sde (14 na)'debs pa la 'tshe ba du ma byas nas bshol/ lhag par lngam gser khang ma btson du bzung ba sogs bya byed ngan pa mang du bshams par/ yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las sbyor gnang bar/ mi ring bar rin spungs pa nang 'khrug byung ba sogs mngon spyod kyi rtag 〈rtags 〉mthong chos su gyur cing / de skabs 'khor ba'i gnas tshul la nges 'byung 'khrungs pa'i rkyen gyis phyag rgya chen po sgo ma du med pa'i rtog 〈rtogs 〉pa mthar thug pa mngon du gyur cing sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ chu yos spre'u zla bar gter sgom tshogs khang du rje nyid dpon slob 'ga' zhig dang bcas rlung khrid kyi nyams bzhes gnang skabs tshes bcu'i nub 'od gsal gyi ngang lho nub rnga yab gling padma 'od kyi pho brang chen mor phebs te gu ru rta phag yab yum rig 'dzin dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi 〈kyis 〉bskor ba gnang ba der tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad nas gu rus rtsa ba gsum gyi gtor dbang dang / dam chos dgongs pa yang zab 'di'i sgos bcas spros med kyi dbang / chos bskor po sto sgrub rdzas rnams kyi byin rlabs/smon lam gtad rgya dang bcas pa gnang zhing / slar rta phag yab yum gu ru padma 'byung gnas dngos su bstan nas bslab bya lung bstan mtha' yas pa (13 ba)mdzad nas skad cig tshogs khang du phebs pa 196

dang mnal sad pa byung zhing / dam chos dgongs pa yang — ba kyi chos skor rnams rim gyis 'beebs pa mdzad/ zhi khro'i lha dbang chen mo dang / mkha' 'gro snying thig na ro'i chos drug dzo har thar gyi rlung gi nyams len sogs la khrid yeg bcas dang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlog bya mgo ma sogs drang nges gyi 〈kyi 〉bstan bcos mang po mdzad/ dpon slob nyung bsdus chas brdzus mdzad nas bod khams bde thabs su lha sar chu rags la rab gnas chu bzlog bo rin po cher brtan bzhugs/ bsam yas soṭa mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams la rab gnas mchod 'bul smon lam mdzad pa 〈par 〉yang nas yang du phebs/ khyad par bsam yas su chos skyong gi 〈gas 〉bskul bar thugs sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal zu nas sgrub dbang gnang ba'i dus mtshan ltas dang gzigs snang du ma byung / stod lung yangs can snye mo rnams su lan mang du phebs shing / mos ldan re ba bskong 〈skong 〉ba mdzad/ skyor mo lung du phebs pa'i skabs shig gsang phu'i mdar bzhugs skabs sgar pa la 'bras spungs pa'i 〈pas 〉phrag dog gi sgo nas mi mtshams 〈'tshams 〉pa'i las du ma byas kyang dgra gnyen phyogs lhung ye nas ma mdzad/ dbu (138na)ru ga tshal dang stod lung bde chen/ la bdun bde skyid smon pa thar sogs su/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub dbang chen mo sman sgrub dang 'brel ba gnang ba'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i lta na bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / hor jing ger gyis spyan drangs par 'dam gzhung / 'khor tsha'i sde rnams su lan 'ga' yar phebs/ 'bri hor mchod yon gyi sku rim dang mtha' dmag bzlog phyir khro rol gyi gtar bzlog sogs gnang / gsang ba'i lung bstan dang mthun par rgya ma khri khang du rje'u rigs las rig 'dzin bu khrid ces 197

pa de khab tu phebs pa las rigs sras dam pa mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs 'khrungs/ gter sgom tsha 'ug sogs gnas rnams/ su phyag 'bas kyi rjes dang / yangs can du chibs kyi rjes/ rgya ma khri khang du bzhugs/ skabs shig nyi ma ba zung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ sde tsha kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung gsan/ khri thog rin chen rnam rgyal/paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya ma / mkhan slob chos gsum bla ma grwa slob rnams la dus kun rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i zab chos spyi dang gsar rnying gi dbang chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstsal/ yangs can du phebs skabs shig (la )(138ba)rgyal dbang ga pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje gtsang du phebs zhor lam du mjal zad skabs nyi ma gsum yun tsam byung ba so tsha 'i gli 'igs ya ma na pa lta sang du byung / padma nga pa thugs sras zla ba sogs skyes bu dam pa du ma rje'i zhabs la gtugs shing / skabs shig 'bri gung pa dang yar phyogs phan tshun 'khrug pa'i dus dang / mang thang dgon sde la gyid shod pa'i dmag gis bskor ba'i dus lugs gnyis kyi sgo de go shinas bsdum nas ba ba la ba da/ yang skabs ga yar klung bkra shis rtse pa sde srid phag mo khru pa'i nang blon du sa pa 〈par 〉sde dpon phal cher ma rangs yo rkyen gyis dus zing che ba byung bar sgo gdonganas rje )da spyan 'dren byung bar pho zang rtser phebs/ gong ma mes dbon la 'thad 'os byu slab 〈bslab 〉do 〈ston 〉dang / sde phran so sor ji ltar ma mas 〈'tsham 〉pa'i bka' nan mdzad kyang don stobs su 'gyur ba ma byung / der gong ma chen bo 'on rgyal bzang du gdan drangs/ pho brangagi khri thog la gong dkar zhabs drung phebs pa re zhig dpung gi tshogs bde 'jags su gnas/ gong ma nas rje nyid la rten gsum ma ka cu

byu ra ba tsho riga' zhig dbang rdzas/ rgya hor gyi rol mo/ za 'og gi na bza 'a bla re sa yol ba sogs mchod rdzas/ kyi bye brag khyad du mtshar ba du ma dang / gos dar sman (13 na)'byu rta drel sogs grangs kyi mi lang ba lta bu phul/ gong ma mes dbon la lugs gnyis kyi thugs bzhed bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas 'a gung du phebs/ skabs shig yig mkhan du mas shog dkar gyi ngos la rgyal ba'i bka' 'as ro 'tshal rnying rgyud dang bcas pa bzhengs/ dbu ru na tshal ru lag gi gtsug lag khang dang zung 'brel gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon shul du rang lugs kyi 'dus sde 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa dang / shing yos lor snye mor bshags ram gyi sgrub sde 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉par/ lung rtog 〈rtogs 〉phul phyin bra ma cho sa skyong rin chen sgar nas grwa bcas ba nga ba gnang / de mnyam nyang po rgod rdzong gi sgrub grwa bar skabs thor bar rdor 'dzin sangs rgyas blo gros grwa bcas brdzangs/ grwa rab bkra shis chos rdzong / gter sgom/bkra shis gangs ra/ bsam yas sa zug 'phrang po o rgyan chos rdzong bcas dang / byang gling gi nub ngos yangs ri'i mtshams grwa bcas sgrub sde du ma btab/ me 'brug sa ga zla bar the ri ma dun thang du gling dang sgar gyi 'dus pa dang / phyogs ma 'a nas skar ldan du ma la bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub dbang sa chog nas/ mar me smon lam bar gyis 〈kyi 〉phyag bzhes zos bcas shin tu rgyas pa sman sgrub dang 'brel pa 〈ba 〉gnang ba'i tshe rje nyid nas dkyil 'khor (14 ba)gyi lha tshogs sogs gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung ba dang / mi tog gi char 'ja' 'od sman gyi dri ngad phyogs ma ra khyab pa sogs der 'dus kun gyi mig gis 〈gi 〉spyod yul du ngo ma ra ba'i mas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung /de snar sa ca ga ra sa la sa ga cad sa par sa la zhing byu —

slob kum la nan tan du gdams/ dus kun sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang / rgyal ba byu/ khro'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhal gzigs/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ bstan bsrungs 〈srung 〉ma rā hu la sogs chos bsrungs 〈srung 〉rnams kyis snga phyir 'phrin las sgrub pa grangs las 'das shing / de ltar rje 'di sku tshe'i tshad gya brgyad yin 'dug kyang rten 'brel phyugs ches pa'i 〈bas 〉bla thang du dbyar chos skabs/ tshe ring yang mi ring zhe dgu yin/thung yang mi thung zhe dgu yin/ zhes yang yang gsungs zhing 〈shing /〉bu slob rnams dang khyad par yangs ri sgar gyi 'dus pa rnams la bstan par gang phan dgos pa'i bka' nan gtan du gnang nas sgo lung du sku khams bsnyel 〈snyung 〉ba'i tshul bstan rgya mar phebs/ khri khang gi lcags ri'i lhog gro bo lung zhes par bzhuṭa nas drung du 'khod pa rnams la zhal chem 〈chems 〉bslab bya du ma bstsal ba dang / sku'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ba dbag tu med pa bstan nas dgung lo zhe dgu pa me (140na)sbrul cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi nya ba'i tshes kyi tho rangs khar mya ngan las 'das so/ de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang / nam mkha' thams cad 'ja'atshon gyi 〈gyes 〉gang ba/ me tog gi char dang / ro ba cho/'i sgra la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas brjod la sa 'das/ zhal cher/sa/ ltar lo gsum gsang rgya byas / sku rim la khag btags te/ das/ngari ga rdzobs rgya dpar 〈dpangs 〉mtho ba grub/ lo gsum thems nas bka' chems bzhin sku gdung rin po che dbu ru na chal ge klu /bang du bzhugs na bod kham sa phan bde'i rtsa kha/sa tu yongs gyur 〈'gyur 〉'dug kyang / thel pa sogs rang phyogs rnams nas mgrin gcig gi nan che bar brten sku gdung rgya ma nas bkur ste du ma dang bcas spyan drangs/ zel gyi khang gas gang ga na byu gser dngul las chos 'khor mchod rten bzhengs —

pa'i nang du bzhugs/ dbu lo chab ser na bza' sogs /sku gdung gi cha shas shig dbu ru na tshal du gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar bzhengs pa'i nang du bzhugs so/ rje 'di 'bri bstan chos sred gnyis na ra sku drin shin tu che ba yin la/ lo rgyus zhib pa rnam thar logs su gsal lo/ 'di nyid la slob ma'i tshogs grangs gi 〈kyis 〉mi lang ba lta bulas/ mchog tu gyur pa ni/ chos srid kyi rgyal tshab dam pa (140ba)rin chen rnam rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / paṇa chen rin chen bsod nams dpal gyi rgya mtsho/ rigs kyi sras dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bcas lo rgyus 'og tu gsal la/ khu bo drung chen rin po che byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs ldan dpal bzang ni phag mortser 'khrungs shing / phyis rgya ma khri khang du gshegs pa tsam las rnam thar ni ma mchis/ drung pa rin chen dpal ni/ zur re lcang gcig dpon rgyud las 'khrungs/ sku gzhon nu nas/ rje ra nyid kyi drung du rab spyobyung zhing 'dul khrims kyi bcas pa phra mo la yang gces spras mdzad pa'i 'dul 'dzin gyis 〈kyi 〉mchog tu gyur/ rje nyid dang mkhas grub du ma las gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan cing / mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la sbyangs/ thel dang gter sgom rnams su sgrub pa mdzad cing rim gnyis/ mthar son mkhas grub zla med du gyur cing / yangs ri gar dang / dbu ru ga tshal gyi bla ma mdzad/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs dra ro gnyis pa bkra shis phun tshogs sogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag du ma'i dbu blar kyur cing / 'di nyid (kyi )rnam thar rgyas pa ni logs su yod 'dus/ kyang kho bos ma mthong / lho pa phun (141na)tshogs rnam rgyal ni lho brag tu sku bltams/ rje ra 'i drung rab tu byung ste rje dang mkhas grub sa ma las gsar rnying gi gdams pa mang byu gsan/ —sgo

bka' bstan mdo rgyud thams cad la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad/yangs ri sgar dang dbu ru na tshal sogs kyi mkhan po mdzad cing / rta phur spyan bzang dang / chu bzar soṭa kyi dgon gamar mang du zhe skyang sa/dam chos dgongs pa zab kyi chos bdag tu lung (gis )zirnga/ pa phe /smin pa lho bod mon du smin/ zhes dang / sog po lha dpal dang /kun mkhyen klong chen po'i skye mthar grags/ mngon par mkhye ga pa thogs med du mnga'/ dar rtse mdor phebs skabs chibs kyi 〈kyi ri 〉 rdo khrod du b.rabs pas byu lus rmar song kyang 〈yang 〉rlung 'phrul dakhor gyi sbyor bas de nub nyid du bsos 〈sos 〉pa dang 'byung ba chus kyang bka' nyan te gnod pa la sa ldog pa/ lngangs yul du bo ci rtse'i phyag phreng 'thor 〈thor 〉sar sdong po skyes pa/ chu sbyin gnang ba'i tshe dzam dmar gyis gser thig po 'bul ba/ slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba'i dus sum pa nam mkha' la 'a gas pa sogs rim gnyis mthar son pa'i yo / tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing / rje dza ro gnyis pa/ zhwa dmar drug pa sogs rtsod bral (141ba)gyi skyes mchog du ma'i dbu bla mdzad/mdo khams sogs la lan mang byon/ chel khang gsar gyi gser thabs dang / sgo mang du thub chen gyi sku bzhengs pa/ 'om/ du rin chen brag gi das/ma/ ba/ma/sa btab nga sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad par grags so/ bla ma chos skyong rin chen ni/ yid bzhin nor mchog gi chos bdag tu lung zin cing / rim gnyis kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan cing 〈zhing 〉shag 〈bshags 〉ram gyi sgrub sde 'debs pa'i khur len dang /mtshams bla lo gsum gyi thog mar mdzad pa yin la rnam thar no ma mthong / bya bstong rdo rje dpal 'bar ni zang mdar 'khrungs/ ras ma sgyuraba'i zung ra spyo byung /rje byun dga' rin chen/ grub thob dbu sa

pa spyon pa sos/sa mkhas grub skyes mchog du ma bston 〈bsten/〉 sangs 〈spa nga 〉gi phu ga lung / tsha 'ug gte ga sgom so ga ga da na gnas rnams su sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas sgom med chen po'i stob/sa pa mngon du gyur cing mkha' la 'phur ba sogs ju 'phrul bstan/ phyis rje ra 'i zhabs ba gtugs shing slob ma'i mchog tu byu ra/ yangs ri'i mtshams bla lo dgu mjad nas/ slar tsha 'ug tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i mtshan yang tsha :/ //ra pa sa du gru / pa shā rdo / / la tha / rgyas //rdo dī) / / / /shā / mcho/ bla ma gtsang pa/ phun tshogs rab yangs pa/ gdan gcig pa ye bye bye / bas / /rdo ras sdu rnyi dro /spya/da1 /ra phu /sa spyan depa // ( / rdo pa/ yang ma mthong ngo /ba ma /da /nga rgyu/ me// / dī rdordo ཿshā hā/rdo /rtsi'i za/dro rdo / bye /da/ rdo/ /swā byebye ༷ bye / /kau bye bye bye kri/ ༷ /zlo ma//rdo ///༷ / ༷ / bye/du/ bye/ yab ni gong du smos pa chos kyi rje rin chen chos kyi rgyal ma tshan dpal bzang po'i sras sgom pa rin chen rnam rgyal phag mo rtser khab tsu byon pa'i sras/ byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs ldan rin chem/ dpal bzang bye nyis kyi/'ardos ba// masaX dache // bye gzi /༷ste / sgru / bye/ bye byeXrdo kyi shā ba ltams/ de'i tshe yum la mi lhas dang / dngos su sa g.ya ba/ sa chu dros 203

/sde /sto /mi /ga /bye 1sgo /gye —1 pa/ ga dang nga dbyar ltar rgyas pa/ 'a gung la gcu sku 'bum gyi bang rim la/ me tog u dum wa ra ya mtshan can zhig 'khrungs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing gcung rin po che rdo rje grags pa'i rnam sprul du grags/ gzhon nu'i rol rtsed kyang 'jig rten phal pa'i spyod tshul las rnam par 'das shing /sbyar gdong 〈sdong 〉gi rtser rigs gsum mgon po dang / mnal lam du rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i zhal gzigs/ sku khams bsnyel 〈snyung 〉ba'i tshe 'khor lo sdom pa la thugs dam mdzad pa'i 8pas 〉de ma thag sku khams dwangs/ yi ge bris klog bka' bstam/ bcos gtsug lag ji snyed brda' 〈brda 〉tsam gyis phul du phyin/ sku na phra mo'i skabs der dbus gtsang gi dge bshes chen po'i rigs la yang chos kyi gsus 'phros mdzad pa'i thog 〈thogs 〉med thobs pa dang ldan/ dgung lo bcu lon pa'i tshe/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan rin chen rnam rgyal chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ dbang chos kyang mang du gsan/ khu bo rgyal (144na)dbang rin chen phun tshogs las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi dbar / phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zab lam dra ro'i chos druga'ajig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zab chos/ ye shos kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / bstan bsrungs 〈srung 〉chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub skor rgyud sogs 'bri gung pa'i chos mdzod mtha' dag gsan/ kerma pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje la/ rngog dkyil bdun sogs dang / zha dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag la rdo rje phreng ba/ narma pa na rim gyi bka' dbum sogs dang / gzhan yang gter ston zhig po gling pa/ mkhan 204

chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen grags rgya ba/ snang gsal ba ku shis rgya mtsho sogs yongs 'dzin du na las gas/ra rnying gi dbang chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas khu bo rje rin chen kun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po'i bkas/ rje 'di dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa shing rta lo'i hor zla dgu pa'i mas bco brgyad gza' skar bzang bar/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol ba'i bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma (143ba)dang ldan zhing / gling rin po che'i chos khrims dang / 'bangs srid rnams la'ang dge ba bcu'i khrims dam par mdzad cing / chab srid mnga' thang yang shin tu rgyas/ klung shod rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i spo'i pho brang gi phyi nang btsan cha sogs rgya bskyed nas/ der brtan chags shing / dgung lo bco brgyad pa me sprel lo la/ chos lung mkhan po kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang spyan drangs/kha bskong grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad cing / mkhan chen de'i drung gdams pa kha shas gsan/ lo der rgyal ba kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dpon slob sgar chen dang bcas kong po nas 'bri gung du spyan 'dren mdzad cing / rje nyid 'khor du ma 〈mas 〉bskor nas bsu ba'i tshul du 'bum thang du phebs cing 〈shing /〉 thel gling stod smad kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis ser sbrengs shin tu rgyas pa bstar te/thel mdun du sgar chen btab nas lo gcig bar phel mdun/ khra ba kha/zur re bkra shis thang sogs 'bri gung du bzhugs shing / rje 'di nyid kyi phyag phyir gling stod smad kyi dge 'dun dang bcas/ rgyal ba narma pa'i drung zab rgyas kyi chos mang po gsan/ khyad par dra ro'i chos drug gi khrid dang / rgyal gyi nya bar ras pa stong lhag gi (144na)mas phud mdzad/ gar chen la 'bul ba gsol phogs sogs rnam thos/ kyi bu'i 705

khengs pa 'phrog pa gnang / tshur la yang rgya zog gi dngos po du mas skyes 'bul mdzad nas klung shod brgyud phyir phebs/ rje nyid phebs skyel zhor rwa sgrong gi gnas gzigs sogs mdzad nas rtse bar bzhugs/se tsha 'bul dpon pa dang / rta 'bul ba/ dbus gtsang gi ja pa sogs kyis 'bul ba rgya che ba phul/ phag lor thel gser khang du gling gi tshogs pa rnams la mos gus/ srog 'khor gyi khrid dang / zab chos/ bde mchog tsa nyi pa'i dbang chen sogs gnang / gyi lor rgyal kyi zla bar/khang gsar yang dgon du dgun khrid/ bla g.yel du ras bod ma da cing tshogs 'khor dga' ston rgya che ba gnang ba sogs/ sngar rmi phyag srol bzhin dbyar chos dgun chos sogs dang / mal gyi thog kha gser khang / 'dzam gling rgyam/ sgo mang sogs kyi sku gsang byugs rten gtsug lag khang sos/sa kyi 'i/ga bsos 〈gso/〉 gling kha dar rgya rtser gzim khang dkar po gas ra du 'debs pa/ mtshe'u kha'i zo zang gi zhig bsos 〈gso 〉rgya che ba dang / mang gi ma ma sa lo ga sa brje len dang / mkham/ slob chos gsum/ nyi se/ la ji/ tsā ri (144ba)sogs gnas gsum gyi do 'dzin dgon sde so so'i bla ma bcas kyi brko 〈bsko 〉bzhag mas drug dus mchod chen mo/ sos gtor sogs sngar sro la rnams mi nyams zhing 〈shing 〉ches cher rgyas par mdzad/ mtshe'u kha'i po brang dang / thel gyi gzim /ba nga dkar po/ lcang lo can/ khra ba kha rtse'i bde chen sding / 'od sna la sogs pa dben gnas rnams su yi dam lha'i bskyed rdzogs nyams bzhes gnang ba'i tshe/ gzigs snang du lho nub rnga yab gling padma 'od kyi ga dal yas khang du gu ru rin po che mjal ba dang / gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog ye shes kyi mgon po bstan bsrungs ma sogs bla ma yi da chos skyong rnam pe kyi zhal ཿ (

gzigs/ khyad par mi zug sa gzi ba da can zhig ges sku mtshams grol nga / 'gro don rgya che ba yong zer ba dang mthun par tha khams mi bde ba hu/ga byung nas sku mtshams zos las dag pa rnams kyi mthong snang du rje 'di rje btsun mi la ye shes kyi mgon po sogs sku'i snang ba mthar yas pa byung / skabs sa yar klung pa dang / bas yas/skyidashed pa sogs dmag dpung ltos che ba dang bcas/ rang bstan lamatho ri tho 〉mtsham sa 〈'tshams 〉byung bar/ rang srid kyis 〈kyi 〉dpu gis 〈gi 〉tshogs/ rnams gyis/ pha rol (145na)'a rnams med med du bcom ste/ bsam yas rgya chen pa'i mdur zhags kyang 'phrog cing /de'i tshe/ byu rab sde pa dpung bcas lhag 〈lhags 〉 sa/ byu ri stag rtser 〈rtse 〉'bul bar bzhed kyang / rje 'dis ma bzhes/ de nas dgung lo sum cu par sku 'khor du na dang bcas/ ma ser dar / 'bab ro // sgom sde sogabasabyang phyogs su phebs pa'i tshe/ sde so so nathamabakur ste zhabs tog rgya chen po byas/ gang la gang ma mas 〈'tshams 〉chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad de 'ji gung ku phebs nas mi ring bar/ mdo stod ma la zod rnams su phebs shing / de'i tshe/ rgya nag nas/ lung las 'bul mi yongs 〈yong 〉bas 〈ba'i 〉mngon mkhyen dang / ri ga ra 'dab chag 〈 gas 〉gi 〈kyis 〉kya ga gas sazhig la chibs rgyugs ba da pha sogs jo ma ra ba bstan cir / rgya 'dri gdug pa can dam la btags der rgya nag nas lung las/ 'a mul mi ci shi dang / tsir shi 'khor ru ma dang bcas lhag 〈lhags/〉 cung shi lam du 'das pa'i kha chem la 'ji gung chos rje de phyogs 'di'i nam mkhari mthongs su seng ge la chibs/ sku mtsham dpe rdzogs pa zhig mjar byu nga zer bar/ blu shi dpon g.yog rnams kyi 〈kyi ri/ 〉mjal ba'i 307

mi/ (145)sdo lta ba snang zer 'ang dad pa thob cing 'ja' sa la ba'i tshe/ rje nyid dpon slob rnams (kyis )bkur ste du ma dang bcas bsu ba mdzad cing / de'i tshe dgun dus yin kyang / nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis gang ba 'brug sgra la sogs ltas ya mtshan pa byung / der rgya mi rnams la gzhi len gya nom pa gnang nas/ 'ja' sa phyag tu bzhes/ 'bul ba rnams slar 'bri gung (du )bzhes rgyur mdzad nas 'bri gung du b.rangs/ rje dpon skob rnams/ dmar tsha/ ma la/rgya shod/ ya ngal nyin srib kyi sde rnams su zabs shing / ske la'i gzhi bdag gdug can zhig gis chibs rag la ma lud nas/ rtsi shing nags tshal ri brag rnams nyil ba byung yang / dpon slob rnams la nyes skyon ci yang ma byung zhing gdug pa can gyis thags ma rnyed/ sde so so nas 'bul zhabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa kulag so sor dbang chos sogs 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan pa mdzad nas 'bri gung du phebs te/ rgya nag gong ma chos kyi rgyal po zim shi rgyag gying zhes bya ba khri la bzhugs pa'i dus gcig gi tshe/ mu ge la sogs pa ltas mi shis pa byung bas/ spor thang gi rtsis mo btab pas/bod du wam bzhi'i nang / sa gnas kyi (14can)byang chub sems dpa' zhig yod bas/ de la lung las sogs phul na dge zhing bkra shis pa yong ba'i lung byung bar/ 'bri phag sa nar sogs kyi mtshan byang bkram te 〈ste/〉 lung las gang la 2bu smod bor dam kha 'phangs pas rje 'di'i mtshan byang la babs 'dug bar/ blon chen tsing shi dang / hu shi 'khor dang bcas par gnang sbyin du ma bskur te btang ba/ 'ja' sa dzad du phebs lam du phul ba gong du brjod pa ltar dang / skabs der shel tham gyis ga tsos sku chas/ gos dar gser dngul rin po che'i 208

dpyad 〈spyad 〉pa sogs rten chas dngom che ba rnams phul/ mi sna rna sa la dga' ston zang zing du mas tshim par mdzad shing 〈cing /〉 gong sa chen por 'bul ba'i bye brag dpang 〈dpangs 〉mtho ba dang bcas brdzong ba gnang / de'i tshe rgya nag gi yul kun dge mtshan bkra shis pa byung bar grags/ phag gi lo la/ phan yul/ zhog pa/ rang zhabs sogs nas yi ge'i 'du byed pa du ma bsdus te/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog /pa/ rdo/dī /gca / / sab sna /shā / / // /rdo/sa/ // / pa/shā //shā rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gdan rabs (145ba)rtogs brjod bcas kyi bris thang / — gser dngul las bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems 'ga' zhig gi sku brnyan/ yang mthing shog la gser gyi rdogyis 〉bris pa'i bka' brgyud rin po che 'di snyad kyi gong sdu / darisnang da /nga nam ( / zlos / /mardo'i lab pa /// // di zlos rte di / rdo ston rgya che ba dang / mi ring bar bka' bstan rnams glogs shing glegs thag dang bcas tshang ba/ gzhan rten rnams dus mtshungs su grub cing 1—/ tsho// dge sdu/ / / pa shā pa :rdo sa sarna rdo sa nga na /so/ bye spya / shā/shā pa spyas / spra sa/ / / ngagyi /sa tshiX // /zlo/ /kyi bka' //shā //bye sgo mang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ skabs der dbus gong ma che // ༷ /rdoX du / skyoX/ / / bye // / ༷ bye/ //// /byebye /bye byebye ༷ bye byerdo nga lha 9

bar 'bri gung gi khog tu bzhuṭa 'jug gnang / dus der song du rje ratna'i skabs smos pa bzhin gong ma ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan de nyid/ skyid shod pa/ (14 na)yar rgyab pa/ gong dkar ba sogs sde phran mang po'i 〈pos 〉sde'u gdong rtse'i khri thog nas/ 'on rgyal bzang du gdan 'dren dang / pho brang ga khri thog la gong dkar zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa spyan drangs te lo shas bzhugs par/ gong ma'i sras gdan sa thol gyi spyan snga sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉rje 'dir zhu nan la brten/gong ma'i dbu 'don gyi phyir/ dpon slob du ma dang bcas 'on phu nas phebs pa rgyal bzang du gzhi len dang / tshong dus brag mkhar du gong ma dang mjal phrad mdzad/ gdan sa thel gyi gnas mjal la phebs pa'i tshe/dge 'dun rnams kyis ser zengs kyis bsus/ spyan snga dang mjal 'dzom dang / rten rnams la mar me snyan shal la sogs pa'i mchod 'bul dang /dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa la mang 'gyed rnam bzhag rgya che ba dang / chos 'brel yang gnang nas/ yang dgon rtser bzhugs sgar btab/ sde phran khag gi dmag rnams so sor gyes bcug ste/ rje 'di dang / 'a dmar ba rnam gnyis pho brang rtser phebs te/ zhabs drung ngag dbang grab/sa pa gong ri dkar por bzhugs su 'jug 〈bcug〉 rang srid kyi dpung gi tshogs pho zang gi rtse zhol du bkang ste/ rtse'i khri la gong ma chen mo snan 'dren mdzad de/ tsho sa chen du khri du ma bshams (14 ba)ste/ gungadu zhwa dmar lnga pa/ g.ya sa — 'a / g.yon du gong ma chen bo dang skyor lung pa gdung rgyud ma da bzhug / ma ma mi dpon gyi gral tshogs shin tu che ba bcas dga' ston gis brjod rgyas par ma da nas/ phan tshun skyes kyi 'bul ba rgya che ba gnang na / bsam yas kyi gnas gzigs zhib par ma da te 〈de 〉nga cung ca ma sa nas/ mi ring bar sku rag pa 310

dang / rtsed zang ma/ 'thong rgyas pa sogs kyi rtser dmag gi 〈gis 〉bskor ba la/ rang srid kyi dpung chen yar klung su 〈du 〉btang bar phanatshun 'gro khyab cher ma byung / der mdun 〈'dun 〉chings su rje 'di yar klung su 〈ku 〉 bsapa'i tshe/ rang srid dmag rnams go mtshon sogs rngams ba da dang ldan pa'i 〈pas 〉nyang po gru kha nas bsus te/ pho brang rtser phebs/ sde khag so sor bka' nan mdzad pas/ mdun 〈'dun 〉chings kyi khas ra ku / dus dbang gis skye bo kun dug lngas spyos pa'i 〈pas 〉dan ba ga la ba dka' yang / gnas skabs der yun ring ba bde 'jag 〈'a ga 〉la ba /da/ khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang / gong ma dpon skon sde khag gi mi dpon bcas par dam bzhag gnang nas 'byu gung du phebs/ byang nas hor gyi gdan zhus byung bar/ sho mon 'dzom (148na)rar chub / hor sam dpal dang / khro rgyal 'bum gnyis ma dan par 'khrug sa te 〈ste 〉byugs dam gtor 'og tu drangs/ hor khro rgyal 'bum rgyas da ba 'a las rgal 〈'gal 〉bar mi ring bar kho rang 'jig rten phyi ma sas 〈 da 〉mor song / sde khag so so nas 'bul zhabs yang dag pa byas nas 'bri gung du phebs/ shing glang lor/ gcung paṇa chen dpal rtse rgya mtsho gdan sar dbang bskur ba mdzad/ de gabs skyor lung pa sngar mal du ma chud pa'i 〈pas/〉 skyor lung nas rgyab brten dgos pa'i zhu ba gul bar/ rang srid kyi dpung chen phan yul brgyud nas btang / rje'i gzigs snang du a phyi chos kyi sgol ma sku shin tu che ba yid du 'ong ba 'dzum zhal rang phyogs la ston pa byu/ga byung ba dang mthun par/ skyid shod dga' ldan pa'i dmas rnam sa bcom ste/rtsan gyi brag la rdzong zabs pa sogs/ skyor lung nga/'i bzhed pa bzhi na grub par/ dga' ldan pa'i sde pa yid ma rangs/ 'bri gung la dmag sna 211

gtod rtsis la/ sde pa dpo g.yog 'dzigang casabod par sa/nang ste/ston bshom 〈bsham 〉gnang sbyin tshad med pa mdzad nas/ dmag 'khrugachad pa dbo/sa pa'i bka' bslab nan tan mdzad bar/ der khas blangs pa'i tshul byas/ mi ring bar thabs du mas/ phan (148ba)yul/ sa rtse ba/ skyed shod kyi dbung chen po bsgril rte byung bas sa zhabs kyi dmag rnams phan yul gyi bar du phyin pa'i tshe/ ba la kyi dmag phu mda' nas/ rang srid bar thems su byed du lhag 〈lhags〉byung bar/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi mthong snang du/ bud med dung thod khyen pa mang po 〈pos 〉lung pa gang ba dang / stag rtse ba'i mi dpon de bud med bzhis 'phyar 〈phyar 〉ba ladril te khyer ba mthong / de'i tshe rang blud kyi dmag rnams kyis pha rolasapa'i go mtshon 'phrog pa/ mi mang bkum pa/ 'ga' zhig btson du khrid/ phal cher bros pa sogs la brtem/ rang phyogs khang thog gi dmag rnams rgyal ste bye ri stag rtse len pare chas pa'i tshe/ korma pa yab sras/ stag lung chos rje sogs bla chen khag gi 〈gis 〉mi sna mngags te mdun 〈'dun 〉chings/ byas/ rang gzhan thams nge da nas le ——/sa bya'i 'bul ba mang du byung / rgyal ba garma pa brgyad pa mi baspyod rdo rje zhing brjes pa'i rnam 'phrul dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag yab sras 'bri gung du gdan 'dreg/ zhus ltar phebs/ rje nyid mkhan slob chos gsum mi dpo / du cag dang bca ga chibs bsur phebs/ kurma pa yab sras sgar chen bkra shis tshal ku btab/ zla ba gsum gyi bar bzhugs/ yang zur lcog grwa pa bca ri )sa (14 na)stong tswag tsam la gsol phogs bsnyen bkur stobs sa ba ba/na / sharma pa yab sras la dbang chos sogs gdams pa kha g.yar 〈 mar 〉gsan/ sgar chen bal gyi tha/nas gzigs 212—

la thobs pa'i tshe dge 'dun rnams kyis ser stengs bkod pa phul du byung ngari 〈bas 〉bsus/ chel gyi gnas gzigs zhib tu mdzad/ bla g.ye la du rje drung yab sras nas/ gling gi dge 'dun rnamasal cho 'brel dang / mang 'gyed rnam bzhag mdzad nas bkra shis tshal du phebs /phan tshun skyes 'bul stobs che ba gnang nas so sor phebs/ yang dpa' pa ba gtsug lag phreng ba/ gter ston zhig po blang pa rnams 'bri gu nga du spyan 'dren mdzad/ dbang chas 'ga' zhig gsan/ chos kyi rje paṇa chen rin po che zhing brjes pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya dpang 〈dpangs 〉mtho ba gnang / rje kun dga' rin chen gyi slob ma ldan ma kun dga' grags pa ti se rdo 'dzin mdzad skabs/ mang yul la dwags tu 〈su 〉byon/ rgyal po'i bla ma chod (du )gyur nas phyis rgyal sras kun dga' chos rgyal bya ba 'bri gung du rje 'di'i zhabs la gtugs/ de nas bzung mang yul gyi rgyal po 'bri gung gi byen bdag gis 〈gi 〉gtso bor gyur/ mang yul du dgon gnas kyang mang du chags/ skabs shig rje (14 ba)'di dpon slob 'od sna'i rgyab tshal du sgar btab nas dge 'dun brgya phrag tsam la lnga ldan gyi khrid gnang ba'i skabs/ dgong gcig gi dus drag char zhig babs pa'i rkyen gyis/ sha bud 〈'od 〉mejigs su rung ba zhig bzhugs sgar dang khad nye bar rgyugs par phyag nas dang / ljags chab gtor bas gnod pa ma byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / dgung lo nga brgyad pa me pho byi ba'i lo/ hor zla bzhi pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes brgya da kyi srod kyi char/ mtshe'u khar rnam grol zhi ba chen mo'i dbyings su thim mo / dgongs // rnyi // rim pa / /du sdirdo rdong che/ sgo ma ba gise / rlo bye rdo/ sdu bye /shā 21

dasal gdung bzhings pa'i nang ril por bzhugs/ slob ma'i tshogs /chos kyi rje phyogasal rnam rgyal/ snang gsal ba kun )ga' che mchogagangs dkar ra na/ ldan chos rje sku mched/ 'bab rom pa'i chos rje sogs rang gzhan gyi slob ma'i tshogs grangs las 'das so/smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi rtsal rdzogs shing / /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i g.yu ral rgyas/ /lung rigs mche sder (150na)rnon pos rgol ngan gyi/ /ri dwags glad 〈2pa 〉 dge / dpal gyi rgya mtshor 'dud/ /gdan sa bco brgyad pa paṇa che / ri po che bsod nams dpal gyi rgya mtsho 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yu kha sa/nga du zos pa ltar/rin chen rnam rgyalagyi gcung po yin la/ rnam sras gling zhes par/ yab byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs ldan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis las/ me mo phag gi lor sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe 'ja' 'od dang / dri bzang gi ngad 'phro ba sogs bltas 〈ltas 〉bzang bo byung / mtshan rin chen dbang gi rgyal bor gsol/ de'i tshe kho bo rgya gar paṇḍi ta dam pa sangs rgyas sa ma sa la yin zhes yang yang gsungs pas kun gyis paṇa chen rin po che zhes gsol zhing brjod/ cher ba da nas yi ge bris klog dang / rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos/ 'jig rten lugs kyi gtsug lag ji snyed byang zhing chub par ma da/ dgung lo ༄bdun lon pa'i tshe/ khu bo / na ra gnyis pa rin chen kun tshogs chos jirgyal po phag mo rtser byen drangs shing / de'i drung du rab tu byung ba dge tshul nyid du sgrub par ma da pa'i mtshan/ rin chen bsod nams da la gyi rgya mtshor gsol/ dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes (15༷ba)pa'i ma/grogs rdzong bya ba'i dben gnas su/ kro bo chos kyi rgya mtsho las phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid gsan cing lam rtags kyi yon tan rnams yongs 214

su rdzogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i gzis/sa zang du ma byung / grogs ltas snar/yum dang sa mched lhan du phebs te/ kye bo rin po cher chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ rwa sgrong rgyal ba'i bste gnas su phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la sogasabaka' gdamasakyi bla ma mang du zhal gzigs/ slar kre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs mkhan slob grangs tshang dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por sgrub/ 'dul ba la sogs pa mdo rgyud kun la sbyangs/ lha sras mi'i dbang pa rgyal dbang ratna'i drung / phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ zab lam dra ro chos drug skyob pa rin po che'i zab chos theg chen bstan pa'i snying po/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig ba/ mos gus srog 'khor gyi dbang khrid/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab sogs 'bri gung pa'i chos mdzod spyi dang / rngog pa'i dkyil 'khor bkun/ me 'byug lor thel mdun thang du bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dbang sgrub chen dang yan lag gi bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa dang sbrel ba soṭa gsar rnying di chos mang po (151na)dang / gzhan yang gcen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ rgyal ba rkarma pa yab sras/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsha/ rig 'dzin las 'phro ming pa/ jo gdan mkhan 'od gsal thong yangs/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs yongs 'dzin bcu phrag gnyis su nye ba las chos mdzod mtha' dag len par mdzad/ dgungalo so gsum bzhes pa sa mo lug gi lo la/ 'gri gung thel gyi gling kha dar /rtse /dza /gyi /sdo /zhi / rgyas ra sgrub pa ma da pas thugs dam rtsal gas nga / ba ma ldan 'das dpa 'khor lo bde mchog gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/ gtso bo'i stag thogs rje nyid la gsol ba'i gsal snang sa / gu ru ma skyes rdo rje dang / cab phyogs bdebacan67)ba ma

sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa dpag tu med pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ bstan bsrung 〈srung 〉chos kyi sgol ma sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsrungs 〈srung 〉ma rnams rjes su 'brang ba gziṭa pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mtha' yas pa byung /lo lnga thems nas dgung lo so bdun bzhes pa chu phag lor sku mtshams grol/ phag mo rtser 'dusapa rnams la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du bstsal/ dgung lo so dgu pa shing mo glang gi lo'i sgron (151ba)gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gsum rgyal kur 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gser khrir zhabs bkod te 〈de 〉shis brjod me tog thor/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi 〈kyis 〉dbus 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/dbyar chos su zab mo lnga ldan gyi khrid dang / rgyab chos su bstan snying la sogs pa dang / dgun chos la bla g.yel chen mor/ dra ro / chos drug dang / dgongs gcig sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ ras pa lnga brgya lhag gis ras kyi che ba'i lang tsho ngom pa'i tshe/ lha lam nas me tog gi char dang / 'ja' tshon 'khrug pa/ gling gi mdun 'khyag rom zhu ba soṭa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung zhing dus kun chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba kho nas dus 'da' zhing / snying po'i bstan pa la shin tu phan pa mdzad/ 'jig rten gyi dreṭa pa can sdig la dga' ba du mas kyang rje 'de'i zhal mthong ba tsam gyi (gyis 〉dad pa rang dbang med pa skyes nas/ sdig bshags dang / smon lam 'debs pa/ phyin chad sdig spong ba'i dam bca' 'bul ba byed cing / ma nus snyom chung la chos dang zang zing gi rtse 〈brtse 〉bas skyong ba dang / 'di snang gi khengs dregs can ji snyed la spyan zur tsam yang mi gzigs/ 'dzam gling rgyan dang thog kha (171na)gser khang gi zhig bsos 〈gsos 〉kyang mdzad/ na na ཿ 6

dgung lo zhe gsum pa sa sbrul lo'i rgyal gyi zla bar dgun chos gnang ba'i skabs snyung tshul bstan nas mtshe'u khar phebs/ sku rim dang sman dpyad du ma phul kyang ma phan par kho bo'i skye ba zhig myur du 'ong gsungs nas/rta lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i gnas su bsdus so/ de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yo ba dang / me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od sogs ngo mtsha ri ba byung / sku gdung rin po che zhugs su phul ba'i tshe/ ring bsrel las/ 'jam dbyangs/spyan ras gzigs sogs rten ya mtshan can mang du byon/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya che ba grub/ nang rten du 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku brnyan mi tshad las lhag tsam bzhengs/ gser khang nang mar bzhugs cing 〈shing 〉sku 'di'i zhal paṇa chen rin po che 'di nyid kho na ltar byung ba'i mtshan du de ltar gsol ba 'di nyid yin la/ rje 'di la slob ma'i tshogs/ rje ra dang / rin chen rnam rgyal thun mong gi slob maragyur pa sha stag ni gong du smos pa ltar la/ gzhan yang grangs las 'das pa mchis kyang 'dir bri bar ma spobs so/(151ba) dug gsum na por 'grogs pa dang bral zhing / /yon tan rin chen tshogs kyi 〈kyis 〉yongs su gtams/ /rnam rtog rlung gi 〈gis 〉bskyod par mi nus pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas deng 'dir skyong 〈skyongs/〉 /gdan sa bcu dgu pa phyogs las rnam rgyal sa/'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni gong smos na rnam sras gling du byams pa chos kyirgyal mtshan legs ldan dpal bzang la sras gsum byung ba che ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ chung ba paṇa chen rin po che sngar brjod pa ltar dang /'bring ba lcags sprul lo la 'khrungs pa pha ga mo sa/cung rim/ po ge zhes phag mor rgyal srid chos ba ci/na du stong ba de chu / dang yu na har gza' 〈bza' 〉217

'bum skyid ces bya ba gnyis las/ sras gnyis 'khrungs pa phyog las rnam rgyal dang / kurma mi pham dbang rgyal zhes grags/ che ba cho kyi sde 'di nyid/ khu bo rin chen rnam rgya chos kyi grags pa pyal ma —/ dpal bzang po dang / paṇa chen rin chen bsod nam sa dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i drungadu rab tu byung / mtshan phyoṭa la sa rnam par rgyal bar gsol/ phyas rgya chenapo lnga ldan/ zab lam dra ro'i chos drug la so/gas pa 'bri gung pa'i chos spyidang / gzhan bshes gnyen kha shas/ las gsar rnyisgo gi chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ lcags pho rta lor (153na)gza' skar dus tshes bzang por phag mo rtse nas 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen po byang chub gling rin po cher gdan drangs ste/ mnyam med 'bri gung pa chen po ra shrī chos kyi mngon bar ma ba'i seng ge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol dga' ston shis brjod rgyas pa grub/ chos srid lhan cig bskyangs pa'i sras su/ mi pham rin chen chos rgyal 'khrungs/ sgo mang gi gtsug lag khang gi zhig bsos 〈gso 〉dang / gong smos chos kyi rje rin chen rnam rgyal zhing brjes pa'i nang rten du bkra shis sgo mang dngul las grub pa rin po che'i mos byug pa bzhengs pa sogs/ 'bri bstan la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad cing / lo 'ga' yar gdan sar bzhugs nas dgung lo nyer gsum pa (la )lhun grub gling zhes par mya ngan las 'das so/ sku gdung rin po che las grub pa'i mchod sdong nang / lhun grub gling gi rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs/dam pa 'di la rnam thar sa bcad las logs su med pas zheb cha ma mchis/ 'di'i sras phag mo zhabs drung mi pham rin chen chos rgyal la sras gnyis byung ba/ skyed phug pa dang / gcung chung ngu dgung 'o lnga la gshegs pa byug skyid phug par sras sa sprul lo pa zhig byung bar phyisa'ajangs su byon pa rje chos kyi grags pa'i yang srid dga' ba'i (16 3ba)218

dbang po'i yab yin par grags gorab gsal shel gyi me long dwangs pa'i ngogs/ /phyi rol dngos kun ma 'dres gsal ba ltar/ /chos kun sgyu mar gzigs pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /sgyu 'phrul ston mdzad bharma rā dzar 'dud/ /gdan sa nyi shu pa/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun chogs bkra shis dpal bzang po ni/de yang gsol 'debs dkon mchog rin chen mar gsal ba ltar/'phags yul du za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin la sogs pa dang / kha ba can 'dir srong btsan sgam po'i sras/ gnam ri gung btsan/ chos rgyal nyid sprul dge slong a dkar ma ti/lha sras mu tig btsan po'i sras/rgyal sras lha rje/ gter ston nyi ma seng ge o rgyan gling pa/ rgya nag du gong ma g.yung lo sogs skye ba mang du brgyud pa'i mthar/ rgya ma khri khang du/ yab lha sras gnyis pa rin chen phun tshogs dang / yum rje'u rigs de nyid las rig 'dzin bu khrid ces pa'i lhums su bzhugs pa'i mayab kyi mnal lam du/ bud med zhig 〈cig 〉gis seng ge'i bu zhig phul nas 'di legs par skyong zhig zer ba dang / yum la 'jam dpal mtshan brjod pod gcig dang / dung g.yas 'khyil gtad pa (154na)zhig byung / me lug lor sku bltams pa'i dus/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang / nam mkha' nas nor bu zhes pa'i sgra byung bar/ yum sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉mtshan nor bu zhes dang / yab rjes chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shes su gsol/ de yang dag po gling pa'i lung bstan du/ gzhu zhes bya ba'i sa cha ru: bkra shis ming can lug lo pa: de yi dri ni sus zos pa: skye ba༄ na phal gyi da zla min: zhes dang / dbu ru na tshal pa dang nye ba ru: bkra shis ming can brla g.yon che ba'i mtshan: zhes dang /dam chos dgangs pa yang zab las: rigs dang chos kyi srid 'dzin21

gdung tshob nga/: chos kyi / la po snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin: zhes sogs tshad ldan gyi gter tsa nga du ma nas yang yang bsngags mi/nga / dbu la gtsugator dang / yi ge ri ཿrnams gsal/ sku na chung ngu mas 'jig rten kyi gtsug las rnams/ la mkhas shing // rol rtsed skabs/ a ba ra bsad pa bso 〈gso 〉ba/ gas la dkar rdo bcal du bsgyur ba ma chag pa sogs rdzu 'phrul bstan/ dgung lo bdun bzhes tshe sgo lung du phebs pa'e tshe/'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' la rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che la bas — brgyud bla mas bskor ba/ bstan (154ba)srungs ma sogs zha gzig/sa/ 'bri gung khang thog gis dbus che dgu rnams kyis phebs bsu dang / phyogs mtha' nas 'dus pa soṭa thams cad kyis zang zing gi 'bul ba mtha' yas pa byung / yab rje ratna'i drung 'bri gung pa'i chos spyi dang / gsar rnying gi dbang chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang la bdun bde skyid slon pa thang du bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang lung sogs gsan/ de nas rgya mar bzhugs shing / dgung lo bcu gcigabazhes tshe/ yab rje ratna'i zhabs sku khams ltem pa'i tshul gyi (gyis 〉lcaṭa ri'i gro bo lung du bcad rgyar bzhugs skabs mjal bas sku zo ngan par 'dug pas spyan chab mang du shor/ rje gong mas nga myur du grags 〈drag 〉yong gsungs thugs bso 〈gso 〉mdzad/ sku mya ngan las 'das par/yum gyi 〈kyis 〉gsang ba mdzad kyang / me tog gi char phab 〈babs 〉pa'i rkyen byas bros stabs su gro bo lung du byon pa'i tshe/ sku gshegs 13 /skyo 11 〈〈 /〉/mepar ga gas pas thugs ba la ba da rlag glags da pa byung /de ma thag sngon rgyal ba rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉tshul 'di ltar bstan 'dug da /ngas mchod pa dang yan lag bdun pa mdzad pas nye dakhor ba rnams ngo mtshar du gyur/ zhal chems ltar lo gsu ma bar gsang ba mdzad/ dgung 220

lo bcu gnyis pa la lha mchog 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil (155na)gnon gyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas gshin rje bshed yab yum sras gsum/o rgyan rin po che/ rje gong ma rnams zhal gzigs/ yang zab bka' srungs gsum gyi sgrub pa mdzad dus tshub che zhing / ma gza' rdo gsum dngos su gzigs/ bka' bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ der bstod pa mdzad/ de nas khu bo rin chen rnam rgyal gyi drung bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs/ mtshan sngar gyi mjug dpal bzang po zhes sbyar/ lo pa spyan snga chos grags rgyal mtshan las/ gsar ma'i dbang chos mang du gsan/ de nas rje gong ma gshegs nas lo gsum the /sa nas chog mang dgongs rdzogs gi 〈kyi 〉'phros rnams dang / dngul gdung bzheng ba sogs mdzad/ de'i tshe yum yang gshegs pas 'das brdzongs rnams grub 'phral/ sde pa mkhar rtse bas rgya mar dmag byas pas/ thugs zos mi bde ba byung bas na tshal du phebs/ skabs shig gtsug lag khang la zhabs bskor gyi sku rtsed dang zags rdo zhig la phyag rjes gnang / mi ring bar dngul gdung grub nas thel du phebs skabs/ rtsog snas sbrul nag zhig 〈cig 〉la sprul nas bsus/ gling rin po che'i gtsug lag khang rnams la gnas gzigs mdzad skabab/ gser khang chos rje rin po che'ithugs sa (155ba)nas 'od zer 'phros nyid la thim pa byung / dngul gdung gi rab gnas la sgam po spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal spyan 'dren mdzad/ de nas na tshal du gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar bzhengs pa dang / mtshams grwa gsar 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉gnang / skabs shig sku khams me bde ba byung bar/ mdun khar rje skyob pa/ laston pa sangs rgyas/ tshe dpag (med/) a byu/ rnam sras bcas kyi dbus rje gong ma phyag na tshe bum bsnams nas bdud rtsi pa/nang ba zheg byung ba dang byu khams221

dwangs/ snye mo sgrub sde sosas mtshams grwa khag lo gsum re nas brje len gnang ba'i rgyun tshugs shing / de skabs su 'dus pa rnams la phyag rgya chen pa lnga ldan/ dra ro'i chos drug yang zab kyi lta khrid rdzogs rim sob//sa sa/sa cing gi dbang chos mang du bstsal/ mkhas grub dam pa lca/ra sa/cig pa ren chen dpal las rang lugs kyi dbang jus mtha' yas pa gsan/ gzhan yang / bla ma byams pa dpal/ sde tsha kun dga' rgyal ma tshan/ phrang gter shes 'od pa sogs yongs 'dzin kha shas las chos kyi bdud rtsi du ma bzhes/ klung shod rta bur thang du 'dus pa che bar bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub chen mo gnang / ra greng gi gnas ga rigs ma dzad nas/ 'bri gung du mtshe'u khar pa chen dpal gyi rgya (155na)mtsho las/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid gsan pa'i 〈pas 〉thugs nyams rtog 〈rtogs 〉tshad med pa khyad par can 'khrungs shing / 'kho da 'das chos kun rmi lam sgyu mar gzigs te sgos bral chen po ma/ngon du 'gyur/ de rjes zel du paṇa chen de nyid las dra ro'i chos drug dgun khrid gsan pas thabs lam gyis 〈rgya 〉thugs dam rtsal rdzoṭa/ bde drod lang tsho ngom pa'i ras rkyang mdzad pas 'khyag 〈'khyaṭa 〉rom zhu ba/ 'ja' tshon gyis bar snang khengs/ ras pa lnga brgya lhag tsam byung / gted sgom du phebs skabs gu ru rin po che sogs gzigs snang mang du byung / skabs shig tsha 'ug tu phebs skabs chos khri khar bzhuṭapas/ nam mkhar bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams zhal gzigs pa'i 〈pas 〉thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis rdo la phyag rjes bzhag bla ma rdo rje dpal 'baragyis mos gus rjen po'i 〈bos 〉rje'i zhabs la gtugs/ spro lung du namapa nga /ba sras za ra chen phebs par mjal phrad dang / zhwa dmar dkon mchog pa ma/ las/ las rdo rje phreng ba sogs gsan/ bka' brgyad kyi gar 222

'phyar sa 〈'cham )〉gzigs 'bu dgos gsu ngas ltar mdzad/ de nas yangs ri sgar pas rje'i phyag phyi mdzad de kong por phebs pa'i tshe/ nyang po 'bras su thubs 'ur bas rdo la phyag zhabs (155ba)kyi rjes bzhagag nang dang / 'grung gshab/ sang sing sogs brgyud nas long por phebs der 'khrug pa zhi bar mjad/ brkung dgon sgrub grwa btab/ 'o thang du phebs skabs/ 'o thang pa zhig gis lo leṭa pa'i dngos grub dgos zhus par/ yul der lo de la 'bras drug shin tu legs pa byung / bu chudang nye bar chu'i gnod pa byung bar phyag nas gnang 'phral chu phar khar 'gyur rdo la zhabs rjes kyang bzhag (bu )chu jo bo mjal bar phebs skabs mkha' la 'ja' gur dang me tog gi char sogs byung / rgya la'i gnas gzigs la phebs dus mi tshos/sa che bas 'ur nas chibs 'grogs 〈'drogs 〉nas sku rdab bsil ba'i rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes bkod/gnas nang du gzigs snang mang du byung zhing / 'ja' 'od me tog gi char yang byung / de nas rtsa nang du phebs skabs/ mchod rten byin canade nyid 'phyo zhing 'gul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba byung / slel lung du o rgyan sgrub phug ma jal ba gnang dus/ bgrod dka'i brag cig la phyag gi 〈gis 〉lung phug par mdzad pas da lta 'byu gung phyag rjes phugs su grag/sa/ de nas sgam por phebs pas/ bsu ba ser zeng bkur ste du ma byas/ spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal dang mjal phrad chos 'brel gsan/(15 na)'jog spyil du mnyam med rin po che dngos su gzigs/ de ltar dwags long kong gsum phal cher gyi 〈kyis 〉rang rang gis 〈gi 〉'byor tshogs/ mtha' yas pas ma da cing / so sor chos kyi bdud rtsis byang chub kyi myu gu bskrun par mdzad nas/ 'bri gung du phebs te rten la mchod 'bul/ khu bo rin chen rnam rgyal dang 'dus tshogs la sku 223

skyes stobs che ba gnang / de nas bsam yas su phebs pas chos skyong gi bsu ba sogs gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad cing / 'das ma 'ongs gi 〈kyi 〉lung bstan mang po dang dbu skra lcang lor bzhag na sku tshe'i rten 'brel yod zhus/ gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod 'bul smon lam rgyas par gnang / de nas chos skyong gi 〈gis 〉slar yos kyi lo la bsam yas la rab gnas mdzad par phebs dgos zhus nas 'bri gung du phebs/ rje ratna'i dpon slob mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje byon nas 'bul ba rgya che ba phul/ rje nyid nas de'i drung nas byang gter soṭa snga 'gyur gyi chos mang rab gsan/ yang gter ston zhig po gling pa las chos du ma gsan/ gong du kong por phebs dus long po nas dpon sa nor bu sgol ma bya ba khab tu bzhes pa la sras zhig 〈shig 〉'khrungs kyang zhag bcu gsum las ma (15 ba)bzhugs/ de nas ring min dpon sa yang sku ma 'am yang de'i gong tsam du bod chos rgyal gyi gdung las nga phod sde pa'i sras mo a 3 g.yang khug bya ba khab tu bzhes par mi ring bar rigs sras che ba dra ro gnyis pa 'khrungs/ yos lor bsam yas su chos skyong gis spyan drangs gtsug lag khang rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ 'brug lor 'phyong rgyas su sde pa hor gsod pa'i gshegs brdzongs gi 〈kyi 〉dbur spyan drangs pa bzhin 'phying ba stag rtser phebs shing mchod yon du gyur/ de nas 'bri gung du bzhuṭa skabs rta lor srid 'dzin sde pa mgon po dpal 'byor gyis (gyi 〉snying la lus med kyi lam nas 'phangs pa'i me tog gi mdas zin pa'i 〈pas 〉rje'i mdzad 'phrin laganod 'tshe mang du byas/ khyad par sku srog la brdo 〈sdo 〉bar brtsam pa na/de dag mkhyen nas byang 'bab rom du phebs/ 'bri gung du dus mi bde ཿཿ4

zhing gtam ngan gyi (gyis 〉phyogs mthar khyab pa sogs byung bar/ da da 'bri gung du mi 'gro gsungs par/ thel pa sogs rang phyos/sa kyi che phra thams cad kyis mgrin gcig gis nan gyis spyan drangs ste dus tshes bzangabar gdan sa chen po'i gser khrir mngal gsol/ dus der gser khang sgo bcad ma las/ nyid dbon rin po cher gyur skabs/ rje skyob pas/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi ma bde ba de 'dul 〈gdul 〉byar gyur 〈'gyur 〉pa 〈ba 〉lung bstan pa ltar/ sde pa skyi da shod pa (158na)yon bdag tu gyur/ rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i spor bzhugs nas chos sred lhan cig skyong bar mdzad/ dgung lo so bdun par chu blun rgyal mtshan gyis myos pa'i skye bos sbyor ngan gyi gsol ba zhus par/ de dag mkhyen yang pha rol pa'i 'dod pa tshim phyir gsol bas bkun gzugs 〈zug 〉drag pos 〈po'i 〉rnam pa cir yang bstan cing / rang phyogs thams cad nyams ngan gyis non/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ nga la o rgyan rin po ches khyod na ba zhig 'ong 〈'ongs 〉ste 'chi ba med gsungs pas grags 〈drag 〉'ong / dpon sa g.ya nga khug dam tshig dang ldan pas nga la brtan bzhugs phul dang rten 'brel yod gsungs par/ bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs sogs phul bas sku khams dwangs/ dus der bka' bsrung ma zhal gzigs/ sngon gyi dran snang mang du byung gsungs/ sgom pa rin chen rnam rgyal phag mor khab tu byon pa nas bzung / 'bri gung gi sgom par thog kha nang so zhes dang / phag mor khang gsar nang so zhes pa/ phan tshun gdung gcig pa'i sku mched la song bas 'bri gung khang thog ces gras/sa la/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen dpal rgyam sku mched (158ba)rnams phag mor 'khrungs shing / gdan sar mnga' 225

gsol bas 〈ba'i 〉rgyun gyis chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing brjes skabs de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉sras phag mo ba mi pham rin chen chos rgyal 'bri gung ge gdan sar bzhugs bzhed la/ rje 'di nyid gdan sa/ra mnga' gso la bas/ khang thog gnyis ma dan pas dus 'khrugs mang du byung /skabs shig dgum dus skabs rtse bar bzhugs dus phag mo bas gsang dmag yong nye byung bar sku 'khor ba rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉mtshan mo dar thoganas dmag byung na zon me chud pa 'dug zhus pas/ de nub gtu mo'i rnal 'byor gyi lang tsho ngosapar mdzad pas phyi nang phag rom man dar thams cad zhu bas ba rol gyi 'jigs pa dang bral zhing kun ngo ma du gyur/ yang skabs 'i/ga dmag gi 〈gas 〉pho brang la bskor bas nyen shin tu che ba byung bas bka' srungasal rbad bskul gnang bas/ dmagarnams bying rmugs 'jibs shing / blo bur 'jiṭa skrag chen po'i 〈pos 〉stong 'ur byas so/ skabs shig sos gtor skabs gtor bzlog gi gseraskyem/sa zor mda' rje rang gi 〈gis 〉'phen par mdzad bas/ thel gyi phun pha sbang la zug pa dang / phan yul nang pa zhing 'og pas gsung rab bzhengs pa'i rab gnas (156na)la spyan 'dren zhus pa'i 〈pas 〉phebs ma thub par rtse ba nas phyag nas gnang ba phan yul du chos 4dngos su babs pa thams cad kyis mthong / zhwa dmar lnga pa sku khams )ma pa'i tshul byung bar/ rje'i zhal nas zhwa dmar ba gshegs 'dug rgya gar gyi phyoṭa zhig 〈shig 〉na 'jag spyil zhig gi nang bzhugs snang / yang 'di'i gzim chung gi mthongs kha'i steng la byon nas gnas tshang g.yar dgos gsung ba che/gas/ byung bas/ sprul sku 'dir byon 〈'byon 〉pa 'dug gsung ba bzhin/ mi ring bar gar dbang chos kyi dbang byug rje 'di'i rigs/ sra // su bltams/ mtshe'u khar dad 'dus lnga stong lhag la rdo rje 226

phreng ba'i dbang gnang ba'i tshi/ dbang 'grem skabs las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dar lam gyi steng na gdan 'dren pa mthong / yang sku mtshams zhig gi dus gsol dpon sku zhabs su phyin skabs bzhuṭa gad la ma bzhuṭa 'dugaphebs pa yin nam snyam phyir thon pa tsam 〈brtsams 〉dus/ nga ma mthong ba yin nam gsungs bzhugs 'dug ma mjal zhus pas/ lo/ bo sog po bzlog tu bye — yin gsung ba sogs de lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ lha sar bas skabs nam mkha' (15 ba)la bcu gcig zhal dngos su gziṭa/rkarma pa sgar chen 'bri gung du phebs par mjal phrad gsol phogs sogs sngar srol ltar gnang / de skabs char zhod che grags 〈drags 〉sgar chen dang / lha sar chu nyen che bar/ garma pa dang / sde pa skyid shod pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor thugs mdun 〈'dun 〉gtad pa tsam kyis charayang chad chu yang bsgyur 〈'gyur 〉bas grub thob kyis 〈kyi 〉grags pas sagasum khyab/ skabs shig sgar chen 'bri gung du phebs te/ riṭa sras gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug ngos 'dzin/ rje la 'bul chen dang bcas sbrul sku bka' khrol zhus par/ thel pa sogs rang phyogs thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉chabs mi 'jug pa shar bas/ sgar chen thugs gtad che ba'i ngor/rje'i 〈rjes 〉bka' brgyud nang dkar ba dang / sprul sku gang du bzhugs kyangab na 'gro'i don yin pas/ da lam re zhig gdan sa gang du zabs kyang zla shas bzhugs nas/ mar 'bri gung du lo shas sku bskyed babyung ba zhal bzhes/ khri 'don gyi 'bul ba sku brdzongs sogs bsam kyisamikhyab pa gnang nas/ dpon slob yangs can du phebs/ rje nyid rtse bar snod ldan gyi 'dus pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs lcags stag gi lo la rigs sras dam (150na)pa dkon mchog rin chen227

dang / shing lug lor dkon mchog phun tshogs 'khrungs/ hor na dpal pha bus byang du spyan drangs pa bzhin lan 'ga' yar phebs pa'i skabs shig spod lha mo dom gyi ri rtser mtha' dmag gi kha gnon la rdo sa /yo /du ༷༷/ /ri / /sgokha shas da pa la phyag nas zhus par/ rgyang nga sar bas ga nas me tog 'thor bar rdo lhar me tog babs pa hor sog kun dad par myur/gaster sgom chu tshan du phebs/ skabs shig nam mkha' la gu ru pad ma nye sras brgyad sogs gzigs snang du ma byung / mkhar rtse bas〈ba'i 〉sde pa 'das par rgya mkhar sde ma lag tshang ma rje yab sras la phul/ mkhar rtser lan 'ga' yar phebs/ skabs shig dar byu mdor yung thang nag gu ba ja par phyin dus mdo pa'i dmag gi 'jigs pa byung ba ji lta ba gzigs shing thugs 'dun gtad pas 'jigs pa las grol/ byang bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras/ 'brug pa mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma/ chos lung mkhan chen byams pa chos rgyal sogs/ bla ma che dgu du mas rje'i zhabs la gtugs chos mang du zhus/ chab mdo rje drung bstan pa rgya ma sa rin po che'i rigs dang / rgya hor gyi dpyad 〈spyad 〉pa gos dar sogs (150ba)dngom che ba dpag tu med pa phul/ lcags byi lo'i dbyar riṭa sras chos rje rnam gsum gyis dbus che dgu du ma dang / rang gzhan phyogs mtha' nas 'dus pa grangs las 'das pa la rtse ba'i bzhugasakhri byang gziṭa mar gur chen khams gsum zil gnon phub te 〈ste 〉myang lugs bka' brgyad bde 'dus sgrub dbang chen mo sman sgrub dang 'brel ba spros bcas shin tu rgyas pa gnang ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur khyim/tsandan gyi phye mas sngag 〈sngaṭa 〉pa'i me tog gi char ya mtshan can babs pa/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sgrags 〈bsgrags 〉pa kun gyis thos pa/ sman sgrub skabs sman khang nas dril bu'i sgra dang / dri 228

ngad kyis phyogs mthar khyab pa/ dbang dang gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉sa/bas 'a/sa ldan rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉rje'i zhabs sa la ma reg par phebs pa/lha klu sde brgyad mthu bo che du mas mir sprul nas dbang gral la 'khod pa so/gas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas blo yul las 'das pa byung / lcags mo glang lo gzhu smad phu gu gdong du rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs 'debs par ba/nang zhing sa 'dul byin rlabs ma da/ de skabs 'bri gung thel pa'i blas 'ga' zhig gis blor ma 'a da pa'i sde dgon nang khul re 'khang che tsam/ byung kyang 〈yang 〉rje'i thugs rjes mi ring bar sor chud/ de (151na)nas zhing 'di'i 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rdzoṭa par nye ba na/ yangs ri sgar gyi 'dus pa rnams la bslab bya zhal gdams nan che ba gnang zhing / 'phral gyi rnam g.yeng la thugs sun pa'i tshul gyis sku mtshams rgyun ring tsam mdzad skabs gzigs snang mang du byung / de nas sku bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ chu stag lo'i khrums kyi zla ba'i ster bdun gyi snga char ting nge 'dzin kho na'i ngang gzugs sku'i snang brnyan chos sku sgos bral mkha' dbyings su bsdus/ de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos/'ja' tshon gyis bar snang thams cad khengs/ me tog gis 〈gi 〉char chen po babs/ sprin gseb nas lha rnams kyis lus byed thon nas mchodapa 'bul ba kun gyi (gyis 〉mthong / lha ldan gyi jo bo rin po che dang /rwa greng ga 'jam rdor/ gser khang chos rje rnams spyan chab mdzad pa dang / mdor na chibs so ba/sa dud 'gro rnams kyis kyang mya ngan byas/sku gdung rim/ po che lo byed gnyis bar rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang bzhugs shing / mchod pa mtha' yas bas mchod/ chog mang gi gral gtsor zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug dang / zang 'gyed kyi dbur stag lung kun dga' bkra shis spyan 'dren dang / gzim (151ba)mal gser ཿ

sku mi tshad tsam 'phral du grub/ gdung rten gser dngul las dbyen sdum ma chod rten thog tshad gnyis pa blo 〈glo 〉'bur rnams su sgo mang gi rnam pa rje 'di'i 'khrungs rabs dang rgyud sde'i lha tshoṭa kyis bskor ba rin chenadu ma'i phra mtshar 〈tshar 〉du dngar ba thub cing / shing 'brug nag zla'i nang du/ sku gdung mkhan chen rnama'ajoms pas zhugs 'bu sa mdzad pas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang / lha mi kun gyi yid dbang 'phrags/thugs ljags spyan gsum dbu skra skye dun khyad par can yin phyir sku sha me thub ma 'ga' zhig byon ba rnams/ gling rin po che'i khang gsar yang dgon du dbyen sdum nang bzhugs shing / chos kyi rje rigs sras dam pa rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad do/ rje 'di kha rnam thar logs su yod/ slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mchis pa las/ 'gran za dang bral ba rigs kyi sras rnam pa bzhi las/ rang re'i mtshungs med chosakyi rje bo rnam gsum ni 'og tu gsal la/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen ni 'phyong rgyas su 'khrungs/ rje ratna'i drung du rab tu byung / yangs ri sgar lhogs grwar bzhugs/ drung pa lcang gcig pa rin chen dpal las dam pa'i chos mang po gsan/ gzhan yang / dwags po bkra shis (153na)rnam rgyal/zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ sde tsha kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags soṭa rtsod bral gyi skyes bu dam pa du ma bsten/mdo sngags/ tha snya/da thams cad sbyangs/ 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra rags la gces par mdzad pa'i 'dul 'dzin gyi mchog tu gyur/ gtsang shag ram dang / gter sgom/ sgam po/ga na sa thel/ na tshal sogs su sgrub pa mang du mdzad/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa thugs su 'khrungs/ phyis rje cho rgyal mun mgasakyi sa la spyogs shing dbang chos mang du zhus/:sa

yangs ri sgar gyi chos khrims lan gnyis dang / shag ram mtshams bla lo bcu drug mdzad/ gnam mtsho'i se mo do la lo gsum sgom mdzad nas/zur re ban grong rdzong du brtan chags/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs zhing brjes pa'i gdung g.yog dang / dngul gdung bzheng ba'i thig rtsa 'a ba bkod mdzad/ rje sku mched gsum gyi dbu blar gyur cing gsararnying gi dbang chos du ma 'bul bar mdzad cing / dgung lo brgyad cu par sku gshegs so/ 'di la rnamathar logs su yod/ mkhan chen (143ba)rnam 'joms phun tshogs/ sa/ mkhan po gu ra ba'i rnam sprul 'khrul med mi na la/ rje chos rgyal kun tshogs kye drung du rab tu byung /rje dang mkhas grub du ma las dbang chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ nyams rtogs phul du phyin/ yangs ri sgar gyi mkhan po lo mang mdzad/ mdo khams sogs la lan mang byon/ 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la bkod/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i par bzhengs/ rje tsā ro pa/dkon mchog rin chen/ chos kyi grags pa gsum gyi dbu blar gyur cing / rdo rje 'chang zhes bsngags par mdzad/ rje dkon mchog rin chen gyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po yin la/ mkhan chen pa zhes grags so/paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ nag shod bra ma shākya rin chen/ rngod bla ma spangs mda' ba bkra shis dar rgyas/ ti se rdor 'dzin ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ la phyi rdor 'dzin kun dga' dpal ldan/ mgar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs sogs rim gnyis mthar son pa'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab so 〈bo/〉mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i mchog gi skur/ /'dul 〈gdul 〉// rlon /// / / sa /snan man/sa su/ /bkra shi/pas sa/ 1 /shā // rdo /pa ཿ

mtshan de rgyal/ /gdan sa nyer gcig pa/ 1 ro gnyis pa bkra shis/ phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ dam pa 'di ni yab mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po dang / yum /ba /zhe 11/ri /tsho 1po /ri /de sa mkha' 'a ma na ldan da na sa g.yang khug ma sras su/ nga khyi lo'i hor zla bcu gcig par/ gzhu smad sgo lung gi kun dga' ra ba'i nye 'dabs skyes 〈skyed 〉mos tshal du dge mtshan gyi ltas phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas/ zas gtsang sras don kun grub pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad mtshungs pa/ skye dgu mtha' dag gis mthong ma thag yid la dga' ba'i dpal yon ster nus pa dang ldan pa sku 'khrungs so/ de nas cher skyed pa na/ gzhon nu rgyan dang ldan pa du mas bskor nas rol rtsed mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten las khyad par 'phags pa'i skye bo'i bya ba las mngon par 'das pas/ chos 'chad dang / gar dang dbyangs dang dbang bskur ba sogs mdzad pa dang yi ge dang bstan bcos gtsug lag thams cad la blo gros dang / spobs pa dang ldan cing / khyad par slob dpon dkon mchog dbang po ces 〈zhes 〉pa las gsung rab ji snyed kyi bee 'don mtha' dag sngaṭa kyi sdeb sbyor (153ba)soṭa chung ngu nas byang chubapar mdzad cing / 'jig rten lugs kyi gtsug lag ji snyed dang / tha na sgra snyan rol mo'i rigs mi mkhyen pa med par mdzad shing 〈cing / 〉'phags yul gyi grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba dra ro pa'i rnam 'phrul rtsod med du grags/ yab rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po'i drung / 'bri gung pa'i chos mdzod byu dang / khyad par zab mo lnga ldan gyi skya bar nas gzhi khrid gsan cing / rtogs pa'i don mngon du gyur/ gzhan yang rdo je phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga pa/ bde gshegs 'dus pa dkyil 'khor man sgrub dang 'brel ba sogs gsar rnying gi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ཿ 3

mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'joms rdo rje la byang gaster sogs snga 'gyur gyi chos mang du gsan/ drung pa rin chen dpal/ lho pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal sogs las chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes/ mnyam med dzi/ma po pa maṅga'i mtshan gyi drung rab tu byung ba'i mtshan bkra shis phun tshogs graṭa pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ dgung lo brgyad nas bcu drug pa'i bar thel byang chub gling rin po cher spros bcas spros med rim gnyis kyi nyams bzhes kyis dus 'da' bas thugs dam gyi rtsal 'don mdzad/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug pa la/ bsam yas mi 'gyur (164na)lhun grub kyi gtsug lag khang du phebs nas/ rten gsum rnams la mchod pa dang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i smon lam mdzad/ chosaskyong gi 〈gis 〉bsu ba sogs gus pas btud/ de'i tshe/ 'phyong rgyas nas spyan 'dren zhus ltar phebs/ 'bul zhabs bzang zhing phar yang lugs gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉tshim par mdzad/ tshur lam sde pa skyid shod pas gzhis kha brag dkar du gdan drangs/ zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas/ dbang chos 'dod mos re ba bskangs/ de nas rgyal chen rtser phebs/ mkhar rtse ba sogs phan yul stod smad kyi sde dpon thams cad kyis ja 'dren 'bul zhabs mtha' las 'das pa byas/ dbang chos mang du gnang / de 'phral stag lung nas gdan 'dren byung bas phebs/ stagalung pa'i mkhan slob kyis gtso byas skya ser thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉chibs thabs 〈thab 〉kyi bsu ba dang / dge 'dun rnams kyis ser zengs rgyas par bstar/ chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang mjal phrad ma da cing /phan tshun chos kyi gtam bgro ba mdzad pa dang / tshoṭa su chos kyi 'khor lo zab rgyas 'grel bshad dang bcas pa gnang bas/ chos rje ngag gi dbang pos sku na phra mo 'di 'dra nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chad pa'i 233

/pa // //ma /sa /sngo /rjernam dbyad 154ba grabs pa 'ad 'dra ba na sbyangs rang 'dug sasu yi rang gsungs cing / der gam/pa she pa'i bye dgu zar/sa cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ de —/sa rtse bar mtshungs med yab rje'i drung bzhus/sa te mi ring bar/ mkhar rtse ba'i sde pa yab sras 'das par/ de'i tshe dpon sa dponablon ltos bca ra tham/sa cad kyis gcis ma lag tshang ma phul/ yangs ri sgar pa la skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi zab chos soṭa dbang chos mang du gnang / dgun der gdan sa chen po byang chub gling du phebs/thog kha gser khang du bzhuṭa/ 'dus par dbang khrid lung du ma bstsal/gling gi bca' sgrig gi rnam bzhag dam par mdzad/ de nasagaza' tshes skar sbyor bzang por dpon slob shin tu mang bar mkhar rtser phebs/chibs bsu dar 'phyar dung 'bud soṭa rgyas par bstar/ rgyun rgyangs par bzhugs/ phan yul khog gi dpon rigs tshang mas gdan zhus 'bul zhabs bzang bar byas/ gang la gang 'tsham luṭa gnyis kyis tshim par gnang / de nas 'bri gung du phebs/ yab rje'i drung 'bul ba dang mjal mi shin tu mang ba byung bar dbang chos kyi re ba bskangs/ byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po phebs ba la gsan pa phran tsheg mdzad/ de nas mkhar rtser (155na)phebs/ de skabs phag mo ba sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉dmag bzod par dka' ba'i dpung gi 〈gis 〉bskor bar/ nyin re bzhin glags lta bas rang srid rnams skrag shing 〈cing 〉dpa' zhum par nye ba na/ nyid kyis skyon mi yong ba'i gsung gi snang ba kho nas dbugs dbyung / khyad par go 'debs zhig 〈shig 〉gi tshe dmag gi rgyab dpung du chos rje bar le ba zhes pas gtor rgyag byas/ dmod bcol sogs rngam rngam mang po byas pa la/ mi kun gyi 〈kyis 〉'di stag lung chos rje'i bla g.yang yin/ mthu stobs dang nus pa chen po yin/ sku rim bzhin leṭa po 23

ma mdzad ma/ leṭa po min zhus pa'i tshe/ de tsam nyis skyom med/ nged rang gi mcha na byus kyang legs po yong la/ khong rang la legs tshogs chen po yong ba med gsungs/ de'i tshe dmag sgar la ltas dang cho 'phrul mi shis pa ba tshogs byung / chos rje bar le ba yang zla ba de kha'i nang du 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltas 〈ltad 〉mor song ba sogs pha rol gyi dpung des rang phyog ci yang ma thub par zla ba sgra gcan las rgyal ba ltar gyur/ de nas lcags byi lo la rtse bar yab mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po'i drung /bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub chen lung bcas yongs rdzogs gsan/ de'i dgun der yab sras lhan (155ba)gcig 〈cig 〉mkhar rtser phebs/ zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku ba/nga mjal phrad leb/sa tshogs gnang / lcags mo glang gi lo gsar ma thag rje yab sra5 ba gsum zhal 'dzoms shing dar 'phyar rol mo'i bye brag khrol ba/ skye bo rnams rta rgyugs bro shon sogs byed pa/ nam mkha' nas kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja' gzhis na la zug pa sogs bkra shis dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dus mtshungs 'grigs pa dang / lhan cig rje 'di'i rigs kyi sras dam pa mtshan dpe dang ldan par bltams te/ rje zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug ma/sa bstan pa'i nor bu zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gdung rgyud ngo mtshar ba zhig 'khrungs so/ zhes phyogs kun snyan pas khyab/ rang srid stos bcas rnams sum rtsen gyi gnas la co 'dri ba'i dga' ston gyis dus 'da' bar byas/ lo der gzhu smad phu gu gdong du pho brang bkra shis tshugs rmang gting 〈'ding 〉ba'i dbu 'dzug 〈tshugs 〉par/rje pa ba sras kyisas 'dul byin rlabs mdzad nas/ mi ring bar yab rje btsum/ chos kyi rgyal po sku'i snang brnyan 'gro 'di'i zhing du mi snang ba'i tshul du gyur pa la/ rje 'dis gong ma'i bka' drin gsob pa dang /235

1ga1do / 14 /ste ཿ//gnas skabs dang mthar thug na na sgrub par da ngas / sku gdugi mchod pa (1cacan)dang / dngul gdung bzhengs pa sogs dgongs rdzogs gi 〈kyi 〉rim pa brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa gnang / chu yos lor gdan sa chen po'i seng ge'i khrir rje 'di mnga' gsol/ rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs rgya khyon shin tu che ba bzo bkod rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sa la 'phos pa lta bu/ stag gdong rtser gzim khang lcang lo can dang / mtha' bskor lcags ri chen po sogs rmang gting 〈'ding 〉ba nas mthar thon pa yud tsam gyis grub par mdzad de/ de mnyam sgrub brgyud rinapo che 'di nyid kyi gdan rabs yongs rdzogs kyi bris thang bzheng ba gnangaste rab gnas dga' ston phyogs gcig par mdzad/ mi ring bar byang nas sog po'i dpon kha dan pā thur zhes pa mthu med kyi dmag ltos mi chung ba slobs nas/ hor stod pa dang sdongs nas/ bod phal cher dbang du bsdu bar brtsams te/ klung shod brgyud nas rdzong gi khad nyer sleb pa na/ hor dpon nam g.yul rgyal gyi 〈kyis 〉gtsos rang srid kyi dmag gi tshoṭa tsham tshom med par phyin te pha rol po cham la phab/ rjes kyang mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor mang du gnang bar phar log mi rnams kyi mthong snang du bud med mang po dmag gi rjes la byung ba dang / khyi (155ba)spyang gi tshoṭangu ba/ sde thog tu thog babs pa/ spra nang du sbrul rgyu ba sogs mi rung ba'i ltas dang / nyes byed gtso bo 'brum nag gi 〈gis 〉gum/ de'i lhag ma yang bsdu med du song ba tsam byung / skabs shig gling rin po cher nag khrims dang bca' yig chen mo mdzad/ sngar srol ltar dgun chos la chosadrug gnang / gtum mo'i lang tsho ngom pa'i ras pa brgya phrag byed gnyis kyis bla g.yel du ras phud dang / phyag bskor gsol 'debs tshogs 'khor 'gyed sogs bzang bar gnang / lha ldan du phebs pa'i skabs 236

shig sa/tsang stod rgyal po'i sku jus mngon mtho'i mgo zug ste/ ga tsang dar smyon chen po jo bo'i spyan sngar sang ba la/ lha srin 'khrug 〈'khruṭa 〉pas rlung dmar ma rungs pa zhig langs te rdo char babs pa dang yul kun rdeg cing ljon shing rnams cog 〈gcog 〉la nye ba'i dus/ der 'khod skye bo grangs med kun gyis dar ma lhongs pa la/ rje 'di la gsol ba btab pa na thugs 'dun gtad pa'i mod la zhi ste spyod yul bde bar gyur pas/'byung bzhi la dbang bsgyur bar nges pa'i grub thob kyi grags pa chen po byung / skabs shig yangs ri sgar gyi mkhan por 〈po/〉 gcung 'bring ba rje btsun (15 na)dkon mchog rin chen la gnang ste khams phyogs subardzong ba gnang / rje nyid gter sgom dang / tsha 'ug rnams su phebagaphyag zhabs kyis 〈kyi 〉rjes mang du gnang / mi ring bar sgar pa dpon slob rnams yar byon grub par/ rje 'di la 'bul ba mtha' yas pa phul/mtshams grwa brje len la gzhis byes kyi 'dus pa ltos che bar dbang chos mang du gnang / chu byi lor gzhu rta 'ur gsang sngags mchog grub gling gi sgrub sde gsar 'debs dang / mtshams grwa lnga bcu lhag tsam ba nga ba gnang / sgar gyi mkhan por 〈po 〉gcung sku gzhon pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad nas/ byang phyogs hor brgyud khams phyogs la phebs/ rje 'di 'bri gung du 'dus pa shin tu che bar myang lugs bka' brgyad kyi dbang sgrub chen mo sman sgrub dang 'brel bar 'dzug 〈'dzuṭa 〉pa gnang ba'i tshe/'ja' 'od dang me tag gi char/ man gyi dri ngad soṭa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung ba ni/ der 'dus rnams kyis mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ de nas gdan sa chen po chos srid kyi khur/ rje dkon mchog rin chen la phul ste/ kun spangs gi 〈kyi 〉tshul gyi (gyis 〉gter sgrom/ po lung / khra ba kha'i bde (15 ba)chen sding sogs su 337
