bzhugs/ dad 'dus rnams la gang ra gang mtshams 〈'a ༷ma 〉chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ sgar pa dpon slob ma ra byor nas/ dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba tshad las 'das pa ram thos kyi bu yang bag khums par phul/ rdzong gi ra sogs lcang rar gzhis byes sogs 'dus pa grangs las 'das pa la rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga pa'i dbang yongs rdzoṭa bstsal ba gegs med grub/ skabs shig spro lung du drang srong dri med kyi bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉gnang skabs/ nub dang par shen tu zil che bzhig byung ba'i mod rje rin chen phun tshogs na bza' dkar chas kyi steng du sku mas dmar po dang / dbu zhwa padma kha dbud bzhes pa zhig11 19 /ste —— —— 14 /re(1dang / nga nga da ra thun nga du sgrub pa la dang / gzhan yang drang srong zhi drag gi snang ba kha shas/ o rgyan rin po che/ rje gong ma mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po rnams dngos su gsal bar gzigs/yang nyin gcig mdun gyi bar snang la bum pa dkar po mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa zhig gzigs pas slar dung dkar du bsgyur/ zhog 〈zhogs 〉thun zhig la byi'u co ga zhig gi skad las/ ci byed ci byed/da lta'i che chos che chos/ 'khor ba'i bya ba 'khor ba'i bya ba/ ti ti ) ma/ bskor (158na)bskor bskor bskor/ hrul gyis bor rgyal gyis bor/ zer bar gsan pas/ drang srong dri med 'od zer nyid kyi sprul pas 'khor ba'i zhen pa spong bar bskul bar mkhyen/ gzhan yang dus kun 'a ma dpal gshin rje dang / ye shes kyi mgon po/ a phyi chosakyi sgrol ma sogs gzigs snang mtha' yas so/ skabs shig mda' lnga pas rlams 〈brlams 〉pa'i mi ngan 'ga' zhig dang / rigs sras dam pa gdung rgyud bstan pa'i nor bu/ lcam sring dpon sa phun tshogs rnams 〈rnam 〉gnyis kyis 〈kyi 〉mdzad spyod la brten/ zhal ngo nang zhig byung /338

po ri kyi sped na ba/sa rnams sa/ zhwa dmar drug pa spyan drangs/ gas la mdzad kyang / mthar chud pa ma byung bar/ chos srid kyi thugs khur gdung cu da pas mdzad/ rje 'di nyang po 'bras rnamar su phebs/ slarasgo lung du bla ma snang gsal ba sogs la bka' brgyad kyi dbang sgrub chen yongs rdzogs gnang / mi ring bar gtsang pa'i sde srid nas rje 'di la thuṭa khur bzhes dgos gsol ba ltar mdzad nas bzhugs skabs/ skyid shod sde pa a dpal gyis rang byog mched ba'i/'i nang mtshan 〈tshan 〉'phab/sa pa lo ki sha ra sog por brngan nas/ mthu med kyi dpung chen po bsku la te/ rje 'di byang (168ba)du spyan drangs par sog yul du phebs nas lo shas bzhugs/ ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang du bstan cing / der sog po rnam sa dad pa skyes/ mi ring bar mdzad pa mtha' ma ston par bzhed nas/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i sa 'brug hor zla bdun ba'i yar tshes bcu gsum la cho 'phrul dang bcas rnam grolazhi ba chen po'i chos kyi dbyings su thim mo/ der sku gdung yin khul gyi lug sha zhig zhugs phul bar/ ring bsrel mang du byung bar sog po rnams tab thob byas/ sku gdung dngos sku 'khor ba rnams kyis yar spyan drangs/ bi ri'i sgang du zhugs phul bas/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung / gdung rus rnams 'bri gung du gdan drangs/ dngul gdung rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i nang du bzhugs pa/ da lta khang gsar yang dgon du bzhugs/ dgongs rdzoṭa ser tshoṭa sogs sngar rgyun ltar grub so 〈bo/〉 de ltar rje 'di la rnam thar rje dkon mchog rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i mdor bsdus zhig las rgyas par ma mchis/ slobama' tshogs grangs las 'das kyang lo rgyus ma mthong bas 'dir bri ba ma lang / rigs sras gdung rgyud bstan pa'i nor bu ni/ gong smos phan 23

yul mkhar rtsir lcags mo glang lor sku 'khrungs/ (15 na)rje sku mched bzhi las gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan/ sku chas rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dkar chas mdzad/ rta / tu sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs la brtson zhing / phyis dgung lo nyer bzhi pa shing byi lor sprul pa bsdus/ pur sbyangs pa'i tshe thugs ljags spyan gsum byon pa'i lo rgyus tsam sa rnam thar logs su ma mthong / rje zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi lo rgyus gzhan du gsal lo/gang gi mkhyen pa'i 'grel bshad 'od zer gyis/ /klu zhabs gnyis pa'i rdor gsung zang rtsi 'dzin/ /legs par phye nas 'gro sa tshim mdzad pa//chos dbyings rang grol zhabs des 'gro kun skyong 〈 skyongs 〉//gdan sa nyer gnyis pa rje btsun dkon mchog rin chen ni/ de yang 'phagasapa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar dam bcas pa bzhin/ 'phags yul dang bod 'dir chos rgyal dge ba'i bshes gnyen soṭa du ma'i skur sprul pa sa/ rgyal po bka' 'bum/ bka' gdams gleṭa bam/ rang re'i gsol 'debs/ pad 'byung a nyi dang / rab 'byams rgyal ba mar 'khod pa ltar dang / skabs 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho de nyid zhing brjes nas/ slar yang zhing 'dir (15 ba)sprul pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sems can gyi don du gang la gang 'dul gyi sku'i skye ba star nas star (la )brgyud pa dang / dus gcig la du mar sprul pa dang byin gyis brlabs pas sprul pa sogs zla ba gcig las chu nang gzugs 'bum phrag 'char bltar/ 'bri gung 'dir rje btsun mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs dang / yum g.yang khug ma gnyis las sras bzhi'i che shos rje dra ro pa gong smos ltar dang / de 'og zhwa dmar drug pa/ de 'og dam pa 'a 240

yin la/ de yang sku sngon ma/ bar do dag pa ye shes kyi sku zangs mdogadapal rir o rgyan gyi drung du byon pa dang / mngal du phebs pa'i skabs sogs shin tu gsal ba/ phyis su gsung ba gzigs snang gsa'i zeg 〈zags 〉mar gsal ba ltar las/ rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i sgo'i pho brang der yum gyi mngal du phebs nas lcags stag lor zla ba brgyad song ba'i tsheblo bur du snyan sogs ma dod pa'i ba spus g.yoṭa pa zhig 'khrungs/ de'i tshe dgun dus yin kyang 'brug sgra chen po dang / mi tog gi char babs/ yum dang sku 'khor 'gas 'di mi bzhugs pa 'dra zhus pas/yab rjes bdag la mi zhig gis dung dkar zhig gtad pa rmis pas skyon med dam gsungs/ 'khrungs snga bas yum gyi nu zho bri bas gad la hor (1 ༷na)pa'i mdzo mo dkar mo zhig gi 'o mas bskyed bsrings nas/dgung lo gsum tsam gyi ma gzim chung rgya mthongs gi 〈kyi 〉nam mkha' gzigs pa'i rkyen gyi 〈kyis 〉lhag mthong gi ye shes ji lta ba gzigs/de skabs sngon gnas rjes dran gsal po byung bas/ thams cad mkhyen ba'i sprul skur thag bcad nas/ thog mar rje'i zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' zhig byung nas phyag rnga dang / ku tig gi phreng ba dang / phyag ḍar sogasasku chas 'ga' zhig phul/ rjes su phyag mdzod seng ge byung bas kyang 'khrul med ngos zin rung sogs 〈sog 〉yul du yon tan rgya ma 'khrungs pas de phyogs su song / yab rjes kyang 'bri bstan la dgongs gdan mi 'dren pa'i thabs ma da/ yi ge bris klog nas brtsams mdo rgyud rig gnas mtha' dag bad tsam gyis thugs su chud/skabs shig yab rje tshoms kyi ku gdong du bzhugs par spyan ras gzigs dngos su gzigs/ klu gong rgyal pos glags bltas pa na yab rje'i zhal khro zhal bstan pas glags ma rnyed/ dgung lo dgu la yab rje 3 /

btsun chos kyi rgyal po'i drung rab tu byung b.ri mtshan / chos rgyal rin chen chos kyi gags pa rgyal mtshan du gsol bas kun gyi (gyis 〉'khyor 〈sgor 〉dka' ba byung bas/ dkon mchog rin chen zhes gsol/dgung lo bcu gnyis par yab chos kyi rgyal (1 0 ri) poX bka' brgyadabade gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub chen mo gsan pa'i tshe gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba byung / gzhan yang gsar rnying gi cho sa mang du gsan/ khyadapar bde mchog dang / mgon po'i dbang gi dus lha gnyis na dngos su gzigs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par chos kyi rgya po bsnyung tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ sku zhebs su byon pas sku zo ngan pa ra 'dug pas thugs skyo ba la tshad ma byung bar/ der yab kyi padma bdud 'dul la sogs gnang nas nga skyon med dam gsungs/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa na sku gdung gi mchod 'bul dang zags/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rin chen las/ gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang / kye rdor/ bde mchog drugacu pa/ gshin rje lcags sdig sogs gsar rnying gi gdams pa mang du gsan/ mi ring bar dngul gdung grub nas/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul skabs rje nyid kur sgo'i zad du yod par/ thag sgra dang bcas zhal 'gram gyi tshal dum me thub ma zhig nyid kyi sku srung 〈pang 〉du byung / de nasadangu lagadung sgrigs pa rab gnas sogs (la/) rje dra ro pa thel du chabs/ sde 'di rdzong gsar du bzhugs pas/ gad la hor du dpon mgon pos spyan drangs zhor/ zur rer phebs pas khrom seb 〈gseb 〉nas/ rgan mo mgo dkar ma zhig thal gyi byung chibs mthur (1 1na/lasabazung nas/ khyed kun dga' nor bu byon nam zer ba zhig byung bar sprul pa zhig yin par mngon/ ra 'dzab tu jo bo mjal bar phebs ma/sto gcig nal gyi sku shin tu che ba zhig gzigs/ de nas zhwa dmar 243

chos kyi dbang phyug thel du dngul gdung rab gnas la phebs bar rje 'a yang phyag phyir phebs/ gser khang chos rje rin po che bzhad ba'i tshems gzigs/ de nas rdzong du phebs nas dgung lo bcu drug pa la/ zhwa dmar ba'i drung dge tshul gyi sdom pa gsan/ mtshan chos kyi 'byung gnas 'phrim/ las rna she rgya ba du gsol/ de nyid las dus kyi 'khor lo byis pa 'jug ba'i dbang bdun/ spyong rgyud bcu gnyis sogs dbang chos mang du gsan/ yang sangs rgyapa rin chen las/ gsar rnying gi gdams pa du ma dang / mkhan chen rnam 'joms kun tshoṭa las/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i zab chos/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa/ zab la dra ro'i chos drug sogs gsan cing gtum mos thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs/ rtse bar gshin rje'i gshed kyi ba pa mdzad pas/ bud med gcer mo zheg gi 〈gis 〉rasa'i phreng ba dang phur bu 'bul ba dang / de nas spro lung du phebs skabs nang ga ga gzim mal sngas mgor bcu gcig (1 1ba)zhal gyi sku li dkar las grub pa chung ngu zhig dang / ju ma bum 'o zhig skyal 〈bskyal 〉'dug par/ de dus 'phags pa yar snying nor bu'i skor dag snang byung /dgung 'o bcu bdun par gcen po rje cho ro gnyis pa las phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi stams khrid gsan pas gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ mi ring bar yum drung sku ltem pa'i bsnyung g.yogs 〈g.yog 〉mdzad cing / gshegs pa'i tshe da /ngas rdzogs rgya che ba gnang / drag podamar chen gyis 〈 kyi 〉sgrub pa mjad pa'i nyin gcig ser ba babs pas gas btab pas chad pa dang / drag ngo ma sku ri tsam zhig gzigs/rta mgrin byer sgang pa'i bsnyen dru ba ma ra zhes ska bas bskyed rim brten 〈brtan 〉par byung ba'i dbu sa/tsug tu spyo skad 'char ba kun gyis thos pa 243

byung / yang dad ldan 'ga' zhig la seng gdong ma'i dbar gnang ba'i dus/ tsa na lis sgra 'byin pa dang / bdud rtsi byur 〈'byur 〉ba byung /de nas yangs ri sgar gyi mkhan po mdzad nas/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la mkhan chen rnam 'joms las bsnyen par rdzogs shing / gdan gcig mdzad cing sku btsun pa'i mthar thug par gyur/ skabs shig bstan bsrungs ma'i bsnyen bsgrub gnang ba'i tshe/ a phyi chos kyi sgro' mas rje nyid thub pa bsod snyoms par lung bstan pa dang / rnam mang mkha' 'gro ma'i bdab bstod 'di mdzad (1 1na)pa byung / yang dam can rdo legs byis pa ra thogs g.yang lhug can zhig gis shog sgril —zhig phyag la phul nas/ 'di zangs mdog dpal ri nas ma hā gu rus gnang ba yin zer bar ga gas pas bla ma sku bzhi'i chos skor dang /yang skabs shig nam mkha'i mthongs su rje btsun mi lar tshe ring mchod lngas bskor bar ga gas pas de nyid las snyan rgyud bdud rtsi mig 〈 gas 〉pa'i skor sogs zab chos kyi dag snang mang du byung / mi ring bar byang lam rgyud 〈brgyud 〉hor dpon gyi sde dang nag shod rnams su zabs/ rgyal po me long gdong zhes pa gdug can zhig yang 〈kyang 〉chos la bkod/ dad 'dus che bar dbang chos du ma bstsal/ ya ngal rten /mi 11 1de /sto /cho 1—— /sathang rgyud brgyud zla ma na du bas/ ra rgya na sa sa dbu'adus pa ltos che bar dbar chos mang du gnang / bde steng / ba dan dgon/ 'brong pa'i sde dkyil rnams su phebs/ so so nas 'bu zhabs rgya che ba dang / 'dod chos kyang du ma bstsal/ der zhwa dam mchog gi sprul sku sgar chen phebs par mjal bod dang / gzhi bdag zor dor zhes pa mthu rtsal can zhig la dge bsnyen gye sdom pa bstsal/bod rgyan da /na dkar du so/na dob/sa che ba byung ri nga sga/ra — smug ba'i 344

yol ba btang bas sog pos (1 1ba)ma mthong bas skyon du ma rtser/rim bzhin 'ba' stod smad du phebs/ stod pas 'bul zhabs bzang zhing 'dod chos dang / sku rim du mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlog gnang / 'ba' dpon khag gi kha mchu che ba 'dug pa bsdum par mdzad pas/ dpon smad pas bka' dang 'gal bar/ sde rnams chus khyer ba byung / khra ma mgor rdo rje gro lod byu sgrub mdzad pa'i nub gcig yud tsam lho nub rnga yab gling du phebs par der yul dang pho brang sogs gsol 'debs nyi ma lho nub ma dang mthun par gzigs pa dang / yang mtho 〈tho 〉rang 〈rangs 〉kha zhig la rdo rje gro lod dngos su gzigs/tha ri phyogs kyi byang lam rgyud 〈brgyud 〉li thang du phebs/ dga' ldan thams cad mkhyen pa'i grwa sa sogs dad 'dus kyi tshogs che bar dbang chos sogs lugs gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉tshim par gnang / de nas sgar mang dar rtse mdor byon/ rje nyid rab sgang rgya mo bza'i lha khang du gu ru dragapo'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i tshe/ de'i rgyab ri bzhag ra'i lha gangs yin 'dug par/ snga phan bla ma sus kyang dbang chos tsam byas na tshub lhong yod 'dug par/ de skabs nyin re bzhin thog ser sgril 〈'brel 〉marabyung / nyin gcig rje'i dbu steng la thog me rdza ma tsam 'khor zhing sdad 〈bsdad 〉nas/ dar gcig nas sku g.yas su (173na)brag 'del 〈del 〉zhig la rgyab 〈brgyab 〉nas zhig la khad byung / de nub kyang lha 'dre'i dmag mang du 'dus cho 'phrul cher ston par/ lta ba'i bskyed rim gyis gzir bas glags ma rnyed/ phyis 〈phyi 〉nub dge bsnyen bzhag ra nang tshang dang bcas 'ong 〈'ongs 〉skyabs sdom zhus/ gtso bo'i ming yon tan phreng bar gnang / mdor thor pas khyab che yang nyer 'tshe ci yang ma 'gos/ sgar mang byon bsan/ li thang dang 245

'bum nyag gzhung rgyud 〈brgyud 〉ri bo che/ spang chig yo nag dgon rnams su phebs/ so so nas bsnyen bkur 'bul ba mtha' yas pasamachod/ dbang chos zang zing sogs lugs gnyis kyi re ba bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas 'bri gung du phebs/ gling rin po che'i bla g.yel du rje sku mched la sku skyes/ gser dngul gos dar ja rta nor sogs grangs las 'das pa dang / gtsug lag khang so sor mar me snyan dar 'phan sogs mchod rdzas dang / mkhan slob chos gsum che khag la rnam bzhag tshogs/ su 'gyed chen sogs stobs che bar gnang / de nas sgar gyi zugs khur gcung la gnang ste/ nyid tsā ri tra dang nyi ser sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad dgongs kyang / rje sku mched kyi 〈kyis 〉dbus rang phyopa sa che phra tshang mas nan gyis shol 〈bshol 〉bar/ phel (1 3ba)khang gsar byang ma'i gzim zugs 〈zug 〉tu lo gsum bcad rgya mdzad/ dgun dus zla ba bcu gnyis par/ rje shā ro pa'i bkas bskulabar/ sngar srol bzhin/ dgun chos tsā ro'i chos drug gi khrid dang /dwags po'i tshogs chos kyi bshad pa gnang / ras pa rkyang pa nyis brgya dang / snam sbyar sum brgya lhag gi 〈gis 〉gtum mo'i lang tsho ngom pa'i gral gtsor rje sku mched kyang bzhugs/ de dus mdun gyi chu'i dar dang /ri sdebs kyi chu mgo rnams dang / mdor na mtshams pa'i chu ra tshun 'khyag rom zhig pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / dus der ga po rje nor bu rgyan pa yang phebs ras tsho mdzad cing / bka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i babs shig 'dir 'dug ngo mtshar che gsungs/de nas sku mtshams gi 〈kyi 〉mus su bzhugs te/ bde mchog mgon bo/ sgol dkar/ yang zab kyi lha bsnyen phal cher sogs bsnyen sgru mdzad pa'i/ rtag 〈rtags 〉mtshan gzhung dang mthun pa byung / lo 246

gsum thems par bye ba na/ rje dra ro pa dang / mkhan chen rnam 'jomasapas nan gyi gsol ba ltar/ dgung lo nyer drug pa shing yos lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu sa/sum sbyor byed bzang por/ gdan sa'i gser khrir zhabs bkod/ gcen po dang (174na)mkhan chen pas dbus 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i shis brjod me tog 'thor/ rang gzhan mchog dman mtha' dag nas legs snyes 'bul ba sngar srol las bzang bar phul/ mi ring bar byang du hor dpon rkarma g.yul rgyal gyis spyan drangs par phebs/ 'bul ba bsnyen bkur rgya che ba byung bar lugs gnyis kyis tshim par gnang /sgod lha mo rnam kyi rtse mor rje gong ma tsho'i phyag bris rdo lhar/ rab gnasal phebs dus/ gnyan chen thang lhas bya rgod la sprul nas gus pa'i rnam mas btud/ de nas 'ji gung du phebs/ gling gi gtsug lag khang la mchod 'bul/ 'dus par mang 'gyed gnang / mkhar rtse sogs su phebs/ dbang chos mang bar gnang / klu gong rgyal pos kyang gus 'dus 〈'dud 〉byas/ de nas rdzong gsar du bzhugs/ zhabs drung sgar pa rnams mdo khams nas yar phebs grub par/ rje dra ro pas rdo rjephreng ba'i dbang gnang bar gsan/ de'i che gser khang mdo ma'i thub pa'i gser sku 'di bzhengs mdzad/ de nas rje zhwa dmar drug pa sgar chen mdo khams nas phebs/ ra sogs thang du sgar btab gsol phogs sngar srol ltar gnang / zhwa dmar ba'i drung rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs zos kha shas gsan nas/ sgar chen phyir phebs/ (174ba )rje 'di thel du sku mtshams la bzhugs pa la/ lus med kyi lam nas 'phangs pa'i mdas snying la zin pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di'i nye gnas dge slong ma tha sbyor ngan gyi 〈kyis 〉lnga mar gtang 〈btang /〉 rje byu mchedanang zhig byung / nyid phyogs nges med sa phebs pa dgongs nas thugs ཿ

thag bcad pa'i tshe/ rang srid rnams kyis zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku spyan drangs te lha mi thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉nan gyi bshol bar/ khri thog gi thugs khur gdung rgyud par phul ste/ nyid thel du sku mtshams mdzad/ skabs shig nyang po brgyud de brag dkar lha chur phebs/ de nas slar gsang thabs kyi 〈kyis 〉lha ldan sogs su phebs nas thel du skumatshams/ kyi mus su bzhugs/ skabs shig zhog phur mthu med kyi dmag dpung che ba 'byor pa 〈pas 〉gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs pas gus pas btud/ skabs shig gtsang nas sde srid kyi sku tshab gnang nas/gong zos thugs sun gyi rtsa ba byed mi rnams khrims rar btsud 〈'dzud 〉par brtsam pa na/ rje 'dis thugs rje chen pos rgyal khrims las skyobs par mdzad pas/ rje dra ro pa thugs shin tu dgyes/ de nas lho nasachos rgyal pho brang pas zhal ngo zhig 'das pa'i sar spyan drangs par phebs/ khra 'brug (1 ngan)gi mchod mjal dang / thang ston gyi gral dbur phebs/ 'bul nod rgya che ba bstar te bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa mdzad/ der 'dus rnams la dbang chos gang la gang mos gnang / shel brag gi gnas gzigs mdzad/ de'i tshe 'bri gung du sog po mthu med rgyugs/ rje 1 ro pa sog yul du spyan drangs 'dug par/nyid re zhig tshur phebs bde ba ma byung / gdan sa chen mo dpal gyi phag mo gru dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang / chims phu rnamasakyi gnas gzigs zhib mor mdzad/ chos skyong gi 〈 sa 〉'das ma 'ongs kyi lung bstan phul/ mi ring bar gtsang pa'i dpung chen 'byor te/ rang srid kyi mnga' 'bangs sa ris phyir 'khyar ba rnams sngar mal byu chud pa byas/ shing byi lor rnam rgyal chos ring der sa btsan gyi pho sang chen po byu sar yags pa rmang gting 〈bting 〉 bar myur bar grub34

cing rnam chal chos rdzong du grags/ lo der gdung rgyud bstan pa'i norabu zhing khams 'phros 〈'phos 〉par/ ser tshogs kyi 〈kyis 〉mtshon dgongs rjogs kyi rim pa sngar rgyun ltar gnang / de nas phan yul za dam du phebs/ gcen po zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug dang mjal zad/zang (175ba)zing gi skyes 'bul dang / chos 'ga' zhig gsan/de skabs lugs gnyis kyi thugs khur rje 'dis gnang skabs yin par/da cha gcung la phul nas kun spangs gi 〈kyi 〉tshul du bzhugs na dgongs pa bzhin/ sku mched bka' gros mdzad nas 'bri gung du phebs/ me stag lor gcung chos kyi grags par gdan sa'i thugs khur phog 〈'bog 〉par gnang / skabs shig rgya nag nas lung las gser yig 'bul mi byung bar/ rnam rgyal chos rdzong du ba'e/sa/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs gi 〈kyi 〉gral dbur spyan drangs par phebs/ zhabs drung dbon dang mjal pod/ stag lung gling gi gnas gzigs mdzad nas/ rwa greng du gnas zhag skabs mtho 〈tho 〉rangs zhig 〈shig 〉la jo bo rje a ti sha zhal gzigs/ de nas thel ca phebs/ paṇa chen dpal gyi tsa mtsho'i rnam sprul paṇa chen sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu las dbang chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas yer pa dang /lo dgon sogs su gnas gzigs la phebs pa'i lo'i mdar/ na mkha' 'ja' tshon gyi 〈kyis 〉gang ba'i dbus su/ thub dbar / spyan ras gzigs/ sgol dkar/ mi g.yo ba/ rje btsun chos rgyal kun (1 can)tshogs bcas la/ rgyal ba zhi khro du mas bskor ba zhalagazigs/ btsun tshal du lha chen dung thod can gyi 〈kyis 〉gus ba btud/ de nas hor dpon gyi (gyis 〉byang du spyan drangs bar bas/snye ston mi byed pa'i bad 'grems mdzad par/ hor rnam gyis yumaḥ

ring po'i bar srog gcod mi byed pa'i dam bca' dang / ri klung rgya sdom/ yig drug khas len sogs der gnas kun thar pa'i lam sna zin par bkod te 〈de/〉 'bri gung du phebs nas mi ring bar 'gom sde dgon spyi nas spyan 'dren byung bar phebs/ thog mar hor gyi sde dkyil du phebs/ sde so so nas bsnyen bkur 'bul ba du ma byung bar 'dod chos gang mtshams 〈'tsham 〉gnang / rngod gtsang ngogs su phebs skabasasog yul nas rje dra ro pa sprul pa'i snang brnyan bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i gtam ngan gsan pa'i 〈pas/〉 gnyen sde'i dgon khag phyogs 'dus gzhis byes sgril ba'i dge 'dun brgya phrag lnga lhag gi 〈gis 〉bdun phrag gcig gi bar rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i cho ga dang / bsnyen bkur yon sogs phul du phyin pa gnang / brag kob ces par 'dus pa ches mang bar 'phags pa yang snying nor bu'i skye bdun ril bu sgrub pa'i sgo nas dbang gi 〈gis 〉smin par (1 5ba)mdzad/ dzad kyi dgon gnas rnams rgyud 〈brgyud 〉za da na du phebs/ dad 'dus rnams la rdo rje byung ba dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang sogs mang du bstsal/ mchod khang dang mgon khang gi zhig bsos 〈gso/〉 tshogs su skyob pa'i rnam mgur /rgya /tho /dza /tshe' gas pa gas ma da nas/ nang na nas gdan drangs/ sangasargyas yel pa'i gnas gzigs nas/ dbyig gu brag rtsa zhes par mgar bston 'dzin kun tshogs dang / nang chen dpon blo gros rgyal po mchod mon la nor bu rgya mtsho'i dbang dang / rdza shis su skye bo 'dus pa 'busazag lhag la thos grol dbang gnang / dge ba'i khas len mang du byung /shar yel phug gnas gzigs dang / nang chen dpon sogs nas bsnye bkur 'bul ba mtha' yas pa byung bar/ so sor chos dang zang ri gis tshim par mdzad nas/ rta ra rgyud 〈brgyud 〉nag shod du bab ཿ

'dus pa rnams la rngog dkyil bdun/ chos drug soṭa gang la gang 'dul chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par gnang / rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i dar sku bzhengs nas dgon gyi rten rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉rab gnas phyogs /zi rnyiX ja/rdo/ po dzopa /shi / /ngag la par 〈 // 〉sa rnyi mdod da/ / bri sogs kyi mchod 'bul/ tshogs su mang 'gyed/ rdzong gsar du gcung rin po cher skyes 'bul sogs stobs che ba gnang / yangs ri snar du cho 'phrul zla bar 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub mchod lo ltar du 'dzugs pa dang mtshams grwa brje len la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gnang / de nas sgam po sprul byu nor bu rgyan pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su spyan 'dren byung ba ltar/ bya yul rgyud 〈brgyud 〉nasadrozloX rdo/sa // pa/ /dri/ / //lja stu shā /// /pa shi/na snan na rdordonas lha yi bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod pa 'bul ba gzigs/ sgam po / //sdu gzi /bsase ༷ 10 / sdu (3 / bub /bye :dro / rdo rdo/ /snang /zangs lung 'jag byul gyi tshon rten rnams la mchod 'bul smon 'dun yang dag pa mdzad nas gnas chen po nye ba'i 'byung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri trar phebs pas/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu dang gnas bdag mkha'/shā sdu //rdzu / sa/ bsgris bza spya ngan/sa zha// / rjo bye/ daskyo shes gi/ chi pa / // (1 ba)mtsho'i 'gra zhag gsum bzhugs pas/ mtsho'i sbya ba bya sgong tsam gyis 〈gye 〉nang bde mchog lhan skyes gsal bar gzigs/ mtsho zas mang du phul/ mkha' 'gro 'bum thil du sku mtshams mdzad/ gzigs 351

snang dpag tu med pa byung / dpa' bo rdo thod kyi rdo zhig la phyag phreng na rjes dang / g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du zhabs rjes kyang byung / tshur lam rgyal dang mal dro rgyud 〈brgyud 〉nas rnam rgyal chos rdzong du phebs/ de nas mi ring bar phan yul lhun grub rdzong du dpon sa phun tshogs 'das pa'i sar sde pa phod mdo bas gdan drangs par ser tshogs gi 〈kyi 〉gral dbur phebs 'bul zhabs kyang bzang / de zhor sha ra 'bum pa'i gnasagazigs dang / der 'dus bla ga mi sde rnams la 'dod lhas mang du gnang nas/ yer par phebs/ gnas gzigs zhib pa dang / zla ba phug tu bdun phrag gcig ring 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i ljags bzlas gnang bas/ phug pa'i steng gi thad nas a kha kha da res thub pa med zer ba'i sgra zhig gsan par nag phyogs pas glags ma rnyid pa zhig tumangon/ sku mtshams grol nas lha sar phebs/ jo shāka gi 〈gis〉dbus rten rnams la gser chab mar mi/ snyan shal sogs mchod 'bul rgyas pa dang / jo shāg 〈shāka 〉rnam gnyis drung gnas (1 8na)zhag re mdzad/ rang byon lnga ldan gyis (gyi 〉gnas zhag mdzad dus/dkon gnyer gyis sgo rgyab 〈brgyab 〉nas nang du phebs ma bcug par/sgor gnas zhag mdzad pas/ phyis 〈phyi 〉nang 〈nangs 〉blo bur du lcags rang grol du byung bar/ nang du phebs/ 'phags pa la gsol 'debs phan bde'i gter mdzod zhes (ces 〉pa 'di thugs la shugs 'byung du byung bar smon lam nan tan mdzad/ra mo che po ta la sogs kyiganas mjal mdzad nas/ rnam rgyal chos rdzong du phebs/ da lta'i tho lung 'du khang gi rte na gtso thub dbang gi sku khri rgyab ma 'di de skabs bzhengs/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas stong sku'i gser thang sogs mang du bzhengs/ skabs shig 'bri gung thel/ gdan sa thel/ sgam po/252

mtshur phu/ ser 'bras dge gsum sogs skos med kyidagon khag thams cad la mang 'gyed shin tu rgya che ba gnang / de skabs sog po hung shā chi'i dmag ltos che ba khad nyer 'byor kyang nyes skyon ma byung / chog lto rgyal po'i mi sna kha shas rje'i drung mngags te/ rgya tshag ma'i go khrab dang /gos dar sogs mang du phul ba'i bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs dang brda lan rgyas par gnang / nang chen dpon kerma rab brtan 'byor te sgom sde'i mchod gnas (178ba)sku tshab cig dgos zhes nan gyi zhus par/ skyesasbyang ga yon tan phul du phyin pa lho rin po che dkon mchog phrin las rnamashāX /bsnyad 〈rdo/sna rdordo / / rdo /pa ༷/dro / // //chod yordo ga coX /rdo sde gzar chen po langs/ bde 'byor byang pa sogs bod sog gi mi sna chen che ba 'bri gung du 'byor/ rnam rgyal chos rdzong gtsang bshig byas/sog po 'ga' zhig gi 〈gas 〉rten gtso thub dbang khri rgyab ma gtsang porabasgyur ba'i kong dib tsam gyis 〈rgya 〉nyes skyon ma gos/ chu nang bzhugs ring nam mkha' nas 'ja' kha dog lnga pa zhig skur zug pa byung / der thub sku spro lung du spyan 'dren mdzad/ rje nyid kyang spro lung du brtan chags nas skabs shig tshoms chen na ba so drug yod pa zhig gsar rgyagagazhis kha'i rgya bskyed gnang bar phyis sgar gyi chos grwa 'dir brtan chags pa la dgongs 'du blang rin po che'i thog kha gser khang /khang gsar/ sgo mang sogs gtsug lag khang rnams kyi zhig bsos 〈gsos 〉kyang legs par mdzad/ lcags sbrul sde gzar dang / rta lo lug lo bcas la sad kyi gnod pa sngar ma graṭa lta bu'i 〈bus/〉 dbus gtsang gi sde dgon phal cher stongs par thug (17 na)kyang / gling rin po cher byer 'tshe cung zad kyang ma byung ba rje 'di'i thugs rje kho — 253

nar go de skabs gcung chos kyi grags pa bsnyenardzogs bskyar mdzad par myu ra'i gdung mi chad pa'i phyir rje nyid nas /lab bzhes gnang bar dgongs kyang / dga' rab dbang phyug mi'i tshul can 'ga' zhig gis skur 'debs kham po che la brten/ 'bri gung myu ra'i gdung dri ma med pa de nyid chad par gyur to/ skabs shig khams phyogs kyi yang dgon bla ma dang / yangs ri sgar gyi 'dus pa'i tshogs la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang / lcaṭa yos lor khang gsar byang du da lta rnying ma khang du grags pa 'di rmang gting 〈btings/〉 bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pamang dag gis gser dngul las byang chub chen po'i mchod rten thog tshad gnyis pa/ bang rim rnams su sangs rgyas byang sems gnas brtan bcu drug bka' brgyud na rim bcas kyi sku rnams bzhuṭa pa bkra shis sgo mang gi bkod pa dang ldan pa/ rin po che du ma'i phras mtshar 〈tshar 〉du mngar 〈dngar 〉ba bzhengs pa zla ba brgyad kyi ngo la gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa grub cing / rje nyid 'dus par bcas pa'i zhi khro rigs bkus dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa cho ga (1 9ba)rgyas par mdzad pa'i rab ston dang / rig byed pa rnams la zang zingagi yon gyis re ba yongs su gang ba mdzad/ skabs shig rje'i gzigs snang du/ bu mo gsum gyis kun gsal 'khor 'das kyi gzigs morabaskyas te/ nyid de gsum gyi zlar gshegs pa na/ brag dmar mi snying 'dra ba'i 'og phug pa zhig gi nang / pha wang me long 'dra ba la gnam gogru bzhi pa zhig sang do rje sems pa'i me long yin zer bar der gzigasapas/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro sogs ngan song gi gnas rnams gsal bar gzigs/ yang ma na hu'i khrus gzhong nang /'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa'i dbus thub pa'i dbang po'i 〈pos 〉nyan thos kyi 354

'kho ra rnams la rgyu 'bras kyi chos ba/sungs pa/ jo bo rjes bo sa kyi spyod tshung bsgo gleng mang du mdzad pa gzig/sa / ji /nga byang ngos zhig 〈shig 〉la dur khrod bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba o rgyam/ byi dur brod yin zer bar/ grub chen dril bu'i zhabs dang / 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med ga rnams tshosas kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / sku'i rnam 'gyur cho 'phrul du ma mdzad pa dang / yang brag phug zhig 〈cig 〉nang / drang srong 'gro ba kun skyob bya bas nyid la 'das ma 'ongs gi 〈kyi 〉lung (180na)bstan mang du gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung / rje 'di gdan sa yun ring ma mdzad kyang / gling dang sgar gyi chos khrims bsdams pa/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i don rnams gsal bar mdzad pa/ zab mo lnga ldan sogs pha chos rnams nyams bzhes dang / rgya cher spel ba/bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrug pa'i cho ga mos gus srog 'khor gyi khrid/mgon po dang bstan bsrungs ma'i skor sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ gong smos gling gtsug lag khang rten rnam ga nyams bsos 〈gso〉sogs 'bri bstan rin po cher bya ba rlabs po che kho nas dus 'da' ba mdzad do/ de nas sku de'i 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams rdzogs nas/ dgung lo re lnga pa shing rta lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang sku khams bsnyel〈mgrel 〉ba'i tshul bstan/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i mas gsum chu srin gyi khyim thog mar shar ba'i dus snga dro dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/shing lug cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin rje chos kyi grags pas rdo rje slobadapon gyi bya ba mdzad de/ byu gdung yid bzhin nor bu bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo ma/sa zhugs phul bas ngo mtshar ba'i ltasabasam gyis mi khyab pa byung / dbu mid las (180ba)ring bsrel sogs rten mang du byon/ཿ51

chog mang ge gral dbur/ stag lung zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub spyan drangs te 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bul ba mtha' yas pa phul/ lo de'i mjug gser dngul las gdung brten 〈rten 〉lha babs dang / gser zangs las gzim mal 'dra sku bcas sku tshad che nges pa grub ste/ gdung rus rnams dngul gdung nang bzhugs te/ thel khang gsar rnying ma khang gi nang /dam pa nyid kyi thugs dam byang chub rten mchog gi g.yas g.yon du bzhugs su gsol te rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par grub po 〈bo/〉dam pa 'di la slob ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa sa/ lho phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi sku'i skye ba dgon mchog chos kyirgyal po sa/ mal dro ba rab tu 'khrungs/ thog mar rje chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi drung rab tu byung / phyis rje dkon mchog rin chen nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gsar rnying gis 〈gi 〉chos du ma gsan/ yang zabagi 〈kyi 〉tshe dbang gi dus tshe lha rigs lnga zhal gzigs/ rin chen brag dang / chu bzang sogs sngar gyi dgon gnas rnams bskyangs/ de nas kho bos 〈bo'i 〉'dul 〈gdul 〉bya khams phyogs la yod yang yang gsungs (181na)nas byon 〈'byon 〉par chas kyang phyi bshol du gyur nas/dgung lo nyer gcig bar gshegs nas gdung bzhu ba'i tshe/ dbu thod las ring bsrel mang du byon/ de'i sku phyi ma lho 'phrin las rnam rgyal sa /ro /tha /khye / //de /nya /kye /kyeg tu gsal/ ba ga pa na pa kun ṭa / lung gas sa 〈 〉yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / bla ma sku bzhi'i chos bdag tu lung zin/ rin chen brag gi bla ma mdzad/ phyis rje chos kyi grags pa'i dbu blar gyur cing gsar rnying gi gdams pa mang du 'bul ba mdzad/khyad par ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i lugs (kyi )tshe dbang 'gal 15

bar mdzad dus/ tshe mda' sor bzhi tsam 'thol ba byung / bsnyen rdzogs bskyar bzhes pas 〈pa'i 〉mkhan po yang yin la/ 'di la lo rgyus gzhan dag nas kha bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas zur tsam smos pa 'di las rnam thar ma mthong / gzhan yang mnga' ris rgyal sras rin chen bzang po/ rgya ston chos rje rin chen chos rgyal / ri bo che chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs mang du mchis kyang 'dir yi ger 'jigs so/mkhyen brtse'i byin mthu ngo mtshar mdzad pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i bdag por gyur pa (181ba)sogs/ /rgyal dbang padma na ra'i zhal skyinamachog /rig 'dzin chos kyi grags par gus phyag 'tshal/ /gdan sa nyer gsum pa/ mtshungs med rig 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan chos kyi grags pa ni/ rgyal dbang ratna'i zhabs nyid mngon dga'i zhing du rgyal ba klong yangs su sangs rgyas zin kyang / 'bri gung pa'i bstan zhabs skyong phyir dam pa 'dir sprul zhing / slob dpon padma'i thugs sprul rtsod med du grags pa ni/ o rgyan gling pa'i thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog las/da lta'i lha sras mu tig btsad po 'di zhes pa nas/ phyi ma'i dus na zhing khams 'bri zhes par/ /ratna'i mtshan can sde dgon skyong ba byung 〈'byung /〉bdud sprul dbang gis tshe yi dus byas na/ /tha ma'i dus na nga yi zugs sprul pa/ /gter chos brgyud 'dzin 'gro la 'brel gsum 'dogs/ /rgyal sras dbur spyon zhes byar grags pa 'byung / /zhes dang / rje ratna la sa grags bla ma kun dga' grags pas zhus pa'i dris lan la/ lan gcig slar yang sa phyogs 'di nyid du/ /'bri yi mi phud bharma'i srid nyams thug /de 'dra'i dus shig myur du 'byung ngam snyam/ /zhes pa la sogs lung bstanadu ma nas zin la/ de yang rgyal sras lha rje'i (181na)rnam 'phrul mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs dang / yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor 257 —

ba'i sprul pa g.yang khug ma gnyis las/ sras bzhi'i tha chung da pa 'di yin la/ thog mar gong zos yab yum gnyis las/ sras mo chud ngu zhig tu 'khrungs/ lo gnyis nas lus de'i 〈des 〉rang gzhan gyi don mi 'grub par dgongs/ ma ma zhig gi rgyab tu khur bas/ gzim chung gis 〈gi 〉sgo'i ya zam la dbu brdabs pa'i rkyen gyis nying mtshams sbyar ste za khongs las ma 'gyangs par/ rigs de nyid du yum gyi mngal du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ phyi rol du/ gzhan gyi tshig don thams cad gsal bar mkhyen/za grangs thems nas shing lug lo'i rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs la sra brtan do rje'i pho zang du 'khrungs pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung / de'i tshe mnyam bzhag gi ngang ting nge 'dzin rgya mtshor bzhugs pa'i dus 'da' ba dang / bstan bsrungs chos kyi sgrol mas ma ma'i tshul du bskyangs zhing 〈shing 〉gyis rim bskyed nas gzhon nu'i rol rtsed skabs/bud med bzhin bzang gos rgyan mdzes ma 'ga' zhig gis rtsed grogs dang / dgongs pa la ji ltar 'khrungs ma thag bka' bstsal ma dgos par de rnams kyis byed cing (181ba)sku 'khor ba rnams drung du 'ong skabasami snang ba zhig byung / de nas yab rje'i drung du gtsug phud phul te mtshan dkon mchog phun tshogs zhes gsol/ skabs shig yab rje'i sku spang 〈par 〉du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha'i mthongs su dpal 'khor lo sdomapa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsal rdzoṭa nyi ma shar ba ltar gzigs/ yang skabasashig gter sgom sman mo'i 〈mos 〉thog zhu phul ba'i tshul byas/ dgung lo lnga pa sa phag lo gsar gyi dga' ston skabs srod 'khor la nam mkhar drang srong chen po ru hu la gzi brjid 'bar ba zhig dang / yab rjes sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang brgya tshar bstsal ba'i skabs tshe chang na pā la'i steng du tshe dpag med ma ba sor tsam pa dang / yab rje'i sku 'od gong dmar po 258

me 'od 'bar ba gzigs/de nas yab mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po'i drung /rje sku mched gsum gyi (gyis 〉dbu gnang rang gzhan gyis (gyi 〉'dus pa grangs las 'das pa dang bcas/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang dang sgrub chen zags pa yan lag gi bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa dang 'brel ba gsan pa'i tshe/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mi snang bar/gzhal yas khang 'ja' tshon lta bu'i nang zhi khro bdun brgya nyer lnga ma 'dres gsal rdzogs su snang ba dang / skabs 'gar rdul tshon gyi bar snangal (183na)dkyil 'khor chen po 'ja' ltar bkra ba dang / tshangs pa'i dku thag la lha dang lha mo mang pos rol mo thog 〈thogs 〉pa'i khrod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mang pos gar mdzad pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon chos kyi rgyal po nyid rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje chos dngos su shar ba dang / dbang 'grim pa dang / gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉skabs zhabs zung sa la ma reg pa byon pa gzigs shing / dkyil 'khor chen por me tog dor ba'i tshe me tog kha dog sna tshogs zhig 〈shig 〉tu gyur nas/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gtso bo'i mgul du 'khril bar/ gsang mtshan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes gsol/ sman khang du sngags kyi sgra dang / 'od dang du ba la sogs pa dang / dbang gral la mkha' 'gro sde brgyad 'jigs rngams can du ma 'khod pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas gzigs snang mtha' las 'das/ yang yab rje las bde mchog sga lo lha lnga'i dbang gi skabs yab nyid te ru nar gyur pa dang / drang srong log tre'i rjes gnangagi skabs drang srong dri med dngos su gzigs/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi bka' 'bum ljags lung gi skabs chab mdo rje drung gis phul ba'i mu tig gi byung ba khyad par can de mgul la sgon par gnang bani gyis sku gdung gi phra la 'bul ba'i lung bstan/ yab rje (183ba)la259

gzhan rkyen gyis sku grib byung ba'i tshe nyid nas khrus gsol ba'i 〈bas 〉lha'i khrus chab ji lta ba 〈bar 〉gyur/ nyid (kyi )phyag khyor du bsnams nas dbu steng du 'jog pa yang yang gnang ba sa rje ratna'i sku dngos yin pa'i brdar bstan/ de nas mi ring bar rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po sku khams bsnyel 〈mnyel 〉ba'i tshul bstan par sku zhabs bcar mar bzhugs pa'i skabs 'phral yun gyi bslab bya mtha' dag lhug par gnang /mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa na/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bur yan lag bdun pa dang / rang gzhan don gnyis grub 〈'grub 〉pa'i smon lam nan tan mdzad/ chog mang gi gral gtsor gcen po zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug spyan drangs mjal phrad gnang / skabs shig zur re brag dkar gyi gnas gzigs la phebs pas/ rje 'di la zhwa dmar drug pas rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes mtshan gsol/ de nas rtse bar phebs te khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun sogs gsan/ yang sku gdung rin poche'i zhos/sa su/ rje nyid sku mched lhan cig mkhas grub sangs rgyas rin chen las/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum sogs mang du gsan/klog gsan pa'i thog mar rang lugs (184na)kyi bskang gso rnams thuṭa 'dzin gnang ba'i tshe/ bde mchog lhan skyes lan 'ga' yar dang /mgon po'i bsto da pa byang shar nag 'dabs ma gsung skabs tshig tu gang yod lha gtso bor bcas pa gzigs/ a phyi phrin las myur mgyogs skabs bstan bsrungs ma gtso 'khor lnga zhabs thang du byon/ gtso mos shel dkar gyi phreng ba rje la sgon pa dang zhing skyong gi bskang gso thugs 'dzin skabs/ zhing skyong yab yum 'khor bcas dang spre'u gnyis kyis gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉mang du byas/ yang skabs shig sngar yab rjer yar rgyab 260

/ngo /ri /ri/) /grid na —das pa byang zhus byung ba na chas gras rgya chung ngu shubs bcas zhig 〈shig 〉yum gyis rje la gnang bar/ de la thugs rtsis che che ltar mdzad pa'i rkyen lta bu'i 〈bus 〉nub gcig mnal lam du/ ro langs 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis ha ha nyi nyi zhes sogs sgra mi snyan du ma sgogasashing / drag tu tsa gas nas mtho 〈tho 〉mtshams 〈'tshams 〉par/ brag de'u zhig gi steng bde mchog lhan skyes gtso rkyang zhig gis nye ba'i snying po'i yig bdun sgras sa g.yos pa tsam gsung bar ro langs de'i 〈des 〉glags ma rnyed pa zhig byung / de nas yig bdun ma dang / bstod pa khrag rgyal ma rgyun chags su (184ba)mdzad pa'i 〈pas 〉mi ring bar nub gcig gis 〈gi 〉mtshan lam du/ dkyil 'khor chen po dur khrod dang bcas gsal rdzogs su snang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon pa'i tshe/dpal bye ru na dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i 〈pas 〉tshoṭa kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur rdzogs par bsgos 〈mnos/〉 rje ratna'i zhal slob bla ma mtha' yas phun tshogs zhes pa las/ gshin rje yang bzlog gi phyag len rnams la thugs 'dris par mdzad/ thel gyi slob dpon dge 'dun rgya mtsho la sa thel klog rnams dang / dge slong phun tshogs tshe ring las gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi bris thig rdul tshon bri ba sogs la shin tu byang ba mdzad/ de nas yab chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul dang / dngul gdung rnams grub cing / gcen rje dra ro pa las yang zab kyi skor yongs rdzogs gsan pa'i tshe/ bar khang g.yu zhal du gu ru rin po che las bka' babs gtad rgya mnos pa'i dran snang byung / skabs shig bar snang la gshin rje tshe bdag dngos su gzigs/ rdo rje 'chang zhes bsngags par 'os pa mkhan chen rnam 'joms las/ shā ro'i chos 261

drug (185na)gsan pa'i thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzags/ ya nga de nyid las thos grol gsan pa'i nub/ slob dpon padmas ye shes pa dngos su phab pa'i gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba byung / dgung lo bcu gcig par/ rje na ro pa la sa drang srong log tri skor rigs gtad dang bca ga/ pa gsan nas/de nyi ) kyis bsnyen sgrub yun ring mdzad pa'i 〈pas 〉gzigs snang mtha' las 'das/ rje zhwa dmar drug pa 'bri gung du spyan drangs/ sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis sogs gsan shing 〈cing /〉 mi ring bar rje sku mched lhan cig rgya ma rgyud 〈brgyud 〉bsam yas su phebs/ byang chub chen po ston pa dngos su gzigs/ bar khang du mkhan slob rjes 'brang gdan 'dzom 〈'dzoms 〉pa'i dus skabs dang / hal po ri rtser dam pa rgyang gi lha khang bzhengs pa sogs sngon gnas dran snang mang du byung / chims phur rje zhwa dmar la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis phyag mchod 'bul ba dang /skyid byud phug tu sngon grub thob me long do rjer gyur pa'i du sa kyi dran snang dang / g.yu brag du 〈tu〉bla ma zhang gi skus phyas/ rgya chen po'i mgur —gsungs shing sku'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad pa dang / sgrags yang rdzong du slob dpon chen por lha mo gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉mtha' brten pa (185ba)gzigs/ 'on stag tshang phug tu seng gdong ma'i sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa dang / brag log 〈logs 〉zhig 〈shig 〉la phyag gi rjes kyang bstsal/ zangs ri khang dmar du ma gcig lab sgon gyis 〈kyi 〉skus /zhe /phyo /bye rte(/) /shā tshi 11 spyor na sa gdams pa gas bcad gsungs pa dang / sa na kyi so de po'i bsam 'grub skus bzhad pa gas byung / nas kun tu bzang nag 〈nags 〉khrod dpal gyi phag mo grur phebs/ 'jag spyil du 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku brnyan gyi drung de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems sogasarten khyad par can du ma rten shom dang bcas/ rje 'di'i dbu lo bas 262

ba'i tshe zur phud lcags kyi khams ltar sra ba ya mtshan pa byung zhing / skra phyag 'bul ba gnang skabs 'gro mgon sku brnyan gyis dbu zhwa phud/de nas rten gyi drung mchod pa'i dngos po gtsang zhing dag pa yid du 'ong ba rgya chen po dag bshams te/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gis mkhan po'i bya ba mdzad/ las slob sogs kha bskong grangs tshang gi dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag pa bzhes nas/ rje drung las spyi don legs bshad rgya mtsho/ phyag mdzod sde pa dkon mchog las snyan ngag daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan/ sde pa lum pa ba las yig rig sogs gsan sbyong dang / rje drung las rdo rje phreng ba'i rtsa dkyil (185na)nyer brgyad pa'i dbang dang rgyud sde'i phyag len/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung gsan pa sogs/gdan sa mthil der zla ba lnga gdan phabs pa'i ring tshul gnas 'khor lo gsum gyi (gyis 〉nyin mtshan 'da' ba mdzad/ de nas zhwa dmar ba zur phud dgon par phebs pas/ rje nyid sa sbug sgrub sder bzhugs skabs bsam yas nas chos skyong gi 〈gas 〉'bri gung du sku dogs yod pas myur bar phebs dgos tshul zhus zhing 〈shing /〉 rje zhwa dmar ba gong dkar du bzhugs skabs der phebs zhor/ srin po ri'i bde mchog gi sku mjal ba gnang dus sku'i sdom pa dngos su gyur nas sngags kyi dbang bskur byin 'bebs mdzad/ de nas gong dkar du rje'i drung gsan bsam gyi 'phros rnams mdzad cing / lha sar phebs gnas gziṭa mdzad pa'i jo shākakyi 〈gis 〉dbus lha rnams las 'od zer 'phro ba byung / yer par gnas gzis/sa skabs rgyal po sras gtsang gi sku las do shal gyi nor bu zhig rje la gnang ba dang / jo bo a ti sha'i spyan sngar khu rngog 'brom sogs sngon tshu tha ma tshe bal mang thugs la 'khrungs/ phan yul du bas gas bdag na'i bsu ba dang / ri chos kyi rdza sku dpal mgon gdo bzhi gad sa7

su gzigs/ (185ba)ra 'dzab tu sngon rgya gar du nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sku ngos mkhyen/ rdzong gsar du phebs nas mi ring bar yum drung sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rnams grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rin chen las gshin rje lcags sdig skor dang / gcen rje na ro pa las yang bzlog mo'i spu gri'i skor gsan nas/ las spyor gyis 〈rgya 〉sgrub pa zhig mdzad dus gshin rje gshed rtag tu zhal gzigs/las sbyor tshad du phyin pa'i ltas du ma byung / yang dpon slob 'ga' zhig dang bcas yang zab kyi bka' bsrung gsum gyi las sbyor zhig yun ring mdzad dus/ ma gza' rdo gsum zhal gzigs/ thams cad kyi 〈kyis 〉mthong bar ma mo'i gtor ma'i zhal nas khrag 'dzags pa dang / drang srong gi gtor ma 〈mar 〉me stag dang du ba 'phro ba/ dam can pa'i gtor maramache ba ring por skyes pa/ sgrub khang du me dang du ba 'khrig 〈'khrigs 〉pa/ sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul dang / yang khyab 'jug gi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ drang srong 'khor bcas dbang du bsdus pas 〈pa'i 〉rtaṭa mtshan grangs las 'das/ yang dpon slob bzhis gza' dug gi spu gri'i las sbyor mdzad pas 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul mang du byung / rje na ro pa las bstan bsrung chos kyi sgol ma'i dbang sgrub skor yongs rdzogs gsan nas bsnyen (18 na)sgrub mdzad pas nyi shar gyi thun zhig la na ma lo 'dab ma'i bstod dbyangs mdzad pa'i tshe bar snang la chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor lngas gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉yid 'phrog pa mdzad pa gzigs/ ban grong shod pa'i spo spo rnam sras dang / las ru mkhan chen pa'i dbon po las dkar nag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs chen po rnams la byang bar mdzad/ skabs shig rje dra ro pa las khams gsum 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar skor gsan nasasog po kha dan sogs bod sog du mas bstan srid la 'tshe ba byung ཿ 4

bar rlung dmar 'khor lo chen po'i las spyor mdzad pas phyi nang gi rtags mtshan mngon du gyur/ yang rje na ro pa dang nyid dpon slob mang ba dang bcas mabon po phyag bzhi pa'i dmag bzlog dgra chos rgyas pa'i gtor bzlog gnang ba'i nub gcig 'bri gung gi lung pa thams cad bya rog ri de'u tsam pa kha dang gshog rtse (las )me 'od 'phro ba grangs las 'das paphyogs kun tu rgyu ba gzigs/ skabs shig rje na ro pas log lnga pā la'i sbyo zhi yo po las ra rgyas pa ga gnang dus phyag ga ga dang / gzhan yang drag mngon spyod kyi las sbyor du ma rje dang lhan gcig 〈cig 〉mdzad/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms las sha wa ri las brgyud pa'i rtsa 'dabs snyan rgyud dang / dza (18 ba)har thar las brgyud pa'i rlung khrid nyams bzhes gnang bas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur mnga' brnyes/ de nas gcen dkon mchog rin chen sgar pa dpon slob mdo khams nas phebs grub skabs phebs bsu mtshe'u khar mdzad/ dpon slob kyis 〈kyi 〉sku skyes gya nom pa byung / de nas rje na ro pa dang mkhan chen pas nyid yangs ri sgar gyi gdan sa mdzad dgos gsungs pa bzhin/ dus tshes dge bar 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gral dbur mnga' gsol/ sgar gyi bca' sgrig mchog tu dam par mdzad cing / mi ring bar phan yul du phebs skabs kha rags kyi gnas gzigs dang / tshe chu phug kyi 〈 〉gnas sgo gsar du bye/gzigs snang rnams gtan la phabs 〈phab〉/ phyag zhabs kyi rjes mang du bstsal/ rgyal stod thod le mgonakhang gnas gzigs dang / za dam gyis 〈kyi 〉gtsug lag (khang )mjal bar phebs dus dpal ldan rtse gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ dpal ldan rtser phebs pas/ mgon khang dkyus ma'i snang ba ye med par/ mgon po mched brgyad gtso 'khoragazhal yas khang sogs ngo mtshar ba zhig gzigs pa dang / de dag gi 265

sko /sgrub ra zhal gdams bslab bya lung bstan mtha' yas pa byung nasadur khrod blo mo rgyal du dbus smyon gzim spyil du de (188na)nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i ma zhag bdun phrag gcig gis 〈gi 〉khongs mtshan ltas rdzogs shing / zhag mtha' ma'i nub srod la mgon po mchedabargyad dzo ker sprul nas/ marmo ni na'i rdo'i steng du bos/ tshoṭa kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ bslab bya lung bstan mgon brgyad rang gis 〈gi 〉brgyud dbang khrid las tshogs bcas gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba byung zhing / sku 'khor nyung bsdus rdzus stabs kyis lha ldan du phebs/ jo shākarin po che mjal ba'i tshe jo bos bzhad pa'i rnam pa byung ba kun gyi (gyis 〉mthong / bcu gcig zhal gyi drung sngon gnas du ma thugs la 'khrungs/ de nas 'bri gung du phebs nas/ dgung lo bca brgyad pa lachos lung mkhan po byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho las bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ de nyid las gsar ma'i chos du ma gsan/ phar yang snga 'gyur gyi chos mang du bstsal/ 'jam dkar gyi bsnyen sgrub ma sha'i las sbyor dang / dbyangs can dkar mo'i bsnyen sgrub mang du mdzad pas mdo rgyud bstan bcos gang la yang mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gziṭa pa mi mnga' ba/mi ba da pa'i gzungs gi 〈kyi 〉dngos grub brnyes/ de nas yangs ri sgar gyi 'dus pa dang bcas klung shod brgyud/ thog mar rwa sgong du phebs/'jam dpal rdo rje'i ral gri la ljags (kyis )(188ba)'byog pa gnang bar smra ba'i rgyal po'i dngos grub thob/ hor dpon g.yul rgyal gyi sde khrod du phebs/ mchod yon lhan cig gnam mtsho'i gnas gzigs gnang skabs/ mtsho dkyil nas gu ru'i phyag rjes gsal bar brten 〈bstan/〉 ga lo phug ca gnas zhag nub slob dpon chen pos sgra mi snyan ba'i ma sgrub dag snang du bstsal ba dang / gnyan chen po thang lhas kyangalha

gus pas btud/ hor bod kyi mi tshogs shin tu che ba dang bcas do mir bzhugs skabs mtsho sman lha'i cha byad can gyis rin po che'i ga'ong pa nor snas bkang ba thog 〈thogs/〉 gser kyi 2 chen ri de'u tsam sga srab kyi 〈kyis 〉brgyan pa gis bzhin gyi nor bu bkal ba mchod pa'i tshul du byung /rgyangs 〈rgyang 〉nas se mo ngo gzigs skabs/ spyan snga shes 'byung du gyur pa'i sngon tshul rnams dran/ rdza del du gnod sbyin ba/nga ba bzang por bsnyen gnas bstsal/ 'dam gyi gad skya lkog tu mchod yon lhan cig sgar phab/ 'byu hor gyi rim gror mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlogabaka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉sogs rgyas pa dang /de'i tshe hor dpon la sras gnyis yong ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ de nas hor dpon mi bzang du mas rgyang ring bar skyel ma dang bcas/ rngod du phebs/ rngod smad pa rnams kyi (18 na)ngor rgyal brag rtsar bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub dbang chen mo thos bcas shin tu rgyas pa zhig gnang skabs/ nyin gcig rje dpon slob 'ga' zhig dkyil 'khor la bskor ba dang yang dag gi dbang grub ma thag yin pas der ngo sgod mdzad pas/ yangadag gi bum thod steng la khru gang tsam 'phags nas yud tsam nas lding khri'i steng la ma 'khrug par babs pa dang / me tog gi char/ 'ja' 'od/sngags kyi rang sgra sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas phun sum tshogs pa byungab der 'dus skal ldan rnams kyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ de'i ma mtho〈tho 〉rangs zhig la mnal lam du kun tu bzang po'i pho brang du yab rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po/ bde 'dus dkyil 'khor chen por gtso bor 〈bo'i 〉sku 〈skur 〉bzhengs/ zhi khro bdun brgya nyer lnga gsal rdzogs su snang ba dang / rig 'dzin kyi 'khor du ma dang bcas rje la dbang shin tu rgyas pa gter byon ltar bstsal/ tshoṭa kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ chos267

kyi rgyal po sku dngos su bstan nas bslab bya lung bstan mtha' yas pa gnang ba byung / de nas gangs shod du phebs/ rngod stod pa rnams kyi ngor/padma gling pa'i gter kha/ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i dbang sgrub dang skye bdun dam rdzas sgrub par mdzad pas/ ril bu sngon (18 ba)las rgya cher 'phel ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / rngod kyi dgon gnas rnams nyams nyes du 〈su〉song ba leṭa par gso ba mdzad/ rnam rgyal dgon du nub gcig gnyan mgon zhal bram gzugs can byung nas/gtum srung rnal 'byor dang / mnyan gyi slob mar gyur skabs kyi lo rgyus mang du mdzad/ zla dgon du phebs nas 'dus pa rnams la dra ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi smin pa mdzad skabs/ nub gcig 'od gsal gyi ngang la dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du phebs pas/ dpal chen na ro pa tsaṇḍa li'i gdams pa dag snang du byung / rgya ston bde steng du spyan 'dren byung bar phebs/ gzhis byes kyi 'dus pa che bar dbang chos du ma bstsal/de skabs kong po 'tsho byed dkon mchog rgyal mtshan las/ bso 〈gso 〉ba rigs pa'i gzhung lugs chen mo rnams la gsan sbyongs mdzad/ gling rdzong dang / byang rta sna brgyud/ shar yel phug tu phebs/ sangs rgyasayel pa'i skus bzhad pa sogs byung / mi g.yel phug tu sgom sho sogasasdon tshul mang du 'khrungs/ gla ba rkang gcig bgrod dka'i gnas rnams gziṭa nas ma 'ongs sku'i skye ba phyi mas gnas kyi sgo 'byed gsungs/ phyag rjes kyi mtshan ma bstsal/nang chen ga nang thams cad la (190na)'dodachos mang du ཿstsal/ rdza gshis khang dmar mdor kurma pa chos dbyingasardo rje dang mjal phrad gnang / bstan bsrungs chos kyi sgrol mas rigs sras bzhi la bstan pa gtad nas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gnas 'dan stod phug pa gting ring dang / rje skyob pa rin po che'i 'khrungs 268

yul grong khyer tsong ngu dang / sgrub gnas rtsibs klung mo che/ spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa shes 'byung ci/ 'khrungs yul sga stod lha sgra sogs su phebs/sā ra has gtso bo mdzad pa'i grub chen brgyad cu zhal gzigs/ glang chen dgon du klu bdud gdug can zhig la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal/ yul der shin tu grang ba ma zad de skabs dgun dus yin 'dug kyang / nyid ras kyang brtul zhugs kyi gtum mo thugs la dran tsam gyis bde drod me dpung 'bar ba ltar gyur/ a byung bla ma sogs bon po mkhasapa 'ga'azhig la gtad khram ser 'bebs sogs rig sngags zab mo kha shas gsan/rna tsha grong mo che zhes bon po'i sde zhig gi 〈gis 〉sgar par mi mtshams 〈'tshams 〉pa'i las byas par chu 'khyag drag po phab nas tshar bcad/ denas ri bo che/ 'ba'/ 'jangs gi 〈kyi 〉ra stag rdzong / li thang rnams su phebs nas 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la bkod/ rje zhwa dmar drug pa (190ba)sgar 'jangs sogs su phebs skabs sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gi byed spyod la thugs phyung ba'i 〈bas 〉kun spangs kyi tshul gyi (gyis 〉skam po gnas su bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs/ snga mkho bzhina'akhor tshogs skyong bar zhu 'bul nan bskyed mdzad/ lo tsā ba blo gros bstan pa phyag phyir khrid nas/ sgra na lnga pa'i gzhung lugs chen mor gsan sbyongs 〈sbyong 〉gnang / gser phye thang zhes par phebs dus sgar du 'brum nag gi 'tshe ba byung bar/ yang zlog gi bsrung bzlog sgrub pa gnangabs/ mnal ltas su gangs ri chen po zhig gi rtser sgar btab pa sogs bsrung rtags mthar phyin pa'i mtshan ltas lung bstan 'ga' zhig dang nad bdag mo dngos su byung bar dam la bzhag sku 'khor 'ga' sngon lo chenab ros ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang 'byon ma myong ba'i gzhag ra'i ri rtser gebag bas lhal de'i mi kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ rim gyis dar rtse mdom36

phebs/ mdo pa rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bu / ba mtha'ayas pa byas/ rgya nag gi rgyal phran li'u rdzong si bya bar sras kyi 'byung tshul ma 'ongs lung bstan ma dzad pa dang / der gnas kun 'a chori ri/ dang zang zingagi re ba gang ba gnang nas yar phebs/ ljangs 〈'jangs 〉rgyab ja dgonadu rje zhwa dmar ba dpon slob snga sor nyid kyis zhu 'bul mjad don bzhin (191na)sgar chen grwa 'grig che ba bzhuṭa par mjal phrad gnang /li thang du spyan 'dre na byung ba ltar phebs/ rgya dkar nag gi sku gsung thugs rten gos dar bcas pa dngom che ba du ma dang / gzhan yang 'bul ba tshad las 'das pa phul/ shi sgab chod phyir yang ba zlog gi byad bzlog mdzad par dgon der lo nyer gcig bar shi chad gi 〈bye〉rgyun chad/mtshams gzhung zhes pa'i yul gyi spang ldebs su la:'i rgyu yig shin tu che ba zhig brkos te rdo'i dung g.yas 'khyil zhig thon pa klad bskor 〈zhor 〉du bzhag rgya mo bza'i lha khang dang ra sa'i rnam snang / 'or ngu'i byams mdun klong thang soṭa gnas mang du gzigs/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i phyag phyir 'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta lnga tsaspa ti zhes pa zhig rgya gar du phyir byon par dbus gtsang bar rje'i phyag phyir 'brangs par/ sgra rig sogs rig gnas mtha' dag la gsan bsam dogs gcod mtha' chod pa mdzad/rim gyis yar phebs pa'i byang gi a rog thang dkar du/ bcen rje spe ro pa dang / hor kurma g.yul rgyal sogs che dgu du mas chibs bsu dang / 'bri gung thel du gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod 'bul/ 'dus par (191ba)mang 'gyed/ rdzong gi rwa sogs lcang rar rje dra ro pa sku mched la/ ngal bsos bu bag khums par nus pa'i sku skyes 'bul ba mtha' las 'das pa mdzad/ mtshams grwa rnams dang ga —des byes kyi dge 'dun stong phrag lhag dang / hor dpon sogs phyos/sa 'dus skye bo tsho

grengs las 'das pa la/ rje sku mched rnams nas zab chos mtha' yas pa gnang / rje dra ro pas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang ba gsan nas/yangs ri gas gyi gdan sa'i khur bla ma spangs mda' ba bkra shis dar rgyas la gnange ste/ nyid rtse bar phebs pas yab rje bzhugs skabs lha'i bde byud longs spyod lta bu la de skabs rje btsun mi la'i yab gzhis ltar gyur 〈'gyur 〉nye bar 'dus byas kyi gnas tshul la nges 'byung che bar 'khrungs/ dpon ma gcig mgon gyi (gyis 〉lung chung du spyan drangs/de nub srod la rgyal 'gong zhig gis tshub ston par ting nge 'dzin gyis tsharabacad/ tho rangs phan yul mkhar rtse yin rgyu ba lha'i khang bzang lta bu zhig gi nang / yab chos kyi rgyal po/ skyob pa rin po che/ 'jam dpal gshin rje/ log —/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ chos kyi sgol ma soṭa rtsa ba gsumarnams khrom tshogs su snang ba'i/ chos kyi rgyal pos gter sgros nas gter chos bzhes dgos pa'i lung bstan dang bslab (191na)bya du ma bstsal nas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sgod mdzad/ tha ba kha bde chen steng dang / zo lung du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig gter sgom du gnas gzigs la phebs pa'i dus/ bsam yas chos skyong gi 〈gas 〉mdo sde mchod pa'i dus phebs dgos nan bskyed byungaltar myur stabs su bsam yas su phebs/ mdo sde'i gziṭa mo dang rtsog tuspyan drangs/ chos skyong gi 〈gis 〉bse 'bag smug dgu sogs rten rnams gzigs phul/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi gsung gleng zhib par shā da nas/spro lung du phebs dad 'dus mang bar bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub dang 'brel ba gnang / bla ma sa ngan pa nyi ma 'od zer bya ba las dgongs 'dus kyi dbang lung tshang ma gsan/ rje zhwa dmar drug pa sgar chen mdo khams nas phebs par mngal phrad dang / de skabs gdung rgyud 271

bstan pa'i nor bu lcam rlung gi mdzad rgyur rten 〈brten 〉sku mchod nang zhig yong nyen mkhyen nas/ zla dgon du phebs bzhed kyis rje sku mched rnams la dgongs zhus 〈zhu 〉mdzad nas thog mar rngod du phebs/ nub gcig mnal lam du/ 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi rdo'i khri la sa bting ba'i gdan la rje nyid rdor skyil mnyam bzhag gi 〈gis 〉byang chub shing la sku rgyab brten te sangs rgyas dgu pa me tog (191ba)mtshan can du sangs rgyas pa zhig byung / bkra shis gangs ra'i phur rgyangs me zhes pa'i gnas ngo mtshar ba sgo 'byed pa mdzad/ gzhan phyogs ngan sems 'chang ba 'ga' la phug yul gyi mtsho nag mor las sbyor gnang bas phyi nang gi rtag 〈rtags 〉mngon du gyur/ de nas zla dgon du 'dus pa khri phrag lhag par bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang sgrub rgyas pa/'bri gung pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ nag shod nas gdan 'dren byung bar phebs/ bla ma shākya rin chen gyis dgon gsar du btab pa'i dgon gyi ming chos 'khor byams pa gling zhes gnang / der 'dus pa rnams la rdo rje phreng ba rtsa dkyil nyer brgyad sogs dbang chos mang du bstsal/ de skabs 'bri gung du rje sku mched nang zhig byung ba gsan pas thugs ngal che ba byung zhing 'bri gung du phebs/ rje sku mched la legs spel zhu 'bul mdzad kyang / gdung rgyud pas ma gsan pas mdzad thabs ma rnyed/ snang gsal ba ngag dbang ye shes grub pa dang / byang bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang por chos kyi gsan pa phran bu mdzad nas/ nyang po brag dkar lha chur phebs/ tshesgrub cig mdzad pas mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / de nas zla dgon du phebs/ dad 'dus mang bar bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dbang sman sgrub dang 'brel ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor (193na)la brten pa 272

sogs snga 'gyur gyi gdams pa mang du bstsal skabs mtshan ltas phun sum tshogs pa byung / spo bo nas spyan 'dren byung ltar/ o rgyan ri khrod spyang ki la sogs brgyud/ dngul lung du sgar btab/ phyogs de'i bla khag rnams kyi ngor/ skya ser gyi 'dus pa che bar bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub dbang chen mo gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉dang 'brel ba zos bcas shin tu rgyas pa bstsal/ dngul lung rdo kha'i phur re zhig dben gnas brten nas/ dgongs 'dus kyi chos bdag rtse le thang 'brog bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin la dgongs 'dus bskor 〈skor 〉gsan par rje dpon slob gsum mtshan mo lan mang phebs skabs chos kyi phyir char dang nags rong 'dam khrod du dka' ba khyad bsad mdzad/ de nas ma bskungs lung zhes pa'i gnas chen 'dran 〈'gran 〉zla med pa de'i gnas su phebs/ bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyi bla mtsho lha rang rang gi mdog dang mthun pa/ bde gshegs zhi ba'i bla mtsho g.yu gru dkar gyi mdog lta bu/ gzhan yang mtsho bran gu ru drag po dang tshe dpag med kyi bla mtsho/mkha' 'gro'i khrus rdzing ma ting ting shing sdong zhig la gdung sha ri ram dngos su yod pa sogs ngo mtshar ba dpag tu med pa/ tsā ri tra sogs gnas chen gzhan pas khyad du 'phags pa gzigs/ der nyin re bzhin 'ja' (193ba)'od dang rol mo'i sgra me tog gi char/ spos kyi dri ngad sogs ltas bzang du ma byung / tshogs 'khor lan mang gnang /de nas spo bo na rnam sa 〈gnam 〉 nga dang / zla dgon du phebs/ snod ldan rnams la zab chos mang du bstsal/ grub dbang nam mkha' lhun grub zhes pa las dus 'khor gyi snyan rgyud sogs chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas nub gcig mnal lam du/ lung pa gcig tu dgra rgyugs pa'i 'ur zhog 〈zhogs 〉zhig gi ngang stegs bu che/na po zhig gi steng rdu/pa tshon 273

gyi dkyil 'khor rnams phyags nas dbus der gser gyi rdo rje zhig bzhag pa byung bar/ mi ring bar 'bri gung du sog po mthu med rgyugs/rje 1 ro pa sog yul (du )spyan 'dren pa sogs byas par/ rje nyid shad rtsol gyis 'bri gung (du )phebs/ rje shā ro pa tshur gdan 1dren zhal mjal yong res thabs sgo ji ltar mdzad kyang don thog tu ma khel/ skabasashig stag sher gyi jag pas bod ru rnams phyags pa'i tshe/ dregs pa nyi shu'i 'khor los las sbyor mdzad pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsar khrag zag 〈zags 〉pa sogs nang rtags dang stag sher gyi jag pa mi ngo rnams lo gsum tshun rtsa rlag tu gyur/ de skabs gdung rgyud pa sku gshegs bas dgongs rdzogs rnams sngar rgyun ltar grub/ shing glang loraganas chen —tsā ri trar phebs (194na)pas 〈pa'i 〉lam zhor sgam po phebs rje nor bu rgyan pa dang mjal 'phrad dbang chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ rim gyis chos zam nas sku 'khor rnams rkang thang khres po rgyab khur dang / nyid g.yag la chibs nas mtsho dkar dang / e na tsā ti'i sar ma mo dngos su gzigs/ g.yu mtsho dang / me 'bar mtsho/ mtsho gnyis ma/ na la dung mtsho sogs phal cher gzigs/ yul smad du phebs skabs bya khyung pa padma bstan 'dzin rje nyid mjal bar byon 'dug par/ bzhed don ltar dgongs pa yang zab kyi skor tshang ma gnang / bya khyung nga'adi dgongs 'dus kyi chos bdag sel med yin 'dug par/ 'bri gung ca byon dgos pa'i ched (gdams )mdzad/ pu ri rgyab bskor dang / bsapo/ e/ bsam yas brgyud/ 'bri gung du phebs/ de nas rje dkon mchog rin chen dang / zhwa dmar drug pa/ gtsang sde srid bcas nas nan zhus ltar/ dgung lo so gnyis pa me stag lor gdan sa chen po'i gser khrir zhabs bkod/ rdzong gas ra du gshin rje tshe bdag dang 274

khro chu'i bsnyen sgrub zhig gnang skabs/ nyi shar gyi thun mtshams la/gshin rje gshed dang khro chu zhal gzigs pa'i mus la 'od gsal gyi ngang 'gro ba kun gyi sems dang byed spyod thams cad (194ba)gsal bar mkhyen/ de nas bya byung ba padma ma bstan 'dzin 'bri rdzong du spyan 'drenamadzad nas za gdagongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang che chung tshang ma/ rdzogs chen gser mun ma/ lam 'bras nyams khrid chos skor yongs rjogs kyi lung bcas dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas grang pa'i gter chos phal zuragasan/ gdung rgyud rigs sras sogs mi mang ba lung bstan du ma nas zin kyang gzhan ngor re zhig sku chas rigs sngags 'chang ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chas su bsgyur nas/ me yos lor/ gtsang nas sde srid kyi sras mo lcam drung khab tu bzhes/ sa 'brug cho 'phrul zla bar dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor chen por chos sman sgrub pas ya mtshan gyi rtags mang du byung / sog po ma med sogs bstan la 'tshe ba rnams la/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po dang / rlung dmar/ yang bzlog gi gza' gdor da mar nag ki nang soṭa las sbyor gyi rim pa mang du gnang ba'i 〈bas 〉 byi nang gi rtag 〈rtags 〉mtshan mngon du gyur te mthu med kyi grong khyer khri phrag dgu yod pa yang ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur/ rje na ro pa sog yul du zhing khams 'phos pas yun ring tsam song kyang 〈yang /〉 ser tshogs dang gral dbur sgam po nas rje nor bu rgyan pa spyan 'dren mdzad/phan tshun dam pa'i chos mang ba (195na)gsan res gnang / lcam drung gi bzhugs yul bye ru stag rtse'i so /brang gsar rgyag dang / rje 1 ro pa'i gdung rten rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs pa gnang nas rdzong gsar du bzhugs nas rab gnas mdzad/ gzhan yang o rgyan rin po che'i skugaser gar blugs las grub pa sogs rten bzhengs 'ga' zhig gnang / 27 5

sngar phan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshes la bsnyen sgrub skor sa dpyad tsam las med par/ rje 'di'i 〈'dis 〉'jam dpal gshin rje rtag tu zhal gzigs shing rjes su gnang ba dngos su thob pa'i man ngag rnamasagasal bar mdzad nas/ skabs shig gzhi bsnyen pa kro bcu gcig par brten pa gnang skabs/ bsnyen pa'i skabs sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul dang /lha rtag 〈rtags 〉mang du byung / nye bsnyen skabs dngos nyams mtshan lam du/ yi dam zhal mang du gzigs pa dang / sman rag khol ba'i sa ba dang / sgrub pa chen po'i skabs dngos grub kyi rdzas chil sgra dang bcas khol ba'i rdzu bar phyag mtshan dang yig 'bru mang po byung ba dang /'chi bdag bdud sgrub skabs/ las gshin sde brgyad bran du khol ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtag 〈rtags 〉mtshan khyad bar can byung zhing /gzhan yang yi dam 'di yi dbang / rab gnas sbyin byugs 〈sreg 〉rdzogs rim/ 'phrin las bzhi las rab (1 5ba)'byams sogs snying po'i bstan pa 'di nyid ches cher rgyas par mdzad/ yang lcags lugs lor/ nub gcig mnal lam du thel gser khang du chos rje rin po ches sngon med lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i skor gnang bar las phran kha bskongs sogs mdzad nas snod ldan la spel bar mdzad par da lta yang mi nyams 'phel/ bye ri stag rtser lcam drung sogs dad ldan du ma la rdo 'phreng rtsa dkyil nyer brgyad pa'i dbang gisatshim par mdzad nas/ bum churnams ril bu sgril ba'i tshe ril bu mang du 'phel ba dang / snod kyi nang du chu tshan ltar khol ba dang snod ldebs su rgyuṭa pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kun gyis mthong / rdzong gsar du yang bzlog gi las sbyor gyi sgrub pa zhig gnang skabs/ mnal lam du bsrun bzlog gi rnam pa zhig gnang bas/ gnas de'i gung na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gi 〈kyi 〉bris sku zhigapa

gis mche ba gtsigs shing bsgrim pa yi/ zhes sogs brgyud kyis 〈kyi 〉bstod pa gsung ba dang / yang nub gcig bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bo sa 'og nas nyi ma dang / steng nas zla ba'i tshul rje'i sku la thim pa byung /yang phyag rgya zil gnon yab yum sras sprul 'khor bcas dngos su gzigs pa dang / yang zil gnon sku shin tu khro zhing mi sdug pa zhig gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis dam sri gdug can ring du bskrad (1 can)pa dang / zil gnon dpa' bo gcig pa sku yid du 'ong ba zhig gis gsungagis 〈gi 〉sgra dbyangs cher sgogs 〈sgrog 〉pa zhig gzigs pa nas bzung dus kun yi dam gyi gsal snang dngos su gsal ba dang / yi dam gzhan gang yang bskyed rim mdzad ma thag de nyid lam lam 'gro ba byung / sa yos lor dbus gtsang kun tu 'brum bu'i 'tsho ba khyab shin tu che ba dang /rdzong gsar gyi nye bskor 〈skor 〉du yang 'tshe ba byung bar dmigs/log byu pā la'i las sbyor sgrub pa mdzad skabs/ thor thun zhig la drang srong dri med dge ba dngos su gzigs nas/ 'brum nag gi 'jigs pa las grol ba'i dbugs dbyung dang / sngon chos rgyal snyarma a sho nar sa tshul gyi lo rgyus dang / shā ga rakṣa'i bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉mdzad dgos sogs bslab bya lung bstan mang du gnang / slar drang srong gi lung ltar dra rag gi bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉bdun phrag gcig gnang ba'i tshe/ rakṣa'iphyag 'phreng gi thag pa sbrul nag 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu gyur pa dang /sku lus la phyag rgya thebs pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs/ rig pa'i rgyal pa dpa' bo rkyang sgrub dngos su gzigs pas 'gro kun sa bdag klu'i gnod pa rgyun 'chad pa'i smon lam nan tan mdzad/ klu'i rgyal po gzi chen dngos su byung nas/ dbu ru na tshal gyi klu khang du rang gzhan kugagyi (gyis 〉sha chang mi khyer bas 〈ba'i 〉khrims (19༄ba)bca' ba gnang 277

na bod khams la phan pa'i lo rgyus zhus/ sngar 'das pa'i dus rgyal po ra snyar gtsug gi nor bu'i sras mtha' yas 'od du gyur tshul dran/thor thun zhig gi skabs rigs rgyal dbu dgu phyag nyis brgya rtsa zhal sdig pa'i zhal sogs tshogs bsgrub snubs lugs ji ltar ba sogs gzigs pa byung / yang bye ri stag rtser zla gsang gi gzhi bsnyen ya ma bcu bdun pa'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i tshe/ nub gcig mnal lam du rtse ba'i tshoms yin rgyu ba zhig tu 'gong po'i sprul pa bande 'gas nyid la co 'dri ba'i tshig mang du brjod pa'i na/ 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i nga ros de rnams dpa' zhum pa dang / yang nub gcig bande seng ge'i mgo can zhig gis ma byas dmag mang du byung bar/ zla gsang rgyud kyi nad ngan gtong ba'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ dmag mi thams cad khrag phyugs nasashi ba dang / nam mkha' nas thog ser mang po babs pa na/ phur bu gsangs shing sdig mdzub mdzad pas/ de dag phyogs gzhan du 'gyur nas ri rtser mchod rten zhig la thog babs nas bshig pa sogs byad kha bsgyur ba'i mtshan ltas mang du byung / yang rta dmar po shin tu legs ba zhig chibs nas nam mkhar chibs rgyugs mdzad pas/ 'di rmi lam byu 'dug par mkhyen cing rmi lam sgyu (1 na)mar grol ba dang / tshesabargyad kyi nub mnal lam du bdag cag gi ston pa lha dang mi'i rgyal po/nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis bskor/ skye bo'i khrom chen po'i dbus su mu stegs gi 〈kyi 〉ston pa drug la thub pas cho 'phrul du ma bstan nas tshar ba da pa dang / dngos su 'jam dbyangs dang drang srong zhi drag 'khor lo sdom pa soṭa yi dam gyi lha mang du gzigs pa dang / dngos nyams 'od gsal gyi ngang rigs drug gi gnas dang / sde brgyad lha 'dre rnams kyis cho 'phrul spre ma ston pa sogs mang du gziṭa par de dag thams cad thugs 7

kyi ro kha pa ra ma kye cing gzi ga cho / 3 ba byung / bsnyen sgrub kyi ltas zla ba tha nga kha kur ba byo /bas cha da ku bye pas sta ga 〈rtaṭa 〉ma cham mngon du gyur/cha 'ong sa 'byung 'gyur ca/nga du ma khye —/ nga/ na phyir de dag thog tu ma babs pa ga// nub kyang thur / yang nub —/cig ma/na la lam du mgon khang zhig tu rjed ma / bye ( ba 'ga' cig ma mas/na srungs 〈srung 〉ma rnams dang lhan gcig〈cig 〉ka /'a 'debs bstod pa mdzad pa dang / yang nub gcig bdag cas li 4 ba pa'i dbang po sku mtshan dpe rdzobs pa zhig mjal ba'i sems skyed gas ri bye smon lam mdzad/ yang paṇḍi 1 nag 〈naṭa 〉kyi rin chenadang ma 22 bas phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa chigs bcad gsung ba dang /ya nga jo bo rje dang mjal ma/sa jo bo / nyid la gus tshul dang / (19 ba)gsu/nga rab kyi ma nga mo mang du mdzad/ yang gnas brtan dus ldan gyis bsku rgya gar shar lho'i ri la byon pas/ der gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dbyar sa/nas/ la bzhugs par mjal/ yang mi dkar po zhig gis ston ba ri 6/2 'gram mams dang bcas pa rje la phul ba sogs/ dngos dang nyam sa 'ad gsal gyi ngang gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba mtha' yas so/lcag / 'brug gi lor e dang phan yul snye mo sogs nas yig rig pa brgya dang bku ༄ 5 mthing shog gi ngos la gser dngul spel mas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal rnying ma rgyud 'bum dang bcas pa po ti brgya dang nyi shu nga 6/ngas pa gnang ba'i/ lo de'i smin drug zla bar grub cing rje nyid ma/— ljab/ra zhus legs par mja da shing 〈cing /〉 zla gsang gi sgo nas rab tu sa/nas pa rgyas par mdzad/ yig rig pa rnams la yon gyis tshim par gnang / gter chen 'ja' tshon snying po las/ de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉za gter chos longs sprul gsum/ zhi khro nges don snying po sogs gas /phar yang dbang chos mang bar gnang / lcags sgrul lor/ dag 37

/sto /cho /yo /byeldan pho brang dang / gu shrī ma da yon gyis sgar gtsang ma da na rgyal sa blangs pa'i sde gzar thim/ shu/ sa ba byung / 'bre gung du bod sog gi mi sna tshan che ba 'byor/ rdzong sa/sa ra sta ga rdzong tha /zi / khang btsan dmigs rnams gshig (198na)rje nyi da rtse ba gzhis khar gdan chags/ rta lo dang lug lor dbus gtsang du sad kyi gnod pa tshad las 'das pas/ mi phal cher mu ges shi/ dbul po rnams kyis mi'i mad pa ldag pa dang /bud med la las khye bsad pa'i sha za ba sogs sngar ma grags pa'i skal pa ngan pa byung bas/ sprel lo dang bya lor sad srungs 〈srung 〉gnang bas 'gro kun mu ge'i 'jiṭa pa las grol/ de nas rje ratna'i a stag kun dga'i zhus lan gyi lung bstan dang / gdung brgyud 〈rgyud 〉mi 'byung ba mkhyen nas/ shing bya hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin sku sngags chas dor nas/ bla ma ba log pa sbyin pa phun tshogs kyis mkhan po dang /ra khyim dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis las slob sogs kha bskong grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ skabs shig nang khul gyi ser skya kha shas kyis snying la dam thi brlams pa'i bya byed mang du rtsams 〈brtsams 〉shing / a bo nag gu bas gzhung mchod yon byu dbyen sbyor gyi zhu log la brten/ mchod yon gyis rje nyid lha ldan du 'gugs gnang thog sgyur sbyang dang / dpal dro shag tu sgor skyil sogs mi 'tsham pa mang du byung zhing / de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yo ba dang /rje bsrung 〈srung 〉mi sog po rnams kyis mthong snang du rje'i sku las me 'bar ba dang / mtshan mo dmag chen po (198ba)'grim pa'i sgra sogs cho 'a lnga du ma byung / 'bras spungs nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ rje nyid la dbugs dbyung bska baba' tham dang / mchod yon du bka' mchid gsung nan bcas skya'i nyas 380

dmigs las grol zhing / snyan grags cher rgyas par gyur/ mtshad yon gyi sku tshab dang bcas/ jo shākya/ zhwa lha khang / 'bri gung thel gyi mtshad khang mgon khang rnams su byin chad bstan don la rgyar dgos nges ma gtogs mchod yon phyogs la mngon spyod kyi las mi mdzad pa'i gtsig 'bul ba gnang / log par lta ba'i bsam sbyor byed po yang mi ring bar rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu mthong chos su gyur/ rje dra ro bas 〈pa'i 〉gdung 'bum rdzong gsar du bzhugs pa thel khang gsar yang dgon du spyan 'dren rab gnas mdzad/ rdzong gsar gzhung sa nas 'bri gung rang la 'jag 〈'jaṭa 〉gnas gnang ba yin yang / rang phyoṭa 'ga' zhig gis go ma chod pa'i blo ngor gzhung 'bul grub/ 'dul ba'i mdo rtsar ma na 'grel dang / zab lam chos drug gi khrid dra ro'i zhabs kyi zhal lung /dgongs gcig gi rnam bshad le tshan gnyi sa/ bde mchog ga lo'i lha lnga/ dril bu'i lha lnga/ drug cu pa/ byu rdo rje sa lugs/ spyan ras gziṭa phreng ba skor ba/sum bskor 〈skor/〉 lhan skyes rnam bzhi/ bla mid sa rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun/ (1 na)ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu/ kun rigs/ bka' brgyad dang / dgongs pa yang zab/ gshin rje gshed yang bzlog me'i spu gri/ lcags sdig sa chu log tri sogs gsar rnying gi dkyil chog sgrub phrin dang / gzhan yang rig gnas sogs drang nges kyi bstan bcos grangs kyi mi lang ba mdzad/sa byi lor dwags po 'tsho byed bsod nams legs pa'i ngor rtse ba'i g.yul khar gur chen khams gsum zil gnon phub te 〈ste/〉 sngon 'gro'i tshogasabasags nas bzung / mar me smon lam yan chad bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa myang lugs sgrub chen dang / dbang mchog rin chenagaser 'phreng (dang )'brel ba/ yan lag bdud byu sman sgrub rkyen bzlog 281

khro rol khyung dgu ma/ thog mtha' bar bku — ku rjo — — tsho — — 57duga'aphyams〈'cham 〉zor 'phyams 〈'cham 〉 ri ( — ri da — pa pa 'a zu ga len gtsang ma ji lta ba zla ba byed gnyis bar 'a du ga nga nga sa / da ma sa / ring ga'anaphyoṭa mtha' nas skal ldan 'dus pa khri phrag du / pa sa pa tshe do nge theg pa'i lam bzang por 'god par mdzad pa'i thon/ mar — ri tun tu 'ba' 'odadang me tog gi char/ 'dzab kyi rang sgra/ sman gyi dri bsung / rol mo'i sgra la soṭa pa der 'dus kun gyi mngo na sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba (1 ba)rmad du byung / sa glang lor chel sgo mang gtsug lag khang la gser phebs sgron pa gnang kyang 〈yang /〉 phyis dam sel phran bu 'ga' zhig gi rkyem/ gyis gser phibs dib pa yin 'dugabad gling gsum pa tshul khrims rdo rje las/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo na thog do bzang luṭa rnying rgyud soṭa snga 'gyur gyi chos 'ga' zhig gsan/phar yang chos kha shas gnang / rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po chos 'khor rgyal du chibs bsgyur bstsal bar/ mjal 'bul du mal dro gung mkhar du phebs/rgyal dbang mchog nas khri thog nas bzhengs pa khri gdan sogs zol 〈gzos 〉sgo che ba gnang / snga 'gyur tsha ga kyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/gu sa bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ dbyings sa bsod nam sa rab brtan gnyis kyis rje la phyag 'bul zhu ba sogs gus 'dud che ba mdzad/ yang phyi lo rgyal dbang lnga pa rgya nag tu chibs kha bsgyur skabs phebs phyel du 'dam thang 'brog tu phebs/ bka' brgyad sa/tso gyur sa/sang sngab/sa snga 'gyur gyi gsung gleng zhib pa mdzad/ mthong gzos tshad med pa gnang / skabs shig sku bad dang chab gzhi la brten pa'i bsnyun bab phyi ba byung bar rje dkon mchog rin chen kyis sgrol dkar gyi dbang phul skabs/ do'i sa tsha mang po mnal lam du byung / snyam po 'tsho byed rab brtan bzang po/ཿ ཿ

dwags po 'tsho byed lo yag sogs (100na)sman pa du mas sman dpyad phul ba dang sku'i rim gro 'bad rtsol gyi 〈kyis 〉rim par dwangs/ shing rtalo thuṭa dam rten cho 'thu la chen po'i ma chod rten gser dngul las grub pa bzhengs 〈bzheng 〉ba 〈bar 〉bal bod kyi bzo bo nyi shu skor gyi las grwa tshugs/ lo de'i mjug sgo lung du rje dkon mchog rin chen zhing khams 'phos pa'i tshul bstan par dgongs rdzoṭa kyi rim pa rgya che bar gnang /shing lug cho 'phrul zla bar thel du phebs nas khang gsar yang dgon du thugs dam mu stegs pham byed kyi mchod rten gzungs 'bul sogs rim gyis grub par/ rje nyid 'dus pa dang bcas pas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ma sad/ rab ston dang / bzo ba rnams la zang zing gi yon sogs rgyas par stsal 〈bstsal/〉 de nas lung du gcen gyi dgongs rdzoṭa chog ma dang gral dbur stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bas shis dpal grub spyan 'dren mjal phrad dang / slar rtse bar phebs nas phan tshun chos kyi gsan pa kha shas mdzad cing 'byu stag thugs nang shin tu gtsang ba byung /khamasanas chos sras kyi mthu 〈thu 〉bo lho 'phrin las rnam rgyal byon nas 'bul nod thin tu rgya che ba phul/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang rgyas pa sgrub chen dang sgraṭa pa dbang phran 'ga' zhig gnang na mi ring bar khams su brdzong ba gnang / skabs shig mgon po phyag (100ba)bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub cig gnang skabs thog mar rang mtshon rang la bkun ba sogs cho 'phrul che yang / mthar lha grub ba'i mtshan ltas rdzogs par byung/ spyo lung gce na rje'i gdung 'bum lha babs dang gser gdugs gzim mal sku bcas bzhengs par grub nas thel du spyan 'dren dang / rab tu gnasapa mdzad/ skabs shig 'bras spungs su rgyal dbang lnga pa ma la bar 283

phebs bas/ sngar ltar zos 〈gzos 〉sgo che ba dang / gshin rje gshed kyi skor la doṭa gcod mang du gnang bar zhib 'bul dang /dbyings sa bsod nams rab brtan dang mjal bod skabs sngar dus ltar gus tshul che ba dang / mchod yon so so nas gnang skyong tshad med pa byung / 'bras spungs dang /po ta la/lha sa bcas kyi gnas gziṭa zhib pa gnang / me byalor gshin rje'i bsrung 〈srung 〉'khor yod pa'i gser gduṭa grub pa gnanganas thel du cho 'phrul mchod rten gyi steng la chub nas de nyid kyi sgo nas rab gnas kyang mdzad/ thub ba na yangs ri sgar gyi chos grwa chen mo sngon chad phyogs med du byon pa las rten thub kyi bzhugs yul med par/'di skabs sgar che chung gnyis yod par zla bsgril nas zhabs drung zur bzhuṭa rim byon gyi gsol skal rjo lung yin ra mchod thebs su sbyar nas gdan chags pa mdzad pa dang / lo dus (101na)sos gtor chen modang /gshin rje yang bzlog gi bsrung 〈srung 〉bzlog sgrub pa soṭa chag med gnang /rje dgon mchog rin chen kyis 〈kyi 〉mchog gi sprul sku 'khrul medalong por 'khrungs pa sngon bzhin mngon sum snang ba bzhin sa khyi lor 'brigung du spyan 'dren dang / mtshan dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang por gsol cing bstan pa'i bdag po don gyis bkas gtad mdzad pa sogs mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bstan par sman yon gyi mdzad pa rlabs chen mchog ku rtser/ sa phag lor gtsang sgar gyi mtshams grwa brje len la tho lung du 'dus pa che bar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams khrid soṭa zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du stsal 〈bstsal/〉 sgar gyi bca' yig gsar du bsgriṭa nas 'dus pa rnams la chos mthun dgos tshul bslab bya nan tan gnang / lo 'dir sad srung bcas chog mdzad par/ nam mkha' stong pa yang bran bzhin du 'khol te/ rgyal khams phyogs ma 'a kun tu 284

'bras drug shin tu legs pa byung / ston dus lha ldan du phebs/ rgyaladabang mchog bcad rgya dam par 'dug kyang rje sku 'khor nyung bsdus (la )mjal kha byung / bzhugs gdan khyad med sogs sngar las zol 〈gzos 〉sgo che ba (101ba)gnang / nyin gnyis ring gshin rje yang bzlog lcags sdig 'char kha gi nang sogs gshed bskor dogs gcod zhib rgyas dang / lcags sdig gi mchod rten bcas chog gi phyag len gsas 〈gsal 〉byed kyi bsku ma dang / zang zing gi gnang skyong che ba byung / 'bri gung du phebs nas/ rang zhabs za kha lho ma ba dang / rong pa rnams kyis spyan drangs par/ mang ra'i sum mdo gzhung dang / 'og rgod rnams su phebs/ so sor chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ rgyal dbang mchogagi bkas bskul ba'i/ gshin rje lcags sdig gis 〈gi 〉mchod rten bcas chog rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon non ljags sgrig mdzad nas 'bul ba gnang bar/ dgyes pa mchog tu bskyed nas/ bka'i glegs bu rten bzang po dang bsngaṭa brjod rgya che ba gnang / gzhan yang bka' brgyad kyi khro rol gnam lcags thog chen sogs dang / yang zab kyi kha bskor 〈skong 〉kha shas mdzad nas/ chos kyi grags pa'i nyi 'od 'bar ba'i tshe/ /blo ldan padma'i tshal rnams bsten re ran/ /rta bdun dbang po nub rir chas pa na/ /zla ba skar mas padma'i tshogs mi dbye/ /zhes gsungs shing / sku de'i 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams rdzogs par nye ba na/ gnas chen tsā rir nags tshal nyams (103na)dga' ba phal cher sha bud 〈'od 〉kyis khyer ba/gdan sa thel dang / 'on du dgun dus stag ma dang / kham bu ku shu'i me tog 'char ba/ rtse bar dgun dus 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur gyis pho brang g.yogs pa/ 'brug sgra 'byung ba sogs mtshan ltas mi legs pa mang du byung / za ba bcu gcig pa'i skor nas bsnyun tshul 285
