bstan pa na/ sku rim rgya cher bsgrubs pa dang / bra sa bu skob rnams kyis zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan du ba (ba kyang /dgung lo re lnga pa sa mo phag gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes btso brgyad kyi srodal thugs ma gtor bsngos rgyas par gnang nas chos skyong ba'i srungs 〈srung 〉ma rnams la bstan pa skyong bar bka' bsgo bar mdzad nas/ mngonapar rdzogs pa byang chub kyi cho 'phrul ston pa mdzad do/ lcaṭa bye cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun nyin/ paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad de/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nasasku gdung yid bzhin nor bu zhugs su phul ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' phal cher 'ja' 'od kyi 〈kyis 〉gang ba dang ze 'bru'i phreng ldan gyi char dang / bya rgod zung gcig dma' ba 〈bar 〉'ongs te bur dud la bskor ba dang /bdun tshig dang tshes bco brgyad byung rdo cog la 'ja' lnga ldan dang / me tog gi char soṭa ngo mtshar ba'i (101ba)ltas bsam la sa 'das pa byung /chog mang gi gral dbur stag lung khri rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal leṭa grub rgyan drangs te 'dus pa dang bcas par bsnyen bkur 'bul ba mtha' yas pa dang / lo der gser dngul las gdung brten 〈rten 〉lha babs mchod rten bzhengs pa yang mi 'gyang bar grub ste/ gling rin po che'i khang gsar yang dgon du bzhugs te/ 'dus pa rgya mtshos rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa sogs dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya dpangs mtho ba rmad du byung ba grub bo/ rnam thar rgyas pa ni logs su gsal/ rje 'di la slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bgrang bar mi nus kyang / mchog tu gyur pa nyi zla lta bu/—rgyal tshab dam pa rgyal ba phyag na padma ngur smrig gi zol la ston pa dkan mchog 'phrin la sa bzang po ni 'og tu gsal la/ lho 'phrin las rnam rgyal ni/ 'thong rgyas lung par 'khrungs/ rje'i drung du rab 286

tu byung / mtshan dkon mchog 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes dang / 'bri gung pa/ri chos spyi dang / bka' dgongs so gas gsar rnying gi gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rje dgon mchog rin chem/ las/ dge tshul mang sgrub 〈bsgrubs 〉shing / rdo rje phreng ba sogs kyi dbang gsan/ba log pa sbyin pa phun tshogs/ sgam po pa nor bu rgyan pa/ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying po/ stag lung bkra shis dpal grub sa gas mkhas (103na)grub skyes chen mang du brten 〈bsnyen/〉 dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod mnga' brnyes/ rje dkon mchog ratnas sgom sde nang chen gyi mchod gnas su ba nga ba mdzad pas/ mdo khams kyi phyogs thams cad la la byon/ 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la bkod/ mi g.yel dpal gyi phug par dgon gnas btab ste gdan chags/ bla ma dgon 'dus/ gro lod/ phyag rdor/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ sa phyi sogs yi dam chos srungs 〈srung 〉mang po'i bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉mdzad pa'i lha rnams zhal gzigs pa sogs rtags mtshan khyad par can du ma byung / phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid snyam kiti'i zhal lung zhes pa 'di nyid ma dzab/ pa dang / bka' 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du babyungs/ khyad par thel gyi rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan dang / bcu gnyis pa'i sku 'bum la gser thog ngo mtshar ba sgron pa sogs 'bri bsta na la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad/ khyab 'jug rā hu la dang /pe sa lo dre kho har tsa dmar ba gas gas pa can thams cad bran du 'a la/lha klu gzhe bdag ma/thu bo che rnams la bka' bsgos pa tsam gyis char chu dus su 'bebs pa so/ga rim gnyis phul du phyin pa'i yon tan du ma ma nga'/ rje 'phrin las bzang po'i rigs bdag tu gyur (103ba)byung / dbang chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul ba mdzad pas bstan287

pa'i sgo na me chen po kho na yin cing / phyis dbus su phebs skabs lam bar du dam sel phran bu'i rkyen gyis dgung lo re bdun la sku zhi bar gshegs so/ 'di la rnam thar rgyas pa ni logs su yod/ mnga' bdag rgyal sras bkra shis phun tshogs ni/ mas yul gyi rgyal rigs las 'khrungs shing / thog mar rje na ro pa'i drung rab tu byung / rje 'di nyid dang /skyes chen 'ga' zhig las chos mang bar gsan/ gshin rje gshed bsnyen bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉mdzad pa'i zhal dngos su gzigs/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las la thogs pa med pa mthu stobs la mnga' brnyes/ yangs ri sgar gyi bla ma lo mang mdzad/ phyis rje 'phrin las bzang po'i dbu blar gyur/dbang chos 'ga' zhig 'bul ba mdzad cing / dgung lo gya bzhi par gshegs so/ paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub ni/ glo bo stod ske mir sku 'khrungs/ rje snyam kirti'i zhabs la gtugs dbang chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ gsang sngags gsar rnying mtha' dag gi bskyed rdzogs phyag len dang / bka' bstan rig gnas thams cad la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pas paṇḍi stor rtser/ gshin rje'i gshed dang yi dam du ma la grub pa brnyes/ 'on rin chen brag dang / na tshal gyi (104na)bla ma yun ring mdzad/ gong ma 〈sa 〉lnga pa chen po'i thugs la shin tu btags shing / mthong zos 〈gzos 〉che ba gnang / rje bha dra'i zhabs kyi dbu blar gyur/ gsar rnying gi dbang chos shin tu mang ba 'bul ba dang /de dag gi phyag len dang rig gnas sogs gsan pa'i slob dpon yang mdzad/ phyis snye mo shag ram gyis (gyi 〉mtshams bla yang mdzad par grags so/ gzhan yang dpal 'bri gung gi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i chos sras bu chen lung rtogs kyi yon tan mnga' ba grangs las 'das so/'phaṭa mchog thuṭa rje'i chu gter las byung zhing / /gsol btab tsam288

gyis 'dod dgu 'bad mid stsol/ /'gro ba'i re bskong 〈skong 〉bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /kurma bha dra'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /gdan sa nyer bzhi pa rje btsun dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po ni/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid bsam bzhin mi'i zol gyi 〈kyis 〉'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar sems can gyi don mdzad pas gong smos rgyal dbang dkon mchog rin chen de nyid/ gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas dga' ldan du mgon po byams pa'i drung lha'i tshogs kyis bsko ra te bzhugs/ de skabs 'byu gung byu ra'i gdung chad kyang / slar yang mnyam med 'bri gung pa'i (104ba)bstan pa skyong phyir/ byang kong long po'i phyogs glang grong zhes par yab sngags brgyud 〈rgyud 〉a bo lha rgyal dang / yum gso dbyad pa'i rigs rdo rje rgyal mo zhes pa las/ rje nyid lha yul nas thang dkar rgod po zhig tu sprul nas lhums su bzhuṭa pa'i tshe/yum la rmi ltas bzang po du ma byung ba dang / dngos su bud med rgyan ldan zhig dang / rtoṭa ldan dung long can zhig gi yum la khrus byed cing bsrung 〈srung 〉ba dang / de nas me sprel hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bcolnga'i tho rangs khar sku bltam pa na/ sna lnga'i 'a 'a zug pa/ me tog dkar po'i char babs pa/ da li'i me tog rgyas pa sogs mtshan ltas kun sum tshogs pa byung / rje chos kyi grags pas sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs te sgar nas grwa pa no no bkra shis dang / dbang rgyal gnyis la sa yul khyim sgo sogs gsal bar bstan te brjong bar mdzad pas khong gnyis kong long gi phyogs phal cher btsal bas grong sogs 'khrul med nges thes rnyed de/ 'bri gung du rje la gsol bas/ slar khong gnyis dang dge slong zang phrug sogs brdzong ba gnang nas/ 'bri gung du spyan 'dren mdzad pas/ rje 'di dgung lo gsum bzhes pa sa 289

khyi zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer lnga la rtse bar phebs/ re zhig (105na)hor khang du bzhugs/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i drung dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang por gsol/ de skabs mnga' ris rgyal sras chos rjes smo lung zhabs drung pa'i sprul sku phebs yod 'dra bas de la phul zhes gser zho lnga bcu bskor 〈skor 〉bskur ba skun phra mo yin kyang phyag tu bsnams te rje chos kyi graṭa par phul bas shin tu mnyes/ gshin rje gshed dang dgongs pa yang zab yid bzhin nor mchogarje'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs bcas pod dbang bka' gtad mdzad de bstan pa'i bdag por don gyis byin rlabs bstsal/ mi ring bar rje bharma ke zhing rjes 〈brjes 〉pa'i skabs/ de nub mtshan phyed tsam la rje nyid nam mkhar byon pa gzigs nas/ spos 'bul ba dang smon lam yang mdzad/ de snga rje 'di zhal sgo mi gsal yang de skabs nas shin tu gsal bar gyur/ dgung lo lnga pa lcags byi lor lha ldan du phebs/ gong ma lnga pa chen tha las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas 'bri gung du bad gling gsum pa tshul khrims rdo rje dang / thugs sras sprul sku las/bla ma dgongs 'dus dang / pad gling gi skor sogs rnying ma'i chos mngapo gsan/ dge slong ra khyim pa dang / nyi khri rin 'byung las yi ge brisaklog rang lugs 'don chos spyod sogs (305ba)la sbyangs/ dgung lo drug pa lcags glang lor gdan sa chen po byang chub gleng du gser khrir / mnga' gsol/ 'dus pa rnams kyis shis brjod me tog 'thor/ lo de nyid du sgo lung la 'dus tshogs la dbang chos thog mar gnang ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char babs/ rje snyam kirti'i zhal slob paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub las/ dgongs pa yang zab gshin rje'i gshed sogs zab cing rgya che bde chos mang bar gas na skabs/ nub gcig 'od gsal 390

ri —— — — rngo she 'ardis ) dag pa ye shes kyi khrus/ rje ri bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dab ri rgya pa ra nga tshe nga ba dang // dpal mgon 'al bzhi pa'i rjes ba/ma/nga sang nub ca na / pa/ bam ba/ces/sa dngos/ su byung mas 'phrin las sa ba rnga ba ༄ ba/ra / — /nga ba / sku ma chen kyi cho sa sras thu bo lho 'phrin ra ma rte — ri sa sa re che dang ra gru 1 ༄ ma gsam// nub spang ༷ ri ma — ) da — nga brdo das ga/ ma tsho che na tha yi/da du 'ong ba'i da kyi ba par ro na ༷ no ༷ ba nge ba ga — pa ) / ma da —/ rtog dang mthun pa zhis/ sa/zigs thi/ra / ba pa sa ba de byed kha ri / phya ga rgya chen po lnga ldan/ dra ro'i chog sa sa do —ga ཿ / ma 'bri sang ba 'i chos tha /sa cad dang / gsar ) ri 0( 〈se 〉 cho ri bas nyi/ pa da khyab pa gsan/ ma lug lor rje dkon mtsha nge / 1/sa pa/ sa ca kyi grab sa pa rnam sa/nyis kyi bka ra 'bum (10༄ na)ra pa 4 /zhe — ba rdo/ ga se ra gyis bris pa bzhings 'phaṭa pa ye de ba ( pa —— baX / ra ba gnang ba'i che nub gcig mtsho chem / sha sa che — bur pa sdo nga steng 'phas/sa ma sgrub thabs dang mthun par bza ri ci / da ṇa 3 sha da ngo/nga/ thon/ nyi khri rin chen 'byung gnas/ba ma dpa/pa ca/ shā — sogs las/ sgra'i mtshams sbyor/ snyan ngag dang rtsib/ kyi pa/zhung chen sos/sa rig gnas mtha' dag la gsan sbyongs 〈sbyong 〉gnang bas byes sbyangs 〈sbyang 〉gi stobs kyis mkhyen rab pha mthar son/lha bri ba la sbyangs pa mdzad pas shin tu mkhas shing / da lta 'bri gung 'dir mkhyen lugs kyi ri mo rje 'dis 〈'di'i 〉zhal slob kyis 〈kyi 〉rgyun yin la/ phyis shig rnam gling paṇa chen da zhe/ma/ mchos/ chos/ grags las/ ska ga lnga pa'i gzhung lugs chen rma ga(/na par ca/ba/ bdum/ sa thugs su chud ba sa slab dpon yang ngo mtshar bas byur/ cag bya lori rta na — zug lha ldan du phebs skabs/ rgyal ma chog dza rwa che na po na ga bka' brgyad 291

kyi gar 'phyams 〈'a ma 〉ga gas 'bul dgos phebs par/ bde 'dus las gzhung sgral las don brgyad dang 'brel ba 'phyams 〈'cham 〉rgyas paramadzad pas gza' phod soṭa gnang skyong tshad med byung / skabs shig dpalastobs 'phrog nag po'i bsnyen (105ba)bsgrub 〈sgrub 〉gnang ba'i tshe/gzhung dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan mang du byung ba dang / khyad par nub gcig 'od gsal gyi ngang mgon po zam gzuṭa kyis bskul ste zangs mdog dpal rir phebs pa soṭa byung / bstan srung ba'i chos kyi sgol ma'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad dus/ bstan srung ma nyid kyis srungaba'i 'khor lo zab rgyacan chig brgyud bka' rgyas btab ste〈ste 〉gnang / 'char can gyi gshin rje gshed kyi bsrung 〈srung 〉bzlog gi sgrub pa thog mar bzhuṭa dus dang /phyis dgung lo bzhi bcu'i bar lo re bzhin sgrub pa'i gral dbur bzhugs dus bsrung 〈srung 〉bzlog gi rtags mtshan khor yug tu byung ba dang / tsārag pad luṭa/ yang zab kyi bla ma ma dbang 'dzin pa soṭa kyi bsnyenasgrubs 〈sgrub 〉gnang dus kyang gzhung mthun gyi mtshan ltas mang du byung zhing / khyad par 'od gsal gyi ngang lho nub rnga yab gling du padma 'od kyi phobrang chen por phebs te gu ru badmas rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma lan du mar byung /gter sgom tshogs khang gi yang thong phug sa phug rnams su sku mtshams mdzad skabs dngos nyams 'od gsal gyi ngang gzigs snang mang du byung zhing / khyad par dgyes pa rdo rje thod pa can gyi lha dgu'i dkyila'akhor yongs rdzogs gsal bar gzigs/ sad bsrung 〈srung 〉char (10 na)'a bas sogs gzhan gyi zhu bar ma ltos par rtag tu mdzad cing sems can re re'i don chung ngu'i phyir yang nyid kyi thuṭa dam gal che rnams kyang btang snyoms su mdzad de/ sad srungs 〈srung 〉thog mar gnang skabs byang na mar sogs sa grang bas za thog tu ba mo kha ba babs pa tsam292

byung ba/ mtho rang 〈tho rangs 〉kyi ma/ dam pa nyid kyis thugs 'dun gtad ma thag zhu 〈bzhu 〉nas nang du thigs pa babs/ skabs shis/ thel gyi khang gsar byang ma'i gzim chung du zla gsang gi gzhi bsnyen gnang ba'i tshe yi dam dngos su zhal gzigs/ phyis mal der zhal bar rang byon byon par da lta yang mjal rgyu yod/ lha mchog 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉bsnyen sgrubs 〈sgrub 〉kyi rim pa dus rtag par mdzad 〈cing 〉so sor gzhung dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur cing / yang phyis shig rtse bar ya ma bcu bdun par brten pa'i gzhi bsnyen gnang du ri 'chi bdag sde brgyad bran du khol ba'i ltas mang du byung ba snang / rje chos kyi grags pa'i gzim mal sku brnyan gser zangs las mi tshad tsam byon gtsang ba bzhengs nas rab gnas skabs sngar mthong ma myong ba'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i dra ba dra phyed go la'i khyim sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / sngar rje nyer brgyad pa'i sku tshe'i mjug nas bzung rje kun dga' rin chen (10 ba)gyi sku thog gi bar thel dang mtshe'u khar phur pa'i rtsa 'phyams 〈'cham 〉darazhing / rgyal dbang ratna'i byu dus nas bde 'dus gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉'di mnal lam du zangs mdog dpal rirazhus dag mdzad pa khungs btsun par grags pa 'di nyid dang / thel du mgon po'i khrag 'byung rol pa/ a phyi'i dgyes gar bcas dar zhing /rje 'dis/ mgon po dang /a phyi'i gtso 'khor/ bka' srung smug nag lcam dral/ ha ra/ chos rje'i dge bsnyen rnam bzhi/ tshangs pa/ thang lha/zhing skyong yab yum/ pe har/ gnod sbyin rtsi dmar sogs rang lugs chos skyong tshang ma'i gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉ngo mtshar ba gsar 'dzugs gnang / phyis phel du yang de mtshungs 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa mdzad/ de nas bzung rang lugs dgon gnas 'ga' zhig la dar/ me sbrul lor rtsetso 3

ba'i g.yul khar gur chen phub ste/ bka' sa༄ ga bde 'du 5) kyi dbang sgrub chen che// yan lag gi sman sgrub/ rkyen bza — 1 ro ga gyur dgu ma gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉sos gong ma na rim kyi 〈 bye 〉phya ba bce rig ji lta ba gnang zhing / ska la lda ma 'dus pa khri phrab/ du ca/ra da sa nga pe zo rje theb pa'i lam la dkri bar mja da pa'e tsho 'ja' 'od ma nge na /kur bye ma / me sto ga gi gyi dri 8 〉so ga sa sa char/ sman bsrung bcu nga /gas nga ma — ra ba ra ta ri ) ju ri sam sa sa mi khyab ba byung / dgu ri lo nyer sa/su ke pa sa rta lor lha lda rgyal khab kyi pho brang (108na)dam ra po rir/ rgyal dbang tha sa cad myo khyen pa ngag dbang blo ba za ra rgya ma 'i drung bsnyen par dzesar / pa'i dge bee ri ba/ sdom pa bzhes pa'i ma tsha na ngag dbang chos grags phun tshos ri/ zhes gan ri / de yang rgyal po bka' thang las/ shākya'i zhing khams lo nga stod ce ri sgo ma// /byang sems/ smon lam gas/na gyi don la brtson/ /ma 'ong ri ma ba ri pa presas zhes bya ba 'byung / /zhes rje 'a di 'u nga bstan thog tu bang pas ma tshan yin la/smin gling nas rtsod bral gyi skyes mchog chosag rgyal ba/ ) ra bad / byugang pa byon par/ g.ya 'a ma lung / shel brag /nam lcabar brang ba/su ma gyi zab gter gyi chos rnams gas na cing / gter gsar dras po'i chas bdag rje 'di la zin pas/ de nyed zung 'grel rtse nang sa cha nga 'di de skabs 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa gnang / dra ga po'i 'phri / sa bzag gzhung / yang bzlog gi dkyil chog sogs bstan ba/ brnga ra kyang 'tha //'a /ba ma dzad/ skabs shig rdo brag rig 'dzi—/ spru da tho ri 5 'phri — ra ri / byo byu par dam chopa dgongs pa yang zab zor sob/ sa/mang / chu co pa ga der sha ra sogs mang bar gas na/ ya nga 3 ri 5 cig de snyad byo — bzhe // bka' brgyad bde 'dus/ bla ma da /ngas ngadus — ) ba ji byu byu ba ga — sa 'a she — ba so /gas mang bar gnang / gzhan yang rtse le sprul sku/ dang da 0) zu spre sku sa /sa dang :mi

mgar bstan 'dzin grags pa/ (108ba)kha ri/sa skyo nang so sogs rang re'i bu slob rnams la dus rtag/ par chos kyi 'tsha/ ra lo bsgor zhing / gtsang gi sgrub sde gnyis dang / thel dang / na tshal gyi ma char/sa grwa rnams lo gsum rer brje len skabs phyag rgya chen pa lnga ldan/ 1 ro'i chos drug sogs zab khyed rang rang gi 'dod chos du ma stsal 〈bstsal/〉 phyis gtsang sgar lo drug re nas brje len gnang / dpon slob lho 'phrin las rnam rgyal las bra ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang sgrub bskyar du gsan skabs/ sa g.yo ba/sngags kyi rang sgra/ mtshan mo dung skad grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba byung /skabs shig dgun dus hor jing gir dpon gyis gdan zhus byung bar klungashod brgyud rwa bsgring 〈sgong 〉gi gnas gziṭa dang / thang lha'i gangs rtse mar rjo dbyar gyi dus ltar 'ja' sna lnga zug pa zang char babs pa sogs dri za'i rgya ri po dgyes pa'i mtshan ma dang bcas/ byang nam ra'i nye 'dabs su ho ra byi sde thog la phebs/ phyogs der gnas pa rnams dang lam bar song sa kyi bye dgu kun gyi zang zing gi 'bul ba bsnyen bkur zhabs tog mtha' pa ri sa pa byung / so sor chos kyis bdud rtsis re 'dod gang ba gnanganas 'bri gung du phebs/ lcags rta lor gzhu snye nas yig mkhan brgya dang bcu gcig/ gis mthing shog gi ngos la sa/se/ra dngul phra can gyis rgyal ba'i bas/'a 'gyur ro 'tshal yongs rdzogs snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum bcas (1༷ na)blags bam brgya dang nyi shu bzhengs pa gnang ba zla ba lnga lhag tsam nas grub ci nga yig rig pa rnams la zang zing gi yo ba 1/ ma ma tho ba dang / de mnyam 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi sto ga 〈stob sa 〉brjod grwa thang nyer gsum bzhengs nas phyogs mthun du bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas bye rdo shā dri snad paci / rgyad rlo shā rdo ༷/ pa/ga' ༵༵ rdoX // bye/shā

zags bam brgya dang nyi shu shog dkar gyi ngos su bzhengs pa yang zla ba bzhi tsam nas grub cing da lta rdzong gsar du bzhugs/ me glang lo ra thel khang gsar byang ma'i gzim chung gi mal du 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas/ der dngul las mchod sdong bkra shis sgo mang bzo bkod khyad par du 'phags pa rin po che du ma'i phra tshar du dngar ba thog tshad gnyis lhag tsam sa steng la 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor gser gdugs bcas sna pā la'i bzo bo mkhas pa mang dag gis bzhengs pa lo de nyid la grub cing / rje nyid 'dus pa dang bcas pas zhi khro'i rigs bsdus kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i tshe 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur dbyibs dang me tog dkar po'i char sogs byung / rgyal dbang drug pa khrir phebs skabs/ lha sar phebs/ pho brang po ta lar rgyal dbang mchog dang /sa bdag sangs rgyas (10 ba)rgya mtsho lhan rgyas su mjal 'bu mdzad /de skabs smin gling gter chen las sha 'ug gter gsar skor gsan cing /phar yang bka' brgyad soṭa chos kyi bzhed pa bskang 〈bskangs/〉 rdo brag sprul sku dang yang phan tshun chos kyi skyes 'bul mdzad nas 'bri gung du phebs/ skabs shig bal du 'dus pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs dus/ sku khams cung mi bde ba zhig byung skabs/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / bstan bsrung 〈srung 〉ma zhal gzigs/ snga phyi nges med du/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i bka' thang / ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs mdzad brgya/ grub thob brgyad cu'i rtog 〈rtogs 〉bzad/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus sogs grwa thang dang / gzhan yang bris sku shin tu mang ba/ dngul gar blugs dang / tsan dan dkar dmar las sku 'ga' zhig sogs rten mang du bzheng ba mdzad/ thel dang gter sgom du lan du mar zabs shing / zel lo sprel ma'i byung ngo cog la mi tshogs shin tu che bar —

dbang dang tshogs 'khor rgyas par mdzad cib/ tshogs khang du skabs shig skas mgor zhabs rjes gnang ba dang / tsha 'ug tu phebs dus tshogs khang nang phyag zhabs kyi rjes gsal bar gnang / skabs shig rong gter ston bdud 'dul gleng pa las de nyid kyi gter chos rnams gsan/ phar yang chos kyi bzhed pa bskong 〈skong 〉bar mdzad/ rje chos kyi grags (110na)pa'i mchog sprul phyi ma 'jang yul du 'khrungs pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs te/ sngar sku na phra skabs lung bstan thang sku phyagabris gnang ltar/ shing bya lor zhabs ring ba mchod dpon dge slong chos 'byor/ gsol dpon 'bug ge roṭa grwa gnyis bcas la de skabs yang phyag bris la 'jangs 〈'jang 〉yul gyi skor yin 'dra ba/skad riṭa mi gcigapa/rtsi shing me tog sna tshoṭa bkra ba/shing thog 'bras drug 'dzom pa/mdunadu chu chen 'babs 〈'bab 〉pa/g.yas su chu mig yod pa/ yul grong sngon gyi dam tshig 'brel che ba/ 'byor ldan zhig gi khyim du yod 'dra bas rtog 'jug zhib dgos pa'i lung bstan zhib rgyas gnang nas brdzong ba mdzad pas/phyi lo khong bzhi yar 'byor thabs yul dang rtsi shing chu soṭa lung bstanaphyag bris ji lta bar sngon phag mo zhab drung yun ring bzhuṭa shing dam tshig 'brel yod pa/ 'jang 〈'a ra 〉tha thar rje'u riṭa zhig 〈shig 〉tu shing sprel lor 'khrungs pa sras ma na sas ngo mtshar ba zhig 'dug tshul gyi lo rgyus rgyas par gsol bas/slar chos 'byor 'bug ge gnyis dang / de rjes ma bla 'phrin las dbang byug ngo gagog kha shas/ bsru 〈glu 〉chas gya sam pa dang bcas gdan zhus su ba nga saganang ba geṭa med du spyan (310ba)drangs/ sa thang smin drug ba'i yar tshes gsum gyi nyin chibs bsu soṭa bkur sa du ma dang bcas/ yab sras mjal phrad skal bzang dga' spyon la spyad nagade nas zang rin po cher phebs te gser khang chos rje ཿ /

rin po che'i drung gtsug phud breg pa/ mtsha na gso ba soṭa mdzad shing 〈cing 〉phyi lo ma tho ga sprul bar ma rab byung du krub nga ra mas da/ ce ri yosalor rtse ba'i pho brang byu/ga bsos 〈gso 〉dang zas yang tho/ ga tho / rtse dga' 'khyil gsar bskrun gnang / mchog sprul cho ga kyi rgyal pos dbus/ lho sprul chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs skyes chen du ma la/ mgo / po 'bri gung pa'i chos spyi dang / dgongs 'dus/ rdo rje phreng ba so gas gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal 〈bstsa la/〉 skabs shig chab gzhi shin tu bsnyel ba byung bar/ zhabs brtan sku rim sman dpyad sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉mi ring bar dwangs shing / sbrul lor yab sras lhan cig lha ldan du phebs/ jo shāka rin po ches dbus gnas gziṭa mchod yon mja pa phyag sogs legs par grub/ de skabs bla khag sde dpon che gnyan shin tu mang ba mjal mi byung bar lugs gnyis kyis tshim par gnang nas/ yar lam la mor chos skyong gi gus/ pas btud/ rgya ma khri yang ku tshang/ (111na)sogs su mos ldan chos kyi 〈kyis 〉tshim par mdzad de/ mi ring bar bal dang gter sgom du phebs/ 'brong ngur chos khrir tshoṭa 'khor gnang skabs bar snang nas 'dzab dbyangs kyi sgra snyan po sgoṭa 〈sgog 〉pa ku/na gyi 〈gyes 〉 thos/ shi nga lus/ bar e pa'i brkos pa ma khas pa 'i ci la du phyin pa klu sbyin sogs kha shas kyis tsan dam/ /kur dmar las stson ga gad sa brtan bcu drug 'khor bcas/ ye sheri kyi mgod po ma ched brgyad gtso 'khor rnams mngon rtogs dang ma thun pa bzo bkod phun sum tshos/pa chi ba bzha nga sa/ yang phyis shig brkos pa gong gsal rnams kyis bsta / bsrungs 〈srung 〉chos kyisgron ma rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro/ tshe ring ma ched lnga / za 〈ba/za' 〉gsoda'aphrog gsum bcas bzo bkod khyad par du 'pha ri pa ngo — ri gyu ra ba bzhengs/rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs gong smos rje chos kyi grags pa'i sku tshe'i mjug398

yi ba shigazhung 'bul gnang ba na 'dug kyang / 'ad sang ra nga bzhugs yu la gal che bar dgongs// ba/zhung ma la — ) yo / su zhu 'du ri ca se nga par/ phyi ri sbyo/ra 'jag 〈'jags 〉gan nga //nga / me ze — nyes rjo ba thi tsha re nang du jo re ba/sar du phebs/ zla gcis bar bzhu / mi nga cirwa ngag e rtsa —3 sha da man phal cher gyis das/'a sto su le pa /sa/ 'bul rgya sa par byung ji ra ba /sa ra sgru /na 'a dri gung ༷ / skabs shin tu rgya che ba yo ma 'a /spyo pa ru ra / sa nga (111ba)'du ri bya sa dus/ lha ldan bar bsgo ra 〈skor 〉ba/ pa ri —ri rgya — — nga 5 brdu ba pa / zhe / ba ma bsnyen/ 'di skabs kha nga chung ba ri ) — bas 〈chas 〉 di ga 〈pe — da 〉las ga zad 'dug par/ me bya zla ba gsum pa'i na nga nas / lta'i pho brang nga de //sar rgya / gnang ba lo de'i ston mjug lam tsa — grub ru se byi nga(jun 〉gar gyi zi nga lhongs dang bcas ha cang rgya chung ba dang / gzim chu nga na da srug gi bkod pa zhib cha ma byung 'dug de skab ga phyab mdzo da dgang po ga khyod kyis gza' skar bcos sogs zhib par ltog ga gsungs pa/phya ma jod ma/sa ci/ba mor bgyis te gzigs phul bar/ da lam byi de 'a grig so yin 'dug gzhan sa rta se zhig la mkhar las byas cha/ khye ga de phung brdal nas/ po yin pas mi rung phebs par/ de skabs me bya yin pa sa pa rta'i don rtsa ba nas med kyang / phyis rje don grub chos rgyal gyi 〈rmis 〉spyo lung gi lha khang grab 〈grabs 〉yu la sa rtar ma/dzad pas slar ba/su nga de dran nas lo ga cig bshol dgo sa byung bar/ de la dgongs pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan du 'dug cing / gzhan yang 'das ma 'ongs kyis 〈kyi 〉'byung 'gyur gsal por ga zigs pa ba / mngom pa/ra mkhyen pa thogs med mnga' ba dpe tsam brjod pa yi na la re re nas spyo ba ra mi nus so/lo de'i sa ga zla bar/ mcho ga sprul cho sa pye bye — po /kwa tsha byes kyi zu mtshosadabus/ sgar thel na tshal sos/sa 3 'a du ri rwa pa che da /ri ba ca sa (111na)299

rtsi ba'i chos khri khar gzim gur khams gsum zi ba da na phyub ste/byung luṭa bka' brgyad bad 'dus kyi sngon 'gro'i ṭa ba ṭa / sa chog la tho 'dzuṭa pa dkyil 'khor sgriṭa 〈zig 〉pa'i ri pa nas ba da nga rtsa ba ma lus pa gar 'phyam sa 〈'cham/〉 nga da ma'i gtor bdagasal tshonaspyan 'dren/mar me smon lam bar gyi lcag byed rgyabyedad da byed mtha' kun tu mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung rgod / phrag du ma smi/ grol gyi lam bzang por ba da byed dngapa da da drug par mchog gi sprul skus dbus bla sa dun cu byed byedapa'igabyed 'deṭa te/ rtse ba'i gzim chung padma 'od du sabyedargya nga ra byon bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zhal byed/thog ra sa da rnams dang rgyal tho 'dzugs pa sogs nabyed dkyi rnamar sal na las bzhengs nas rtsa ba'i sgrub chen yan dab gdabyed don dbaraphran tshang ma dang /rdul tshon spyan 'drin bar byedagabyedan gnang ba'i bdunaphrag gsum la grub nas/bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi ṭa chen lam 'bras kyi khrid/ bla sgrub kyi khrid soṭa bstsal/ rsharing bar bstan 'gro spyi sger kyi gegs chags 〈chag 〉lta bus sbyong (jun 〉gar rgya dmag ltos mi chung (113ba)ba byang nas 'byor te zir bun shin tu che ba'i mgo tshuṭa/'di skabs sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi 〈gyes 〉lha sar phebs dgos tshul nan cher byung yang rje nyid sku na dang bcas bas ma grub par/ mchog sprul chos kyi rgyal po lha ldan du phebs pa'i za gcig tsam nas yar bas grub/'di skabs rje'i mnal lam du sbyong 〈can 〉gar kyi dbon ma ring don grub dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig byung bar zugs rje chen po'i byed gnang byedal ba dngade'i gdong dbyibs sogs mngon sum ltar gziṭa shing gdug pa can de dag dbang du bsdus pa dang / de rjes rgya nag gi dpon khag lnga 300

sa /ri dbyibs soṭa phyis kun gyi 〈kyis 〉mthong ba khyad med mngon sum lta dur gziṭa shing skad cha sna tshogs pa dang / sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi byus kyang ring por mi gnas tshul zhus pa zhig byung bar de dag kyang thuṭa rjes dbang du bsdus pa yin 'dug pa ltar/ phyis de dag thams cad don thog ku ma khel ba gcig kyang ma byung / de ltar rje'i thugs rjes sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi 'bri bstan tsa gnod 'tshe gtan nas ma byung yang / rdor smin grwa sogs dgon pa mang du gtor ba dang / bla ma mang du skongs 〈bkrongs 〉pa dang /rdor brag sprul sku dang thugs yid gcig 'dres yin pa skongs 〈bkrongs 〉pa sogs kyis thugs chad pa dang / lhag par sbyong (jun 〉gar khral len pa mang du 'byor pas dam grib kyi 〈kyis 〉sku khams ltem zhing / de skabs sa g.yob/ gong po nyags su (113na)'ja'i yol ba bres pa sogs byung zhing / sman dpyad dang / sku'i rim gro mang du bgyis kyang /skye 'gro bsod nams dman cing / gzhan rgyud la mi rtags 〈rtag 〉pa'i chos tshul ston phyir dgung lo re gsum pa sa khyi zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyi shar la sku'i dkyil 'khor chos byu dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ de'i tshe me tog gi char babs pa/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sngon rtse ba'i thag nyer/ 'dre skad dang / sgom zhon ma sogs kun gyi 〈kyis 〉thos pa rnams kyang / de skabs med par gyur pa ni gnas ngan du skyes pa de dag mtho ris su 'dren pa 〈par 〉ra dzad pa yin la/zla ba bdun pa'i tshes drug la sku gdung rin po che zla gsang gi sgo nas zhugs 'bul mdzad pa'i tshe/ mes sku la ma gnod cing / slar 'bar byed ci yang med pas/ sku nyid las ye shes kyi me /la dog sna tshogs rtse sko thams cad bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs su 'bar zhing / me'i sgra301

phal pa ci ji bang med par me seb 〈ba/seb 〉mas rog cho 'i — snya/na sna tshogs pa dang / du ba yang shin tu dmar 'ang ga cha/ba da nga bsur dri sogs med par dri shin tu zhim pa dang / nam mas ra 'ja ri tshon /ba dog lnga ldan gyi gur dang / gzhu dbyibs/ rtsi bas/ brgya da pyi (113ba)rnam pa sogs kyi 〈kyis 〉gang ba/ me tog gi char sder ma tsam pa dang / rgya chen gyi me tog tsam sogs de'i nyin mo'i ring babs pa/ nam mkha'i dbus g.ya 'a dag pa la chu 'dzin gyi mchod lha'i gzugs/ shin tu gsal ba du ma sogs gdung chog ma grol bar dang / lhag par sku tshig 〈tshigs 〉rnams la 'ja' 'od me tog gi char sogs nga man ra ba'i ltas bzang brjod las 'das / zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du chog mar gi gral dbur/sgam po sprul sku kun bzang nges don dbang po spyan drangs/ 'dus pa dang bcas nga ra bsnye — bkur 'bul ba mtha' las 'das pa mdzad/ e pa dbu mdzad klu bye ma/ gyis tsan dan dkar po las gzim mal 'dra sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam pa bzhengs/ phyi lo sa phag lor bal bod bzo bo mang tsam gyis gser dngul kha sa 4 babs mchod rten thog tshad gnyis pa/dbu thog tu gser sa/dugs spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor bcas bzhengs pa yang zla ba lnga nas grub/ gdan sa chen po'i khang gsar 'ogamin du dam pa nyid kyi thugs dam sgo mang gi g.yon phyogs su bzhugs/rje don grub chos kyi rgyal po 'dus pa dang bcas pas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par mjad/ gangs ri ti ser gser 'bum sogs dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa snga ra rgyun las gsum 'gyur gyi lhag pa (114na)shin tu rgya che ba byu ba 〈bsgrubs 〉so/ rnam thar rgyas pa lo gas su yod/ slob ma mchog tu gyur pa ni/ chos srid kyi rgyal tshab dam pa la/ mas gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog don grub chos ga kyi rgyal ngo da 7rig tu gas la/ chos 302

rngo / sgyu kyi thu bo lho ren po che chos/ kyi rgya ba /tsho ni/ nas che sa du ra ngas/ rje 'di'i drung rab tu byung ri /nga ga ri rna rnying bra/ cho ri zu/tha da ya — / pa sa/san/ rig ga nas dang mad pyod rgya ca tsho se — —7 su / do zung /dam / cha 'dzin pa kho na mjad/ nor za ba bye ma/ rte ra gan — pa na /dzi /tsa /mi /dza 1 ma gachags 'a na sru ma yang ma da/ na dam par da ba/ ga 〉ma/ ma nyam te chos brgyad kyi rtog pa mnal laca du yang mi mnga'/ zag ga drug gi 'khrul snang thams cad dbyi/ngas su das/ pa sogs pa ma/ tan bsam gyi/ mi khyab pa rgya mtsho lta phu mnga'/ mnga' ris ba dwa nga ri / pa ri dge slong 'grub se dang / mkha' spyod ces pa ma che da gnyis nga da pa sa/te ra ma ma da ra /tsā rir sgrub pa yun ring mdzad/ dka' thub bcud le / kho nar brten/mthar nyi ser sgrub pa mdzad nas/ sa/ces 'grub se phung pa lhag med 'od lus su yal/ gcung mkha' spyo da kyang gsheb/sa/ nas pur byis pa lo brgyad kyi tshad tsam du gyur cing / dri ba/ma po tham sa/ cad kyi sa tshor ba dang / 'ja' 'od dang me (114ba)) pa / spu/ mar rol ma 'i sgra so gas byung bar grags/ thel yangs rir dge slo nga chu rtsa da // ga mcho ga rab brta na zhes pa tshe 'di blos btang gi chos pa ri yangs 〈( nang 〉rtser som/ pa zhi ga yod pa gsheṭa skabs dgun stod yin yang dbang ——/zhu shin tu bkra ba zus pa kun gyi (gyis 〉mthong zhing / tshems ra ring bsre pa byon pa sepa /sa dang / gzhan yang rim gnyis mthar son pa'i bla ma grwa slob rdo bar phyag rjes 'jag pa dang / lus lha skur bsgyur ba so gas zu 'phrul ston nus pa'i slob ma ngo mtshar ba grangs las 'das sa /dkon mchog gsum gyi gsang gsum de —ri /ra/ /gcis gyur 'phrin 'a sa bsam mi khyab pa yi 〈yis/〉 /bye nga ) ma/ 'ji na byu nga 'gro rnam/sa sgra la mdzad pa/ / do na grub chas kyi rgya tsa sa da ba /pa la ba 'a ri sa/ /30

gdan sa nyer lnga pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po 'phrin las don kun grub pa dpal gyi sde ni/ de yang rje chos kyi grags pa'i yang srid/ zhe sa ma'i gdung las phag mo zhabs drung gi sras su 'jangs 〈'jang 〉rgyal thang du sbrul lor sku bltams/ mtshan dga' ba'i dbang por grags/ nam pa chos dbyings rdo rjes kyang gus 'dud ngos 'dzin sogs mdzad cing /de nyid bzhugs na skyu ra'i gdung yang mi chad cing 'bri bstan 'phel rgyas shin tu che ba zhig yong rgyur 'dug cing / gsol 'debs sa (yang 114na)gsum mar/ ma 'ongs byu ra'i gdung rgyud mtha' ma ru/sbrul lo pa yi zab gter 'phro 'byin cing / /dam chos ma ) yo gas 'gro kun sgrol//don grub chos kyi 'bangs der gsol ba 'debs//zhes pa 'danyid don thog tu babs pa yin kyang / de skabs rje 'phrin las bzang po sku na phra bas sku dbang cung zad kyang med/ zhabs phyi rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉sku rimacher ma byas pa dang / snyiṭa dus kyi spyi dgos 〈sgos 〉sems can bsod nams dman cing gong gi lung bstan gsal drags pas bar chad kyis yab sras rnams rgya yul du sku gshegs 'dug cing / bar do dag pa ye shes kyi sku sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams dang / phal cher dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen por ma hā gu ru'i drung du bzhugs par graṭa/ de nas lo mang 'das rjes 'jangs 〈'jang 〉gla thar rje'u rigs yab 'bras se dngos grub bkra shis dang / yum rnam 'joms ma gnyis las shing pho spre'u loyal ga'i ri dwags zla ba'i mas nyer lnga'i mtho rang 〈tho rangs 〉khar dge mtshan du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ de'i nyin par 'bri gung phyogs su yang me tog kya char dang / 'ja' tshon/ chu 'dzin gyi gdugs dkar soṭa bltas 〈ltas 〉bzang du ma byung / de'i tshe rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen (yang 114ba)gzigs dkon mchog 'phrin la sa bzang po zhes mtshan 304

dkar sa gsum du graṭa pa gang de'i mkhyen pa dus gsum sa 〈gsal 〉 ragazigs pas snga gong nas lung bstan thang khar ljags bkod gnang ltar/de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉zhabs ring ba mchod dpon chos 'byor/ gsol dpon 'bug ge gzhan ga gnyis la/ bka' mchid lung bstan zhib gsal shog dril bcas ba nga brda gnang bar khong bzhi lho lam brgyud 'jangs 〈'jang 〉phyogs su 'byor te yul der phal cher btsal bas/ma ba lung pa de lung bstan sku zang shog sgril 〈dril 〉ltar gnang ba'i 〈bas 〉nges shes rnyed de/ ha ku sa zhes bod skad ru gser tog can du graṭa pa der/ 'brasase dngos grub bkra shis bya ba chos nor gyi dpal dang ldan pa de la/ srasamatshan ltas bzang ba/ dga' ba'i dbar po'am/ kerma pa gang rung thogs pa zhig yod pa thos pas/ da tshang du phyin bas/ sras de 'khrungs nas zla shas las ma song kyang 〈yang /〉 khong bzhi gzigs 'phral dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur sogs byis pa phal gyi ngang tshul da na cing ya mtshan can zhig 'dug pa sprul sku 'khrul med du rtogs shing / yar lam/ stag sham gter ston la gsung rtag 〈brtag 〉zhus par yid ches pa'i lung bstan mdzad cing / 'bri gung du 'byor nas/ rje la lo rgyus gsol bar/'khrul (115na)med yin pa zhal gyi (gyis 〉bzhes te/ khong bzhi la tshe dpag med kyi byu/ mtshan byang / dam rdzas le mtshan 〈tshan 〉bcas gnang nas thon rte/ rim gyis tha bar 'byor/ gza' tshes dge bar mtshan dkon mchog 'phrin las don grub tu gsol/ tshe dpag med kyi sku dang dam rdzas le mtshan 〈tshan 〉zhabs brtan tshigs bcad bcas phul/ slar bla ma 'phrin las dbang byug mgron gnyer rin chen o rgyan sogs ser skya bdun/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyisagatsos bas 〈glu 〉chas gya nom pa dang bcas gdan zhus su 〈zhur 〉thon/305

'jangs 〈'jang 〉gla bar 'byor/ bsru 〈rlu 〉chas rnams phu ra kyang yab kyis gsan ba /sa ma gnang bar ring zhig 'gyangs/ skabs der rgyal thang ribs lnga lha khang dang / don grub gling / kong rtse ra ba bcas su phebs bzhugs gnang / de nas sa glang cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyitshes gcig la gong rtse ra nas dbus su chibs bsgyur gnang / de skabs rje dgung lo drug las ma lon kyang bod skad thams cad rang byung du mkhyen cing chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung gleng dang / lo skyar gu ru padma sogs lam bar rnams su gzigs snang sogs ngo mtshar ba byung / 'ba' ra la'i rnam snang / chab mdo/ nang chen khog phal cher dang / gong zos rje chos kyi grags pa'i lung bstan pa'i (115ba)gla ba rkang gcig gi gnas sgo yang phye/ byang rta sna/ spang chig yo nag dgon sogs brgyud rim gyis thel mdun sogs su thel sgar gyi chibs thab kyi bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas sgo lung gi kun dga' ra bar phebs/ me tog gi char dang / 'ja' tshon yang byung / smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes gsum gyi nyin/ chos sras kyi thu bo lho sprul chos kyi rgya mtsho/ phyag mdzod rnam rgyal/ hor dpon bsod nams dbang phyug sogs bla dpon che phra du ma'i chibasabasu dang / pho brang gi rtser bkra shis khra ring / gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang bcas chos bzang lha'i mdun sa bzhin bltar 〈bstar 〉ste/ rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog gi pho brang du yab sras lhan rgyas te ljongs 'di rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal yon lta ra skye dgu kun bskal 〈skal 〉bzang dga' ston la spyad/ 'bri gung lha mi sde spyi nas brtan bzhugs shi sa brjod legs 'bul rgyun mi chad pa ska ba ldan shing rta'i rgyun la 'khru ba byung / mi ring bar yab sras lhan cig gdan sa chen po byang chub gleng du phebs/ mnyam med 306

ra ཿbi zhe bar/na yid ba'i/na nor bu dang / rnaca/ 'dem bha dra'i ma/tshan ca rnga ri 〈bye 〉drung btsug phud phul/ mtshan sngar da ma/ cha chog 'phrin sa (ri do ca ba ce pa 'i kya jug tu cho — kyi ( ci ra/ zhes to ra ba ma/dzad/saser khang 'dzam kring rgyan sosas/ (1157)gtsus/ lag la/ nga mgon khang bcas par ba /nas gzigs sa chod 'bul/ tsho sa chen du mang 'gye/ ba rgya che ba gnang / de skabs nas yi ge'i rigs thams cad rang bya da du ma khyen cing / byang yu ba sems dpa' stag mo 'u sa sbyin gyi lo rgyus dang bar da dag pa ye shes kyi rdzu zangs mdog dpal rir bzhugs skabs dang / yum la sku 'khrungs dus / kyi tshul rnam sa/ gas la bar zhib rgyas su gsung ba sogs der yod kun ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de nas sgo lung du phebs/ 'dus pa rnams kyis this baja da me tog thor nas rtse bar bzhugs nas/ dgung lo bdun pa ci gas rta/ ba/ lor rje bha dra'i drung bar ma rab byung du grub/ de mas dzam ba 'u/ma lho sprul chos kyi rgya mtsho/ stag lung 'od 'jo sprul sku/ dpal ri sprul sku so gas/ skyes chen du mas rje 'di'i zhabs ngategs te/ rje ra/nga ma'i drung mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zab cha pa ri zab mo lnga ldan chos drug soṭa dang / dam/ pa sa/nga ma rim byon gyi bka' 'bum sa ṭa kyis 〈kyi 〉dbang lung rnams dang / rdo rje phreng ba rngog dkyil bdun/ lu nag dril gsum gyi bde mchog mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'i dbang che chung / myang dang / sangs rgyas gling pa/ kerma gling pa/ratna gleng pa/ 'ja' tshon (gling )pa sogs gter byon rtsod bral rnams kyi dbang chos sogs gsar rnying gi dbang chos bsam gyis mi (115ba)khyab pa gsan/ rang lugs kyi cho ga sbyo da sogs 'don spyo da gar jig dbyangs gsum/ snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag sogs la ba/san bye ngas mthar phyin pa mdzad/ chu sbrul lor sa ga zla bar yab sra sa lhan gcig 〈cig 〉307

par lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ jo shāka gis dbus rten rnams la gser chab dang / mar me snyan shal sogs mchod 'bul thugs bskyed smon lam yang dag pa gnang / de skabs rgyal dbang drug pa'i sku tshab pad dkar bar rje 'dis gtsug phud phul bar mdzad pa'i mtshan dkon mchog don grub rin chen zhes gnang / jing gi rjo lha bzang bcas pa mchod yon so sor mjal 'bul sogs grub nas bste gnas su phebs/ mi ring bar thel dang ba/te 8 sgram rnams su phebs nas/ gter sgom tshogs khang du phebs skabs 'ja' tshon sna lngas sku mdun nas bsus pa der yod kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur cing /tshogs 'khor gnas gzigs sogs gnang nas rim gyis rtse bar bzhugs gdan 'jags/ shing rta lor tho lung du gtsang sgar gyi brje len skabs rje bha dra'i zhabs dang lhan gcig 〈cig 〉'dus pa rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par gnang bas 〈ba 〉rje 'di'i chos gnang ba'i thog mar 〈ma 〉yin/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa shing lugs 〈lug 〉lo nas lhag pa'i lha 'ga' zhig gi bsnyen sgrub kyang rim (11 na)par gnang zhing / me spre cho 'phrul zla bar 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gsan gyi gzhi bsnyen gnang bas gzhung gi rtag 〈rtags 〉mtshan mngon du gyur/rje snya ba'i zhabs nas tsan dan dkar dmar las gnas bcu mgon brgyadasogs bzhengs pa gnang skabs/ rje 'di'i rten bzhengs 〈bzheng 〉gi thog mar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed yab yum sras sprul/ 'jam dbyangs zhi drag sde bla ma/ las gshin sgrub pa po bcas bzo bkod shin tu dngos gtsang ba bzhengs/ lo de'i zla ba drug par/ gter sgom du rje 'di phebs par gnang zhing / 'di skabs rten 'brel 'grig na rje 'di sku tshe'i tshad don drug tsam dang / chos kyi sgo 'ga' zhig 'byed rgyu 308

ches 1 lha rngo 1rdo1— 1 —— ——yod 'dug kyang / ga la dpon da nga ma 'a mdzad 'a la gnod pa ri 'a sa skal can yin 'dug pas rten 'brel bzlog pa'i bya ba ngan pa mang du byas pas gnas gsar rnying phal cher gyi gnas gzigs dang gnas sa gsar 'byed kyi rten 'brel chug 〈'byuṭa/〉 gzim spyil du bcad rgya bdun phrag gcig gnang ste/ tshes bcur phyogs 'dus kyi mi tshogs shin tu che bar bla ma zhi ba'i dbang stsal 〈bstsal/〉 tshoṭa khang soṭa su phebs nas rtse bar bzhugs gdan 'jags/ dgung lo bcu bzhipa me bya lor/ rje gong mas mkhan bo dang / lho sprul chos kyi rgya mtshos las slob mdzad (11 ba)de dge tshul du sgrub/ lo der rje gong ma'i drung rang gzhan phyogs 'dus kyi 'dus pa shin tu che ba dang bcas/ byung lugs bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub chen smar khrid du gsan cing / de rjes bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dbar sman sgrub dang sbrags pa dngos grub lam 'bras kyi khrid sogs gsan/ ma 'gyangs par sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi zir bun shin tu che ba byung bas/ lha sar rje nyid phebs/ 'di skabs jun gar gyis rdor smin grwa gsum gtor ba/ blam mang du skongs 〈bkrongs 〉pa soṭa tshub che skabs yin kyang 'bri'i bstan srid lhos bcas la rje yab sras kyi thugs rjes nyes skyon ci yang ma byung /de nas yar phebs nas mi ring bar/ sa khyi lor rje gong ma sku khams ltem pa'i skabs/ sku mdun bcar mar bzhugs shing mnal bsrung 〈srung 〉ba dang zhabs brtan gso la 'debs sogs mdzad cing / de nas gzhan don la gshegs pa'i tshe/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba mdzad/ de skabs klu dkar zhabs drung chos grags rje nyid thugs bso 〈gso 〉ba'i phyir dgongs/ jo ṭa kyi zhabs 'degs la ched gtad kyis byon nas slob dpon pra wa ha sti'i thuṭa dam dzi 〉 ma las grub pa'i rdo rje gzhon 309

(5:) / 1jo /sne :ri /ste —— /ste/ /) 11 —— sa (1 ba pa/ pa ba/ za cha dra/cha baṭa/zug ra/sde/ ra/ ba/sa phul/ 'di skabs mnal lam du rje gong mas nyid la bka' (118na)brgyad kyi dbang rgyas pa zhi / gnang ba ni phyis bka' brgyad sgrubardzo chen 'di tsho 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉pa'i dge ltas su 'dug lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i yar tshes brgyad la/ gdan sa chen mo byang chub gling du/ bla g.yel gyi gserakhrir rje 'di 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol shis brjod me tog 'thor/ phyi lo sa phag lor dngul gdung rin po che grub par/ rje nyid 'dus par bcas pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ de nas sgo lung gzim mal ci tsan dan las grub par dra ba sdom pa'i sgo nas rab gnas kyang gnang /'di skabs mnal lam du rje gong ma bar do dag pa ye shes kyi sku dang mjal bas dngul gdung gyi 〈gi 〉gzungs 'bul phyag len la nor 'khrul yod med zhus par/ tshar 'khrul byung ma song gsungs pa'i 〈pas 〉thuṭa blo bde bar byung / sde pa lum pa'i chos mdza / las sgra na tsan gnyis kyi gzhungaluṭa chen mor gsan bzhes gnang ba brda tsam gyi 〈rgyas 〉thugs su chud/lcaṭa byi lor thub bstan yangs ri sgar du rje gong ma'i dgongs rdzoṭa su rje dharma kirti'i ljaṭa bsgrigs 〈sgrig 〉gtsug tor dgu pa'i cho ga gsar 'dzug 〈'dzuṭa 〉kyang gnang / lo der gong ma khrung shi rgyal pos bod khams sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi 〈kyis 〉sdug bsngal la 'god pa skyobs 〈skyob 〉phyir bdudadapung mthar byed kyi (118ba)dpung chen bzhengs nas thog mar gzho rong brgyud/ deng gzhi cang jun dang / tā lo ye bcas phebs par/ rje nyidamatshar dgu thang du mjal phrad du phebs par khas gnyis na nas bdag rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de nas mi ring bar/ rgyal dbang drug pa'i rnam sprul li thang du byung ba rgyal mchog bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho 310

dang ma li cang 'jun dpung chen bcas phebs par/ klung shod brgyud ra bgreng 〈sgrong 〉mdar phebs bsur phebs/ mchod yon gnyis na nas gzigs bskyangs shin tu che ba byung / de nas phan yul gyi shongs brgyud lha sar phebs/ rgyal dbang mchog gser khrir phebs pa'i legs 'bul mdzad/ 'di skabs gong zos lho nas phebs pa'i deng gzhi cang 'jun dang / tā lo ye gnyis bskyar (du )mjal phrad gnang na/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i skabs bsam yas chos skyong gi lung bstan phul bar 'bri bstanal 'phel rgyas che ba zhig yong rgyur yod 'dug kyang / zhabs gras log smon la dbang ba 'ga' zhig gis ngor ma grub pa snang / de nas yar 'byu gungadu phebs nas/ phyi lo lcags glang lor rgyal dbang mchog la zhabs brtanashis brjod rgyas pa zhig 'bul bar/ lha sa brgyud 'bras spungs su phebs/ma la kha gsung 'phros zhib rgyas gzigs (11 na)bskyangs che ba dang /lha ldan du rgya sog bod bcas kyi che gnyan mjal mi shin tu mang ba so sorare 'dod chos bzhin bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas 'bri gung du phebs/ sbyong (jun 〉gar gyi zir kun skabs sos gtor dang / yang bzlog gi sgrub pa soṭa sngaṭa rnying ma'i phyag len dus rim phal cher chaṭa 〈chag 〉par/ chu stagalo nas sos gtor chen mo soṭa sngar rgyun ltar gnang / yangs ri sgar gyi chos khrims bar skabs su cung zad 'chal bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan rtsa 'dul ba dang / de yang dge 'dun rnam par dag pa la rag la par gsungs pa dang / rje skyob pa rin po ches tshul khrims la bsngags par mdzad pa bzhigazhi drag ga mtshams 〈'tshams 〉kyi sgo nas chos khrims dam par bsdom 〈sdom 〉pa mdzad/ gzhan yang chos grwa chen po 'dir thos bsam sgom pa chos spyod bcu'i bya bas dus 'da' ba mdzad pa dang / dge 'dun gyis 〈kyi 〉sde la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rgya dkar nag 311

gi sku rten mchog tu gyur pa dang / rgya hor gyi sgrub sil / gags rol mo'i byebrag khyad du 'phaṭa pa du ma rin thang bral ba'i kha dog rnam par bkra bas 〈ba'i 〉bzang gos kyis 〈kyi 〉bla bres yol ba/ 'phan phye phur 'phyams 〈'cham 〉phod sogs grangs las 'das pa/ skye dgu kun gyi blo yul las 'das pa dag lo (116ba)ltar bzhin sbyor 'jags stsal 〈bstsal/ 〉shing 'brug lor 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan rabs ga thang sum cu so dgu gsar bzhengs dang / rje gong ma'i skabs gsar 'debs gnang ba'i rdzong gsar bku shis tshugs kyi 'phro lus zhib tshags dgos rigs rnams grub nas rtse ba nas lha babs zla bar rdzong gsar du chibs bskyod/ gdan rabs bris thang dang phyogs mthun rab gnas bkra shis dga' ston rgyas pa ra mdzad/ skabs shig gter sgom chab tshan du phebs skabs sngon bshad ltar rten 'brel phal cher chug 〈'phyugs 〉zin yang / da dung gnas phran sogs mjal ba dang / o rgyan phug pa rnyed nas rten 'brel cung zad 'thig rgyu yod 'dug par/ zhabs gras 'ga' zhig lam lta bar gtong ba ma da skabs/ dge slong mdo sdes thar sa mi 'dug gleng bar/ o rgyan phug pa soṭa gsar 'byed kyi rten 'brel chug 〈'byuṭa/ 〉 gang ltar 'brug lo de'i ston mjug gter sgom du phebs/ gnas gsar rnying /phal cher zhibam la gnang zhing / so so tsho sa 'khor smon lam thugs bskyed 〈skyed 〉yang dag par mdzad/ gnas gsar ma'i la rtser phebs skabs 'ja' gur ba/ba / mgon khang phug tu brag log 〈logs 〉nas rnga brdung ba kun gyis thos pa sogs ya mtshan pa byung / rje mi la/ sgrol ma/ dzasbya la sogs( ) mi zilha mang 110na du zhal ga gas/ gzhan yang gsar du ga gas snang rang byon shin tu mang ba gtan la phabs 〈phab/ 〉 de nas rim par rgyab bskor brgyud/ tsha 'ug dpal gyi ri khrod du phebs/ rdo rje glo dkar 312

gyi rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i sku rjes sa rdos srubs 〈bsub 〉pa yang 'dir yod pa'i ngo zod mdzad pas kun gyis gsal bar rnyed/ tshogs khang sogs gnas gzigs dang / de skabs gter sgom dang gnas 'dir phyag rjes kyang 'ga' zhig gnang 'dug cing / gzim spyil du dpon slobatshang mas sku tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad nas gdan sa chen mor gos sku chen mo zhal 'byed sogs sa/nang / shing sbrul lor/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin sku 'khor mi nyung ba dang bcas chibs btegs nas/ byang 7ma brgyud/ stag lung / yangs can sogs gnas gzigs gnang nas/ shangs stag sna bde chen chos kyi pho brang du bya zla'i tshes brgyad dus tshes dge bar mngal spangs gsum pa kro bo rin po che byang chub chos kyi snying po las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang dag pa bzhes/ gzhan dbang lung kha shas phar gnang tshur gsan mdzad nas/ gnas chen zab ku lung gi gnas gziṭa zhib par gnang nas/ rta shags sgrub sde gnyis su phebs/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i thugs dam thun (110ba)mong ma yin pa 'khor lo sdom pa yin yang / bar skabs su bsnyen pa byed mi ji zhung la song ba zhig byung bas rgyas pa'i rigs mi spyogs pa rnams la/ bsnyen yig bsdusapa ljaṭa sgrig mdzad cing gso bar mdzad/ lam bar dang phyogs der gnasapa kun gyi 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pa byung zhing so sor chos dang zang zing gis tshim par gnang nas stona'abri gung du phebs tsub/ yangs ri gar du rgyun chaṭa gsum pa dang / gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa dang / bco lnga pa gnyis kyang ma chaṭa 〈 ga 〉pa btsugs mdzad/ gsang sngaṭa snga 'gyur gyi ring luṭa 'a nyid mi nyams zhing 〈shing 〉rgyas pa dang / bod khams bstan 'gro'i bde thabs kyis 〈kyi 〉rtsa ba mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i gnyen por/ tshas313

grwa chen po yangs ri sgar 'dir myang lugs bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen ji srid bar lo ltar chags 〈chag 〉med du 'dzugs spyi sdus/ sna pa /spya sna // da pa /sa byed sam sbya / sbyardo/ rnashā dro )zi brdoṭa 〈bsdo( 〉gnang ste/ phyag len nag 'gros 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma 'di nyid mdzad nas me lug lor thog sdu/ / //rdo zlo / /de /〈zhogazi /bye /shā /budhid gas/bye /ra du ba dīngashi ༷nami po 'gyangs par gegs med du phyir phebs grub/ rje gong (311na)ma'i zlodro ཿshā pa /dro bye sa.o 'a /rdo rdo /sdiXs ba pa ga // ༷ da' zlo /rdo/sango /sashe// ge brtan po rnyed kyang / dbon po lha sri thar dang / gsol dpon leṭa bzang gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉rtsod gzhi skoraga' zhig brtsams pa/ rang phyogs ser skya phal cher yid srubs kyi 〈kyis 〉brgyud rlams 〈brlams 〉pas lo (9)la mchod yon la don med du gtugs pa la mo chos skyong gi lung go 'dzol lta bus/ lha sri'i bu mchog sprul min par yin pa ngos bzung ba sogs rtsod gleng chen po byas pa'i tshe/ rje nyid lha ldan du phebs/ mi dbang chen / / / mag // rnyi /1 ༷ ༷ /na/tho/ maX // / drozlos sbyardo /rta /sna rdo zloshā thon/ gnyis par gzhan yod du dogs pa'i yi ge thon/ kho pa'i bu rtsa ba nas ma don 〈thon 〉pas don grub ste yar phebs nas/ mi ring bar sgar mkhan zur rgyal sras 'phrin 'a tshe bdag sogs ser skya mang ba mngags ste/ sa bya lo'i smin drug zla bar 'bri gung du gegs med spyan drangs nas thog mar rtse bar yab sras mjal 'a ma skal bzang dga' 314

ston gnang ste/ thel du chos rje rin po che'i sku mdun du gtsug phud bzhes/ 'di skabs yul srol phal cher dge las la sha'i longs spyod (111ba)cher byed srol 'du ga stabs mi 'os par dgongs te thams cad rang rang gi yul srol la ma 'thas ches pa sa gcod ma thub yang 〈kyang /〉zhabs brtan gyi sha legs par bcad/ rim gyis mchog gi sprul sku la 'bri /dro / /rdzu spya bye 〈 pa nā / sa da/zha /na pa 1 / /drosalha /paci //rdo /bye / lho sprul chos kyi rgya mtsho la dbang chos mang bar gsan/ sgo lung du sngar bka' brgyad/ mgon po/ khro chu/ drag po bcas gtor khag bzhi lo rer // /bye / / snya du rsha shā jug/ spya dri rdo na ma 〉 // spya radu/sa spyi shā // na/sa //dro dgos yin rung / de lam du bzhag tshe chags 〈chag 〉nyams gyi 〈kyi 〉rgyur 'dug par dgongs te las sne ba brkos 〈bskos 〉te shing stag lo nas chaṭa rdo / 〉/bye /nga ba //shā /rdo rdo //go // sa 〈shā //rdo dro/pa 〈/ba/ma dro she pa/ pa / // / pa / spyan /spyashā misna // /sda /shā // ma/ /rte ran pa rad /bye na // /shā / rdo dīX /'brardo 〉ste rdo //sna lnga ni / /zi / rdo/rdo /shā shā rdo'i chu〉 /dro zlordo /dīrji /) // di/ /su/ ngasdu / ste/ rdo / /du / spyang kurdo 〉 shā bye bye / /bye / /bye bye /rdo / kyi sdidī /sda /༵/ ༷ ༷bye bye rdo / ༷/ 315

srungs 〈srung 〉rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub mang du mdzad bar/ so sor gzhung dang mthun pa'i rtag 〈rtaṭa 〉mtshan bzang po mngon du gyur/ khyad par tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i skabs/ 'a 'a tshon gyi dkyil na slob dpon chen po dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan zhal gzigs/ lo drug re'i mtshamasagatsang sgar brje lenaskabs dang / thel shar gyi mtshams res dus/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa'i zab chos/ phyag chen lnga ldan/ na ro'i chos drugayang za rjogs chen sogs khrid mang du gnang ba'i 〈bas 〉 'di blos btang gi zos pa mang rab byung / khyad par sgam po sprul sku kun bzang nges don dbang po/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta/ na thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ dpa' bo rdo rje gtsug lag soṭa rtsod bral gyi skyes mchog 'ga' zhig rje'i spyan sngar byon pa soṭa la gsar rnying gis 〈gi 〉chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal 〈bstsal/〉 lhag par mdo smad stong 'khor nas snga ra'i (133ba)chos rjes/ zang zing 'bul ba rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran pa lta bu phul/ skabs shig bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi ga thang / phyis 'khrungs rabs pad 'byung a ti ma dngos gtsang ba sogs bris sku mang ba bzhengs mdzad/ tsan dan dkar dmar las thub dbang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis bzhengs pa/dbu mdzad klu sbyin gyis mgo btsuṭa tsam la dbyu mdzad 'das nas re zhig lus/'jangs〈'jang 〉gla bar thub bstan rab rgyas gling gi dgon gnas gsar du btab pa yang da lta yang dar zhing rgyas/de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun gnas dang 'go ba'i tshoṭa gnyis bsaṭa pa'i zhing ca spro lung ca lha khang rtend brten par bcas pa bzhengs par 〈bzheng bar 〉dgongs ste sa rta mgoma'i dmar phyoṭa la gza' dang skar spyor soṭa shin spyo dge bar/ sa chog sa blangs byun rlabs sogs rgyas par mdzad nas/ sa lug cho 'phrul ma ba'i 316

nang nas gtsug lag khang steng shod sa babacu gnyis re yod pa re mig dru sha mong btings pa myur bar lo der grub/ lcags sprel lor zhib tshag dang / mngon dga' la rten khri gsar du bzos te sngon gyi sku bzhugs yul cher med pa rnams de khar gdan 'dren mdzad/ lcags bya lor b.labod kyi bzo pa mang tsam 'bod par gnang ste/ gser dngul chub mchod rten/ su stegs pham byed 'am 〈dam 〉cho 'phrul chen po/ skuma'i gyin rlabs dbyen bsdum (113na)bcas kyi mchod rten thog tshad phyed gnyis re rin po che du ma'i po'i 〈pos 〉mtshar 〈tshar 〉du mngar — 〈dngar 〉ba bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs nas lhun grub rdo je'i sgor bzhugs/ rab gnas mang du gnang / chu khyi lor bzo pa sngon sa mas kyis 〈kyi 〉steng du bal po dbu mdzad rdor shing sogs mang tsam gyis/ thub chen khams gsum mdzes rgyan byin rlabs char 'beb 〈'a bas 〉tu 〈su 〉grags pa thog tshad gnyis pa khri rgyab gser gdugs bcas bzo bkod ngo mtshar ba mjal ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren pa/gsar zho sum stong lhag dang / zangs khal drug ba skor las bzhengs pa yang lo de'i mjug tu grub/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan du bzhugasate/bde mchog zla gsang / zhi khro rigs bsdus bcas byu sgo na rab gnas ma du ma da/ bkra shis dga' ston sogasashigatu rgyas par ga ra / tshu phag lor dbu mdzad sngon ma soṭa mang tsam gyis gnas bsabra ri ma'i sku rnams gser zangs las grub ba dang / dngul srang bdun pa bdun bcu 〈chu 〉lhag tsas las rje snya dra'i zhabs kyi sku brnyan mthong pa don ldan mi tshad las lhag pa dang / e pa'i dbu mdzad sar bu chos 'phel dang rang grwa kha shas kyis rin po che'i phye ma dang sman dar (413ba)bcas mas cho 'phrul bco lnga'i bkod pa/ gnas bcu'i 317

bzhugs yul brag ri bcas bzhengs/ cho 'phrul 'og min dang gnas bcu bde ldan du bzhugags shing / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgo nas rab gnas yang yang gnang / rab byung bcu gsum pa me yos lor sngon gyi tsan dan gyimadzad bcu 'phro lus rnams/ e pa dbu mdzad rgyal mtshan dang / rang re'i grwa pa 'byor ldan can 'ga' zhig gis brkos/ lo der mchog gi sprul sku/ gdan sa chen po byang gling chos kyi seng khrir dbang bskur shis brjod me tog 'thor ba gnang / sgo lung chos ga chen mor bka' srungs 〈srung 〉dam can rgya mtsho'i gar 'phyams 〈'cham 〉gsar 'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉 gnang ba'i lha grangs sngar gyi steng / zang / ma ring mched lnga/ rnam thos sras sogs 'phar ba mdzad/ lo de'i mjug tu mdzad bcu rnams legasapar grub/ rje gong ma'i skabs blos blangs zhig 〈shig 〉yod na yang yang bka' stsal 〈bstsal 〉bas dgongs pa rdzogs byed dang / sgom don la med mi rung du 'dug pas/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bzo khyad phul du phyin pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba bzhengs pa brkos pa gong gsal rnams dang / gzhan yang bzorigs mang dag gis mgo btsugs pa yang (11 na)'brug lor grub cing mngon dgar bzhugs ste rab gnas kyang gnang / sa sprul lor snyigs dus kyi ma hā paṇḍi ta si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas byon par/ phan tshun dbang chos mang ba gsan res mdzad/ rta lor chab kyi bsnyun gzhi shin tu — ba byung kyang 〈yang 〉mi ring bar dwangs/ chos ga chen mo 'dir lo ltar za ba drug pa'i nyer dgu la rje gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs su gtsug dgu'i cho ga'i bdag 'jug gi chas dang /'dus par bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad cing / chu sprel zla ba gnyis pa nas/ bal bod kyi bzo pa mang ba rim gyis 'byor nas rjes su dbu mdzad snya na shing yang byung nas/ 318

rdo rje 'chang nas ma na po 'bri gung pa'i gdan sa rim byon gyi sa (gyi 〉bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang / yi dam chos srungs 〈srung 〉bcos gser zangs las grub pa mi tshad tsam pa bzhengs pa rnams chu bya lor grub nas chos 'khor rdo rje'i snying por bzhugs/ gser dngul las lha babs pad ma spungs pa bkra shis sgo mang sku tshad gzhan las che ba bde mchog drug cu'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa rten 'brel gyi khyad/ myang 'das tshab rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten rnams snga gong bzhengs pa rnams dang mthun pa/ lha snyen gyi g.yas g.yon du/ 'od dpag med dang / mgon po kun tu gzigs (114ba)pa khri rgyab dang zags pa thog tshad lhag pa gser zangs las grub pa bcas/ shing khyi lo nag zla tshun gegs med grub/ lha ldan nas bka' bstan tshar re/ sde dge nas mtshal par bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis bcas spyan 'dren mdzad nas gtsug lag khang so sor bzhugs/ tsan dan dkar dmar las sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sku dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod ngo mtshar ba bzhengs pa yang myur bar grub/ so sor rtsa gsum/ zhi khro rigs bsdus/ zla gsang /'khor lo sdom pa sogs rgyud sde gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor mang du zhal phye ste 〈ste/〉 rje yab sras 'dus pa dang bcas pas rab tu gnas pa shis brjod yang nas yang du mdzad/ bzo rigs pa rnams la rten rnams snga phyir rim grub skabs zang zing gi yon sogs tshad las 'das pas tshim par gnang ba dang / gtsug lag khang drug po re rer yang /stong 'khun 〈khun 〉rgyal po'i gan ma da las byung ba'i rgyu dang kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i/ bla bres/ 'phan/ phye phur/ rgyal mtshan/ yol ba/ rten rnams la na bza' snyan shal/ de dag gi mdun du rgya hor khache sogs kyi dpyad pa ngo mtshar ba grangs las 'das pa mar me'i rgyun 319

'dzug 〈'dzugs 〉sogs mchod rdzas kyi bye brag blos dpag par dka' ba 'bul ba mdzad/ de ltar dgongs bzhed rlabs po che rnams grub nas sku de'i (135na)'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams rdzogs par nye ba na phyinang gang du yang rtag 〈rtags 〉mtshan mi leṭa pa mang du byung / mchog gi sprul sku'i 〈skus 〉dbus zhabs ring pa rnams la 'phral yun gi 〈rmi 〉zhal sgo bslab don du ma dang / khyad par du nyid kyi gdung 'bum gseradangul sogs ma 'grig kyang / sa phyogs stod smad la mchod rten che chung gang lhogs re bzhengs/ nang du gdung rus re bcug na sa sde gzhan la mi shor 'bri bstan dar rgyas kyi rten 'brel yod gsungs pa dang / bde can zhing bkod kyi pad gdong zhig zhabs phyi rnams la bstan nas der kho bo sdod pa yin/ nga rang gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i mthus bde ldan zhing du bsgod 〈bgrod 〉par ba tshom mi dgos 'dug gsungs/de nas nyid bsnyun gzhi 'di yin cher med par sku zor shin tu ngan pa byung nas/ shing khyi nag pa zla ba'i nang du bka' brgyad sgrub chen gnang ba grol 'phral/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pa/ sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang po'i nyi dros la zab dgongs chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba mdzad do/ de'i tshe nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi 〈kyis 〉gang zhing rol mo'i sgra soṭa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung /zla ba de kha'i nyer dgu'i nyin mchog sprul bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul (115ba)gyis phyag len mdzad de zla gsang gi sgo nas sku gdung rin po che zhuṭa su phul/ zhe dgu'i gdung chog dang / sgo lung du sa 'bum bzhengs pa dang / lo mjug rtse bar chog mang / phyi lo shing phag lor/gzim mal sku bcan cha ba gser zangs las bzhengs pa spro lung 'du khang du bzhug ga dngul gdung lha babs thog tshad gnyis lhag bzhengs320

pa gdan sa chen po'i khang gsar 'og min du bzhuṭa shing / gangs ri ti ser gser 'bum bzhengs pa sogs dgongs rdzoṭa kyi rim par 〈pa 〉sngar srol gang yod grub bo/ slob ma'i tshogs ni/ rgyal tshab dem pa mtshungasamed chos kyi rje rin po che bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul ni 'og tu gsal/chos sras kyi thu bo mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zab gsang smin grol gdamasapa'i rgyun 'dzin/ mgar sprul dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma da/ rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa bde gshegs klu riṭa sgon du gar dus rgyal bu gzhon nu dang / skyob pa nyid kyi spyan sngar mgar chos sding pa shākya dpal/ rgyal dbang ratna'i zhabs 'bring bla ma gtsang pa ngag dbang don grub/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi slob ma bstan 'dzin kun tshags/ chos kyi grags pa'i dus bstan 'dzin grags pa sogs skyes ku du ma'i (115na)skye mthar graṭa shing / nang chen du 'khrungs/ rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung thog mar dge bsnyen/ bar du dge tshul/ mtha' mar bsnyen par rdzoṭa/'byu gung pa'i chos thams cad gsan/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la sbyangs/ rje bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/ lho chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub skyes bu du mas 〈ma'i 〉zhabs la brten chos kyi mdzod la mnga' brnyes/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing /'dir snang chos brgyad kyi dri ma 〈mas 〉ma bgos/ phyis rje rdo rje 'chang chos kyi nyi ma'i riṭa bdag tu gyur nas/ 'bri gung pa'i chos thamasacad dang bka' brgyad bde 'dus sogs gsar rnying gis 〈ga 〉gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul ba mdzad pas chos brgyud la bka' drin shin tu che ba yin no/ gzhan yang grub pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ri gnyis /bye bye // / / shā / /shā —— pa dzi spyardo/bri ba // drod / la/sa na— mas

grol sprin gyi zeg 〈zags 〉ma yis/ /skal ldan 'gro ba'i don gnyis lo tog tshal/ /rgyas mdzad 'gro 'dul mtshan des bdag sogs skyong 〈skyongs 〉/ /gdan sa nyer drug pa rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma 'phrin las (136ba)phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba bzang po'i sde sa/ rje gong ma 'phrin las bzang po sa khyi lo gzhan don la gshegs nas/ lcags byi lor spo bo dga' ba lung du gter chen chos rje gleng pa'i sras su 'khrungs kyang zla shas las ma bzhugasashing / lo 'ga' yar 'das pa na gong yul o rong zhes par rje'u rigs las/yab sde pa tshe ring dbang rgyal zhes gzhung sa'i mda' dpon gyi las tshan yod pa zhig dang yum 'od zer bu khrid zhes (ces 〉pa la sras gnyis 'khrungs/ gcen po 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta yin la/ gcung po rje 'di nyid/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang mtshan 〈tshan 〉shing pho 'brug gi lo la 'khrungs pa/ rje don grub chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrib med lha'i spyan gyis gzigs te/ dgung lo bzhi bzhes pa me lug lor dge slong chos 'byor ngos 'dzin gyi ched du song bas/ phyag phreng mgul phur sogs 'khrul med bzhes ste yid ches 'drongs pa byung (ba'i )tshe/ sku bsrung 〈srung 〉dam rdzas phul ste zhabs brtan mi tog 'thor ba soṭa byas/ de skabs yab yum dang lhan cig gnas chen tsa ri tra'i rtse bskor du phebs/ de nas gong du smos pa ltar ston pa 'jig rten cabyon pa'i dus mu steṭa tog 〈rtog 〉ge pa soṭa kyis klan na btsal ba bzhin du/ dbon po lha sri thar gyis kho rang gi bu rje 'phrin las bzang po'i (11 na)yang srid yin pa'i rgyab skyor lo sems dpa' dang / la mo chos skyong la bcol nas rtsod bzlos chen po byas (pa'i )tshe/ rje don grub chos kyi rgyal po sku dngos lha ldan du zabs te/ mi dbang pho sa bar zhu /22

gtubs gnang ba'i tshe/ jo shāka yid ba /na nor bu'i drung du rtag sgrilaphul bar rje 'di 'khrul med babs te/ sa bya zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du/sgar bla zur dpon slob rgyal sras dang / mgron gnyer dkar 'dzog sogs ser skya sum cu'i skor bas 〈rlu 〉chas bcas thon te/ gegs med du spyan drangs nas/ bcu pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i tshes gcig nyi shar la/ rtseb sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu yab sras mjal 'dzom gnang zhing dga' ston dang / zhabs brtan shis brjod sogs rgyas par grub ste/ bcuganyis pa'i nang byang chub kyi gling rin po cher phebs/ tshes bco lnga rgyal phur 'grub sbyor bzang por/ chos kyi rje rin po che'i drung / rje chos kyirgyal po'i zhal snga nas gtsug phud bzhes shing / mtshan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul du gsol/ sgo lung chos ga chen mor phebs nas/ rdzong gsar du yab sras thabs gcig 〈cig 〉tu bzhugs/ lcags khyi lor rje gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i drung / rgyal ba'i bstan pa (13 ba)rin po cher rab tu byung ba'i mtshan sngon ma'i mjug tu dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma 'phrin las phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba bzang po'i sde zhes sbyor ba gamang / snga phyir yab sras lhan gcig 〈cig 〉 la dang gter sgom du lan mang phebs shing so sor mchod 'bul/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam yang dag pa bstsal/ chu byi lor rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du chos mdzod kyi sgo phye ste phyag chen chos drug sogs mgon po 'bri gung pa'i chos ma lus pa dang / rngog dkyil bdun/ rdo rje phreng kyi sa zhe sob da la 'a ra brgyad pa/ myang lugs bka' brgyad ba 'dus gas dang / gzhan yang lo snga phyir sangs gling dgongs 'dul/ padma gling pa'i skor sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying gis 〈gi 〉chos bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang / lho dkon mchog chos kyi rgya mtsho pa / kyang rje skyob pa rin po 323

che'i zab chos thugs kyi nying khu sems bskye ra che /sa ri ra ma ri ku gsan/ shing yos lor/ rgyal dbang bskang ba zung ze sam ca/ba/ se ba pa nas bod ljongs su chibs/ bsgyur gnang skabs// ze 'api khas dwa ri bsu — rwa bgreng 〈sgong 〉du phebs nas der rgyal dbang ma cho la gtsug du da ngul bar mtshan kun bzang dkon mchog nyi ma 'es gnab / snga phye nges dad du yi ge bris klog nas brtsams / rang 'u gas/ kyi (138 )'don chos spyod gar thig dbyangs gsum byed grub kyi ci ri ri dkar nag snyan ngagadon rgyan so lnga/ bso 〈gso 〉dpyad rgyud bzhi/ lha bris so/gas la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang / phyis si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas las sgra na lnga pa sogs mdo rgyud rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen rab phul du phyin/ me sbrul lor nag shod dgon sde spyi nas gdan 'dren nan zhus byung bar/ chos 'khor byams pa gling du chibs bskyod de dgon du pad gling nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgrub chen rtsa dbang dang bla med bcu gsum gyi dbang sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis der 'khod pa'i lus can kun byang chub kyi myu gu mchog tu smin par mdzad nas phyir phebs/ sa lug lor sgom sdenang chen nas/ sa skyong rdo rje tshe dbang nas gdan zhus nan ta na che b.rabarten/ sku 'khor mi nyung ba dang bcas gzhu rong brgyud/ nag shod hor/ 'brong pa'i sde nang bcas nas phebs par lam bar du 'khod pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad nas 'bul zhabs bzang du byas/ so sor chos kyi〈kyis 〉tshim par gnang nas lo de'i 'khrums kyi zla ba'i nang du nang chen sde thog chi phebs/ lho mgar/ nang chem/ mi rje'i sras sosas ser skya shin tu mang bas chibs thab kyis bcu sa / mchod yon ma ja ga 'phrad dang / zhabs (138ba)brtan brgya ris da so —nas/ dpang 〈dpa ri ba 〉mtho ba byung / rdzong thang sgar thog tu / lho ma ga ri kyi (gyi sa 〉da su ri na bla 324

shā /sto /sto /sdi /mi 1 4 grwa ma ba tsam zhe/sa zhabs ba bas / bka' brgyad ba 'dus sgrudabang che / cho/ 'dzug 〈'dzuṭa 〉par gnang ba/ skal ldan gyi 'dus pa khri phrag rnya ga/ —4 ste na tsul gyi go 'phang 〈'phangs 〉dam par 'god par mdzad shing 〈cing /〉 ba phye da gnyis tsam nas gegs med du grub/ mi g.yel dgon dang / g.ya nga chem/ dgon so ) su phebs/ gzhan yang sde so so nas gdam/ zhus bsnyen bkur 'bul ba zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byung /khyad par shong chepya dpom/ tshang nas snga phyir brgya 'bul gsum pa dang /lnga pa sogs ngal bsos bu'i dpal la 'gran nus pa lta bu phul/ so sor dbang chos kyi bdu da rtsis der sa/nas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag (la )thar pa'i sa/ bo / 'debs pa gnang nas rim gyis yar phebs te/ lcags sprel ra 'i sto mjug 'bri gung du phebs grub/ mdo khams nas byung ba'i zang zing gi dngos po thams cad rje gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar 'bul ba mjad shing 〈cing /〉 mi ring bar yab sras lhan gcig 〈cig 〉lha ldan du phebs/ gong sa mchod yon so sor 'bul stobs che ba dang / gzigs bskyangs bdab/ rkyen bla na med pa byung / lcags bya lo nas bzung rje gong ma'i chos ga/ chen mor gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par (11 na)bcas pa so skye ri blo yul las 'das pa bzhengs gnang skabs/ mchod rtem/ gyi 'a 5/ gzungs 'bul rab gnas sogs gang 'os zhabs 'degs mdzad/ chu phas/ lor rje gong ma nas/ nyid 'byu gung khri thog gi 'gan khur mdzad dgos pa'i — /ga' nan byung bar re zhig gong ma nyid nas sngar mus gnang dgos pa'i zhu nan mdzad/ 'di skabs mi dbar chen po'i sras wang tsho gyur me cha ma rgyal thu sa gtum zhing gzu lum che la che gnyan kun 'a mnar spyod che ba dag yi ma kyang / rje 'di dang sku nyer gyur pa ma zad/ tshad chad thugs rjes khro sa/tum gyis 〈rgya 〉tsha ngar bcil te/ rje 325

/snye /ga /ce /ce /ri / da la gus 'dud na tu ba bcas/ 'dam dang / 4 stag sogs su gdan zhus byung (ba )ltar lan mang du phebs me stas lor lhagapa'i lha phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gzhi bsnyen gnang ba sogs yi dam chos srung rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub snga phyir lan 'ga' yar gnang / khyad par yang zab kyi bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i bsnyen sgrub dus rtag par mdzad/ rab byung bcu gsum pa me yos lor gong ma nas bka' nan bcas/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi yan lag lnga'i 'bras bu mchog tu dge bar gdan sa byang chub gling gi theg chen chos kyi khrir mnga' gsol/rje (13 ba)chos kyi rgyal pos dbus 'dus pa rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉shis brjod me tog 'thor/ lha ldan nas wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi sku tshab gdong / leṭa skyes spam mtho ba soṭa mchog dman kun gyi legs 'bul sngar srol las lhag pa byung / de nas sgo lung du yang khrir zhabs bkod shis brjod grub/lo de'i lha babs zla ba'i dus tshes bzang bar chos grwa sgo lung gi lha chen khams gsum mdzes rgyan gyi drung / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal pos mkhan po gnang ste/ las slob kha bskong 〈skong 〉grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ lcags lug lor rdzong gsar gyi yig drug 'khor chen gsar bzhengs gnang / phyi lor gong ma'i gdan rabs bzheng gnang skabs/ rjes kyang mnyam med dwags po rin po che dang / rje bla ma mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bzhengs/phyogs mthun rab gnas kyang mdzad/ mi ring bar rje gong ma sku khams mi thang zhing sku zor shin tu ji zhan du gyur par/ zhabs brtan sku rim sogs mang du mdzad/ gong nas kyang bslab bya zhal chems mang du gnang zhing / khyad par lha khang shod kyi sdeb 〈sdebs 〉bris 'phro lus rnams phyis rje 'dis grub par mdzad/ de nas shing khyi zla ba bzhi par rje chos kyi rgyal 326

pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i sku gdung la mchod (130na)'bul smon la ma / gdung zhugs 'bul/ zhe dgu'i gdung chog sogs dang / chog mang ser tshogs gi 〈kyi 〉mjug bsngor/ gcen po 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa spyan 'dren mdzad/ phyi lo shing phag lor/ gzim mal sku 'dra/ gdung brten 〈rten 〉lha babs bcas grub nas rab gnas gnang / rtse bar yang gser zangs las sku brnyan dang / gong nas zhal chems ltar/ sa 'bum mchod rten gsar bzhengs sogs rim gyis grub/dgongs rdzogs dang zags mnyam med zas gtsang sras kyi 'khrungs rabs brgya pa'i grwa thang bco lnga che legs zhig 〈shig 〉kyang bzheng bar gnang /lo ltar sos gtor/ bka' brgyad sgrub chen yang bzlog gi bsrung 〈srung 〉bzlog sogs chag med/ lo drug re'i skabs rta shag 〈shags 〉kyimatshams grwa brje len la lnga ldan chos drug sogs dang / rang rang gi 'dod chos rgyas par gnang / lo gsum re'i skabs bal shar gyi mtshams par lnga ldan dang / na tshal gyi sgrub sder yang zab kyi bka' chos stsal 〈bstsal/〉 lnga ldan gyi khrid yig khyer bde shel dkar phreng ba zhes pa gsar du gnang zhing / skabs shig tsha 'ug rgyab bskor du phebs skabs tshogs khang du rdo chung zhig la phyag mdzub kyi rjes gsal bar byung / rdzong gsar gyi tshoms bka' (340ba)brgyud pho brang gi gdan rabs bla brgyud thub dbang dang slob dpon rnams sman 'dam dang skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che'i sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa bzhengs/ lcags 'brug lor bod khams bde thabs kyi ched du dmigs/ gter lung tsho nas bshad pa ltar/ gter sgom gyi yang dben 'brong ngu sum mdor ba/zim spyil gyi g.yas g.yon rnams rgya bskyed nas/ gu ru padma'i sku za hor ma yum gnyis mtshan brgyad/ rtsa gsum rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo bcu 317

yab yum bcas/ bzhengs/ rtse b.rim /ma/ khang gsar bskrum/ mgon po phyag ba / pa dang / a phyi cho sa kyi sgo ma'i sku 'chi mad da ga' tshal gyi yig drug 'phrul 'khor ma sogs gsar ba zhe nga na ba/na nga / gzham ya nga snga phyi nges med du sgo lung yi/ mchod khang rtser gu ru pas sa / — 'i dngul sku garablugs ma/ gnas bcu bka' thang tsha sa srungs 〈( sang 〉yo ngas rdzogs sogs bas sku mang rab/ rje stobs 〈stob 〉pa rin po che nas rje don grub chos rgyal bar gyi gong ma rnam sa/ kyi bka' 'bum ji yod dang / gsar rnying gi chos skor sogs pa/ ti mang ba gas ra bzhengs/ thub chen khams gsum mdzes rgyan gyi drung dngul gyi maṇḍa / dngos gtsang ba 'bul ba/ chu lug lor gnas chen tsā ri tra'i yul smad kyi zhig gsos dang sbrags (131na)lha khang thog gnyis pa/ gdan rabs bla brgyud rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉sku gsar bzhengs sogs gnang / lo de'i dbyar si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed chos kyi 'byung gnas mtshur phu nas mdo khams su phebs skabs/rje nyid phebs skyel gyi tshul du 'dam gzhung du phebs/ rje gong ma'i rnam sprul 'khrul med 'jangs 〈'jang 〉yul du 'khrungs pa/ rje ti da dang si tu rin pa che rnam gnyis kyis sgrib med du gziṭa pa thuṭa dam rtag 〈brtag 〉pa rtse mthun byung bar ngos 'dzin gdan zhus 〈zhu'i 〉sgor sogs zhib cha dkrig dan bka' gros mdzad nas/ ko khyim la sgang nas gnam mtsho dang phyir lam ra sgreng sogs kyi gnas gzigs bstsal/ dgun smad mchog gi sprul sku bdag cag gi rje bla ma gdan zhus pa 〈zhu ba 〉sngon ma rnams 'jangs 〈'jang 〉dang / shing sprel gnalo gsar 'phral rgyal sras nor bu'i 〈bus/ 〉gtsos gdam/ zhus 〈zhu 〉ba phyi ma rnam sa sde da da brdzong ba gnang / spre'u zla bar gter sgom du phebs te/ 'dus pa khri phrag tsam la rtsa gsum gyi gtor dbang sogs bstsal/ de ma/sa mcha pa gi sprul sa 318

rim/ pa/ che khangangs sdo rijang 〉nas gegs med dbus su phebs grub ste lo de'i smig/ drug zla ba'i tshes ba/cig la/ rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i nanas ma chogatu yab sras nyi zla zung (131ba)'brel gnang ste/ rang gzhan gyi bla khag soṭa mchos dam /na bar gsum thams cad kyis dga' ston leṭa 'buladapang 〈dpangs 〉ma tho ba byung / mi ring bar rdzong gsar sogs/ nas gling rin po cher pheng sa / stobs 〈skyob 〉pa 'jig rten gsum ma go / kyi snang brnyan yid bzhim/ nor bu'i drung / mchog gi sprul sku rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes/ ma tshan gsil sags mdzad/ thel gyi ga /sa gziṭa mchod 'bul mang 'gyed soṭa lo ltad las rgyas par bstsal nas/ thub bstan chosag chen po yangs ri sgar du phebs/ 'dus spyi'i brtan bzhugs me tog 'thor zhing / gar mkhan chos dbang lhun grub nas 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ de nas rjo nga — /sa ra du ya ba sra sa thabs cig 〈gcig 〉tu bzhugs/shing bya lo ri ma gas ra bye da ga' ston dang / sos gtor dus rim sogs sngar rgyu ma/ la pa ga lhas/ par stsal 〈bstsal/〉 sngon mjug gter sgom du phebs/mchog sprul rje bla mar gnas kyi lo rgyus sogs zhib par ngos spyod ma da/thel du shar nub byi mtshams grwar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa sogs chos mang du gnang / de nas lha ldan du phebs/ mchod yom/ mjal kha dang 'phrul snang gi rten rnams gnas gzigs mchod 'bul smon lam (133na)mdzad cing / rgya bod kyi che gnyan shin tu mang ba mjal mi byung ba so sor re ba bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas 'bri gung du phebs nas/ mi ring bar gzhan don du gshegs par nye ba na/ sar gyi mchod las las sde brje len gyi skabs su babs pa dang / khyad par sgar mkhan chos dbang tshun grub 'du ba ma snyo mas nas 'tsho ba'i re thag chad pa na/ gang phyir 'os babs sa sor ba / ra gnang bar/ 'ga' zhig gis dgongs pa u 329

/tshu /) /phyo /skyo /de /ga 11 zhesaṭa nan zhus dang / dga' ṭa nga 'ba' ga sa sa blangs nagra ma 'grig dus ngan gyis 〈kyi 〉snang tshul la thuṭa skyo nas gzim zug cathugs dam kho nar bzhus/sa shing / sgo lung rtse ba rdzong sogs su than bya sogs ltas mi legs pa mang du byung zhing / me khye lor rtse bar sos gtor grub 'phral sku skran dang chab gzhi'i 〈gzhis 〉bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan kyang /rje bla ma sku na phra ba'i stabs/ phyag phyi ba rnams bdud kyi 〈kyis 〉yid khebs pas le lo btang snyom/sa ngang du lus nas/ sman pa'i gsol sman 'bul ba tsam las zhabs brtan sku rim sogs cher ma grub par brten/dgung lo zhe gsum pa nag pa zla ba'i mas bcu dgu'i nyi dzos tsam la gzugs sku'i dkyil (133ba)'khor chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/ de'i tshe lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas phyag len mdzad de sku gdung rin po che zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sgo nas zhugs suphul skabs kur khang las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/kur dud kyang dri zhim zhing kha dog dkar ba rtse mo dang po shar dang mthar nub tu 'gro ba/ nam mkhar chu 'dzin mchod lha'i gzugs dang / 'ja' tshon me tog gi char sogs der yod kun (gyi )mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ rtse bar sa 'bum mchod rten dang / spro lung gdan rabs gras su gzim mal 'dra sku gser zangs las grub pa 'phral du bzhengs grub/ dgun smad chog mang ser tshogs/ phyi lo me phag lor gdung rten gser dngul la rin po che'i po'i 〈phras 〉mtshar 〈tshar 〉du mngar 〈dngar 〉ba bkra shis sgo mang bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa sku tshad sngon ma rnams las lhag pa myur bar grub ste/rje bla mas dbus gnang 'dus pa rnams kyi 〈kyis 〉rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dgongs rdzogs rnams/ sngar rgyun ltar grub bo/ dam pa 'di la slob ma'i tshoṭa grangs las 'das kyang mchog tu gyur pa chos sras 330

skya thu bo lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan sa/ sa sbrul lor nang chen du 'khrungs/ dgung (133na)lo lngar rje don grub chos rgyal drung rab tu byung / mtshan dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes gnang / rje 'gro 'dul nyid las dge tshul dang /lnga ldan chos drug yang zab soṭa 'bri gung pa'i chos thams cad dang / gong ma'i rigs dbon dpon slob kun bzang las bsnyen par rdzoṭa shing gsar rnying gi dbang chos mang po gsan/gshin rje'i gshed dang / log tri la yi dam mdzad/ rje 'gro 'dul zhabs sku tshe thung ba'i tshul bstan pas chos brgyud chad par nye ba na/ khyab bdag snyarma surya'i zhabs la/ chos phal cher 'bul bar mdzad pa dang / dge tshul dang / bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad pas 'bri bstan la sku drin lhag par du che/ shar yel spar cher rten mang du bzhengs shing / mdo khams kyi 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams smin grol la bkod nas/ dgung lo nga gnyis par nged cag chos kyi bskal pa 〈skal bas 〉'phongs pas zhi bar gshegs so/ gzhan yang grub pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dge slong ngag dbang zhes ro gcig chen po'i rtog 〈rtogs 〉pa mngon du gyur cing /'jam dbal gshin rje gshed kyis 〈kyi 〉bskur 〈skur 〉lam gyis sgyur nus pa dang / smos bral gyi de nyid mtho shing 〈zhing /〉 'khor lo sdom pa sogs lha mang po dngos su zhal (133ba)mjal ba dge slong dbang bsgyur sogs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig mchis kyang 'dir bri ba ma spobs so/sras bcas rgyal ba'i zugs rje gcig 'dus shing / /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtso rdo rje 'chang / /'gro ngor ngur sprig gar bsgyur thams cad mkhyen/ /chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gdan sa nyer bdun pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang mtshan brjod par dka' 331

ba dkom/ mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma sa/ de yang gong du smos po rgyal dbang ratna'i skabs brjod pa ltar/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen dpal de nyid la/ slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas zhes pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de nyid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur par/ sems can gyi don du sprul pa'i snang brnyan mtha' mas pa ston pa la tshad ma mchis kyang / skabs 'dir 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po 'phrin las don kun 'grub pa dpal gyi sde de nyid snyigs dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod 'dul dka' ba rnams kyi snang ngor re zhig dag pa'i zhing mchog tu gshegs pa'i tshul ston 〈bstan 〉kyang / slar yang sngon gyi thuṭa (134na)bskyed dam bca'i mthus bskul te ljongs 'dir mchog gi sprulapa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba mdzad pa rang cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i yul dang nye ba'i cha/ li kyang zhes pa nang tshan phu tshu la zhes pa'i grong du yab sa 'jangs 〈'jang 〉sa tham rgyal po'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i brgyad 〈rgyud 〉bsod nams tshe brtan dang / yum yang rgyal po de'i blon po 〈po'i 〉brgyud 〈rgyud 〉tshe ring bzang mo bya ba las/ shing phag lo'i bya'i zla ba'i bzang po gsum pa'i tshes kyi srod 'khor la sku bltams/ de'i tshe yum la rmi ltas sogs mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / phyag na padma bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang / ma hā paṇḍi ta si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed 'am 〈dam/〉 chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam gnyis kyis sgrib med lha'i spyan rnam par dag pas gzigs te/ 'bri gung dang 'jangs 〈'jang 〉sa tham sa khad 'gyangs 〈rgyang 〉stabs/ gang spyi'i 〈ci'i 〉ngos 'dzin sogs si tu rin po che nas mdzad dgos pa'i 'di nas bka' mol gnang (ba )332
