ltar/ de nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉zhabs gras bla ma bstan 'phel zhes pas/ rje gong ma'i phyag phreng sogs khyer te ngos 'dzin du phyin pas the tshom med pa phyag phreng sogs 'khrul med du bzhes (134ba)pa sogs yid ches byung thog 'di phyogs nas gdan zhus 〈zhu 〉pa 〈ba 〉bla ma chos dbang dang /dkon mchog lhun grub ngo g.yog rnams/ chu lug lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes mgor thon/ dpal spungs nas si tu'i dbon po kun khyab bcas/shing sprel zla ba gnyis par sa tham du 'byor te/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer bdun gyi nam langs tsam la chibs thog la bzhengs ste phebs pas/ thub bstan rab rgyas gling nas bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas zhag shas bzhugs/bkra shis lhun grub gleng sogs dgon khag mi sde sogs nas gdan zhus bsnyen bkur 'bul ba mtha' yas pa byung / rim gyis phebs pa'i lam dpal spungs su si tu rin po che dang lhan rgyas gnang / der 'bri gung nas gdan zhus pa 〈zhu ba 〉phyi ma rgyal sras nor bu dpon g.yog rnams dang 'dzom 〈'dzoms 〉nas/ nang chen sogs brgyud hor nang du bon lha'i khyen lta bu'i 〈bus 〉chu chen zhig la chibs rag sgal 〈rgal 〉skabs ser ba 'jigs su rung ba zhig babs te nyen shin tu che ba byung yang / rje 'di'i thugs rjes gdug can gyis glags ma rnyed/ de nas rim gyis thel sgar gyi chibs bsu sogs dang chos grwa chen po yangs ri sgar du 'dus sde rnams kyis 〈kyi 〉ser zengs/ rwa sogs 〈sog 〉thang du raX phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde/ phyogs kyi bla khag 〈135na〉gi sku tshab sogs brgya phrag du mas chibs bsu bcas/ lo de'i hor zla bcu pa 'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po'i tshes la pho brang gi rtser bkra shis khra ring gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs dang / rol mo'i bye brag du ma bcas bkur ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsar te/ dpal 'bri gung gi lugs brgya'i mdun sa pho brang chen po 333

sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug dang zhal mi gnyis pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang / nyi zla zung 'brel gdan 'dzom 〈'dzoms 〉pa na/ ljongs 'dir skye dgu mtha' dag rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i bde byed kyi dpal la spyod par gyur cing /kurma pa yab sras/ sgam 'brug sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla chen rnams dang rang gzhan mchog dman thams cad nas zhabs brtan legs 'bul shin tu rgya che ba byung / de nas yab sras lhan gcig 〈cig 〉rdzong gsar du phebs nas mi ring bar bya rgod phung po'i ri dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i gdan sa chen po byang chub kyi gleng rin po cher phebs/ gza' skar dge bar thog kha gser khang du mnyam med ra shri dang tha mi dad pa chos rje rin po che'i sku brnyan yid bzhin nor bu dang rje bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi drung gtsug phud phul/ mtshan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma zhes gsol/ gtsug (135ba)lag khang rnams la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul sogs zhib rgyas gnang / de nas bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa thub bstan chos grwa chen po yangs ri sgar gyi kun dga' ra bar phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba ser sbrengs bkod pa du mas mdun bstar/ ga tshang phyi sger tshang ma nas zhabs brtan 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ de nas rdzong gsar du bzhuṭa gdan 'jags/ shing bya lo'i sa ga zlabar bka' brgyad sgrub chen skabs rje gong ma nas/ 'dzugs dbang nas sgrub rdzas mjug dbang bcas gnang ba gsan/ gzhan yang snga phyir tshe dbang rigs gnyis/ gu ru zhi ba sogs 'ga' zhig gsan/ lo de'i dbyar smad rje yab sras gter sgom dang thel gyi gnas gzigs dang / stonamajug lha ldan du phebs/ mchod yon mjal phyag 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rnams la gnas gzigs grub nas/ mi ring bar me khye lon sos 314

gtor gyi mjug tsam nas rje gong ma sku khams bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa nabasnyun g.yog sogs sku mdun du bcar mang bzhugs/ de skabs rje nyid la mnal ltas mi legs pa mang du byung zhing / za ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa na/ rje nyid ston pa mya ngan las 'das (135na)pa'i dus dge slong kun dga' bo'i snang ba bzhin thugs khral shin tu che ba mdzad/ dgongs dzogs rnams sngar rgyun ltar grub/ lo de'i sgon zla'i tshes bcu drug gza' tshes dge bar/ gdan sa chen po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khrir rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam par rje 'di mnga'agasol/ 'di lo sku na phra stabs bka' brgyad sgrub chen gyi phyag len lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad rtsis la/ de skabs nub gcig rje'i mnal lam du/ rje bde bar gshegs pa dang mjal bar zhal snga nas sku khams ltem pa'i tshul gyis tshogs dbur 'byon mi thub pas khyed rang rdor slob gyis gsung ba zhig byung bar brten/ dbu mdzad dkon mchog tshe ring gis phyag khrid sogs phul te rje nyid nas rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag len gnang bas mchog dman kun ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur/ skabs der mnal lam du/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ bstan bsrungs 〈srung 〉ma/ rtsi dmar ba sogs gzigs/ de nas lho rin po che las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zab lam dra ro'i chos drug sogs rang lugs byu dbang chos mang du gsan/ lo de'i dgun rtse bar ser tshogs kyi mjug bsngo rje nyid nas mdzad/ me phag lo'i dbyar stod rje gong ma rnam gnyis kyis 〈kyi 〉(135ba)chos sras kyi thu bo dam pa mgar sprul chos kyi nyi ma las/ mar mi mnyam med dwags po 'gro mgon phag gru/rje skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa rin po che nas gong ma 'ga' zhig gi bka' 'bum ji yod sogs mgon po 'byu gung pa'i zab mo'i chos thams cad dang / bka'335

brgyad bde 'dus/ rdo rje phreng ba sogs/ gas/ra ting ci dngang chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ dbyar smad rje gong ma'i gdung rten grub pa ra/ phel du phebs/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab gnas sta dngos dngasprel ba rgyas pa gnang / de nas gter sgom gzim spyil du 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i tshe gzhung nas bshad pa'i mtshan ltas kyang byung / de nas rdzong gsar du mgar sprul las rgya ba'i ba / da 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung sogs mang du gsan/ snga phyir gsan sbyo ngas 〈sbyong 〉gnang ba'i tshul la rang lugs kyi 'don chos spyod rnams dang yig rigs rtsis dkar nag sogs dang / phyis slob dpon ma hā paṇḍi ta rdzogs chen pa don grub bskal bzang las mdo sngags tha snyad mtha' dag gsan pa skyes sbyangs kyi stobs kyis brda tsam gyis mkhyen rab phul du phyin/ snga gong sgar mkhan ga ga chos dbang lhun grub gshegs khar/ rtsis sgod kyi lhag ma'i dngos po rnams/ grwa tshang la spyi 'jog 'am 〈gam 〉(13 na )'du khang rgya bskyed sogs rje'i thugs la gang babs zhig sgrub zhus pa la/'du khang rgya bskyed gnang bzhed ltar/ sa glang lor 'du khang na ring brgyad che ba'i na ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod pa gsar bzhengs dang / zhoral gzim chung a phyi'i dkor mdzod sogs zhig bsos 〈gsos 〉dgos rigs bcas lo de rang la grub cing rab gnas gnang / lo snga phyi'i mnalaltas mang du byung ba rnams rnam thar du gsal/ lcags stag lor thel gser khang la char zhod kyi zhig ral che ba byung ba rnam/sa/ phyi lo zhig bsos〈gsos 〉gnang ba 'phral du grub/ thel dang gter sgom rnams su lan mang babs shing / gnas gsar rnying phal cher gnas gzigs dang phyag rjes kyang kha shas gnang 'dug grub thob bste da cu'i ga thang sogs bris sku yang 'ga' zhig dang / lcags yos lor sgo lung du bka' brgyad 33

bde 'dus kyi 'khor chen gsar bzhengs dang / de kha'i sgo nas rab gnas kyi cho ga gsar du mdzad nas gnang / chu 'brug lor sgo lung chos grwa chen mor/ gtsang gi sgrub grwa sogs mtshan grwa brje len la lnga ldan dang / dra ro'i chos drug gi khrid/ gzhan yang rang rang gi 'dod chos dbang sogs stsal 〈bstsal/〉 lo ltar gyi sgrub chen bka' brgyad grol 'phral/ nag shod 'gom (13 ba)sde dgon spyi nas spyan 'dren nan zhus byung bar/ byang phyogs su gnas pa'i skye 'gro kun byang chub kyi myu gu bskrun phyir/ lo de'i sgron zla'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin/ sku 'khor brgya lhag tsam dang bcas klung shod brgyud chibs kha bsgyur/ rwa bsang 〈zang 〉rgyal ba'i dben gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gnas gzigs dang / stag lung nas gdan zhus byung (ba )ltar phebs/ chibs thab kyi bsu ba rgyas pa dang /dgon rtser bsangs dang dar rol mo sogs bkur ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstar te/ stag lung sprul sku ngag dbar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal bzang po dang mjal phrad lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng zhib pa gnang /'bul zhabs bzang ba byung zhing / lha khang rnams la gnas gzigs mchoda'abul sogs mdzad nas phebs pa'i lam bar du/ dri za'i rgyal pos bsu ba'i tshul du char zhod che ba byung / de nas gnam mtsho'i bkra shis do bo cher gnas gzigs sogs bstsal nas rim gyis phebs pas/ 'khor tsha/ro dmar/ nag chu sogs sde so so nas gdan zhus bsnyen bkur 'bul ba mtha' mas pa byung zhing / gang la gang mtshams 〈'tsham 〉chos zang zing sogs lugs gnyis kyis tshim par gnang ste/ nag shod sde dgon spyi nas chibs bsu du ma (138na)dang bcas zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes gnyis nyin chos 'khor byams pa gling du 'dus tshogs rnams nas ser zengs rgyas337

pa bstar ste phebs/ dgon la sku skyes mang 'byed bye 'jos/ rgyas par stsal 〈bstsal/〉 sde dgon spyi mthun nas gso / ba nan gyis btab pa'i ngor/der gnas kun la smin grol chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed phyir/ skyang lugs bka' brgyad bde gsheṭa 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub chen mo sngon 'gro'i sa choganas bzung mjug rgyal tho bsdu ba'i bar gyi gong ma na rim gyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba sgos bcas shin tu rgyas pa gnang ba'i tshe phyi nang gang du yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing / der 'dus lus can mtha' dag theg pa chen po'i lam la dkri ba mdzad cing zla gcig lhag tsam nas grub/dgon gyi rten gsum rnams la rab gnas sogs bstsal/ spyi sger so so nas 'bul zhabs dpang 〈dpangs 〉mtho ba byung zhing / zla ba dgu pa'i mjug la tshur chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i lam du/ 'brong ngur ba'i bla ma phur dga' nas gdan zhus rang lugs dgon pa gsar du 'debs rtsis las yul byin gyis brlabs pa mdzad pas mi ring bar dgon gnas legs par grub 'dug cing / che 'brom/ so zug rang zhabs sbra kha bcas kyi sde so sor (138ba)gdan zhus 'bul zhabs tshad las 'das pa byung /so sor dbang chos sogs gang mos gnang zhing 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams mthong thos dran reg don ldan du ma da nas/ zla ba bcu pa'i mjug la sgo lung chos grwa chen mo dang de nas rjong gsar du phebs grub/mi ring bar za ba bcu gcig par lha ldan du phebs/ mchod yon mjal phyag sku skyes 'bul ba/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchoda'abul bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thugs bskyed gnang / che gnyan shin tu mang ba mjal mi byung ba rnams re 'dod bskang 〈bskangs 〉nas/'bri gung du phebs grub/ skabs shig grwa tshang gi mchod las khag dang rdzong gsar du dge las thams cad sha'i longs spyod cher byed srol yod stabs 338

srog gcod mang du bgyis 〈bgyi 〉dgos 'dug par/ rgyud rdo rje 'bang ba las/ snying rje yi ni sems kyis su/ /'tshe dang gnod pa spa bar bya/ /bdag nyid shi bar gyur kyang sla'i/ /srog chags gsod pa de ltar min//zhes sogs rgyud dang mdo du ma nas sha khrag gi nyes dmigs mang du gsungs pa bzhin/ rje nyid skye 'phreng du ma nas byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i stobs kyis/ dud 'gro rnams 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las skyobs 〈skyob 〉pa dang / srog gcod bgyis 〈bgyi ba 〉po dag ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bsrung 〈srung 〉ba'i ched (14 na)du tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos nye bar blangs te/ srog gcod bgyis mi chog pa'i khrims bca' ba mdzad cing de la gzhan la 'doms shing rang gis rjes su mi srung ba ni mi rig dgongs te rje nyid kyang sha'i bzhes pa spang (bar )mdzad/shing lug lor skye dgu bde skyid rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / de'i bya ba dge 'dun gyi sde dang / de yang 'dul khrims la rags 〈rag 〉las phyir/chos grwa chen po yangs ri sgar 'dir gong ma rim byon rnams nas bca' sgo mdzad par grags kyang / bar skabs bskal dus kyis cung zad bag yangs su gyur par/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ rang ngam yang ni 〈na 〉gzhan la yang / /sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang / /phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste/ /bde yang mi phan mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyes can 'ga' zhig drag shul gyi cho gas gnad la dbab pa dang / gzhan phal cher chad las bshags sbyangs grub nas/ sdom ro phul te/ bslab bskyar la nan tan du gdams pa sogs 'dul khrims la zhi drag gang mtshams 〈'tshams 〉kyi sgo nas bsdam 〈sdom 〉par mdzad pa ni/ thub pa'i bstan pa kha mdzad pa mchog tu gyur/ gangs can lha gcig 'phags pa snying rje'ilha'i snang brnyan (13 ba)thog tshad phyed gnyis lhag tsam gser dngul 339

las grub nga lo de'i stsom zla'i tsher bco lnga gza' tshes nga re par ba ca bo dbu ma ngad ngag dbang bsta sa/ 'ji ma can bcas mi/ bcas 'a 'a ma pa tshugs/ lo snga phyi nges med du bka da brgyad bde 'dus so gas yi da ri lha ri bsnyem/ spu ba 'ag ri zhig dang / phal cher drang srong dri med dge ba da 3 ga pa'i lhar mdzad cing / sku tshe'i bar bsnyem sgrub dus kun tu mdzad nga ra dngos nyams mnal lam sogs la tha dang bcu/nga gi snang ba sosas / ma na ltas bzang po mang du byung ba dang / khyad par ri bo kun 'du ga kyi bkod pa ngo ma 4 ra ba gzigs pa 〈par 〉snang / de skabs nge da cag kong tsa du skyes nas lo ngo bdun lon pa 'i tshe/ rje bla ma nyid nas/ rje gong ma'i 44nga srid yin pa 〈par 〉gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad la/mtha' drub tshul ba shi yod pa las drang don nam dgongs cam/ kyi gsung du 'dug pas// pad phreng seng ge'i nga ro'i mdo las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/ /gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltarasnams 〈snang 〉/ /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu nyid dang du ma'i brda' mdzad do/ /zhes pas sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu da ci / sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa/'i gsung yin 'du / bdag so skye pa na 〈skye 〉zhig la (140na)byang chub sems dpa' dang / dam pa gong ma rnams kyi ngo mtshad ba'i yon tan cha shas cung zad tsam yang med rung / gong gi dgongs can gyi gsus de bzhin/ re zhig gdan sa ma stongs tsam la dgongs pa yin 'dug pas/me sprel lor sgo ra mkhan zur rgyal sras kyi 〈kyis 〉dbus ser skya mang tsam nged bsu bar brdzong brda' gnang bas/ dbo zla'i nang du sku zhabs/ su 'byor/ zhal da kyi ba mjal ba'i skal bzad thob/ lo der lho sprul cho /ga kyi rgyal mtsham mdo kham sa nas byon te zang zing gi 'bul ba 340

spam mtho ba phul/ spre'u zla bar gter sgom du mi tshogs khri phrag gsum tsam la gu ru zhi ba sogs gsar ting gi dbang mang du stsal 〈bstsal/〉mgo zla ba'i nang du zugs rje chen po'i sku brnyan khri rgyab sogs bzo bkod khyad par du 'phag ga pa grub ste/ chos grwa chen po'i 'du khang du bzhugs te/ rje nyid 'dus pa dang bcas zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug bdun phrag gnyis kyi ring /rgyal po'i lus/sa kyi spyan ras gzigs/ kyi sgo nas bum sgrub gnang / me bya lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor bzang por/ mkhan po lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / slob dpon rdzogs chen don grub bskal (140ba)bzang kha bskong 〈skong 〉lnga bcu lhag bcas kyi dbus/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang dag pa bzhes ste/ 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra rags kun la nan tan du mdzad pa ni/ snyigs dus kyi gangs can 'dir 'dul 'dzin gyi mchog tu gyur/ khyi lod gter sgom du gnas gsar ma'i shel phug rnying mar tshe sgrub bcad rgya dang / rgyab bskor du tsha 'ug dpal gyi ri khrod du yang phebs/ lcagag ri byi lo ra rgya ci/ sras bstan 'dzin bzang pos chos grwa chen po'i shags 〈shag 〉bskor rgya bskyed byas par grub bstun/ g.ya' ma ri'i rje nyer brgyad pas btab pa'i sgrub sde bar skabs su stongs nas yun ring song bar/ chos grwa dang zung 'brel du sgrub grwa zhig byung na sgrub rgyud rinapo che 'di nyid kyis 〈kyi 〉ring lugs la sman par dgongs mgon khang zhig bsos 〈gso 〉dang sprags mi 'gyur bde chen gling zhes pa 'di nyid gsar 'debs gnang / 'di skabs sa skya gong ma kun dga' blo gros yab sras dbus su phebs thor the dang gter sgom du phebs/ sgo lung durje nyid dang mjal phrad dang dngo/ngas bzhed ltar tshe dpag med sgra mi snyan 341

pa'i dbang 'bul ba mdzad/ phyi lo der bzang gos du ma las u rgyanabakra shis sogs rang ga lngas bdag cag gi ston pa'i sku khri rgyab sogs rdo rje'i chos bcu gsum dang ldan pa/ mar me mdzad/ byams pa/ nyan thos (141na)mchog zung / spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal bsos 〈gso/〉 phyag dor zhi ba/ tshangs pa brgya byin bcas yod pa'i gos sku chen mo bzhengs pa gnang bar/ chu stag zla ba bzhi par grub ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab gnas dang zhal 'byed sogs gnang 'phral/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bris sku bsdus pa'i luṭa kyis 〈kyi 〉gos sku bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs pa yang zla ba gnyis kyi 〈kyis 〉grub cing za gsang gi sgo nas rab gnas gnang / gzhan yang ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs/ gdan rabs rim byon gyi rtogs brjod/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus sogs bris sku mang ba bzhengs shing / gser dngul tsan dan dkar dmar sogs las/ bde mchog lhan skyes lha lnga'i blos blangs dkyil 'khor gser dngu' rnams rang zhabs dbu mdzad tshe ring skyabs dang / tsan dan rnams rje rang gis phya ga brkos mdzad pa bzo bkod khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs pa sa yos lor grub/ de nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad/ lo der mi 'gyur bde chen gling gis 〈gi 〉bla brang dang / spyil bu kha shas gsar 'debs gnang / 'brug lor nged sogs la rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe brgyad pa'i dbang dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung / lo ltar sgrub chen bka' brgyad skabs de nyid kyi dbang chog rgyas pa rin chen (141ba)gser 'phreng sogs stsal 〈bstsal/〉 gdan sa chen mo'i rten gtso mnyam med ratna sa'i sku brnyan yid bzhin nor bu la gser zangs las grub pa bzhuṭa khri bzo khyad kun sum tshogs pa gsar bskrun mdzad pa lo der grub cing / gser ཿ

— — — — tshukhang du ga 〈ba gas 〉nas na rnams dang bcas par 'a ra sdom pa'i sgo nas rab gnas kyang gnang / sprul lor gter sgom du mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yang phug dang rang byem/ ngo mchar ba du ma gtan la phab shing 〈cing /〉 gnas gsar rnying gi lo rgyus gnas bshad gsar duganang / lug lor rin chen gnyis pa srang lnga brgya dang bdun cu lhag las sangs rgyas gnyis ba gu ru padma'i sku brnyan mi tshad las lhag pa dang /gzhu stod reb mdor yig drug 'khor chen dang / tshe gzungs/ yi brgya/ rigs gsum mgon po bcas kyi 'khor lo ster bzhi 'phrul bskor khyad du ra tshar ba bcas rnams rang zhabs kyi bzo bo rnal /sa/ kyis grub/so sor zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab gnas mdzad/ lo der rgyal ba narma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje 'bri gung du phebs par thog mar gter sgrom du mjal phrad dang / de nas rdzong du bgegs thar byed kyi dbang dang chos 'ga' zhig gsan pa mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 〈pas 〉phung po gsu ma pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sku gser zangs las grub pa dang / mi 'gyur bde chen gling du mdo las gsungs pa'i (143na)snyaca la'i bkod pa sman 'dam las grub pa sogs bzhengs/ sa sprel lo'i zla ba drug par mi tshogs khri phrag phyed gnyis tsam la gu ru zhi ba dang / rang rang gi 'dod mos kyi dbang stsal 〈bstsal/〉tshogs khang du yang rdzong mkha' 'gro gsang ba mchog grub kyi phug par bcad rgya zhag shas dang / gnas gsar ma sogs kyi gnas phal cher zhib gzigs gnang / dur khrod pha wam skyabs chen du tshogs 'khor gnang skabs bya rgod shin tu mang ba babs nas tshogs la rol zhing / der 'khod mi mang ba la 'tsher ngad med pa rje'i sku khris su sdod pa soṭa kun ya mtshan pa byung zhing rgyab bskor gyi tsha 'ug dang / gling rin po cher phebs/343

'ad skabs sal char gams gzigs sogs sngar rgyum la sa/ byub pa gamang pa sa phyis 'dir mi phebs pa'i brdar go de nas bal bod kyi sde gzar chem/po langs zhing 〈shing /〉 snga lo mi/nga 'brug lo nas sa g.yos mang du byung ba dang / nam mkha da khrag gi mdong/ su 〈tu 〉gyur pa sogs mi dge sen lta — rnam grangs mang zhing / de rjes/ lo shas bar yul gru pa la ched 'brum nag so gas nad yan/sa khyab che ba byung ba bcas la snga phyir bsta / srid bde thabs kyi spyi rim mang du mdzad/ de sngon tsam nas/ bod 'dir nad 'khrus/ sogs dus mi bde ba yong ba mkhyen cing lung bstan (141ba)tshigs bcad zhig 〈cig 〉gnang byung bar/ phyis de dag thams cad mngon du gyur/ lcags phag lor sgo lung gi mtshams grwa brje len skabs 'dus pa rnam/sa 'a zab mo lnga ldan chos drug yang zab kyi lta khrid sogs dang / nged so/gas kha shas la dbang 'ga' zhig gnang / ston gyi dus lho rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan byon par/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs dbang mang bar gsan/ de nas lo der bal bod kyi sde 'khrug skyar 〈bskyar 〉lang byung bas/ snga phyir rgya nag gi dpon dmag ltos che ba 'grim par brten dbus gtsang phal cher yo sgom che zhing / skye dgu phal cher dus dbang gi dmu rgod kyi bya byed la thugs phyung ba'i tshul gyis zhing 'di'i 'dul 〈gdul 〉bya rdzogs par nye ba na/ sa g.yos kyi rnam grangs mang zhing / mtshan mo 'ja' dkar kha shas zug pa sogs phyi nang gang du yang mtshan ltas mi legs pa mang du byung cing / snga ma lo shas gong nas zhing 'dir mi bzhuṭa pa'i gsung mang du phebs kyang / nged cag phal cher bdudakyis yid khebs pas yid dzig 〈'phaṭa 〉tsam yang ma byung / de nas chu byi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'e mjug dpon slob lho rin po cher chos dang zang zing gi tha /mang cha sngar las lhag par stsal 〈bstsal 〉nas / mdo khams su 344

brdzong ba ba/nang / zla ba gnyis/ par byu bar sos gtor gyi skabs sku 'khrug la bste / sku zor ji zhan du gyur nas/ rdzong (143na)gsar du phebs/ mas cha pa gzhi'i bsnyun babs/ byu ba byung bar/ sman pa rnams kyis gas mi ba/ dpyad dbul ba/ nged cag rnams nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs nam/ tan/ dgon khag ris med la mang bskol gyis mtshon sku'i rim gro le bar med par sgrub 〈bsgrubs 〉kyang / spyi dgos 〈sgos 〉kyi sems can bso da nams dman cing 'dus byas la rtag par 'dzin pa rnamar she chos 'a / bskul phyir/ sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po'i tshes kyi tho rangs/ khar gzugs du 'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i gnas su / bsdu ba'i tshul bstan par spyi dang bdag dmus long thang la khyacanas pa lta bu'i mya ngarwa gyi khang bur chud cing / ci bya btol 〈gtol 〉ched 'u gyur kyang / 'dus byas kyi chos la bya thabs med par go zhing /byu tha/dung rin po cher ma cho da 'bul khrus gsol sogs dang / gar thel sa /gas mas dge 'dun byed nyis brgyar nye bas zhe dgu'i gdung chog rten gsu pa rnams la ma cho ) 'bul/ rgyal ba kerma pa'i 〈pas 〉dbus gangs ljongs kyi byes che na rnam sa la 'bul ba/ dbus gtsang gi dgon khag ris med la mang bas/la/ rang 'a/bas kyi mi sde la 'gyed chen soṭa sngar rgyun ltar grub/ zla ba de kha'i nyer bdun nyin nged kyis rdo rje slob dpon bgyis ste 'dus pa ba'i bcu sko ra gyi (143ba)zhi khro riṭa bsdus kyi sgo nas sku gdungayid bzhin nor bu zhugs su phul bar/ nged dadul 〈gdul 〉bya rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar pur dud kyis yu na ring g.yoṭa pa/ nam mkha' phal cher 'ja' tshon gyis gang ba dang / bkra mis rta ri ga brgyad kyi rnam pa shin tu gas ba/ bya rgod mang ba ru ra dud 'a/ ba sko ba sogs mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / phu gu gdong du sa 'bum byang chub mchod rten 3 5

thog tshad gsum zin nges pa zhe dgu'i khongs su grub/ gser zangs lasagazim mal sku brnyan sku tshad che nges bzhengs te/ chos grwa chen po'i 'du khang du bzhugs shing so sor rab tu gnas pa bgyis/ zla ba bcu par rtse bar chog mang ser tshoṭa dang / phyi lo chu glang lor gser dngul las gdungarten lha babs shin tu dngos gtsang ba grub cing gdan sa chen mo'i khang gsar 'og min du bzhugs te zhi khro'i sgo nas rab gnas dang / gangs ri ti ser gser 'bum bzheng ba sogs dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rnams sngar srol las mi dman pa nges par grub po 〈bo/〉zhal slob ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bgrang bar mi nus kyang /mchog tu gyur pa rnams ni da lta yang kun gyi shes par nus la/ chos srid kyi gnyer kha ni nyams chung kho bo cag la 'bog par mdzad mod kyang /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba dben cing / chos (144na)brgyad skor 〈dkor 〉gyi 〈rgyas 〉sbag 〈sbags 〉pa zhig mchog dman kun gyis khrel ba'i gnas su gyur cing / skyes bu'i yon tan cha tsam med kyang lasadabang gis rje bla ma'i gdan sa ma stongs tsam zhig la dgongs pa yin 'dra bas/ rang gi gnas tshul cung zad brjod na/ kong yul gyi char mnga' bdag byung gi rgyud pa yin khul du grags pa'i sngags rigs shig las lcags stag lor skyes/ lo bdun lon nas 'bri gung du slebs/rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi nyi ma dang mjal bas skal bas nga thob la du chos rje rin po che'i drung dge bsnyen mnos/ ming dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes gnang / 'bri gung pa'i chos phal cher dang / bde 'dus sogs gsar rnying gi chos mang ba thob lo bco lnga'i steng dge tshul mnos/ ming bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigasamed 'phrin las phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gnang /346

/ bye / / rdo la par kyi cho shā lasri /tsha / zlo // rdo /pa/ shā / //sa ma/ // bo'ur phog pa bzhin las ma 'das kyang re zhig ming btags tsam las rje bla ma nyid nas khur bzhes gnang / lo nyer gsum par rje bla mas mkhan po dang / lho rin po che 〈ches 〉las slob mdzad nas kha bskong 〈skong 〉grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs shing mi ring bar rje bla ma (144ba)sprul pa bsdu ba'i tshul ston ba ma da pas mya ngan gyi sa bar tshudacing chos srid kyi khur 'di theg dka' ba byung kyang 〈yang /〉 da lta'i bar sagon po 'bri gang pa'i bstan par sman pa'i bsam sbyor mi dman khul du 'dinas se /de ltar rgyal bstan kun gsal yangs pa'i dbus/ /nyin mo'i zlogang/ //shā /rdornyi dro shākya /shā rgyusar la /di/ra ba// nam nor/'i lo //dri rdo rdo/ rang nyid shes byar blo rmongs pas/ /yin rloms la sogs nongs pa'i dri ma'i tshogs/ ci mchis las nyon shes sgrib chab 〈chabs 〉cig par//brgyud/spya / /rdo /rdo pabyed lda/na spyan/ / shā shā //sa ba/rtsegs lta// ngad rshaX 'i/ge ma / yis/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa gling bzhi ru/ /rta ljang na bun bral bzhin yun gnas shog /khyad par sgrub brgyud ri gling chu gter cher//sbya sa/ /rdo pa pa /mgo// mapo sa bami byed /rdo/na brji/rdo nga // pa shā sna /rgya/ /dro de'i man ngag sdom gsum gnad gcig pa/ /nges don phyag rgya che dang rdo rje'i theg /bla med nying khu'i zag 〈byuṭa 〉ma rtag 'bebs pas//rin chen 'byung gnas yongs su bsams 〈gtams 〉par shog /de 'dzin (145na)skyes bu sa zla'i phreng ba dag /lha lam khyon du na 347

mkha'i nor bu dang / /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan ji bzhin rtag 'char ba// sku tshe mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag gong 'phel shog /rjes 'brang dge 'duna'adus sde rgyu skar ltar/ /yongs gang sdom pa phra rag kun bsrungs shing / /rig lam bcu soṭa thos bsam sgom la brtson/ /chos spyod bcu yi 'dabastong bzhad par shog /'jig rten khams 'dir nad shātshon dbula'aphongs sogs/ /rgud pa zhi zhing longs spyod bde skyid tshogs/ /rab rgyas rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa dang / /kun kyang bag yod chos la 'jug par shog /bdag kyang phyag rgya chen po'i bskyed rim kyis (gyis〉//gnad la dbang thob rnal 'byor bzhi rdzogs shing / /thabs lam ba / lta rdzogs rim zab mo yis/ /sa bcu lam lnga skad cig bsgod 〈bgod 〉sa shog /ma gyur nam mkha'i ma 'a mas 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngalargya mtshor gru bo ches/ /yongs grol 〈sgrol 〉bde ldan sa la rab bkod 〈'god 〉pa'i/ /ded dpon chen por bdag nyid yongs gyur cig /de ltar mnyam med mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdan rabs rim byon chos kyi 'byung tshul gser gyi 'phreng ba zhes pa 'di yang rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i chos (145ba)kyi rje dbang rin po che yan gyi lo rgyus dang / rgyal dbang dkon mchog rin chen gyis mdzad pa rin chen phreng ba/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i padma'i phreng ba/ sde don grub chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa gdan rabs shel dkar phreng ba/dpa' bo'i chos 'byung gi gras 'bri gung gi lo rgyus sogs phal cher mdor bsdus tsam las sngon chad rgyas pa zhig mi 'dug par brten/ rje gong ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar/ deb gter gsar rnying / chos 'byung gong smos lnga sogs go bsnan/ sku bltams lo dang gdan sar phebs lo sogs mi mthun pa 'ga' 'dug par/ mgos lo tsā'i deb gter dang /348

chos kyi grags pas 〈pa'i 〉padma'i zeng ba sogs la zhib tu dpyad nas —lo rgyus gzhan dag nas kyang kha bskang 〈bskangs 〉te cung zad rgyas par // dasnga pa phyi di sna ga/nyer bye/ /dro /shā dro pa /nāX sa/ spya/na 〉(bye 'chang chos kyi nyi ma'i slob ma tha shal/ dpal 'bri gung pa'i gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa'am rje 'jig rten gsum mgon nas nyer dgu pa'i thog tu gnas pa bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med bye phyi bye / bye rdo byebye /bye/ bye bye ༷ pa rdo pa kyi /shā/ ༷ /rdo/ ༷༷ bye sbyardo/ po gzhu smad sgo lung yangs ri sgar gyi kun dga' ra ba'i re'u mig lhun grub dga' 'khyil du sbyar ba'i/ slar chu phag lor zhus dag nan tan bgyis te yi ge pa ni e rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi rigs las rdo rje tshe bye rjo spya /kau she/༷ byeX bye ///ra// zhi/nga pa/ zi pa —— / 'i rdordon pardo ri na /shā/ rte //bye ༷ ༷ sdu bye/ bye // bye bye ༷ bye rdong/ 〉sduX byebye/1 ra ba bye ༷/ /smyo gye / stso/ bye/bye byebye/ ༷/ / / ༷ bye snye/bye 349

'ji gung gdan rabs gser zer rtsom pa po/ 'bri gung bstan 'dzin pad ma'i rgyal mtshan/gtso 'gan dpe sgrig pa/ chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs/gtso 'gan dpe sgrig pa gzhon pa/ ma grong mi 'gyur rdo rje/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ chab spel ma brtan phun tshogs/dpar zhus pa/ bye srang / bu byung dbang 'dus/ 〉 〈 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/bod ljongs shin hwa par 'debs bzo gas dpar/bod ljongs shin hwa dpe tshong khang gis bkram/1989lo'i zla 7par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1989lo'i zla 7par par thengs dang po btab/deb grangs 1—2 50013257—80589—000—575 1(mi ga )(bod 1)rin gong sgor/ 2 50
